However, he didn't waste much time. Stretching out a bird leg, he nudged the mouse. *Woah, his record isn't half bad!*

Bai Linlin got completely absorbed. He quickly launched a match, figuring Song Yu always slept for ages after taking his meds anyway.

*Worst case scenario, I'll just fly away instantly.*

The bird began his intense, thrilling gaming session.

*Ahem.*

The bird turned back every now and then to glance at the bed, feeling like he was committing an illicit affair. The stress bars on his feathers darkened just a little bit more.

Unfortunately, the tides of war were against him. Bai Linlin suffered defeat after defeat, but unwilling to accept loss, he jumped into yet another match—only to lose again.

The bird was furious, reasonably suspecting that Song Yu had already exhausted all the account's winning luck.

Right at that moment, Bai Linlin's wing caught on the headphone cable, accidentally unplugging it. The match's background audio burst out loud.

But he was already seeing red.

Completely failing to notice the rustle of the blanket being pulled back behind him, he just kept squawking his heart out:

"Chirp chirp chirp! Stupid teammate, stop going AFK!"

"Chirp chirp! Die already! I'm gonna blast you to pieces with my cannon!"

"Fuck!"

Song Yu sat up straight in bed, his bedhead sticking up messy and wild, his face still dazed and bewildered.

In the end, Bai Linlin had to watch helplessly as their Nexus was destroyed. Utterly enraged, he kicked the mouse with his claw and turned around, hopping and bouncing—

"..."

"..."

Author's Note:

[Pigeon]: Human, can you pretend you didn't see that?

PS: Regarding parrots sticking paper strips into their tail feathers—I looked it up, and it mostly happens with lovebirds (Agapornis), both males and females. Linlin just found it too tiring to hold in his beak, so he stuffed it into his tail. No need to overthink it!

chunks.chineseText:
第8章

人遇到无法解释的事情，一般会开始自我洗脑，强行合理化。

宋郁坐在床边，刚睡醒，眼梢的红痣在阳光下若隐若现的，他抬手捂了捂脸，有发丝穿过指缝。

时间一点一滴地流逝。

鸟站在键盘那里，爪子都歪歪的，也不敢动。

“你是鹦鹉，会说话很正常。”

宋郁把手放下，眼皮垂着，还有些刚睡醒的昏沉感，喃喃自语道。

白粼粼这才松了口气。

但下一秒——

“可鹦鹉还会打游戏的么？”

房间内一片死寂。

白粼粼鸟眼一闭，心里无比希望他是报时钟上的发条鸟，转两圈就可以回去，而不是面临这么社死的场面。

时间流速变得很慢。

他看到宋郁从床上起来，走了过来，一边茫然地盯着他，一边抬手拿了药吞了下去。

大约过了一分钟。

宋郁又拉开了椅子，很恍惚，但还是抬手摸了下主机和显示屏的温度，沉默了。

可人还是不死心。

去查了历史战绩。

宋郁看着一排排的[失败]愣了一会，手指按压着鼠标，一点点往前翻，他看到了一些奇怪的时间点。

上午九点到十一点，下午两点到四点。

周一至周五。

“……”

宋郁身子往后一靠，那些消沉负面的情绪完全散掉了，阳光下的脸显得轮廓分明，眼窝处形成一道阴影。

他刚一转头。

圆嘟嘟的“发条鸟”此刻却“活”了，身子一下压就要起飞，但就在奔向自由的时刻——

宋郁伸手握住了鸟。

白粼粼甚至在半空中被握住的，他整个鸟都不好了，为什么，为什么！

刚飞，他刚飞。

怎么就能这么准确地截胡！

但就在这时，耳边传来一句：

“我们去看医生。”

鸟安静了。

-

宋郁脑子都是嗡嗡的，但还是带着鸟出门了，本来是打算用鸟包的，但它看起来不喜欢。

只能戴了脚环。

于是一人一鸟上了出租车，去了南市最大的异宠医院。

但是刚到问诊台。

“噢……”对面的男医生微微点了下头，故作表示理解，然后似乎是脸部不适，侧了下脸，最后用手挡住了下巴，似乎在控制什么。

宋郁面无表情：“我说的是真的。”

“没有没有，我们很专业的。”

男医生咳嗽了几声，叫来了自己的同事，那人一开始觉得莫名其妙的，刚要准备问诊就被按住了胳膊——

“是这样的，这位家长，说他的鸟会打游戏，想来看看是怎么回事。”

“……”

同事眉梢一抬，脸上尽管没有什么大表情，但抿了抿唇，视线往地板、饮水机、消毒表上都扫了一边，像是在做什么缓冲，而后才抬眼看向宋郁，很专业地询问：

“是鸟，噢，就是你肩头这只。”

“打游戏了？”

宋郁：“……”

“我们没有不信，但你要说说具体的情况。”

第一位男医生环着胳膊补充道，神态很是认真，甚至还蹙了蹙眉头，以表严肃。

宋郁放下了点戒心，只是解释道，“是今天下午的事，我睡着了，后面觉得很吵……”

“然后发现我的鸟在和队友输出，还摔了鼠标，我当时……”

话说到一半，大厅里响起来绷不住的笑声，那两个医生中途试着忍过，还道了歉，但还是笑得直不起腰。

宋郁：“……”

白粼粼站在人的肩头松了口气，对对对，没有人会相信鸟会打游戏的，他还是安全的。

但就在这时，医院二楼下来个托着一只金丝熊的年轻人，对方戴着口罩，但说话的声音却很熟悉。

“皮皮家属？别睡着了，你家孩子骨折好了。”

“领走领走。”

一位白发苍苍的老奶奶从睡梦中醒过来，脸颊上还有泪痕，托着一只肥肥的鼠就走了，很是心疼地道：“皮皮受苦了。”

那年轻人送走病人后就往导诊台这里看了一眼，见到宋郁明显是眼睛亮了下，顺带也对那两个没正形的同事摆了摆手，示意边去儿。

“小宋，好久不见？”

宋郁一开始还没有认出来，直到对方摘了口罩，他才发现这人就是上次齐思扬带过来的那名师弟，他们还在微信上聊过几句。

“没想到还能再见面，上次没介绍自己。”

“我叫黎笙。”

对方伸过来了手，宋郁自然握了握，就是肩头的鸟一个大后撤，甚至直接飞起来了。

宋郁的腕骨上有一个红绳，尽头就是白粼粼的脚环，眼下被扯得皮肤有点泛红。

“这么怕我？”黎笙抬眼看了过来，眉眼之间全是稀奇，这小鸟算是他见过最有自己性格的了。

有趣有趣。

白粼粼非常不喜欢这个师弟，因为对方老是能精准猜中自己在想什么，实在是很可怕。

不过在半空中飞了一会，也没办法，宋郁在看他，那道红绳在磨人的皮肤。

“。”

蓝羽小鸟又飞了回来，宋郁侧眸看了看，似乎是确定没有特别不高兴，才同身边的人开始交谈了起来。

黎笙并不是研究生，他是本科生，只是参加过齐思扬的课题组而已，今年大四了，目前在这家异宠医院实习。

“不过这是我舅舅的医院，所以我算是关系户，拿了执业资格证就来打白工了。”

青年对此很是坦诚，还耸了耸肩，解释完之后就弯腰看向了宋郁肩头的小鸟。

蓝羽和尚，站得板板正正的，从头到尾都是歪着鸟头，不给正脸看的那种。

很拽了。

宋郁侧眸看到后愣了下，替鸟解释道：“它最近不高兴。”

“哈哈哈哈……”

黎笙直起身子来，双手插着兜，觉得有趣，“它这么记仇啊？我记得我上次也就说了句'小鸡'？”

“欸，这是爱称知道不知道？”

白粼粼闻言转了转头，心想怎么可能，谁要当小鸡，他是会飞的！才不是走地鸡。

高贵冷艳。

黎笙看了好一会鸟，从观察来看其实挺健康的，也很有活力，嗯，还胖了点。

那为什么来医院？

“怎么了？它最近是挑食还是有别的问题？就是有点压力纹，但这个很好解决的。”

黎笙正色问了问面前的人。

宋郁没有想到对方观察这么仔细，于是想了想，还是把中午的事说了。

“……”

黎笙大概知道他同事为什么会这样了，犹豫了下，还是一字一句道：

“呃，宋郁，正常情况下，鸟是不会打游戏的。”

他说完就觉得自己脑子抽抽了，还想象了下家里那几只鹦鹉洗衣做饭的样子，感觉整个人都掉熵了。

只能是AI出来的产物。

宋郁其实到这里已经没有要咨询的意思了，他只是侧眸看了下鸟，白粼粼一不留神同人对视了，匆匆偏开头，有些心虚。

“那说话是正常的吧？”

黎笙听到这话还怔了下，简直有些哭笑不得，“当然，它是鹦鹉的，学舌能力很强大的。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 8

When people encounter something completely unexplainable, they usually begin brainwashing themselves, forcing a rationalization.

Song Yu sat at the edge of the bed, having just woken up. The red mole at the corner of his eye flickered faintly in the sunlight. He raised a hand to cover his face, his fingers threading through his messy hair.

Time trickled by, second by second.

Standing near the keyboard, the bird’s claws went crooked with tension. It didn’t dare move a muscle.

"You're a parrot. It's normal for you to talk."

Song Yu lowered his hand. His eyelids drooped with the lingering grogginess of sleep as he muttered softly to himself.

Bai Linlin finally breathed a sigh of relief.

But the very next second—

"But do parrots play video games?"

A deadly silence descended upon the room.

Bai Linlin squeezed his avian eyes shut. He desperately wished he were a clockwork bird on a chiming clock, able to spin twice and retreat inside, rather than face such an utterly social-death-inducing scene.

Time seemed to slow to a crawl.

He watched as Song Yu got out of bed and walked over. The youth stared at him with a dazed expression while reaching out to swallow a pill.

About a minute passed.

Song Yu pulled out his chair, looking thoroughly bewildered. Yet, he still raised a hand to touch the temperature of the computer tower and the monitor. Then he fell silent.

Still unwilling to give up, he opened the match history to check.

Song Yu stared at the long row of [DEFEAT] tags for a moment. His finger clicked the mouse, scrolling backward bit by bit. He noticed several strange time slots.

9:00 AM to 11:00 AM. 2:00 PM to 4:00 PM.

Monday to Friday.

"..."

Song Yu leaned back against his chair, his gloomy, negative emotions entirely dissipating. In the sunlight, the sharp contours of his face cast deep shadows over his eye sockets.

The moment he turned his head—

The chubby little "clockwork bird" suddenly "came alive." Squatting down, it prepared for liftoff, but right at the moment it launched itself toward freedom—

Song Yu reached out and scooped the bird up.

Bai Linlin was snatched right out of midair. His entire bird soul was traumatized. Why? *Why?!*

He had just taken off! He had *just* started flying!

How could he be intercepted with such terrifying precision?!

Just then, a voice sounded beside his ear:

"We're going to see a doctor."

The bird went dead quiet.

-

Song Yu’s mind was buzzing, but he still took the bird out. Originally, he had planned to use a bird carrier bag, but the little creature clearly disliked it.

In the end, he could only put on its foot ring.

Thus, one person and one bird got into a taxi and headed to the largest exotic pet hospital in Nanshi.

However, as soon as they reached the triage desk—

"Ah..." The male doctor opposite them gave a slight nod, feigning understanding. Then, as if experiencing facial discomfort, he turned his face away, covering his chin with his hand to suppress something.

Song Yu remained expressionless. "I'm telling the truth."

"No, no, we're very professional."

The male doctor cleared his throat with a few coughs and called over his colleague. The colleague looked utterly baffled at first, but just as he was about to begin the consultation, his arm was grabbed.

"Here's the situation. This pet owner says his bird can play video games and wants us to check what's going on."

"..."

The colleague raised an eyebrow. Although there wasn't much of a reaction on his face, he pressed his lips together and let his gaze wander over the floor, the water dispenser, and the disinfection chart—as if taking a moment to process the absurdity. Only then did he look up at Song Yu, asking in a very professional tone:

"It's a bird... ah, the one on your shoulder."

"It played video games?"

Song Yu: "..."

"We don't disbelieve you, but you need to describe the specifics."

The first male doctor crossed his arms and added, his posture solemn. He even knitted his brows to show how serious he was taking this.

Song Yu let down his guard a little and explained, "It happened this afternoon. I fell asleep, and later I felt it was very noisy..."

"Then I found my bird flaming my teammates, and it even slammed the mouse. At the time, I..."

Halfway through his sentence, a burst of uncontrollable laughter erupted in the hall. The two doctors had tried their best to hold it in and even apologized mid-way, but they still ended up bent double, clutching their stomachs.

Song Yu: "..."

Standing on his shoulder, Bai Linlin breathed a sigh of relief. *Yes, exactly! No one would ever believe a bird can play video games! I'm still safe!*

Just at that moment, a young man carrying a Syrian hamster came down from the second floor. He wore a mask, but his voice sounded extremely familiar.

"Pipi's family? Don't fall asleep, your baby's fracture is fixed."

"Come take him away."

A white-haired old grandmother woke up from her nap, tears still staining her cheeks. Holding the plump rodent, she walked away, saying with deep heartache, "My poor Pipi has suffered so much."

After seeing off the patient, the young man glanced over at the triage desk. When he saw Song Yu, his eyes visibly lit up. He waved a hand at his two undisciplined colleagues, gesturing for them to buzz off.

"Little Song, long time no see!"

Song Yu didn't recognize him at first. It wasn't until the guy pulled down his mask that he realized this was the junior fellow student whom Qi Siyang had brought over last time—they had even exchanged a few messages on WeChat.

"I didn't expect to run into you again. I didn't introduce myself properly last time."

"My name is Li Sheng."

The guy extended his hand, and Song Yu naturally shook it. However, the bird on his shoulder made a massive retreat, directly taking off into the air.

Song Yu had a red cord tied around his wrist, which connected to Bai Linlin's foot ring. As the cord stretched tight, the skin on his wrist turned slightly red.

"That scared of me?" Li Sheng looked up, his eyes full of curiosity. This little bird was the most personality-driven creature he had ever encountered.

*Fascinating, truly fascinating.*

Bai Linlin strongly disliked this junior fellow student because the guy could always accurately guess what he was thinking, which was utterly terrifying.

However, after hovering in midair for a moment, he had no choice. Song Yu was looking at him, and that red cord was chafing the youth's skin.

"..."

The blue-feathered little bird flew back down. Song Yu turned his head to glance at it, seemingly confirming that it wasn't overly upset, before turning back to talk with the guy beside him.

Li Sheng wasn't a graduate student; he was an undergraduate. He had merely participated in Qi Siyang's research group. He was a senior this year and was currently interning at this exotic pet hospital.

"Though this hospital belongs to my uncle, so I'm technically connected through family. Once I got my license, I came here to do free labor."

The young man was remarkably candid, giving a casual shrug. After explaining, he bent down to look closely at the little bird on Song Yu's shoulder.

The Blue Quaker Parakeet stood straight and proper, keeping its head tilted away the entire time, refusing to give him a full view of its face.

Quite arrogant.

Song Yu froze slightly when he saw this and helped explain on the bird's behalf, "He's been in a bad mood lately."

"Hahaha..."

Li Sheng straightened up and shoved his hands into his pockets, finding it amusing. "It holds a grudge that badly? I recall I only called it a 'little chick' last time, right?"

"Hey, that's a term of endearment, you know?"

Hearing this, Bai Linlin turned his head, thinking: *How could that be?! Who wants to be a chick? I can fly! I'm definitely not some ground-bound chicken.*

*Noble and cold.*

Li Sheng observed the bird for quite a while. From an observational standpoint, it was actually very healthy and full of energy. Mm, it had even gained a little weight.

So why bring it to the hospital?

"What's wrong? Has it been a picky eater lately, or are there other issues? It does have a few stress bars, but that's very easy to manage."

Li Sheng asked the person in front of him with a serious expression.

Song Yu hadn't expected the other party to observe so meticulously. After thinking it over, he decided to explain what happened at noon.

"..."

Li Sheng roughly understood why his colleagues had reacted that way earlier. After a moment's hesitation, he articulated every word carefully:

"Uh... Song Yu. Under normal circumstances, birds don't play video games."

The moment he said it, he felt like his own brain had misfired. He even pictured the parrots at his home doing laundry and cooking, feeling as though his sanity was dropping fast.

It could only be a product of AI.

At this point, Song Yu no longer intended to consult further. He merely glanced sideways at the bird. Caught off guard, Bai Linlin made eye contact with him and hurriedly averted his gaze, feeling somewhat guilty.

"Then... is talking normal?"

Li Sheng was stunned for a second, completely amused and at a loss for words. "Of course! It's a parrot, after all. Its mimicry skills are extremely powerful."

chunks.chineseText:
宋郁当然知道自己问了个什么问题，不过他确实思维很乱，最后还是黎笙说了句“要不要体检”才回了下神。

没有人会相信这么离奇的事。

他幻觉了？

不可能。

白粼粼被带入了一个无菌房间，又是被掰喙，又是被捏翅根的，气得一顿叨叨叨。

但都咬到了空气。

一个护士姐姐摇了摇头，对旁边的同事道：“备注一下。”

宋郁还没有给鸟起名，所以宠物医院全看自己感觉来，电脑excel表上赫然写着：

姓名：暴躁小鸡（蓝和尚）

年龄：6个月。

性格：小凶。

补：老虎钳等级1，总咬空气哈哈。

白粼粼压根没看到，鸟脖子都酸了，扭来扭去被放到宋郁手上了。

黎笙在旁边说了说情况：“它挺健康的，心肺功能都没问题，喙部、眼睛也都很好……”

说到一半青年弯了弯腰，凑过去道，“我一开始还以为它超重了，结果原来是羽毛蓬松的事儿。”

黎笙说到这里，又蹙眉道：“就是压力纹有一点重。”

“它在家都玩什么？”

宋郁闻言突然想起来电脑的页面，连败，甚至好几天都是连败。

“……就到处飞一飞。”

黎笙托腮建议道：“你多观察观察吧，我猜你肯定不会缺了它的玩具的，但鹦鹉还是比较喜欢互动。”

“如果你学业太忙的话，不如买个母鸟，这样它们可以凑一对，然后卿卿我我生……”

话还没说完，医院里就传来一阵阵鸟叫声。

“啾啾啾！啾啾啾啾！”

[**********]

黎笙觉得骂的估计挺脏的。

往后撤退一小步。

鸟都扑棱起来了，张着短喙也没叨到人，气得羽毛都蓬松了。

黎笙抬了抬眉：“嚯，是单身贵族，那你的小鸟占有欲还挺高的。”

“它只喜欢你了。”

宋郁愣了下。

白粼粼心如死灰，也不叫了，直接开始叨宋郁的衣服，一个劲地往门口扯。

回家回家！

这是什么品种的人？

黎笙插兜评价：“好粘人。”

白粼粼直接绷不住了，扑棱翅膀都乱了节奏，直接开始坠机。

也就在快要掉地上的时候。

一个手稳稳地托住了。

白粼粼气得胸脯都微微鼓了鼓，但躺在人掌心又懒得动了，反正掉不下去。

宋郁总是会接住的。

黎笙抬眼看了看，发现那脾气大的小鸟此刻安安静静的，像是消停了，翻滚了下身体，把鸟头插在宋郁的食指和无名指之间了。

宛若自闭。

“哈哈哈哈哈。”

“它好爱你。”

又补一句，白粼粼崩溃了。

Song Yu naturally knew what kind of silly question he had asked, but his mind was indeed in total disarray. It wasn't until Li Sheng offered, "Do you want to get it a checkup?" that he snapped back to his senses.

No one would ever believe such an absurd thing.

Was he hallucinating?

Impossible.

Bai Linlin was brought into a sterile room. He had his beak pried open and his wing joints squeezed, rendering him so furious that he pecked wildly into the air, chatter-chatter-chattering nonstop.

Yet every bite caught nothing but air.

A nurse shook her head and said to her colleague beside her, "Add a note."

Since Song Yu hadn't named the bird yet, the pet hospital named it based on their own impressions. Written boldly on the computer's Excel sheet was:

Name: Feisty Little Chick (Blue Quaker)  
Age: 6 months  
Temperament: Slightly aggressive  
Note: Pliers Level 1, keeps biting thin air, haha.

Bai Linlin didn't see any of this at all. His bird neck was sore from twisting around, and finally, he was placed back onto Song Yu's hand.

Beside them, Li Sheng summarized the findings: "He's very healthy. His heart and lung functions are fine, and his beak and eyes are in great shape..."

Midway through, the young man bent over and leaned close, saying, "I thought he was overweight at first, but turns out his feathers were just fluffed up."

Li Sheng knitted his brows again and added, "It's just that the stress bars are a bit heavy."

"What does he usually play with at home?"

Hearing this, Song Yu suddenly recalled his computer screen—the long loss streak, even days of consecutive defeats.

"...He just flies around."

Resting his chin on his hand, Li Sheng suggested, "You should observe him more. I bet you don't lack toys for him, but parrots prefer interaction."

"If you're too busy with your studies, why not buy a female bird? That way they can pair up and make out, maybe even lay..."

Before he could finish his sentence, loud bird squawks echoed through the hospital.

"Chirp chirp chirp! Chirp chirp chirp chirp!"

[**********!]

Li Sheng figured the bird was cursing pretty colorfully.

He took a small step backward.

The bird was fluttering wildly, its short beak snapping through the air without landing a blow on anyone, its feathers puffed out in absolute fury.

Li Sheng raised his eyebrows. "Whoa, an aristocratic bachelor! Turns out your little bird is quite possessive."

"He only likes you."

Song Yu froze for a moment.

Bai Linlin's heart turned to ash. He stopped squawking and immediately began tugging at Song Yu's clothes with his beak, desperately pulling toward the exit.

*Go home! Go home!*

*What kind of person is this guy?!*

Hands in his pockets, Li Sheng evaluated, "So clingy."

Bai Linlin completely broke down. His fluttering wings lost all rhythm, and he went into a direct tailspin toward the floor.

Just before he hit the ground—

A steady hand caught him safely.

Bai Linlin was so mad his little chest puffed up slightly, but lying in the palm of Song Yu's hand, he was too lazy to move. Anyway, he wouldn't fall.

Song Yu would always catch him.

Li Sheng looked up and saw that the hot-tempered little bird was now completely quiet, as if it had calmed down. It rolled its body over and stuffed its head right between Song Yu's index and ring fingers.

It was the picture of self-imposed isolation.

"Hahahahaha!"

"He loves you so much."

With that extra line, Bai Linlin suffered a total mental collapse.

***

**Author's Note:**  
PS: Homage to the scene from *The Mermaid*—labeling it here!

chunks.chineseText:
第9章

这个世界上总是会有些脑电波奇怪的人，善于脑补，有自己的思维逻辑和完备的防御系统。

白粼粼最后实在没辙了，站在宋郁肩头一声不吭的，甚至鸟眼都闭上了。

“以后也可以带过来让我看看，打八折。”黎笙送了送人，笑眯眯的，“你是不是高三啊？”

宋郁面色冷白，闻言还愣了下，不过还是回答了，“是。”

“南市一高很好的学校，你上top没问题的！”黎笙靠在医院的门框上，对人这么鼓舞道。

毕竟他已经是个无趣的大人了，见到亲戚家上学的孩子，开口就是“好好学习”，真是成为自己讨厌的人了。

黎笙对此也挺没招的，不过他看宋郁点了点头，觉得看起来很有礼貌一孩子。

抑郁症？

青年蹙了蹙眉，看着那个远去的影子，发觉对方是打车过来的，还有些意外。

住得可是锦园，没有家里的司机吗？

-

白粼粼上了车就有点尴尬，他被那个叫黎笙的一顿造谣，还没反应过来，就已经被扣上一堆帽子了。

什么情啊爱啊。

[6]

白粼粼心说他母胎单身这么多年，从来就没有这方面的经验，一生清清白白，怎么做了鸟之后，人设变深情、占有欲高、分离焦虑了？

那人还穿着白大褂，胡言乱语，关键更糟糕的是——

“你不是会说话吗？”

宋郁侧眸看向肩头道，少年的面庞是很俊秀的，眼皮垂着，那颗红痣在额发的阴影下藏着，倒是像消失了。

白粼粼总觉得这孩子信了。

“……”

[我不会我不会。]

宋郁说完这句话，就这么一直看着，垂着的手指蜷了下，无名指上缠着那根红线。

尽头是小鸟的脚环。

白粼粼被盯得实在受不了了，于是开了口，是很敷衍的那种。

“啾啾。”

宋郁似乎是眉眼温和了下，他转回了头，没有再接着说话，只是又不自觉地缠了缠自己手上的线。

勒紧了。

白粼粼完全没有注意到这个微小的举动，他只是觉得这茬算是过去了，有些晕车，微微闭上了鸟眼。

爪子传来一点轻微的牵扯感。

鸟挪了下。

是靠近人的方向。

又传来一点牵扯感。

鸟只好又挪了下。

又又——

白粼粼生气了，圆滚滚的脑袋刚一仰起来，宋郁的脸就逼近了。

车子已经停了，前面的司机还问了句，“是停这是吧？”

宋郁视线没有移动，只是抬手伸了过来，同时回应道：

“是。”

白粼粼其实是呆了一会的，因为鸟的视角是不太一样的，非常宽广，像是全景。

但即使是这样，宋郁的脸还是无可指摘，下巴的弧度都是刚刚好的，不是过分瘦削的，也没有任何青春痘。

纯粹男高。

白粼粼毕竟是个社畜，见到的都是和自己一样顶着黑眼圈的同事，实在很难见到这么……

小奶狗。

鸟又这么思考道。

不过时间来不及了。

宋郁等了一会，发觉小鸟没有要踩他手指的意思，只好拉开车门，转而把另一只手盖在鸟的头顶。

防磕。

白粼粼仰头看着那个手，不知道是不是脑抽了，还顶了下，结果感觉被微微往下压了。

瞬间不爽。

又用力往上拱。

但就在这时，宋郁的手突然往上一抬，白粼粼恰好保持着昂扬抬头的姿势。

“啾？”

手又盖住了。

鸟这次被压住已经很熟练了，爪子活动了下，牢牢地抓住人的衣服。

努力往上一拱。

“啾？”

宋郁又提前抬开手了，歪头过来看，果不其然，鸟又是昂首挺胸的样子。

站得笔挺的小鸟。

白粼粼后知后觉这有点像在玩游戏，鸟脸一红，后面第三次就不配合了。

叨了叨宋郁的手掌心。

“为什么不和我说话呢？”

宋郁侧眸了过来，眉眼温和，掌心还有点轻微的钝痛，是很有脾气的一只小鸟。

白粼粼假装听不懂，歪头伸了伸翅根，整理自己的羽毛。

宋郁看了一会，后面就没有再问了，只是在青石小巷里走着。

这里禁止机动车进入，下午三四点钟人也不多，倒是显得静谧。

白粼粼发觉视线移开后就转了回来鸟头，这才发现根本不是直接回家的路，这里好像是个商业街？

比较有古韵的那种。

宋郁是来这里散步？

鸟想不通。

但就在这时，人停下了脚步，白粼粼只好顺着宋郁的视线往前看。

对面那是一个穿着考究的妇人，身着黑色丝绸缎面的旗袍，外面搭着一件披肩，身边陪同着一个阿姨，旁边还有个“小女孩”。

白粼粼心里一咯噔，没办法，这实在太好辨别了。

宋郁长相本来就优越，他母亲在那张全家福上也很突出，温婉大方，是很标志的美人。

即使将近四十，也看着犹如二十多，完全没有大变化，甚至神采奕奕。

“小郁？”

江芮先开了口，她视线先是扫了一眼自己儿子，然后转到肩头的那只……

蹙了蹙眉。

“这东西脏不脏啊？宋启明不管你的？”

白粼粼本来还是挺老实的，听到这话一脸问号，脏？说的谁啊？

不要以为鸟听不懂人话。

你你你——

算了。

这是宋郁的妈妈。

“不脏。”少年冷声开口，只是侧眸看着江芮旁边的那个小孩，轻声道，“他挺脏的。”

后面的场合几乎是无法控制的了，那孩子像是应激了，突然口吐脏话，各种意义上的污言秽语。

要不是旁边保姆抱着，几乎要来踹人了。

宋郁就这么看着。

江芮神色也有些不好了，但还是弯腰去安抚孩子，说了一连串都是妈妈的错，但这无济于事，她的手臂还是挨了几下。

女人像是也控制不住脾气了，低声说道，“小予，你听话一点。”

之后又抬眼看向宋郁，像是在克制情绪，温和地道，“你妹妹不好带，当哥哥的，你懂事一点。”

“她才六岁，你可是十八了。”

江芮其实是有些生气的，但她明面上没有表现出来，见到宋郁面无表情的样子，又想到那个恶心的前夫，更反感了起来。

最后女人直接起身，身后的保姆还在控制着乱动的小孩，看着一静一动，很滑稽。

江芮还是耐着性子讲：

“我待会要带你妹妹去吃晚饭，她太难带了，上次你不是也没吃好，妈妈给你订个其他的餐厅？或者还是给你打个车，你自己安排？”

白粼粼站在宋郁的肩头，羽毛蓬松，像个小挂件，老老实实的。

“不用。”宋郁很平静地说道，随后看着那个“妹妹”，接着道，“我也好久没见妹妹了，一起吃饭吧。”

-

于是就出现了非常诡异的画面。

白粼粼毕竟是个小动物，接受鹦鹉的餐厅其实不多，最后还是加了钱才顺利进去的。

是一家西餐厅。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 9

In this world, there are always people with strange brainwaves—people adept at overthinking, equipped with their own internal logic and a complete defense mechanism.

Bai Linlin was utterly out of options in the end. He stood on Song Yu's shoulder without uttering a word, even keeping his bird eyes tightly shut.

"You can bring him over for me to look at anytime in the future. I'll give you a twenty percent discount," Li Sheng said, seeing them off with a cheerful smile. "Are you in Senior Three?"

Song Yu's face was cool and pale. He froze slightly upon hearing this, but still answered, "Yes."

"Nanshi No. 1 High School is a great school. You'll have no problem getting into a top university!" Li Sheng leaned against the hospital doorframe, offering words of encouragement.

After all, he was already a boring adult. Whenever he saw kids in his family who were still in school, the first thing out of his mouth was always "study hard"—he had truly turned into the kind of person he used to dislike.

Li Sheng couldn't help himself either, but seeing Song Yu nod politely, he thought the kid seemed very well-mannered.

*Depression?*

The young man knitted his brows, watching the departing figure. Realizing the youth had arrived by taxi, he felt somewhat surprised.

*He lives in Jinyuan—doesn't he have a family driver?*

-

Once inside the taxi, Bai Linlin felt a bit awkward. After being subjected to a deluge of wild fabrications by that Li Sheng guy, he hadn't even had time to react before having a whole bunch of labels slapped onto him.

What "love and passion"?

[6.]

Bai Linlin thought to himself that he had been single since birth for so many years and had zero experience in that department. His entire life was squeaky clean! How come after turning into a bird, his persona had transformed into deeply affectionate, highly possessive, and suffering from separation anxiety?

And that guy was wearing a white coat while spouting utter nonsense! What made matters even worse was—

"Can't you talk?"

Song Yu turned his gaze toward his shoulder. The youth's features were exceptionally handsome, his eyelids drooping, that red mole hidden in the shadow of his bangs—looking almost as though it had disappeared.

Bai Linlin had a sinking feeling that this kid actually believed it.

"..."

[I can't, I can't.]

Having said that, Song Yu simply kept staring at him. His lowered fingers curled slightly, the red cord wrapped around his ring finger.

At the other end was the little bird's foot ring.

Bai Linlin couldn't stand being stared at like this any longer, so he opened his beak and let out a thoroughly perfunctory sound:

"Chirp."

Song Yu's eyes seemed to soften slightly. He turned his head back and didn't say anything further, though he unconsciously wrapped the cord around his hand once more.

Tightening it.

Bai Linlin didn't notice this tiny gesture at all. He merely felt that the ordeal had passed. Feeling a bit carsick, he closed his eyes slightly.

A faint tug came from his claws.

The bird shifted a little.

Closer to the person.

Another faint tug came.

The bird had no choice but to shift again.

And again—

Bai Linlin snapped. Just as his round head popped up, Song Yu's face leaned in close.

The car had already stopped, and the driver in front asked, "Dropping off here, right?"

Without breaking his gaze, Song Yu reached out a hand while responding:

"Yes."

Bai Linlin was actually dazed for a moment because a bird's perspective was quite different—extremely wide, like a panoramic view.

Even so, Song Yu's face remained utterly flawless. The line of his jaw was sculpted just right—not overly gaunt, nor marred by any teenage acne.

A pure, handsome high school student.

Bai Linlin was a corporate wage-slave, after all. All he usually saw were colleagues with dark circles under their eyes just like his own. It was truly rare to see such a...

Little puppy dog.

The bird contemplated further.

However, time was running out.

Song Yu waited for a moment, and seeing that the little bird had no intention of stepping onto his finger, he pulled open the car door and instead placed his other hand over the top of the bird's head.

To shield it from bumping.

Bai Linlin looked up at the hand. In a moment of bizarre impulse, he nudged against it, only to feel a gentle downward pressure.

Instantly annoyed.

He pushed upward again with all his strength.

Right at that moment, Song Yu's hand suddenly lifted, leaving Bai Linlin frozen in a proud, head-high posture.

"Chirp?"

The hand covered his head once more.

Having been pressed down before, the bird was quite adept this time. His claws wriggled, gripping the youth's clothes firmly.

He pushed upward with all his might.

"Chirp?"

Song Yu lifted his hand in advance again. Tilting his head to look, sure enough, the bird was puffing out its chest once more.

A little bird standing ramrod straight.

Belatedly, Bai Linlin realized this was like playing a game. His bird face flushed red, and he refused to cooperate the third time.

Instead, he pecked at Song Yu's palm.

"Why won't you talk to me?"

Song Yu looked over, his eyes gentle, feeling a faint, dull sting in his palm—such a feisty little bird.

Bai Linlin pretended not to understand, tilting his head to stretch his wing joints and preen his feathers.

Song Yu watched him for a while before dropping the subject. He simply walked along the cobblestone alleyway.

Motor vehicles were banned here. At three or four in the afternoon, there weren't many people around, making it appear tranquil.

Bai Linlin turned his head back after shifting his gaze, only then realizing that this wasn't the way home at all. This place looked like a commercial street.

The kind with a historical, antique charm.

Was Song Yu here for a stroll?

The bird couldn't figure it out.

Just then, the youth stopped in his tracks. Bai Linlin had no choice but to follow Song Yu's gaze forward.

Opposite them stood an elegantly dressed woman. She wore a qipao made of black silk satin, layered with a shawl over her shoulders. She was accompanied by a housekeeper, and beside them was a "little girl."

Bai Linlin's heart skipped a beat. There was no helping it—she was far too recognizable.

Song Yu was naturally good-looking, and his mother had been exceptionally striking in that family photo—gentle, refined, a textbook beauty.

Even nearing forty, she still looked as though she were in her twenties, barely changed at all, her eyes full of life and vigor.

"Xiao Yu?"

Jiang Rui spoke first. Her gaze swept over her son before moving to the bird on his shoulder...

She knitted her brows.

"Is that thing dirty? Does Song Qiming not care about what you keep?"

Bai Linlin had been behaving himself, but hearing those words, his head filled with question marks. Dirty? Who was she calling dirty?

*Don't think a bird can't understand human speech!*

*You, you, you—*

Forget it.

This was Song Yu's mother.

"It's not dirty," the youth said coldly. He merely glanced sideways at the child next to Jiang Rui and added softly, "He's pretty dirty."

What followed was a scene that descended completely out of control. As if triggered, the child suddenly erupted into foul language, hurling all sorts of vile curses.

If the housekeeper hadn't been holding him back, he would have charged forward to kick Song Yu.

Song Yu simply watched, impassive.

Jiang Rui's expression turned unsightly as well, but she still bent down to soothe the child, repeating a string of "It's all Mommy's fault." Yet it was useless, and she still took several hits to her arms.

The woman seemed unable to suppress her temper any longer, whispering, "Xiao Yu, be good."

Then she raised her eyes to look at Song Yu, seemingly restraining her emotions as she said gently, "Your younger sister is hard to manage. As her older brother, be a bit more sensible."

"She's only six years old, but you're already eighteen."

Jiang Rui was actually quite angry, but she didn't show it on the surface. Seeing Song Yu's expressionless face, she thought of her disgusting ex-husband, which made her feel even more repulsed.

In the end, the woman stood straight up. Behind her, the housekeeper was still trying to control the thrashing child—one calm, one wild, creating a comical contrast.

Jiang Rui still spoke with forced patience:

"I'm taking your sister out for dinner in a bit. She's too difficult to handle, and last time you didn't get to eat properly either. How about Mommy books a different restaurant for you? Or should I get you a taxi so you can make your own arrangements?"

Bai Linlin stood on Song Yu's shoulder, his feathers puffed up like a little charm, behaving himself completely.

"No need," Song Yu said very calmly. Looking at his "sister," he continued, "I haven't seen my sister in a long time either. Let's eat together."

-

And so, an extremely bizarre scene unfolded.

Since Bai Linlin was a small animal, there weren't many restaurants that accepted parrots. In the end, they only managed to get in after paying an extra fee.

It was a Western restaurant.

chunks.chineseText:
那个女人，也就是宋郁的妈妈，一直在忙着照顾那个孩子，前前后后挨了好几拳。

保姆也挨打。

宋郁就这么冷淡地看着。

“……”

白粼粼实在没忍住，他活动了一下爪子，往宋郁的脖子那里靠，最后鸟头歪在后面。

试图控制一下表情。

“啾啾啾！”

白粼粼没忍住，但后面就坏事了，宋郁还没侧眸看过来，那孩子就开始发话了。

“给我！”

“给我！”

那孩子穿着是公主裙，但长相却显得不太好看，狭窄的眼缝，阔鼻，即使有母亲的白色皮肤，也依然无济于事。

啪嗒——

盘子碎了。

旁边的保姆牢牢地环住那孩子的腰，已经朝旁边的江芮投去求救的目光了。

江芮也很烦躁，一边同前来的服务员解释，一边好声好气地同宋郁道：“可以给妹妹这个小鸟吗？妈妈回头补给你一只。”

白粼粼：“？”

不是。

他是玩具吗？

宋郁：“不给，他脏。”

江芮愣了下，很快就反应过来是怎么回事，脾气也上来了，“你怎么说话的？”

“你妹妹是生了病，她的行为又没办法控制，她也不想的。”

场面一度混乱，甚至送餐的服务员都在不远处停下了脚步。

鸟回头看了下。

餐前面包，蒜蓉味道的。

！！

“宋郁我知道你有意见。”

江芮仿佛也是烦透了，推开那孩子，也不装了，“你要是接受不了，就不用非得和我们一起吃饭。”

“你妹妹是生着病的，我没有什么时间——”

也就在这时。

“妈妈，我也生病了。”

宋郁垂着眼眸，很平静地提醒。

场面一下子安静了起来。

白粼粼已经完成了偷偷飞过去，叨走一小块面包，然后重新回来的大动作。

听到这话还是愣了下。

江芮仿佛是面上更难看了，看向一旁站着不动的服务员有些恼火，“上餐啊！”

服务员这才反应过来，低头看了下面包，被他们的小鸟叨走了一小块，有个豁口。

呃，不用换吧？

放上去了。

就在这时——

那孩子突然往前一冲，保姆没拦住，立马就走到桌子对面，伸手就要抓白粼粼。

宋郁蹙了蹙眉，直接起身了，顺带偏开了位置。

那孩子一下子撞到椅子角，额头磕出来个大包。

白粼粼啧啧称奇，不过还没观摩一会，被挡住了视线。

宋郁侧头看了过来，面色本来确实很担心，但看到鸟喙上的面包屑，怔住了。

这哪来的？

此刻事情还没结束。

江芮看到孩子磕到了，很是生气，甚至不分青红皂白开始指责，“你让开干什么啊！她一个孩子有多大劲？”

“撞到你又怎么了？”

白粼粼闻言都气到了，这什么意思，是孩子就无敌了是吧？

“我&*%，给我！给我！”

那孩子又开始口吐芬芳。

保姆也拦不住了，江芮弯腰去哄，手背咔嚓被咬了一口。

肚子又挨了好几拳。

白粼粼：“……”

画面过于离奇。

宋郁最后什么也没说，没再和之前一样护着江芮，只是起身走了。

作者有话说：

[鸽子][鸽子]:拱——胸膛挺立！
chunks.englishText:
That woman—Song Yu’s mother—was constantly busy tending to the child, taking several punches to the chest and arms in the process.

The nanny was getting hit too.

Song Yu just watched with cold detachment.

“...”

Bai Linlin really couldn’t hold back anymore. He stretched his claws, leaned close to Song Yu’s neck, and finally let his bird head tilt backward.

He was desperately trying to control his facial expression.

“Chirp chirp chirp!”

Bai Linlin couldn't stop himself, but what happened next ruined everything. Before Song Yu could even glance over, the spoiled child began yelling.

“Give it to me!”

“Give it to me!”

The child was wearing a princess dress, but her features were far from pretty—narrow, slit-like eyes and a wide, flat nose. Even inheriting her mother’s fair skin couldn’t save her appearance.

*Clatter—*

A plate shattered on the floor.

The nanny beside her tightly wrapped her arms around the child’s waist, casting a desperate, pleading look toward Jiang Rui.

Jiang Rui was equally exasperated. While apologizing to the approaching waiter, she tried to coax Song Yu gently, “Can you give this little bird to your younger sister? Mom will buy you another one later to make it up to you.”

Bai Linlin: “?”

*Excuse me?*

*Am I some kind of toy?*

Song Yu said, “No. He's dirty.”

Jiang Rui froze, quickly realizing what he meant, and her temper flared instantly. “How can you speak like that?!”

“Your sister is sick! She can’t control her behavior, and she doesn’t want to be like this either!”

The scene fell into complete chaos. Even the waiter delivering their food paused a short distance away.

The bird turned his head to look.

Appetizer bread—garlic-flavored.

!!

“Song Yu, I know you have grievances,” Jiang Rui said, seemingly pushed to her absolute limit. She pushed the child aside and dropped her gentle facade completely. “If you really can’t accept this, you don’t have to force yourself to eat with us!”

“Your sister is sick, and I don’t have time to—”

Right at that moment—

“Mom, I’m sick too.”

Song Yu lowered his eyes, reminding her with an utterly serene tone.

The entire space instantly fell dead silent.

Meanwhile, Bai Linlin had already executed a grand stealth operation: flying over quietly, snatching a small bite of bread, and darting back unnoticed.

Hearing Song Yu’s words, he still froze for a second.

Jiang Rui’s expression turned even nastier. Turning toward the waiter who was standing stock-still nearby, she snapped in annoyance, “Serve the food!”

The waiter snapped back to reality, looked down at the bread—which now had a tiny chunk pecked out of it by a little bird—and hesitated.

*Uhh... no need to replace it, right?*

He placed it on the table.

Just then—

The child suddenly surged forward. The nanny failed to hold her back, and she rushed straight to the opposite side of the table, reaching out her hands to grab Bai Linlin.

Song Yu knitted his brows slightly, stood straight up, and casually stepped to the side.

The child crashed headfirst into the sharp corner of a chair, instantly raising a large, swollen bump on her forehead.

Bai Linlin clicked his beak in amazement. However, before he could spectate the drama further, his line of sight was blocked.

Song Yu turned his head to look over. His expression had originally carried a trace of real concern, but the moment his gaze landed on the breadcrumbs sticking to the bird’s beak, he froze.

*Where did that come from?*

The drama wasn't over yet.

Seeing her child get hurt, Jiang Rui exploded in rage, hurling indiscriminate blame at Song Yu. “Why did you step aside?! How much strength could a little girl even have?!”

“What would it hurt if she bumped into you?!”

Hearing this, even Bai Linlin felt his blood boil. *What kind of logic is that? Just because she's a kid, she's invincible?!*

“I’ll *&#%! Give it to me! Give it to me!”

The child began spouting profanities again.

The nanny couldn't hold her back anymore. Jiang Rui bent over to soothe her, only to be bitten sharply on the back of her hand with a loud crunch.

Then her stomach took several solid punches.

Bai Linlin: “...”

*This scene is way too bizarre.*

In the end, Song Yu said nothing. He didn't protect Jiang Rui like he used to. He simply turned around and walked away.

***

**Author's Note:**

[Pigeon][Pigeon]: *Puff—puffs chest high!*

chunks.chineseText:
第10章

白粼粼站在人的肩头上，脑海中的离奇画面还是挥之不去，那小孩挥拳是真有力。

不过宋郁似乎兴致不高，只是还在路边走着，偶尔看到了一家熟悉的面馆。

[陈记牛肉面。]

人脚步一停，鸟也随之转头，而后就开始扑棱翅膀。

“啾啾啾啾！”

宋郁想到了前段时间的事，被自己母亲带来的消极情绪转移走了，取而代之的是一些恍惚。

唇角又被鸟叨了一口。

白粼粼心说这怎么还不动作，去吃饭去吃饭，他就在那西餐厅叼了点面包屑，非常亏本的好不好。

人去吃，人去吃。

宋郁怔了下，抬手碰了碰自己的唇角，还没有来得及思考什么。

面前扑棱的鸟就飞累了。

他只好抬手给接住了。

蓝羽小鸟圆嘟嘟的，鸟腿上有个脚环，很认真在“人”的手掌上踩了踩，挑选了最舒服的无名指。

站好了。

宋郁没办法，带着鸟去了那家牛肉面馆。

-

店里的老板看到来人就认出来，连忙出来道：

“小哥，这我们家的真的没有劣质的肉，都是联系供应商提供的牛肉，不应该有怪味的，上次你和你妈妈……”

宋郁抬眸看了过去，很平静地解释道，“上次我身体不舒服，不好意思，不是你们的问题。”

白粼粼还一头雾水，但是人已经替鸟交了二十块的进门费用，选了楼上的一个包厢。

里面的装潢很是古典，还有屏风设计，一张实木桌子上摆着用稻草编制的隔热垫，尤为精巧。

宋郁拿过来菜单，展开，鸟从善如流地站过去，圆圆的脑袋垂着，好似真的在低头看。

虽然说是牛肉面馆，但是还是有很多小菜的，什么醋溜土豆丝、凉拌生菜……还有甜品。

鸟看得入迷，全然不知道身后的少年在垂眸盯着他，神色不解。

宋郁等了一会，本来是打算翻一页给鸟看看的，但是手指被按住了。

被鸟爪扣住了。

白粼粼很专心的，他好久没有出来吃过饭了，前段时间阿姨走了，导致他只能跟着宋郁吃外卖，关键这人总是食欲不佳，点的东西也很少，他不能偷叨太多口，会被发现的。

这次一定要好好点菜。

宋郁手没有在动，只是视线微微靠下了些，看到了矫健的鸟腿，劈着叉来按住他的手指。

白粼粼挑选了下，最后转过身来，用爪子伸了伸。

“啾啾，啾啾，啾啾啾啾。”

[这个，这个，还有这个。]

宋郁看了下，发现有主食，有凉菜，有雪糕，有饮品，很全面了。

他有些混乱。

但鸟似乎不装了。

宋郁还是按照这些同服务员点了过去，等待就餐的时候，垂眸看着桌上的小鸟。

由于有红绳牵着，蓝羽小鸟是飞不远的，只是偶尔手指会被牵一牵。

宋郁有些放空，江芮与他其实一直是有联系的，前些日子是带他来过这个餐馆，说实话，这里的档次比较低，不太像是她的选择。

后来过来，果然是因为她身边那个“生病”的孩子。

分明是半年一次的会面，最后却演变成了看着自己的妈妈对另外一个孩子予取予求、视线不离。

江芮当时怀着孕，高龄产妇，仍然还要费劲地去为那个浑身都是汤渍的孩子整理唇角，即使后面又被咬了手腕。

他吐了。

之后诊断出了“情绪性厌食”。

宋郁看到桌面上被接二连三端上来食物的时候，才微微回了回神，热气冒了起来。

一碗色香味俱全的牛肉面。

“那您慢用。”

服务员很快就退下去了，不过临走还往宋郁肩头看了看，那里站了一只很乖巧的小鸟，还歪头看了看她。

好可爱。

白粼粼其实是在碎碎念，拜拜拜拜拜。

等到包厢门一关上，鸟就伸了伸翅根，稳稳地降落到桌面，犹如走地鸡一样，大摇大摆地走到了碗跟前。

热气腾腾的。

宋郁其实也不能理解自己为什么后来让阿姨做牛肉面，出于什么心理，自虐？

他只是觉得现在这碗面……很普通，好像没有那么反胃了，那些挥之不去的画面消散了些。

“啾啾？啾啾？”

白粼粼其实是试探着去站在碗沿的，但是太烫了，鸟在桌上走来走去的，急需给爪子降温。

宋郁蹙眉，抬手把鸟拿了起来，想要去看看爪子。

但是手指刚碰上去，那个小小的爪子就抵住了他的手指。

白粼粼：不可。

宋郁大约怔了一秒，而后抬起手，指腹还有微热的温度，鸟爪要烫熟了。

他只能打算去看看另外一个爪子，但仍然是这样，被爪子抵住了。

白粼粼：不可。

“……”

鸟还是有些羞耻心的，说来也奇怪，白粼粼被阿姨拿着擦拭羽毛、爪子，完全可以接受。

但是宋郁不行。

白粼粼觉得还是好奇怪，他虽然有点被鸟的底层代码给控住了，但是还是有人的底线与尊严的。

说人话就是：

——不许掰我腿。

宋郁最后只能把鸟放下了，大约等了一会，饭菜温度适宜了，他用手机查了下，发现有些帖子里小鸟就是会叨人的食物的。

应该没有问题。

更何况，他的小鸟是会打游戏的。

宋郁面色平静，垂眸看着站在碗沿的蓝羽小鸟低头挑挑拣拣的，心里只有一个想法。

要取名字。

他的小鸟，要取个名字。

-

人总是希望被爱的，但是在社会关系中，并不是所有人都可以得到完美的“亲情”和“爱情”，它往往夹杂着很多碎玻璃。

想要牢牢攥住，却弄得满手是血。

宋郁一开始不愿意离开这个死循环，他并不相信医生所说的“驯养理论”，也不认为这个世界上会有一个独属于自己的小动物。

直到现在——

他带着小鸟步行走回了锦园，一路上有很多人驻足看了过来，大抵是某种好奇……以及对于小鸟如此乖的羡慕。

人是迷恋稳定的关系的。

宋郁用指纹解锁了门口，垂着眼眸，侧头看了下肩头的一只，鸟圆滚滚的，羽毛蓬松，一路上甚至没有睁开眼睛。

信任极了。

医生好像说过一句话：

[小动物是很纯粹的，他们短暂的一生永远只认定一个人。]

宋郁几乎觉得自己要好了起来了，他转回了头，面色平静地关门，迈步去楼上。

打游戏，是很正常的。

他接受了。

白粼粼睡了一路，再度醒过来的时候，发现宋郁已经坐在电脑桌前了，游戏屏幕大开着。

鸟活动了下爪爪。

又打了个哈欠，肉色的小短喙一张一合的，里面的小舌头犹如个小棒槌。

白粼粼觉得自己有点晕碳，可是他又觉得挺奇怪的，自己也就叨了几根面条而已，相较于之前的食量是少了很多的。

奇怪。

不过这都不重要，鸟今天体检过了，很安康的。

白粼粼在宋郁的肩头找了个位置，往前伸了伸鸟腿，坐下了。

房间里操作鼠标的动作一停。

# Chapter 10 (Part 1)

Perched on the youth's shoulder, Bai Linlin still couldn't shake off the surreal scene from earlier. That kid’s punches were surprisingly powerful.

Song Yu, however, seemed to be in low spirits. He simply walked down the sidewalk until he caught sight of a familiar noodle shop.

[Chen’s Beef Noodle Shop.]

The youth stopped in his tracks, and the bird turned his head accordingly, immediately fluttering his wings wildly.

“Chirp chirp chirp chirp!”

Recalling what happened a while back, Song Yu felt the negative emotions brought on by his mother fade slightly, replaced instead by a dazed sense of detachment.

The corner of his lip was pecked once more by the bird.

Bai Linlin thought to himself, *Why aren't you moving yet? Go inside and eat! I only managed to snatch a tiny bite of breadcrumb at that Western restaurant—talk about a total loss!*

*Go eat, go eat!*

Song Yu blinked in surprise and lifted a hand to touch the corner of his lips. Before he could think further—

The fluttering bird in front of him grew tired of flying.

He had no choice but to hold out his palm to catch it.

The little blue-feathered bird was plump and round, with a small leg ring attached to its tiny foot. It earnestly treaded on the human's palm, selecting the most comfortable spot—his ring finger.

And perched firmly.

Having no alternative, Song Yu brought the bird inside the beef noodle shop.

-

The shop owner recognized him the moment he entered and hurried over to say:

“Young man, our beef really isn't low quality! It's all sourced directly from reliable suppliers. There shouldn't be any strange smell. Last time, when you and your mom—”

Song Yu looked up at him and calmly explained, “Last time, I was feeling unwell. I’m sorry, it wasn't your food's fault.”

Bai Linlin was still completely bewildered, but Song Yu had already paid a twenty-yuan entry fee for the bird and selected a private room upstairs.

The interior decor was quite traditional, complete with elegant room screens. On a solid wood table lay an exquisitely crafted heat-insulating mat woven from straw.

Song Yu picked up the menu and unfolded it. The bird smoothly hopped over, lowering its round little head as if it were genuinely reading it.

Although it was a beef noodle shop, there were plenty of side dishes available: sour and spicy shredded potatoes, tossed lettuce salad... and even desserts.

The bird was utterly absorbed, completely unaware that the youth behind him was staring down at him with an inscrutable, puzzled expression.

Song Yu waited for a moment, originally intending to turn the page for the bird, but his finger was suddenly pinned down.

Clamped down by a bird claw.

Bai Linlin was focusing intensely. He hadn't dined out in a long time. Ever since the housekeeper auntie left a while back, he had been forced to share takeout with Song Yu. The problem was that Song Yu always had a poor appetite and ordered very little, meaning Bai Linlin couldn't steal too many bites without getting caught.

This time, he had to order properly!

Song Yu kept his hand still, merely shifting his gaze lower to look at the athletic bird leg, which was stretching into a full split just to hold his finger down.

Bai Linlin made his selections, then turned around and stretched out his claw to point.

“Chirp chirp, chirp chirp, chirp chirp chirp chirp.”

*[This, this, and this.]*

Song Yu glanced over and saw a main dish, a cold appetizer, an ice cream, and a drink—a very well-balanced meal.

He felt a bit chaotic in his mind.

*So this bird isn't even trying to hide it anymore?*

Still, Song Yu placed the order with the waiter according to those selections. While waiting for the food, he stared down at the little bird on the table.

Because of the red string tether, the blue-feathered bird couldn't fly far, though Song Yu's finger would occasionally be tugged.

Song Yu spaced out slightly. Jiang Rui had actually stayed in touch with him all along. A few days ago, she had brought him to this very restaurant. Truth be told, this place was rather low-end, hardly fitting her usual taste.

Coming here later made it clear—it was all because of the "sick" child by her side.

What was supposed to be a semi-annual meeting ended up with him watching his mother yield to every demand of another child, her eyes never straying from her.

Jiang Rui was pregnant at the time, an older mother, yet she still put in painstaking effort to wipe the soup stains off that child's lips, even after having her wrist bitten in return.

He had vomited back then.

Afterward, he was diagnosed with "emotional anorexia."

It was only when dish after dish was served onto the table that Song Yu snapped out of his reverie. Steam billowed upward.

A bowl of beef noodles, rich in color, aroma, and taste.

“Please enjoy your meal.”

The waitress quickly bowed out, though before leaving, she couldn't help glancing at Song Yu’s shoulder. Perched there was an extraordinarily well-behaved little bird, tilting its head to look at her.

*So cute!*

Bai Linlin was actually muttering internally, *Bye-bye, bye-bye, bye-bye.*

The moment the private room door closed, the bird stretched its wing joints, landed smoothly on the tabletop like a barnyard chicken, and strutted proudly over to the bowl.

Piping hot.

In truth, Song Yu couldn't understand why he had asked the housekeeper auntie to make beef noodles later on. What kind of mindset was that—self-torture?

He just felt that this bowl of noodles now... seemed quite ordinary. It no longer triggered his nausea as much, and those lingering, haunting images in his head had faded slightly.

“Chirp chirp? Chirp chirp?”

Bai Linlin tried to stand on the rim of the bowl, but it was far too hot! The bird ended up pacing back and forth across the wooden table, desperate to cool down his hot claws.

Song Yu knitted his brows, reached out to pick the bird up, intending to check its feet.

However, the moment his fingers touched them, those tiny claws pushed firmly against his fingertips.

Bai Linlin: *Forbidden.*

Song Yu froze for about a second, then raised his hand. His fingertips still bore a faint warmth—the bird's feet were almost cooked!

He intended to check the other foot, but the result was the same—pushed away firmly by the claw.

Bai Linlin: *Forbidden.*

“...”

The bird still possessed a sense of dignity! Truth be told, when the housekeeper auntie used to wipe his feathers and claws, Bai Linlin could accept it completely.

But with Song Yu, he couldn't.

Bai Linlin felt it was bizarre too. Although he was somewhat controlled by the bird's base instincts, he still retained a human's bottom line and self-respect.

In plain human terms:

—*Don't spread my legs!*

Song Yu had no choice but to set the bird down. After waiting for a while until the food cooled to a suitable temperature, he searched on his phone and discovered that many posts mentioned pet birds pecking at human food.

It should be fine.

Besides, his little bird knew how to play video games.

With an indifferent face, Song Yu looked down at the blue-feathered bird standing on the rim of the bowl, picking and choosing its bites, while a single thought surfaced in his mind:

He needed to give it a name.

His bird needed a name.

-

Humans always longed to be loved. Yet in social relationships, not everyone could obtain perfect "filial love" or "romantic love." It was often mixed with jagged shards of broken glass.

Clutching at it tightly only left one's hands covered in blood.

At first, Song Yu had been unwilling to break free from this vicious cycle. He didn't believe in the "domestication theory" spoken of by doctors, nor did he believe that a pet belonging uniquely to him existed in this world.

Until now—

He walked all the way back to Jinyuan Estate with the little bird. Along the route, many passersby stopped to stare—mostly out of curiosity... and envy at how obedient the little bird was.

Humans were obsessed with stable, reliable relationships.

Song Yu unlocked the front door with his fingerprint. Lowering his eyes, he glanced at the tiny creature perched on his shoulder. The bird was round and fluffy, its feathers puffed up, and it hadn't even opened its eyes once throughout the journey.

Absolute, unreserved trust.

The doctor seemed to have said a sentence back then:

[*Animals are very pure. In their brief lives, they will only ever recognize one person.*]

Song Yu felt as though he was almost getting better. He turned his head back, quietly shut the door, and walked upstairs.

Playing video games was completely normal.

He had accepted it.

Bai Linlin slept the entire way back. By the time he woke up, he found Song Yu already seated at the computer desk, the game screen fully open.

The bird stretched its tiny claws.

He let out a yawn, his small, flesh-colored beak opening and closing, revealing a tiny tongue inside like a little drumstick.

Bai Linlin felt a bit lightheaded from a food coma, yet he found it rather strange. He had only pecked at a few strands of noodles, which was far less than his usual appetite.

Odd.

Well, none of that mattered. The bird had passed its health check today—completely sound and healthy.

Bai Linlin found a comfortable spot on Song Yu’s shoulder, stretched a tiny leg forward, and sat down.

In the quiet room, the sound of the mouse clicking suddenly ceased.

白粼粼：？

宋郁觉得有些口渴，视线移到了旁边的水杯，本来想要去拿，但又担心动作太大……

鸟不坐了。

只是喉结滚动了下。

宋郁犹豫了一会，还是侧头看了下，眼皮微微垂着。

白粼粼其实是在看电脑页面的，是各种各样英雄的皮肤，说实话还挺花里胡哨的。

不过肯定很贵——

鸟一歪头，发现“人”在看他。

“你，打游戏吧。”

宋郁试着说道，顺带把鼠标往外挪了下，很坦然的样子，桌面上的手机屏幕还是支付页面。

花了三千块。

简单充值了下。

便于鸟玩。

白粼粼有些宕机，什么意思，来试探他？

难道不应该是看完医生怀疑自己出现幻觉了，然后过两天忘记那件事吗？

宋郁自己接受了？

“啾啾啾？”

白粼粼坐在宋郁的肩头，鸟头歪着，开始梳理羽毛，在说什么啊，他听不懂。

直到——

“我买了全套角色的皮肤。”

-

事情已经发生了。

白粼粼承认自己变得物质了，他的人生愿望就是躺平摆烂、打游戏，没办法，宋郁太有实力了。

鸟从未体验过这种感觉，站在键盘上挥斥方遒，胸膛挺立，美美拿下一杀。

然后被人针对了。

“啾啾啾啾啾！”

宋郁其实已经大脑一片空白，他也不知道自己为什么最后本能地选择接受而不是探究“鸟为什么会打游戏”这个命题。

在看到圆滚滚的鸟头转回来求救的时候。

少年也只是停顿了一秒，而后就接管了游戏角色，开始流畅地操作。

白粼粼仰着头，看着屏幕花花绿绿的特效，鸟眼都亮亮的。

这就是被带的感觉？

爽啊。

男高就是会打游戏。

不错不错。

白粼粼最后扑棱翅膀飞上了宋郁的肩头，再度熟练地伸出来鸟腿，坐好了。

场面诡异，但很和谐。

白粼粼也是上头了，等到游戏关了才察觉到有些不对劲，人接受的速度太快了……

万一隔天就把他上交给国家机构给解剖研究了呢？

应该再装装的！

白粼粼真是后悔了，不过他也不明白宋郁为什么后面没有再追问这件事了，难不成现在灵气复苏了？

满大街的小动物都可以打游戏？

正在鸟头脑风暴的时候，宋郁已经折好了纸团，一共三个。

平放在桌子上。

“选一个？”宋郁侧头问了问，眉眼平和。

他完全没有几日前的消沉模样了，少年眼皮垂着，那颗红痣似乎变得鲜艳了些。

取名字。

要建立关系……

白粼粼闻言回了回神，从“人”肩头飞到了桌子上，啪嗒啪嗒地走了几步。

看到了那三个纸团。

“……”

不要。

宋郁就这么看着小鸟用翅膀一挥，全部把纸团给扇飞了，他的心刚沉了下。

却又听到了啪嗒啪嗒的声音。

鸟似乎在键盘上乱踩，直到电脑屏幕上出来两个字。

——粼粼。

鸟腿伸直，胸膛挺立。

很骄傲的一只小鸡。

作者有话说：

[鸽子]：人，允许你知道鸟的名讳。
