# Chapter 10 (Part 2)

Bai Linlin: ?

Song Yu felt a bit thirsty and shifted his gaze toward the water glass nearby. He originally wanted to reach for it, but he hesitated, worried that too much movement might...

Cause the bird to stop sitting there.

His Adam’s apple bobbed slightly.

After a moment's hesitation, Song Yu turned his head to glance over, his eyelids drooping slightly.

Bai Linlin was actually looking at the computer screen, which was displaying skin previews for various heroes—truth be told, they were pretty flashy and extravagant.

Though they were definitely expensive—

The bird tilted his head, only to realize the "human" was staring at him.

“Go on, play,” Song Yu tried saying. He casually nudged the mouse slightly outward, acting completely natural. On his desk, his phone screen was still displaying a payment confirmation page.

He had spent three thousand yuan.

A quick top-up.

Just to make it convenient for the bird to play.

Bai Linlin was momentarily stunned. *What's the meaning of this? Is he testing me?*

*Shouldn't he have suspected he was hallucinating after seeing a doctor, and then forgotten all about it a couple of days later?*

*Song Yu accepted this himself?!*

“Chirp chirp chirp?”

Sitting on Song Yu’s shoulder, Bai Linlin tilted his head and began preening his feathers, acting clueless. *What are you talking about? I don't understand a word.*

Until—

“I bought the entire set of character skins.”

-

What was done was done.

Bai Linlin admitted he had become materialistic. His ultimate life goal was simply to lie flat, slack off, and play video games. There was no helping it—Song Yu was just way too stacked with wealth.

The bird had never experienced such a feeling before: standing atop a keyboard, commanding the battlefield with chest puffed high, effortlessly securing a First Blood!

And then... he got targeted by the enemy team.

“Chirp chirp chirp chirp chirp!”

Song Yu’s mind was actually a complete blank. He didn't know why his instinct ultimately drove him to accept the reality rather than investigate the philosophical question of "why a bird could play video games."

When he saw the round, fluffy bird head turn back toward him to plead for help—

The youth merely paused for a second before taking over the game controls, executing smooth and flawless maneuvers.

Bai Linlin tilted his head back, watching the dazzling, colorful skill effects on the screen, his bird eyes sparkling brightly.

*Is this what it feels like to get carried?*

*So damn satisfying!*

*High school boys really know how to play games!*

*Not bad, not bad at all.*

In the end, Bai Linlin fluttered his wings and flew back onto Song Yu’s shoulder, skillfully stretching out his bird legs once again to sit down comfortably.

The scene was bizarre, yet strangely harmonious.

Bai Linlin had gotten carried away in the heat of the moment. It was only after the game closed that he sensed something was off—this human had accepted the situation *way* too quickly...

What if Song Yu handed him over to a national research facility for dissection tomorrow?!

*I should have kept acting clueless!*

Bai Linlin was genuinely filled with regret. Yet he couldn't understand why Song Yu didn't pry further into the matter. Could it be that spiritual qi had revived in this world, and every pet on the street was now capable of gaming?

While the bird was amidst his mental storm, Song Yu had already folded three crumpled paper balls.

He placed them side by side on the desk.

“Pick one?” Song Yu asked, turning his head, his brow calm and gentle.

He showed none of the despondency from a few days ago. As the youth’s eyelids drooped slightly, the crimson mole beneath his eye seemed to glow a bit more vividly.

A name.

He needed to establish a bond...

Bai Linlin snapped out of his thoughts, flying down from the human's shoulder onto the desk, taking a few *pitter-patter* steps forward.

He spotted the three paper balls.

“...”

*No.*

Song Yu watched as the little bird flicked its wing, sweeping all three paper balls off the table in one go. His heart sank slightly.

Yet soon, he heard the *pitter-patter* sound of footsteps again.

The bird seemed to tread randomly across the keyboard until two characters appeared on the computer screen:

—Linlin.

The bird stretched its tiny legs straight and puffed out its chest proudly.

A very triumphant little chick.

***

**Author's Note:**

[Pigeon]: *Human, you are granted permission to know this bird's glorious name.*

chunks.chineseText:
第11章

宋郁一开始还没太反应过来，只是低头看着桌面，毛绒绒的一团站得很是板正。

鸟腿甚至还保持着劈叉的状态，一条踩在键盘上，一条保持“金鸡独立”。

“粼粼？”

宋郁轻声喃喃道，昏黄的台灯下显得他的轮廓清晰的，修长的手指往前伸了下。

鸟头被顶了下。

白粼粼差点没撅过去，只能敷衍地叨了“人”一口。

他才不要用乱七八糟的名字，什么花花、球球、可乐、甜豆……

想想都很幼稚。

做人要有人格，做鸟也要有鸟格。

尽管现在是转生为……咳咳宠物了，但那句话怎么说的，兽人永不为奴！

白粼粼伸了伸自己的翅膀，非常高贵地收回了鸟腿，对宋郁点了点头。

少年怔了下，而后自言自语道，“这是你原来的名字？”

白粼粼仰着鸟头看过去，心里有些欣慰，这么聪明，他就知道高中生是人类智力巅峰期。

不过也好也好。

宋郁这么轻而易举就接受了他能打游戏的事实，那看起来……接受度还挺高？

毕竟在广大文艺作品中，最能接受玄幻事件的就是上学的小毛孩了。

还不爱告诉家长。

觉得自己是被神选中的。

白粼粼越想越觉得正确，最后甚至还眯了眯鸟眼，盘算着怎么驯服宋郁。

这可是鸟选中的人。

“那是别人给你起的么？”宋郁声线有些平直，尽管面色还很温和，但情绪其实不怎么好。

手指伸了过去。

白粼粼愣了下，心说这是什么和什么，但还是自动抬脚起驾了，侧头梳理了下羽毛。

显然是没有理解到事情的核心。

翌日。

宋郁带着鸟准备出门，他头发干爽，穿着黑色外套，衬得皮肤更为冷白，在玄关处耐着心给鸟套脚环。

门口的光斜斜地打过来，少年面色偏冷，但动作却温和。

白粼粼困成毛球了。

他不知道宋郁怎么还不上学去，这五一假期有这么长？什么学校居然还不补课，真是天理难容。

白粼粼非常没有道德心地谴责。

其实是因为宋郁今天起的有些早，看到纸巾盒里的鸟一动不动，还是很担心，就那么给搓了搓鸟头。

白粼粼被弄醒了。

睡眠严重不足18个小时！

他也不知道怎么回事，这几天尤其的困，连带着羽毛都开始自动蓬松。

“要戴脚环才能出门，嗯？”

宋郁侧眸看着鸟，像是在商量，语气很温和。

其实是没辙了，鸟从早上就开始缩在人的肩头，闭目养神，羽毛蓬松，现在连爪子都看不到了。

不好戴脚环。

宋郁也担心弄痛它。

大约是停了一两秒。

白粼粼闭着眼睛，在人肩头活动了下位置，最后找到一个合适的地方，微微侧了下身子。

伸出鸟腿。

非常矜贵的样子。

宋郁怔了下，但冷着的面容很明显地化了，只是很轻地去托着那个爪子。

这次是步行出门，白粼粼一路都在补觉，只是隐隐约约觉得有些莫名熟悉的感觉。

这条路……

白粼粼睁开眼睛一看，果不其然是那家要拿自己配种的店，那家店老板还在躺椅上歇着。

？！

白粼粼当即就要去叨宋郁，但是少年恰好转了个头，害的鸟没叨成，反而圆滚滚的脑袋撞上了人的耳垂。

宋郁似乎是察觉到了点触感，侧头转了回来，抬手碰了碰鸟，轻声道：

“我来问问你以前主人的事。”

“我学一下。”

白粼粼宕机了，什么啊？

店老板似乎也没有想到自己还能见到当初那只病鸟，并且看起来还挺有精神，羽毛都很鲜亮。

……亏本了。

不过他在听到买主的话后，还是如实说了：

“没有，它没有被倒卖过，就打孵出来它就在这儿。”

“你要是说怎么养鹦鹉，那我还是有点门道的。”

店老板闲着也是闲着，倒是让这年纪不大的小孩进来，毕竟……挺有钱的。

潜在客户。

再卖他一只。

宋郁蹙了下眉，这再次和他的预期不符，没有主人，那怎么会有名字？

白粼粼在人肩头打了个哈欠，一来二去算是明白怎么回事了。

宋郁大概是误会了。

名字是他自己的名字，不是什么“前主人”起的。

白粼粼在人肩头调整了下位置，靠里挪了挪，不过还是回想了下刚才“人”的说辞。

——我学一下？

怎么茶茶的？

不过这个念头也就一闪而过，白粼粼很快想起来一件重要的事，当初这个店里的鸟……谁骂他了！

君子报仇，一月不晚。

宋郁本来是在同老板交流一些什么养鸟的问题，但手指缠着的红线骤然被扯了下。

肩头的小鸟起飞了。

“啾啾啾！啾啾啾啾！”

白粼粼直接占据最高点，即天花板的陈年吊灯，开始居高临下地质问。

[当初谁骂我的？赶紧出来！]

店面的各色鹦鹉开始叽叽喳喳的，有的窃窃私语，有的则是完全走神。

[我去，它怎么变好看了。]

[那个，那个，那是你主人？]

后者是一个紫色系的牡丹，翘了翘尾巴，跟着啾了几声。

白粼粼并不知道这个动作的意思，只是见有鸟问他了，回复了下：

[是的。]

本来这是平平无奇的对话，但不知道怎么了，角落里的一只玄凤开始蛐蛐。

[不过是鸟仗人势而已，有什么好骄傲的？]

白粼粼眯了眯鸟眼，刚转生的记忆开始如潮水涌来，当时在大胖秃头店主旁边的……好像就是这个黄色的。

！

他都不当人了，自然是一点委屈都不受了，此仇必报。

于是乎，鸟一个俯冲。

宋郁根本来不及反应，只是看到了两团毛绒绒的东西在扭打，战况激烈，最终半空中飘下一个黄色的羽毛。

“啾啾啾啾！啾啾啾！”

[哇你好厉害，真勇敢！]

牡丹非常认真地夸赞道，再度翘了翘尾巴，有些羞涩。

白粼粼大获全胜，扑棱翅膀飞到了一旁空着的栖杆，非常闲情雅致地梳理了下自己的羽毛。

玄凤被叨的乱七八糟，还没来得及输出就被店老板给抓住了，关进笼子里了。

也就在这时——

“它肯定是之前被欺负了，不然我的小鸟不会去攻击的。”

宋郁赶在店老板开口前说道，面色冷淡，直接给对方整不会了。

店老板：……

他这次真不讹人了。

“它在家里很乖的。”

宋郁再次强调，完全没有任何犹豫，只是蹙眉看向了不远处的木头栖杆。

白粼粼正在和旁边的牡丹聊天，毕竟人家先和他打招呼的。

“啾啾啾啾。”

“啾啾，啾啾啾啾啾啾啾。”

[是它太菜。]

[嗯嗯，你的主人好好看。]

“啾？”

白粼粼直接呆住，战术后退，什么意思。

但与此同时，宋郁也在蹙着眉头，旁边的店老板则是看到了商机，抓紧推销：
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 11

At first, Song Yu didn't quite register what was happening. He simply looked down at the tabletop, where a fluffy little creature stood straight and proper.

Its bird legs were even stuck in a split—one stepping on the keyboard, and the other raised in a "golden rooster standing on one leg" pose.

"Linlin?"

Song Yu murmured softly. Beneath the dim yellow light of the desk lamp, his features looked sharp and defined. He extended a long, slender finger forward.

The bird's head received a slight poke.

Bai Linlin almost fainted on the spot. He could only give the human a perfunctory peck.

He didn't want any messy, ridiculous names like Huahua, Qiuqiu, Kele, or Tiandou...

Just thinking about them was childish beyond belief.

A human needed dignity, and a bird needed bird-dignity too!

Even though he had been reincarnated as a... ahem, a pet, as the saying went: Orcs will never be slaves!

Bai Linlin stretched his wings, drew back his leg with immense nobility, and gave Song Yu a firm nod.

The youth froze for a moment before muttering to himself, "Is that your original name?"

Bai Linlin tilted his bird head up to look at him, feeling quite relieved in his heart. *So smart! I knew high schoolers were at the peak of human intelligence.*

*Still, this is great.*

Song Yu had accepted the fact that he could play video games so easily, which meant... he had a pretty high threshold for weird things?

After all, in pop culture and fiction, school kids were always the ones most open to fantasy and supernatural occurrences.

And they hated telling their parents.

Always thinking they were the chosen ones.

The more Bai Linlin thought about it, the more logical it seemed. In the end, he even narrowed his avian eyes, scheming about how to tame Song Yu.

This was a human handpicked by a bird!

"Did someone else give you that name?" Song Yu's voice was somewhat flat. Although his expression remained gentle, his mood was actually quite dark.

He extended a finger once again.

Bai Linlin blinked, wondering what was going on, but still automatically lifted his foot to mount the finger, turning his head to preen his feathers.

Clearly, he hadn't grasped the core of the issue.

The next day.

Song Yu prepared to head out with the bird. His hair was dry and neat, and he wore a black jacket that made his skin appear even more cool and fair. At the entryway, he patiently tried to put an anklet on the bird.

Light from the doorway streamed in diagonally. The youth's expression leaned cold, but his movements were remarkably gentle.

Bai Linlin was so sleepy he had curled into a furball.

He didn't understand why Song Yu wasn't going to school yet. Was the May Day holiday really this long? What kind of high school didn't force make-up classes during holidays? It was simply outrageously unprincipled!

Bai Linlin condemned it without a shred of moral standing.

In truth, it was because Song Yu had woken up early today. Seeing the bird lying motionless in the tissue box, he got worried and rubbed its bird head.

Bai Linlin had been forcefully awakened.

His sleep was severely under eighteen hours!

He didn't know what was happening either; he felt exceptionally drowsy these past few days, and his feathers were fluffed up naturally as a result.

"You need to wear the anklet to go outside, okay?"

Song Yu glanced sideways at the bird, sounding as if he were negotiating in a gentle tone.

In reality, he was out of options. Ever since morning, the bird had been huddling on his shoulder with its eyes closed to rest, its feathers so puffed up that its feet couldn't even be seen anymore.

It was impossible to attach the anklet.

Song Yu was also worried about hurting it.

After a second or two of pause...

Bai Linlin, eyes closed, shifted around on the human's shoulder until he found a comfortable spot, then tilted his body slightly.

He stuck out a leg.

With an air of supreme grandeur.

Song Yu paused, but his cold expression softened visibly. He very gently cupped the little bird foot.

This time they went out on foot. Bai Linlin spent the whole way catching up on sleep, only feeling a strange, vague sense of familiarity.

This path...

Bai Linlin opened his eyes to look. Sure enough, it was that pet shop whose owner had wanted to use him for breeding! The store owner was still lounging on his recliner.

?!

Bai Linlin immediately went to peck Song Yu, but the youth happened to turn his head right at that moment. The bird missed the peck, and instead, his round little head bumped straight into the youth's earlobe.

Noticing the touch, Song Yu turned back, reached up to touch the bird, and said softly:

"I came to ask about your previous owner."

"So I can learn from them."

Bai Linlin short-circuited. *What in the world?*

The store owner didn't expect to see that sick bird from before either, especially looking so energetic with bright, lustrous feathers.

...He had taken a loss!

However, upon hearing the buyer's query, he still spoke truthfully:

"Nah, it was never resold. It's been here ever since it hatched."

"Now, if you're asking how to raise parrots, I do know a thing or two."

Since the store owner had nothing better to do, he let the young kid inside. After all... he was pretty wealthy.

A potential client.

Maybe he could sell him another one.

Song Yu knitted his brows. This contradicted his expectations again. If there was no previous owner, how did it have a name?

Bai Linlin yawned on his shoulder, finally putting two and two together.

Song Yu had probably misunderstood.

The name was his own real name, not given by some "former master."

Bai Linlin readjusted his position on Song Yu's shoulder, shuffling a bit closer inward, but he couldn't help recalling what the human had said earlier.

—*So I can learn from them?*

*Why does that sound so subtly green-tea manipulative?*

However, the thought flitted away quickly. Bai Linlin suddenly remembered something important: back in this shop, which of those birds had insulted him?!

A gentleman's revenge is never too late, even a month later!

Song Yu was originally talking to the shop owner about bird-rearing tips, but the red leash wrapped around his fingers was suddenly yanked taut.

The little bird on his shoulder took flight!

"Chirp chirp chirp! Chirp chirp chirp chirp!"

Bai Linlin instantly claimed the highest vantage point—an ancient chandelier hanging from the ceiling—and began demanding answers from above.

[Who talked trash about me back then? Step forward right now!]

The various parrots across the shop started chattering. Some whispered amongst themselves, while others completely spaced out.

[Woah, how did it become so good-looking?]

[Hey, hey, is that your owner?]

The last question came from a purple-hued Lovebird, which twitched its tail and chirped a few times.

Bai Linlin didn't know what that tail-twitching gesture meant, but seeing a bird asking him, he replied:

[Yes.]

It was originally an ordinary conversation, but for some reason, a Cockatiel in the corner began talking shade.

[Just a bird riding on its human's coattails. What's there to be proud of?]

Bai Linlin narrowed his bird eyes. Memories from right after his reincarnation came rushing back like a tide. Back then, next to the fat, bald shop owner... it seemed to be this exact yellow one!

!

Now that he wasn't even human anymore, he certainly wasn't going to suffer any grievance! Vengeance had to be served!

And so, the bird executed a divebomb!

Song Yu didn't even have time to react; he only saw two fluffy balls tangled in a fierce brawl. The battle was intense, culminating in a single yellow feather drifting down through the air.

"Chirp chirp chirp chirp! Chirp chirp chirp!"

[Wow, you're amazing! So brave!]

The Lovebird praised him earnestly, twitching its tail once more with a touch of shyness.

Triumphant, Bai Linlin flapped his wings and landed on an empty perch nearby, leisurely preening his feathers with elegance.

The Cockatiel was pecked into a disheveled mess. Before it could even counter-attack, the store owner grabbed it and locked it in a cage.

And right at that moment—

"It must have been bullied here before. Otherwise, my bird wouldn't attack."

Song Yu spoke up before the shop owner could open his mouth. His face was cold and impassive, completely flabbergasting the owner.

Shop owner: ...

*I really wasn't gonna scam you this time!*

"It's very well-behaved at home."

Song Yu reiterated without the slightest hesitation, only frowning as he looked over at the wooden perch nearby.

Bai Linlin was chatting with the neighboring Lovebird, since it had greeted him first after all.

"Chirp chirp chirp chirp."

"Chirp chirp, chirp chirp chirp chirp chirp chirp."

[It was just too weak.]

[Mm-hmm! Your owner is so handsome.]

"Chirp?"

Bai Linlin froze on the spot and executed a tactical retreat. *What do you mean?*

At the same time, Song Yu was also knitting his brows, while the shop owner seized the business opportunity and immediately began pitching:

chunks.chineseText:
“牡丹也很好看的，那只是紫伊莎的，非常受欢迎的颜色，也很活泼。”

“鹦鹉其实是需要陪伴的，正好这只是母鸟，价格也不贵，你要是……”

宋郁面色微冷：“我不买。”

店老板愣了下，啊？

“粼粼。”

宋郁还是唤了一声，鸟仿佛这时候终于想起他了，扑棱翅膀飞了回来，又紧紧地站在他的肩头上。

“回去了。”

少年侧头同鸟轻声道。

店老板一脸不解，这什么也不买吗？

怪亏的。

但就在这时，店老板突然感觉到一股视线感，抬眼就对上了白粼粼。

鸟磨了磨喙，试图恐吓。

但那高中生一回头，那鸟立刻安安静静的，还会往人的脖子上歪。

“。”

店老板震惊，觉得虎口又传来隐隐的痛感。

幸好是送走了。

-

回家路上。

白粼粼是真的没有想到宋郁这么抢手，当初他可是看了支付宝余额才死心塌地的，现在的这群鸟，真是外貌主义协会！

不像他，只物质。

这下白粼粼觉得自己也茶茶的。

不过这次出门也不算完全没有收获，他还是学到了一些鸟类的肢体语言。

不就是贴贴？

白粼粼决定实践一下，毕竟宋郁只能有他一只小鸟，适当的，还是要给予一些“情绪价值”的。

要拴住人的心。

从而稳固鸟的地位。

此乃阳谋。

白粼粼在宋郁肩头活动了一下身体，开始慢慢地往里挪，脑袋也歪了歪。

起初一切正常。

宋郁中间还侧头了一次，用手护了下鸟的身体，因为旁边有个骑单车的人过去。

白粼粼继续往里挪，心想这还不简单，区区一个高中生，手拿把掐好吧？

但就在这时——

鸟也不知道是走神了还是怎么的，贴过头了，他的爪子已经站在了人的皮肤上。

但锁骨那块，很滑。

最后的场面不可控制。

人来人往的。

白粼粼最后的记忆是一顿扑棱翅膀，拂过宋郁的下巴和喉结，试图用爪子刹车，但又害怕弄伤对方。

最后一头栽进——

对方的T恤里。

宋郁本来是在好好地走着路，但现在，面无表情地停了下来。

“……”

腰腹处的肌肉有钝钝的戳感。

一下一下的。

鸟迷了路，在找出口。

作者有话说：

[鸽子][鸽子]：这里是哪里，叨叨叨……
chunks.englishText:
"Lovebirds are very pretty too! That one's a Violet Opaline, a super popular color mutation, and very lively!"

"Parrots actually need companionship. Conveniently, this one's a female, and the price isn't high. If you..."

Song Yu's tone turned slightly cold: "I'm not buying."

The store owner blinked. *Huh?*

"Linlin."

Song Yu called out softly. As if finally remembering him, the bird flapped its wings and flew back, perching snugly on his shoulder once more.

"We're going back."

The youth turned his head and spoke gently to the bird.

The shop owner was completely perplexed. *He's not buying anything at all?*

*What a waste of time.*

Just then, the shop owner felt a sharp gaze resting on him. Looking up, his eyes met Bai Linlin's.

The bird ground its beak, attempting an intimidation tactic.

Yet the moment the high school boy turned his head, the bird instantly went dead quiet and cuddled against the boy's neck.

"..."

The store owner was stunned, feeling a phantom throb of pain in the web of his hand again.

*Thank goodness he took it away.*

—

On the way home.

Bai Linlin really hadn't expected Song Yu to be so popular. Back then, he had only pledged his loyalty after looking at the kid's Alipay balance! These birds nowadays were such superficial shallow-pates!

Unlike him, who was purely pragmatic.

Now Bai Linlin felt that he was acting a bit like a green-tea snake himself.

However, this trip wasn't a total loss. He had managed to learn some avian body language.

*Isn't it just snuggling?*

Bai Linlin decided to put it into practice. After all, Song Yu could only have him as his sole little bird. Giving a little bit of "emotional value" was necessary.

He had to capture the human's heart.

To solidify his position as top bird.

This was an open, foolproof strategy!

Bai Linlin shifted his body on Song Yu's shoulder, shuffling closer to his neck and tilting his head.

At first, everything was normal.

Song Yu even turned his head once to shield the bird's body with his hand as a cyclist passed by.

Bai Linlin kept shuffling inward, thinking: *Isn't this a piece of cake? A mere high schooler—I've got him wrapped around my finger!*

Right at that moment—

Whether he zoned out or miscalculated, the bird leaned in too far, his feet stepping directly onto bare skin.

And the collarbone area was extremely slick.

The resulting situation spiraled out of control.

With people bustling all around...

Bai Linlin's last memory was a frantic flurry of flapping wings brush against Song Yu's chin and Adam's apple as he tried to brake with his claws—while simultaneously panicking about scratching the boy.

In the end, he dived headfirst—

—Right into the boy's T-shirt.

Song Yu was walking along normally, but now he stopped dead in his tracks, expressionless.

"..."

He felt a dull, poke-like sensation against his abdominal muscles.

Poke. Poke. Poke.

The bird was lost, trying to find an exit.

Author's Note:

[Pigeon][Pigeon]: Where am I? Peck peck peck...

chunks.chineseText:
第12章

最后是拐进了一个隐蔽的死角，白粼粼才被“解救”出来。

鸟坐在人的掌心，两个爪子朝外伸着，头顶圆滚滚的，羽毛蓬松。

有点呆。

“……”

“……”

其实是有一点尴尬的。

白粼粼很快反应过来了，灵活地蹦跶起来，开始伸展翅根，歪头梳理羽毛。

故技重施。

假装什么事情都没有发生过。

但人其实并没有太在意鸟心里的小九九，宋郁只是抬手把鸟头微微圈住了，蹙眉去看了看那个喙。

色泽光滑，结实有力。

看起来没有受伤。

也就在这时。

宋郁的指腹传来一阵钝钝的夹痛感。

他垂眸看过去，但鸟已经迅速地把短喙收回去了，然后把脑袋咻得一下卡进人手指围成的圈里。

开始自闭。

“……”

白粼粼叨人叨习惯了，一下子也没太反应过来，只好赶在对方看过来，缩起来。

不过高中生好像耐咬一些。

宋郁又抬手把他放到了肩头，只是轻声道：

“这次不要摔了。”

白粼粼鸟脸一红，调整好站姿，再也不动了。

那家店里的鸟纯不正经。

贴来贴去的，它们怎么没从栖杆上掉下去！

宋郁其实没有觉得小鸟叨人有什么坏处，毕竟它力气不大，指腹上还残留着点微弱的触感。

不过想到这里。

少年脚步一停。

腰部被戳的感觉好像又席卷过来，有点……奇怪。

“啾啾？”

宋郁闻声回了下神，侧头解释了下，“没事。”

一人一鸟步行回了家。

-

白粼粼回到家就把刚才那档子事给抛之脑后了，开始琢磨今天吃点什么好东西。

宋郁似乎有事，回来给他添完粮后就上楼了，独留给鸟一片自由空间。

白粼粼非常熟练地用喙拨了拨“五谷杂粮”，让它看上去又被叨过的痕迹。

随后大摇大摆地去了厨房。

但一无所获。

由于家里阿姨不在了，冰箱不再成为稳定的物资刷新点，白粼粼铩羽而归。

岛台上盘子里还装着粮食，白粼粼站过去叨了两口。

报吃。

他扑棱了下翅膀，决定去楼上找宋郁。

让人去点外卖！

卧室门是虚掩着的，或者说是从来没关过，因为宋郁后面发现只要一关，鸟就在门口努力地制造噪音，爪子扒拉半天。

况且鸟还要睡在卧室里的纸巾盒里的，一来二去人就养成了“留门”的习惯。

白粼粼此刻俨然一个走地鸡，拱着鸟头塞进门缝里，啪嗒啪嗒走进来了。

卧室里没人，只有不远处的洗手间有水流的动静。

洗澡？

今天怎么白天洗？

鸟往浴室门那里走了走，探头看了看里面，磨砂玻璃上全是雾气，人也不出来。

白粼粼想了想，只好扑棱翅膀去了桌子上，思索着要不要开一局游戏。

但时间应该不太够。

鸟最终决定放弃，打算继续回门口蹲人，但是刚一转头，余光看到了个东西。

四四方方，屏幕有着纯正的黑，但却泛着光泽。

俗称：手机。

白粼粼实在是很难抵抗这种诱惑，他扭头看了看浴室，很好，宋郁还在洗澡。

鸟走了过来。

探了探头。

手机屏幕上倒映着一个圆滚滚的鸟头。

白粼粼有些心虚，他记得宋郁的手机是没有密码的，他看起来也不太像是会看软件使用记录的。

那他……偷偷玩一下……

那塌方明星的瓜他还没有吃完，这么长时间过去了，吞了几个亿应该查出来了吧？

互联网的世界丰富多彩，对鸟的吸引力是不言而喻的。

白粼粼心里咳咳了两声，然后伸了下鸟腿，刚想准备动作——

但就在这时。

手机屏幕突然亮了。

鸟给吓了一跳，战术后撤，不过他定睛一看，发现原来是弹过来一条微信消息。

噢噢。

白粼粼放松了下来，他又往前走了几步，低头看了看，锁屏只是有微信提示，不显示内容。

鸟松了一口气，他只要不点到这个就可以了。

但或许是怕什么来什么，白粼粼用爪子往上一滑，结果页面直接给跳转了。

“……”

鸟腿悬停在半空中。

白粼粼已经来不及收回鸟眼了。

[江芮：转账60000]

[江芮：宋郁，你已经很大了，你要体谅妈妈。]

[江芮：你妹妹那个样子，我当然要再生一个，不然让宋启明看笑话吗？]

白粼粼还保持着金鸡独立的状态，他心想完了完了，这是隐私，不能看不能看。

鸟开始掩耳盗铃，闭着眼睛，伸腿试图切走这个页面。

但也就在这时，手机又嗡嗡震动了声。

又来了一条消息。

白粼粼滑页面的爪子抖了下。

与此同时，南城另外一处的别苑里，身着丝绸睡衣的女人在看消息。

秀眉微蹙。

手机页面上一条是她最新发的消息：

[那个小鸟真的不能给妈妈吗？小予她认准了那只。]

对方回复的是……

[宋郁：。。？]

江芮判断不出来这是什么意思，但难免有些烦躁，本来这段时间事情就多。

抑郁症……

那能是什么病？

才十几岁能有什么人生烦恼？

江芮实在是无法理解，尚美那里还有一大堆事等着她处理，下周还约了小予的医生。

自己都没有崩溃。

他一个孩子能出什么问题？

说到底还是宋启明个丧良心的。

江芮一想到前夫就胸口发闷，他能春风得意多久，华秉这几年很明显有下坡路的意思。

老爷子一醒，他和那狐狸精的好日子就到头了。

江芮把手机扔到了床上了，面色相当不愉，也就在这时，门口传来一顿哐哐乱砸的声音。

还伴随着些鸟类的嘶哑声。

外头保姆似乎是在哄，但像是无济于事。

江芮只能深呼吸一口气，调整了下面部表情，转而朝门口那里走去。

卧室里点有熏香，旁边的床头柜那里还摆着昂贵的珠宝，光线暗沉但奢靡。

门缝里有些透光，外面的场景很是温馨。

女人似乎在弯腰哄，一句一句道：

“哥哥会给你送过来的，为什么不喜欢这几个？”

“很好看的呀，也是蓝色的。”

断断续续的声音从门口传进卧室里，保姆的影子在靠近墙边的一侧，似乎在清扫什么东西。

-

白粼粼把这个页面切走后松了一口气，丝毫不知道自己误触了什么。

不过原来宋郁的妈妈叫江芮，刚才的消息好像还转钱了……

那这个关系是？

鸟想不通，后面也就不想了，开始正儿八经地去找短视频app，但翻了半天居然没找到。

手机屏幕自带的主题，没有游戏，没有娱乐软件。

“……”

白粼粼退而求其次，转而点开了淘宝，里面花花绿绿的商品一下子就弹出来了。

鸟的眼睛微微放大。

薯片！

奥利奥！

鱿鱼丝！

……
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 12

Only after turning into a hidden, quiet alleyway was Bai Linlin finally "rescued."

The bird sat in the boy's palm, both claws sticking outward, its round head fluffed up with feathers.

It looked rather dazed.

"..."

"..."

Truth be told, it was a little awkward.

Bai Linlin quickly snapped out of it, hopped up nimbly, stretched his wing roots, and tilted his head to preen his feathers.

Re-executing his old trick.

Pretending as if nothing had ever happened.

In truth, the youth didn't pay much attention to the bird's inner schemings. Song Yu merely cupped the bird's head loosely with his fingers, frowning as he inspected its beak.

Smooth color, sturdy and strong.

It didn't look injured.

Right at that moment—

Song Yu felt a dull, pinching pain on the pad of his finger.

He looked down, but the bird had already quickly pulled its short beak back, instantly popping its head into the loop formed by the youth's fingers.

Entering self-isolation mode.

"..."

Bai Linlin was so used to pecking people that he hadn't reacted in time. All he could do before the boy looked over was curl into a ball.

*Though high school boys do seem a bit tougher to bite.*

Song Yu raised his hand again and placed the bird back on his shoulder, merely saying in a soft voice:

"Don't fall this time."

Bai Linlin felt his bird face flush red. He adjusted his standing stance and froze completely still.

*Those birds in that shop were completely unrefined!*

*Snuggling and rubbing around—how come they didn't fall off their perches?!*

Song Yu actually didn't mind the bird pecking him. After all, it didn't use much force, leaving only a faint sensation lingering on his fingertip.

Though, speaking of which...

The youth paused in his steps.

The sensation of being poked around his waist seemed to surge back again. It felt... odd.

"Chirp chirp?"

Song Yu snapped back to reality at the sound, turning his head to explain, "It's nothing."

One human and one bird walked back home.

—

The moment he got home, Bai Linlin threw the incident out of his mind and started deliberating what good food he should eat today.

Song Yu seemed to have something to do. After refilling the bird's food bowl upon returning, he went upstairs, leaving the bird with a space of total freedom.

Bai Linlin skillfully nudged the mixed bird grains with his beak to make it look like it had been eaten.

Then he waddled proudly into the kitchen.

Only to return empty-handed.

Since the house housekeeper was no longer around, the refrigerator was no longer a reliable spawn point for supplies. Bai Linlin returned defeated.

A bowl of seed mix sat on the island counter. Bai Linlin flew over and took two pecks.

Tasted terrible.

Flapping his wings, he decided to head upstairs to find Song Yu.

And order delivery!

The bedroom door was left ajar—or rather, it was never fully closed. Song Yu had discovered that whenever he shut it, the bird would relentlessly make noise at the door, scratching away with its claws for ages.

Besides, the bird slept in the tissue box inside the bedroom anyway. Over time, the boy had developed the habit of leaving the door cracked open.

Looking like a walking chicken at this moment, Bai Linlin nudged his bird head through the crack and pattered inside.

There was no one in the bedroom. Only the sound of running water came from the nearby bathroom.

Showering?

Why take a shower during the day today?

The bird walked closer to the bathroom door and peeked in. The frosted glass was covered in steam, and the boy didn't come out.

Bai Linlin pondered for a bit, then flapped his wings onto the desk, wondering whether he should start a game.

But there probably wasn't enough time.

The bird ultimately decided to give up and plan to crouch by the door to wait for the human. But just as he turned his head, something caught the edge of his vision.

Square and sleek, its screen was pure black yet glistened faintly.

Commonly known as: a smartphone.

Bai Linlin could hardly resist such temptation. He turned to look at the bathroom—great, Song Yu was still showering.

The bird stepped closer.

He poked his head forward.

The phone screen reflected a round little bird head.

Bai Linlin felt a bit guilty. He remembered Song Yu's phone didn't have a passcode, and the boy didn't seem like the type to check app usage history.

So if he... played with it secretly for a moment...

He hadn't finished reading the gossip drama about that ruined celebrity yet! After all this time, the investigations into those hundreds of millions of embezzled yuan must have made progress, right?

The digital realm was colorful and vast, and its pull on a bird was self-evident.

Bai Linlin cleared his throat mentally, extended a bird leg, and prepared to make his move—

When suddenly—

The phone screen lit up.

The bird startled and executed a tactical retreat. But peering closer, he realized it was just a pop-up WeChat notification.

*Ah, okay.*

Bai Linlin relaxed. He took a few steps forward and looked down. The lock screen only showed a WeChat alert without displaying the content.

The bird breathed a sigh of relief. He just needed to avoid touching that banner.

Yet, as luck would have it, Bai Linlin swiped upward with his claw, and the screen jumped straight into the app!

"..."

The bird leg hovered frozen in midair.

It was too late for Bai Linlin to look away.

[Jiang Rui: Transfer ¥60,000]

[Jiang Rui: Song Yu, you're old enough now. You need to be understanding of your mother.]

[Jiang Rui: Given your sister's condition, of course I have to have another child. Otherwise, won't Song Qiming just laugh at us?]

Bai Linlin was still balancing on one leg. *Oh no, oh no,* he thought. *This is private! I shouldn't be looking at this!*

Playing the ostrich, the bird shut his eyes and stretched out his leg to try and switch away from the page.

Just then, the phone buzzed with another vibration.

Another message arrived.

The claw swiping the screen trembled slightly.

At the same time, in a villa elsewhere in Nancheng, a woman dressed in silk pajamas was staring at her phone.

Her delicate brows were subtly furrowed.

The last message sent on her phone screen read:

[Can't you really give that little bird to Mom? Xiaoyu has her heart set on that specific one.]

The response from the other side was...

[Song Yu: ..?]

Jiang Rui couldn't tell what that meant, which inevitably irked her. Things had been chaotic enough lately.

Depression...

What kind of illness was that anyway?

What kind of life troubles could a teenager possibly have?

Jiang Rui genuinely couldn't comprehend it. Shangmei still had a pile of affairs waiting for her attention, and she had an appointment with Xiaoyu's doctor next week.

She herself hadn't broken down yet.

How could a kid like him have any issues?

In the end, it was all Song Qiming's lack of conscience.

Just thinking of her ex-husband made Jiang Rui's chest tighten with frustration. How long could he stay riding high? Huabing had clearly been on a downward trend over the past few years.

Once the old master woke up, his and that vixen's good days would come to an end.

Jiang Rui tossed her phone onto the bed, her face dark with displeasure. Right at that moment, a loud bang and crashing echoed from outside the bedroom door.

Accompanied by the raspy screeches of birds.

Outside, the nanny seemed to be trying to soothe someone, but it appeared to be in vain.

Jiang Rui could only take a deep breath, adjust her expression, and walk toward the door.

Incense burned quietly inside the bedroom, and expensive jewelry sat on the nightstand beside the bed. The lighting was dim, yet extravagant.

Light trickled through the door gap, presenting a seemingly warm scene outside.

The woman seemed to bend down to coo gently, speaking sentence by sentence:

"Brother will send it over for you. Why don't you like these ones?"

"They're very pretty, and they're blue too."

Fragmented voices wafted from the hallway into the bedroom. The nanny's silhouette hovered near the wall, seemingly sweeping up something off the floor.

—

Bai Linlin let out a sigh of relief after closing the page, completely unaware of what he had accidentally tapped.

*So Song Yu's mother is named Jiang Rui, and that message earlier seemed to involve a money transfer...*

*So what kind of family dynamic is this?*

The bird couldn't figure it out, so he stopped overthinking it and began searching earnestly for short video apps. However, after scrolling for ages, he couldn't find a single one.

The phone ran a stock theme without a single game or entertainment app installed.

"..."

Settling for the next best thing, Bai Linlin tapped open Taobao instead, and a colorful array of items instantly popped up.

The bird's eyes widened slightly.

Potato chips!

Oreos!

Shredded squid!

...

chunks.chineseText:
琳琅满目，鸟看得着了迷、忘了情，甚至开始丝滑地用鸟腿刷主页，还自动把看中的东西加入了购物车。

等到准备付款的时候才一下子反应过来，他密码都快要输完了。

[4-5-3-2-8-6]

白粼粼记得牢固无比，觉得羞愧难当，最后赶紧取消了支付页面。

在桌子上蹦跶了两下。

！

什么时候鸟可以拥有一部手机！

白粼粼有点沮丧，他不应该对别人的钱有这么大的占有欲。

但如果，就是说如果，宋郁可以给他买一台iphone最新版呢？

鸟畅想着未来。

不过现在还有另外一件事，白粼粼歪头看了看浴室，里面的水声已经停了。

完事了？

鸟扑棱扑棱翅膀，非常安全地降落。

“啾啾？”

宋郁蹙眉看了下门口，磨砂玻璃的外侧有个圆滚滚的身影，他抬手拿了下毛巾。

简单擦了下脸，修长的手指穿插过发丝，往上捋了下，露出光洁的额头。

“啾啾啾啾。”

外面还在催促。

宋郁有些轻微的怔然，但还是收拾得快了些，换好衣服后打开了门，低头看了过去。

果不其然门口站着一只板板正正的小鸟，在仰头看他。

并且由于地板上有水汽，鸟腿还在匀速地劈叉。

“怎么了？”

宋郁蹲下身子，开口问道，面容在逆光下显得轮廓分明，他伸了手指过去。

鸟立马抬腿上来了。

白粼粼的目标只有一个，他也要洗澡！

鸟很爱干净的，每天都兢兢业业地梳理羽毛，雷打不动。

但白粼粼总觉得这不算真正地洗澡，他也要进大浴缸，也要用香波波。

“啾啾！”

心动不如行动，鸟扑棱翅膀飞了起来，叼着宋郁的衣服，往里扯。

人虽然不解，但还是跟着走了。

直到鸟站在了淋浴的把手那里，开始抖了抖身子，羽毛一点点地蓬松。

最后成了个炸毛球。

宋郁愣住了。

-

最后还是给黎笙拍了照片，那边回复倒是很快。

[黎笙：鹦鹉会洗澡的，和尚这个品种本来就很爱玩水的，你可以给它弄个小小的‘浴缸’？]

[黎笙：流动的水也可以，它自己会蓬毛的。]

宋郁侧眸看了下淋浴把手上的那只，已经圆滚滚的，成了两倍大了。

白粼粼歪了歪头，他其实是想要人给他放水，但不知道宋郁怎么拿手机了？

鸟有些紧张，在淋浴把手上又调整了下站姿。

他购物车好像忘记删了……

“要洗澡？”

白粼粼闻言松了一口气，“人”看来没有发现，于是鸟点了点头。

羽毛又蓬了一个度。

抖了抖身子。

宋郁再度有种奇怪的感觉，原本冷白的脸上泛起些红晕，他从来没有照顾过……人或者动物洗过澡。

这是比较亲密的行为。

只发生在信任与被信任的关系下。

但也就在这么愣神的时候，耳边再度传来“啾啾”的声音。

圆滚滚的鸟已经伸出了爪子。

歪头看过来了。

宋郁身体先一步行动，反应过来的时候，手指上已经托着一个沉甸甸的小鸟，爪子包裹得很紧实。

羽毛也软软的。

“啾啾啾！”

[要洗澡。]

白粼粼又仰头看了看淋浴头，这次人终于反应过来了。

给开了。

不过调整了好长时间的水温。

宋郁其实在反应过来鸟要在他手上洗的时候，气血都有些上涌，他很难不不去想：

小鸟都这么聪明的？

还会找人？

而后又自己纠正：

不是。

是只有他的小鸟是聪明的……

宋郁几乎有些走神，直到虎口传来点微微的戳感，回头一看，鸟正专心致志地叨着。

白粼粼咬得很爽。

很解压。

但一抬鸟头——

“……”

“……”

最后还是如愿洗上澡了，淋浴开得很小，白粼粼一点点地往水流那里挪。

开始伸了伸翅膀，羽毛蓬松极了，一秒，两秒……鸟开始沉浸甩水。

哗啦啦。

鸟一开始还有些拘谨，后面就完全沉浸了，水温适宜，抖起来更是不知天地为何物。

最后甚至有些重心不稳。

啪唧翻了。

但好在“人”一直看着，稳当当地托着了，鸟的短喙正好插在两个手指之间。

白粼粼有点缺氧，爪子一伸，直接躺板板。

但被很轻松地提了起来。

宋郁在说话：

“还洗不洗了？”

“你洗得很好。”

鸟不解，这有什么可夸奖的，但还是很骄傲地挺了下身躯。

“啾啾！”

[当然！]

白粼粼最后迷迷糊糊地爬上了人的肩头，闭上了眼睛，后面的事情就不太清楚了。

宋郁在发现鸟在他肩头睡着了之后，就没有怎么大动过。

小鸟脑袋歪着，短喙就这么戳着他的脖子。

歪歪地贴着人。

宋郁大脑一片空白，甚至觉得皮肤里血液都在流动，很热。

他几乎没有什么犹豫，拿起来手机打开了购物软件。

买了些东西。

[鹦鹉小澡盆。]

[鹦鹉专用沐浴露。]

[鹦鹉保温箱。]

这些都还算是正常的，后面几乎就是全部买了些相关的东西，宋郁只是觉得或许……或许它喜欢呢？

[鹦鹉奶粉。]

[鹦鹉迷你小窝。]

[鹦鹉针织小围兜。]

[鹦鹉小秋千。]

[……]

买到最后，宋郁又看到了些新的东西。

[鹦鹉钥匙扣。]

[鹦鹉相框。]

[鹦鹉木头雕塑。]

人有些走火入魔，直到肩头有轻轻的咂巴声才回了回神。

宋郁这才没有继续再挑下去了，只是侧头看了看鸟，好在是没有吵醒，还在睡。

他垂眸准备付款，购物车上面全部是鹦鹉的用品，因而也就没有往下滑。

直接全部结算了。

作者有话说：

[鸽子][鸽子]：不费吹灰之力清空购物车！
chunks.englishText:
A dazzling array of items met his eyes, leaving the bird completely captivated and entranced. He even began swiping through the app’s homepage with a smooth flick of his little bird leg, automatically adding whatever caught his fancy into the shopping cart.

He only snapped back to reality when it was time to pay—he was nearly done entering the password!

[4-5-3-2-8-6]

Bai Linlin remembered the numbers with absolute precision and felt utterly mortified. In a panic, he quickly cancelled the payment screen.

He hopped on the table twice.

*Gasp!*

When could a bird finally have a phone of his own?!

Bai Linlin felt a bit dejected. He really shouldn't be so possessive of someone else's money.

But what if—just what if—Song Yu could buy him the latest iPhone model?

The bird indulged in sweet fantasies of the future.

However, there was another urgent matter right now. Bai Linlin tilted his head to look at the bathroom; the sound of running water inside had stopped.

Done already?

Fluttering his wings, the bird landed safely on the floor.

"Chirp chirp?"

Song Yu frowned as he glanced toward the door. Through the frosted glass, he could see a round, chubby silhouette. He reached for a towel.

After quickly wiping his face, he ran his long, slender fingers through his damp hair, pushing it back to reveal a smooth, pristine forehead.

"Chirp chirp chirp chirp."

The little creature outside was still urging him.

Song Yu felt a slight moment of daze, but he sped up his movements nonetheless. Once dressed, he opened the door and looked down.

Sure enough, a small bird stood there, rigid and proper, looking up at him.

And because the floor was damp with steam, its little bird legs were steadily sliding into a split at a constant speed.

"What's wrong?"

Song Yu squatted down and asked, his features clearly defined against the backlight. He extended a finger toward it.

The bird immediately stepped up onto it.

Bai Linlin had only one goal: he wanted to take a bath too!

Birds were naturally very clean. He painstakingly preened his feathers every single day without fail.

However, Bai Linlin always felt that preening didn't count as a real bath. He wanted to get into a big bathtub too, and he wanted to use scented shampoo!

"Chirp chirp!"

Action spoke louder than words. The bird fluttered his wings into the air, grabbed Song Yu's clothes with his beak, and tugged him inward.

Though puzzled, the young man followed along.

It wasn't until the bird stood atop the shower handle, shivering his little body as his feathers puffed out bit by bit...

Eventually turning into a frizzy, fluffy ball.

Song Yu froze.

-

In the end, Song Yu snapped a photo and sent it to Li Sheng, who replied almost instantly.

[Li Sheng: Parrots know how to take baths! Monk parakeets love playing in water by nature. Why don't you make a tiny 'bathtub' for it?]

[Li Sheng: Running water works too. It'll puff up its feathers on its own.]

Song Yu glanced sideways at the bird perched on the shower handle. It was already round and plump, looking twice its usual size.

Bai Linlin tilted his head. He actually wanted the human to run the water for him, but why was Song Yu staring at his phone instead?

The bird felt a little nervous and adjusted his posture on the shower handle.

He seemed to have forgotten to clear his shopping cart...

"You want a bath?"

Hearing this, Bai Linlin let out a sigh of relief. It seemed the "human" hadn't noticed. Thus, the bird nodded.

His feathers puffed up another notch.

He shook his body.

Song Yu once again experienced a strange sensation. A faint flush crept onto his pale, cool face. He had never taken care of... a person or an animal taking a bath before.

This was quite an intimate act.

It only happened in a relationship built on mutual trust.

Yet right as he was lost in thought, the sound of "chirp chirp" echoed in his ears once more.

The chubby bird had already extended a claw.

It tilted its head, looking over.

Song Yu's body acted before his mind could catch up. By the time he realized what he was doing, a heavy little bird was already resting on his finger, its claws gripping tightly.

Its feathers felt impossibly soft.

"Chirp chirp chirp!"

[*I want to take a bath.*]

Bai Linlin looked up at the showerhead again. This time, the human finally got the hint.

He turned on the water.

However, it took him a long time to adjust the water temperature.

Truth be told, when Song Yu realized the bird intended to take a bath in his hands, a surge of blood rushed to his face. He couldn't help but wonder:

*Are little birds really this smart?*

*They even know how to ask people for help?*

Then he corrected himself:

*No.*

*Only his little bird is this smart...*

Song Yu was practically zoning out until he felt a tiny, gentle pecking sensation on the web of his hand between his thumb and index finger. Turning his head, he saw the bird intently pecking away.

Bai Linlin found nibbling on him quite satisfying.

It was very stress-relieving.

However, the moment he raised his bird head—

"..."

"..."

In the end, he got to take a bath just as he wished. The shower was set to a gentle trickle, and Bai Linlin slowly waddled toward the stream of water.

He began stretching his wings, his feathers fluffed up to the extreme. One second, two seconds... The bird became completely immersed in shaking off the water.

*Splish splash.*

The bird was a bit reserved at first, but soon he surrendered himself entirely to the experience. The water temperature was perfect, and as he shook his feathers, he forgot everything else in the universe.

In the end, he even lost his center of gravity.

*Plop!* He flipped right over.

Fortunately, the "human" had been watching the entire time and caught him securely in his palm. The bird's short beak happened to get wedged right between two fingers.

Short on oxygen, Bai Linlin stretched out his claws and played dead on his back.

Yet he was easily lifted up.

Song Yu spoke up:

"Are you still bathing?"

"You're doing a great job."

The bird was baffled. What was there to praise about this? Still, he proudly puffed out his little chest.

"Chirp chirp!"

[*Of course!*]

In a daze, Bai Linlin eventually scrambled onto the human's shoulder and closed his eyes, oblivious to everything that followed.

Once Song Yu realized the bird had fallen asleep on his shoulder, he barely made a sound or moved an inch.

The little bird's head was tilted, its short beak propping against his neck.

It leaned snugly against him at an angle.

Song Yu's mind went completely blank. He could even feel the warm blood pulsing beneath his skin, burning hot.

With almost no hesitation, he pulled out his phone and opened the shopping app.

He purchased a few items.

[Mini Bathtub for Parrots.]

[Parrot-Specific Body Wash.]

[Parrot Incubator.]

These were all fairly normal. However, almost everything he bought after that was related in some way. Song Yu simply thought that maybe... just maybe, it might like them?

[Parrot Formula Milk Powder.]

[Mini Parrot Nest.]

[Knitted Parrot Bib.]

[Mini Parrot Swing.]

[...]

Toward the end, Song Yu spotted even more novelty items.

[Parrot Keychain.]

[Parrot Photo Frame.]

[Wooden Parrot Sculpture.]

The young man seemed utterly entranced until a soft smacking sound from his shoulder snapped him back to reality.

Only then did Song Yu stop browsing. He turned his head slightly to check on the bird. Fortunately, he hadn't woken it up; it was still sound asleep.

He lowered his eyes, preparing to check out. The shopping cart was filled entirely with parrot supplies, so he didn't bother scrolling down further.

He simply paid for the entire cart at once.

The author has something to say:
[Pigeon][Pigeon]: Cleared out the shopping cart without lifting a finger!

第13章

大约是过了几天，宋郁在家里收拾快递的时候，接到了来自S州的电话。

“小郁，最近还好吗？你的小鸟取名字了没？”

陈开鹤此刻在S州大学提供的公寓里，电脑屏幕上还有些有关鸟类迁徙的数据曲线，他整个人精气神都非常足，想着同宋郁联系一下。

毕竟医院这里有了好情况，老宋说不定过几个月就清醒了，这宋启明总算是没完全丢了良心。

不过他也不敢冒昧地告诉宋郁这件事，万一又是上次那样空欢喜一场就不好了。

孩子也快高考了……

电话那头传来了温和的问好，而后才回答了问题：

“粼粼，它叫粼粼。”

陈开鹤抬了抬眉头，语气很是慈祥，拿着手机道：“‘林林’，树木丛生，不错不错，五行属木，耐活。”

但电话那头沉默了下，还是解释道：

“是波光粼粼的粼粼。”

“应该……属水？”

陈开鹤怔了下，随即就是大笑起来，说自己搞错了，不过他倒是认真想了想：

“属水，我想想啊，金利水，爷爷家里正好有个小金锁，给小鸟拿着玩吧？”

“我让小齐给你送过来！”

后半句老头子越想越好，像是自我肯定了一样。

宋郁听完就蹙了蹙眉，放下了手上的裁纸刀，只是婉拒道：

“那太贵重了，它……就是个小鸟。”

白粼粼正在茶几上勤勤恳恳地叨快递盒子，捕捉到关键词之后停了动作，歪头看了过来。

宋郁今天穿着很是简约，一件普通的白色衬衫，袖口微微往上挽了挽，显得很青春洋溢。

不过还在打电话。

“您早些休息吧，齐思扬肯定也很忙，陈爷爷，这也不太好……”

但话还没说完，宋郁肩头就一沉，侧眸一看，黑松石一样的鸟眼正圆圆地盯看着自己。

鸟也要听。

“哎，小郁不会的！小齐这学期没那么忙的，我和那孩子处得不错，他女朋友还是我这老头子撮合的。”

“送个东西而已，不必担心。”

宋郁这才回了回神，但眉毛还是蹙着，金子有点太过了。

白粼粼见人没有让他下去，于是就靠里挪了下位置，鸟头也往那边歪了歪，靠近手机的听筒。

电话那头是个老头子的声音：

“欸，这又不贵，小动物可比孩子好伺候多了，给个小金锁戴戴怎么了？”

“噢不过太重的话，你挂在它的小房子里，图个好兆头嘛！”

白粼粼愣了下，鸟脑加载中，金子……给鸟吗？

但就在这时，宋郁还在婉拒，声音很透彻：

“陈爷爷，它就是个小鸟，要金子其实也没——”

白粼粼着急！

“啾啾啾！”

“啾啾啾啾啾！”

鸟甚至开始扑棱翅膀，叨了下宋郁的手指，意图不言而喻。

[要要要！]

[鸟要小金锁！]

[给鸟戴！]

宋郁根本说不了多少话，对面的人更是高兴了，说小鸟叫起来真有劲。

最后更是压根不听“拒绝”的说辞了。

老爷子只顾输出：

“噢噢，时间不早了，我要睡觉了，对了，我让小齐再给你带本书。”

立马挂了。

宋郁深吸一口气，最后也没什么办法，只是抬手接了下半空中的鸟，也是奇怪，电话一挂，它就不啾啾了。

此刻很是乖巧地站在他的掌心，仰头看人。

脑袋圆圆，鸟腿一个直立，一个斜着，看起来有种拽拽的感觉。

“饿了吗？”

“。”

宋郁把鸟又放到了茶几上，接着拆快递，东西其实不少，物业那里从早上就上门送了一次，待会估计还要送。

白粼粼心里美美的，在茶几上啪嗒啪嗒走了几步，心心念念着自己的小金锁。

嘿嘿嘿。

不过就在这时——

“我买这个了么？”

少年喃喃自语，几乎有些不太明白，因为那是一袋卫龙辣条。

白粼粼闻声扭头一看，鸟眼都亮了亮！

往前啪嗒啪嗒又走了几步，扑棱翅膀飞到人肩头了。

低头去看快递。

！

鸟爱吃！

宋郁俯身半蹲着，面色有些困惑，但他看了盒子的地址，是自己家没错。

他之前加购物车了？

还是app自动加的？

肩头沉甸甸的，鸟又站过来了，不过宋郁的担心自己姿势太靠下，用手往上托了托鸟。

但也就是这个动作——

碰到鸟的胸脯了。

人有点微愣，因为手指传来的触感非常……舒服，一层层的羽毛，很厚实，非常软，还回弹。

宋郁没怎么碰过这里，不过鸟没太在意，只是用喙撑了下人的手指，稳稳当当地站好了。

“啾啾！”

宋郁这才收回了手，把那袋子卫龙辣条放桌上了，心想可能是自己之前误点了。

但很快事情就不对了起来……

乐事薯片一箱。

劲仔小鱼一箱。

无骨凤爪四袋。

白桃乌龙气泡水一提。

拆一个，困惑一个。

宋郁整个人都有些恍惚，因为后面拆的全是零食，什么干果、酸奶、肉脯、辣条、饼干……全品类了。

他被大数据杀熟了？

白粼粼整只鸟都美了，飞到茶几上走来走去的，心想真是美梦成真了，低头就开始叨叨叨。

不过就在快要把辣条包装袋撕开个口子的时候，上方传来少年不解的声音。

“我什么时候加购物车这么多零食……”

鸟的动作一顿。

白粼粼非常谨慎地没再叨包装袋了，而是战略性地后挪了下，咳咳，这个这个这个……

都和鸟没有关系！

宋郁觉得很奇怪，他本来就不怎么热衷购物，零食……怎么会添加这么多？

或许是鬼使神差，他看了眼桌子上的鸟。

“……”

“……”

白粼粼仰着头，圆滚滚的，有些拘谨。

“怎么可能？”

宋郁蹙眉自言自语道，觉得自己异想天开，它只是个小鸟……

但这个思绪刚一过去。

——小鸟还会打游戏。

宋郁总是会选择性忽略那些不合理的事情，以至于现在强制性地回顾起来了，整个人都有点宕机。

少年微微俯身蹲下，和茶几上的某只视线齐平。

“……”

“……”

白粼粼胸膛挺立，歪了歪鸟头，咳咳咳。

不过也就在这时，门铃响了。

-

齐思扬是来送东西的，不过看到门口物业人员还是吃了一惊，一堆快递，甚至用的小推车。

宋郁开门先是打了招呼，而后给了物业人员上门费，言行举止都很礼貌，看着状态好了很多。

不过就是肩头那只存在感实在太强了。

一会低头看手机屏幕。

一会歪头梳理羽毛的。

一会……

好的，现在抬头看他了。

齐思扬收回了视线，同宋郁点了下头，不过还是问了下，“你买这么多东西？”

他顺手拿了些，替人搬了进去，低头看了看箱子标签，全部都是鹦鹉相关的。

“……”

行吧。

“也还好”，宋郁停顿了下，最后纠正道，“只是一些必需品。”

Chapter 13

A few days later, while Song Yu was tidying up delivery boxes at home, he received a phone call from S Province.

"Xiao Yu, how have you been lately? Have you named your little bird yet?"

Chen Kaihe was currently in an apartment provided by S Province University. On his computer screen were data curves regarding bird migration. He was full of energy and thought he would check in on Song Yu.

After all, things had taken a turn for the better at the hospital. Old Song might wake up in a few months, proving that Song Qiming hadn't completely lost his conscience after all.

However, he didn't dare rashly share this news with Song Yu. It would be terrible if it turned out to be another false alarm like last time.

Besides, the boy was about to take his college entrance exams...

A warm greeting came from the other end of the line before answering the question:

"Linlin. Its name is Linlin."

Chen Kaihe raised his eyebrows and spoke into his phone in a fond, grandfatherly tone: "'Linlin'—as in lush, thriving trees? Not bad, not bad at all! It belongs to the Wood element, strong and resilient!"

However, the other end went silent for a moment before explaining:

"It's Linlin as in 'glistening ripples on water'."

"It should... belong to the Water element?"

Chen Kaihe froze briefly before bursting into hearty laughter, admitting he had gotten it wrong. Still, he gave it some serious thought:

"Belongs to Water, huh? Let me think... Metal generates Water! It just so happens that I have a little gold lock at home. Why don't I give it to the little bird to play with?"

"I'll have Xiao Qi bring it over to you!"

The more the old man thought about his idea, the better it sounded to him, as if seeking self-validation.

Song Yu frowned upon hearing this and set down the utility knife in his hand, politely declining:

"That's far too valuable. It's... just a small bird."

Bai Linlin was diligently pecking at a delivery box on the coffee table. Upon catching the key phrase, he paused his movements, tilted his head, and looked over.

Song Yu was dressed very simply today, wearing an ordinary white shirt with the sleeves lightly rolled up, exuding a bright, youthful vibe.

He was still on the phone, though.

"You should get some rest early. Qi Siyang must be very busy too. Grandpa Chen, this really isn't appropriate..."

Before he could finish his sentence, Song Yu felt a weight on his shoulder. He glanced sideways to find two round, obsidian-like bird eyes staring intently at him.

The bird wanted to listen too.

"Ah, Xiao Yu, not at all! Xiao Qi isn't that busy this semester. I get along great with that kid, and I was even the matchmaker for him and his girlfriend!"

"It's just delivering an item, nothing to worry about."

Only then did Song Yu snap back to reality, though his brow remained furrowed. Gold was a bit too excessive.

Seeing that the human wasn't telling him to get down, Bai Linlin shifted his position slightly inward. He tilted his head toward the receiver of the phone.

The voice of an old man came through the speaker:

"Aiya, it's not expensive at all! Little animals are much easier to cater to than children. What's wrong with giving it a little gold lock to wear?"

"Oh, if it's too heavy, you can just hang it up in its little house to bring good fortune!"

Bai Linlin froze, his bird brain processing the information... Gold... for a bird?

Just then, Song Yu was still attempting to decline, his voice crisp and clear:

"Grandpa Chen, it really is just a small bird. It doesn't actually need gold—"

Bai Linlin grew anxious!

"Chirp chirp chirp!"

"Chirp chirp chirp chirp chirp!"

The bird even began fluttering his wings, pecking at Song Yu's finger with a glaringly obvious intention.

[*I want it, I want it, I want it!*]

[*Bird wants the little gold lock!*]

[*Put it on the bird!*]

Song Yu could hardly get a word in edgewise, and the person on the other end became even happier, remarking on how energetic the little bird's chirps sounded.

In the end, the old man completely ignored all attempts at refusal.

He simply blurted out:

"Alright, alright, it's getting late and I need to head to sleep. Oh right, I'll have Xiao Qi bring a book over for you as well."

And he hung up immediately.

Song Yu took a deep breath, helpless in the end. He could only raise his hand to catch the bird mid-air. Strangely enough, the moment the call ended, it stopped chirping altogether.

Right now, it stood obediently in his palm, looking up at him.

Its head was round, one bird leg standing straight while the other leaned at an angle, giving it an oddly smug look.

"Are you hungry?"

"..."

Song Yu placed the bird back onto the coffee table and resumed unboxing the packages. There were quite a few items. The property management staff had delivered a batch earlier that morning and would likely bring more later.

Bai Linlin felt delighted inside. He strutted back and forth on the coffee table with pitter-patter steps, his mind consumed by thoughts of his little gold lock.

Hehehe.

Just at that moment—

"Did I buy this?"

The youth muttered to himself, utterly bewildered, because what he held in his hand was a bag of Weilong spicy gluten sticks.

Hearing this, Bai Linlin turned his head to look, his bird eyes sparkling instantly!

He took a few more pitter-patter steps forward, navy wings fluttering as he flew up onto the youth's shoulder.

He looked down at the package.

*Gasp!*

The bird loved eating these!

Song Yu crouched down halfway, a confused expression on his face. However, he checked the address on the box, and it was indeed his home.

Had he added it to his cart before?

Or had the app added it automatically?

His shoulder felt heavy as the bird perched on him once more. Worried that his posture was too low, Song Yu reached up with his hand to support the bird.

Yet that very motion—

Touched the bird's chest.

The youth froze slightly. The touch against his finger was unbelievably... comfortable. Layers upon layers of thick, exceptionally soft feathers that bounced right back.

Song Yu had rarely touched this spot before. The bird, however, didn't mind much, merely bracing against the youth's finger with his beak to stand firmly.

"Chirp chirp!"

Only then did Song Yu withdraw his hand. He set the bag of spicy sticks on the table, assuming he must have accidentally tapped it earlier.

However, things quickly took a strange turn...

A box of Lay's potato chips.

A box of Jinzai small dried fish.

Four bags of boneless chicken feet.

A pack of White Peach Oolong sparkling water.

Unboxing one yielded another wave of confusion.

Song Yu felt completely dazed, because everything he unboxed afterward was snacks—dried nuts, yogurt, jerky, spicy sticks, biscuits... an entire spectrum of treats.

Had he been targeted by big data algorithms?

Bai Linlin was living his absolute best life. He flew onto the coffee table, pacing back and forth, thinking that a dream had truly come true. He lowered his head and began pecking frantically at the packaging.

However, just as he was about to tear a hole in the bag of spicy sticks, the youth's perplexed voice sounded from above.

"When on earth did I add so many snacks to my cart..."

The bird's movements stiffened.

Bai Linlin very cautiously stopped pecking at the packaging and strategically shifted backward. *Ahem, cough, cough...* This, this, this...

Had nothing to do with the bird!

Song Yu felt it was extremely bizarre. He had never been fond of shopping, so why would he add so many snacks to his cart?

Perhaps driven by some strange impulse, he glanced at the bird on the table.

"..."

"..."

Bai Linlin held his head high, looking round, plump, and a bit fidgety.

"How could that be possible?"

Song Yu frowned and muttered to himself, thinking he was indulging in wild fantasies. It was just a small bird...

Yet no sooner had that thought crossed his mind—

*—The little bird even knows how to play video games.*

Song Yu always selectively ignored absurd anomalies, to the point that forced retrospection now left his entire system temporarily paralyzed.

The youth bent over slightly and crouched down, bringing his gaze level with the creature on the coffee table.

"..."

"..."

Bai Linlin puffed out his chest, tilted his bird head, and cleared his throat awkwardly.

Right at that moment, the doorbell rang.

-

Qi Siyang had come to drop off the items. However, he was still taken aback upon seeing the property staff at the door—a mountain of delivery boxes had been loaded onto a trolley.

Song Yu opened the door, greeted them first, and paid the staff a delivery fee. His manners were impeccable, and he appeared to be in a much better state.

It was just that the bird on his shoulder possessed far too strong a presence.

One moment it was leaning down to look at a phone screen.

The next, it tilted its head to preen its feathers.

The next...

Alright, now it was looking up at him.

Qi Siyang pulled his gaze back and nodded at Song Yu, though he couldn't help asking, "Did you buy this many things?"

He reached out to help carry a few boxes inside. Glancing down at the labels, he saw that they were all parrot-related supplies.

"..."

Fine then.

"It's not that much," Song Yu paused briefly before clarifying, "Just some daily necessities."

chunks.chineseText:
齐思扬进到客厅后看到还有一堆箱子后直接愣住了，不过里面这些好像不是鹦鹉用品，他松了口气。

这凡事都有度。

太溺爱了也不好。

不过想起来自己来送什么东西的时候，还是沉默了。

盒子里放着一个小金锁，黑绳串着，看着很是精美。

齐思扬其实很难控制得住，“我也不知道我老师怎么想的，这……这不沉吗？”

“我说过了，但他老人家不听。”

二人在这么闲聊着，鸟已经从宋郁的肩头飞下来了，啪嗒啪嗒走到那个盒子那里。

观察ing。

“噢，对了，老师还让我给你带本书，鹦鹉学舌的，他听说你的小鸟不太爱说话，特地找的。”

齐思扬递了过去，环着臂膀看了下茶几上的箱子，上头还放着一袋软糖。

青年的确有些意外，但后来想想也正常，宋郁也就是个高中生。

“给我一袋呗？”齐思扬转头看向宋郁，开玩笑道。

“当然可以。”

宋郁在低头看那本书，头也不抬地道。

但就在这时——

齐思扬弯腰的时候，发出了点困惑的声音。

“嗯？”

宋郁顺着视线看过去，鸟正站在旁边，爪子按着那个糖的包装袋，仰头看着人。

羽毛蓬松，身姿挺立。

脖子上套着金坠子。

“……”

然而白粼粼没有捍卫成功，被宋郁一下子捞起来了，放到了人的肩头。

“我回头给你买新的。”少年不由自主地就说出来了，低头看着鸟，自己都愣了下。

白粼粼刚刚专心套金坠子，没太认真听人讲话，不知道齐思扬获得了“允许”。

思考了下。

点了点头。

齐思扬不知道为什么，他总觉得自己不应该在这里。

但鸟似乎反应过来了，歪头看了过来，扑棱翅膀飞到茶几上，叼着那袋子东西过来了，一个用力甩。

人，送你。

-

齐思扬实在很难形容自己现在的感受，他的肩头也多了只东西，没太敢动。

白粼粼歪头看了看这个人，多大了，还要吃糖？

但他很有品味，这是鸟最喜欢的一个口味，宋郁原来买过的，限量而且贵贵。

吃吧吃吧！

但这个“人”不吃。

鸟观察了下，攀爬到对方的手臂上，认真地给包装袋咬出来个口子，又歪头去看齐思扬。

这怎么还不吃？

但是他还没观察多久，整只就被捞走了，宋郁微微蹙了下眉，不过也就那么一秒。

“它平常很乖的，不随便上别人身上。”

“不好意思。”

鸟再度回到了原来的领地，调整了下位置，开始专心致志地梳理羽毛。

还打个哈欠。

齐思扬听到宋郁的解释后连忙点了点头，不过还是很难不被那只小鸟吸引。

金坠子……它自己戴的？

宋郁：“老师还有让你转告些什么吗？”

齐思扬回了回神，把视线收回来了，“啊？”

“没有了。”

齐思扬像是反应过来什么，确实时间不早了，下午还有个学术会议。

他低头看了这袋子糖，说实话一开始只是想拿一块，没想着带一整袋的。

但是现在……

鸟都拆开了。

齐思扬想了下，举着那袋子糖同宋郁晃了晃，笑着道：

“那多谢了。”

“……”

终于走了。

-

白粼粼心里还是美美的，在那人走了之后，就从宋郁肩头飞下来了，开始站在茶几上“走秀”。

小金锁是实心的。

沉甸甸的。

鸟死活不愿意放下。

宋郁弯腰试图给摘下来，但每次都被叨了指腹，钝钝的夹感，不痛的那种。

他垂眸看着，手指还是没有收回来。

白粼粼走两步，被挡一步，最后气得叨住不放开了。

然后就被提起来了。

鸟爪晃晃悠悠的。

最后安稳地落在了“人”的掌心，宋郁面色平和，手指这才被放开，已经叨出来个红印。

很有劲。

也就在这时——

“喜欢金子？”

“我给你买。”

作者有话说：

ps：那金锁是比较迷你的，陈老银行老客户，送的。
chunks.englishText:
When Qi Siyang entered the living room and saw another pile of boxes inside, he was utterly stunned. However, realizing those weren't parrot supplies made him breathe a sigh of relief.

Everything required moderation.

Overindulgence was never a good thing.

Still, when he remembered what he was here to deliver, he fell silent again.

Inside a small box lay a tiny golden lock threaded on a black cord, looking exquisitely crafted.

Qi Siyang found it hard to hold back: "I really don't know what my professor was thinking. Isn't this... too heavy?"

"I told him, but he wouldn't listen."

As the two chatted casually, the bird had already flown down from Song Yu's shoulder, taking pitter-patter steps toward the box.

Currently observing.

"Oh, right. Professor also asked me to bring you a book on teaching parrots to talk. He heard your little bird isn't much of a talker, so he specially looked for it."

Qi Siyang handed it over, crossing his arms as he looked at the boxes on the coffee table. On top rested a bag of gummy candies.

The young man was indeed somewhat surprised, but thinking about it, it made sense—Song Yu was just a high school student after all.

"Can I have a bag?" Qi Siyang turned to Song Yu, asking playfully.

"Of course."

Song Yu was looking down at the book, replying without raising his head.

Just at that moment—

As Qi Siyang bent down, he let out a sound of confusion.

"Hmm?"

Song Yu followed his gaze. The bird was standing right beside the bag, its claws firmly pressing down on the candy wrapper as it looked up at the guest.

Its feathers were fluffed, its posture standing tall and proud.

And around its neck hung the golden lock.

"..."

However, Bai Linlin failed in his defense. Song Yu scooped him up in one motion and placed him onto his shoulder.

"I'll buy you a new bag later," the youth blurted out instinctively. Looking down at the bird, even he caught himself off guard.

Bai Linlin had been so focused on putting on the gold lock earlier that he hadn't listened closely to their conversation, unaware that Qi Siyang had received "permission."

He thought about it for a moment.

Then he nodded his head.

For reasons unknown, Qi Siyang suddenly felt like he shouldn't be here.

Yet the bird seemed to have snapped out of it. It tilted its head, looked over, and fluttered its wings down to the coffee table. Grabbing the bag of candy with its beak, it brought it over and tossed it with a forceful jerk.

*Human, here you go.*

-

Qi Siyang found it truly difficult to describe his current feelings. Another living creature now perched on his shoulder, and he didn't dare make a sudden move.

Bai Linlin tilted his head to look at the man. How old was he, still eating candies?

Still, the man had good taste. This was the bird's absolute favorite flavor—one Song Yu had bought before, limited-edition and quite pricey.

Eat up, eat up!

Yet this "human" didn't eat.

The bird observed for a moment, scrambled up the man's arm, intently bit a hole in the packaging, and then tilted his head to look at Qi Siyang again.

Why wasn't he eating yet?

Before he could observe any longer, the little ball of feathers was scooped away. Song Yu's brow furrowed slightly, though only for a split second.

"He's usually very good. He doesn't just climb onto other people."

"I'm sorry."

The bird returned to his original territory, adjusted his stance, and began devotedly preening his feathers.

He even let out a tiny yawn.

Upon hearing Song Yu's explanation, Qi Siyang nodded repeatedly, though it was still impossible not to be drawn to the little bird.

The golden lock... did it put that on by itself?

Song Yu asked, "Did Professor ask you to pass along anything else?"

Snapping back to reality, Qi Siyang pulled his gaze back. "Huh?"

"No, nothing else."

Realizing the time, Qi Siyang knew it was indeed getting late, and he had an academic conference that afternoon.

He looked down at the bag of candies. To be honest, he had only intended to take a single piece initially, not the whole bag.

But now...

The bird had opened it for him.

After a moment's thought, Qi Siyang held up the bag of candies, shook it toward Song Yu, and said with a smile:

"Thanks a lot then."

"..."

Finally, he left.

-

Bai Linlin was still feeling delighted. Once the guest departed, he flew down from Song Yu's shoulder and began strutting across the coffee table like he was on a runway.

The little gold lock was solid metal.

Quite heavy.

Yet the bird refused to take it off no matter what.

Song Yu leaned down, trying to remove it, but every attempt resulted in his fingertips getting pecked. It was a dull, clamping sensation—not painful in the slightest.

He looked down quietly, keeping his fingers right there.

Bai Linlin took two steps forward, only to be blocked. Infuriated, he clamped his beak down firmly and refused to let go.

And so, he was lifted right up.

His bird claws dangled in the air.

Eventually, he landed safely in the "human's" palm. Song Yu's expression remained serene as his fingers were finally released, leaving behind a faint red mark.

Quite a strong bite.

Right at that moment—

"Do you like gold?"

"I'll buy you some."

The author has something to say:
PS: The gold lock is a mini version, a gift from the bank given to Elder Chen as a VIP client.

chunks.chineseText:
第14章

白粼粼鸟眼蹬得浑圆，身子都往上一拱，站得笔直笔直的。

“啾啾？”

[真的？]

宋郁不知道为什么，大抵猜出来它在说什么，于是就道：

“真的。”

白粼粼立马扑棱翅膀飞起来了，开始叨着宋郁的衣服往楼上扯，少年起初不解，最后跟着上楼了才明白了。

它要打字。

开了电脑。

宋郁面色恍惚，只是垂眸看着在键盘上忙忙碌碌的鸟。

那毛绒绒的一团先是啪嗒啪嗒走过去，然后用喙戳开了屏幕显示键，动作相当之熟练。

“……”

白粼粼压根就没有什么别的想法，他只是觉得这个机会千载难逢，金子固然好，但是鸟不能单独出去倒卖。

不如买点其他的。

鸟打算新建个记事本，给列个清单目录。

美滋滋。

但鼠标放得太远了，白粼粼像往常一样伸自己的鸟腿，压根没碰到。

“啾啾？”

宋郁面无表情地给挪了过去，鸟成功扣住，操作了一下。

卧室里光线明亮，窗外还有绿茵茵的树，倒是显得风景宜人。

宋郁后面就拉开椅子坐下了，眼皮微微垂着，只是看着在键盘上动来动去的小鸟。

它现在长大了点，体型约等于大半个保温杯。

尾羽长长的，很漂亮。

宋郁其实什么也没有想，他只是就这么看着。

直到肩头一沉。

鸟完成了，他侧眸看了过去，一个圆滚滚的鸟头凑了过来，几乎要碰到他的睫毛。

宋郁：“写好了？”

“啾啾！”

鸟的回应铿锵有力。

宋郁闻声抬眼看了下屏幕，沉默了一会。

“你是说。”

“你要一台iphone17？”

-

白粼粼压根没有想过宋郁会这么容易地接受一切，也就看了那么一次医生，后面就完全不管了。

也没有把鸟捉去研究。

！

好人！

白粼粼这段时间过得很是不错，因为宋郁真的说到做到，不仅购置了清单上的所有东西，还再次请人装潢了下二楼的那个房间。

原来里面有些鸟类的攀爬支架，还有树窝，还有几个小秋千。

宋郁让人往里放了几个柜子，设计是比较现代风的那种，有灯带，然后还有透明亚克力板制的匣子。

鸟当时有些不解。

直到宋郁把那个金坠子放了进去，侧头看了下鸟。

似乎是在教。

鸟举一反三，从和宋郁睡觉的那个卧室叼来了小围兜、几包辣条、脚环……总之是些鸡零狗碎的玩意儿。

一个一个放进去了。

白粼粼觉得简直完美！

宋郁那天甚至还抽空帮鸟设置了下手机的功能，给鸟插了电话卡，垂眸改了下手机名称：

——粼粼的iphone。

鸟特别高兴，站在人的肩头啾啾，以表愉悦。

宋郁只是头也不抬道：

“粼粼。”

像是在自言自语。

鸟不解，“啾啾？”

宋郁只是侧头看了下，没让鸟的话落地上，很温和道：

“嗯。”

手机甚至还可以支付，宋郁直接转了五万过去，不过关于密码这个，人觉得麻烦，就用的自己的，把购物软件开成为了免密。

白粼粼感觉自己像是到了天堂，一连好几天都兴奋地睡不着，直到一天午夜——

鸟在纸巾盒里打滚，反正也睡不着，就开始叨叨叨自己的“床”，咬成均匀的条条。

手机设置了“早睡锁机”。

鸟不能熬夜。

不过就在白粼粼快把自己的床给拆没了的时候，听到了被子掀开的动静。

宋郁起来了？

脚步声似乎靠近了点。

鸟装死。

短喙里还有着没咬断的纸条。

白粼粼本来还想着“人”起来干什么的，下一秒他就被“拿”起来了，那根没咬断的纸条被很轻地拨开了。

！

鸟丝毫不敢动，躺板板。

但宋郁只是给他换了个新的纸巾盒，白粼粼这才后知后觉，原来他的“床”不是耐造，而是换得勤……

鸟回到了新的床后就偷偷地滚了下身子，而后试图瞅瞅人在干什么。

宋郁没有接着睡觉，只是在椅子上坐着，也不像是梦游，就是醒了。

少年似乎察觉到一点视线感，又往纸巾盒这里撇了一眼。

鸟立马闭上。

白粼粼其实不太知道宋郁为什么会割腕……至少他现在看不出来什么具体的事。

江芮，他妈妈。

上次不小心看到消息了。

宋启明，这个是那次偶遇江芮听到的，再往前推就是通电话那次……宋郁提到了自己爷爷。

没见过。

白粼粼不由自主地开始梳理信息，不过它也偷偷打了个哈欠，总觉得最近身体怪怪的。

怎么一点也不困？

都持续好几天了。

不过就在这时，桌子的抽屉发出点动静，人似乎拿出来个东西。

白粼粼起初还不知道是什么，但后面闻到一股血腥味。

-

宋郁其实不清楚为什么鸟最近这么粘人，他已经走到门口了，但它还是没从身上下来。

“今天周五，我会早点回来。”

宋郁侧眸同鸟解释道，还伸了下手指。

肩头的某只小鸟像是又不聪明了一样，只是歪了歪头，一个劲地看“人”。

“啾啾。”

人，鸟很担心你。

白粼粼其实也没什么办法，他不知道为什么宋郁要自残，并且白天看起来非常正常。

抑郁症……

“我尽快好么，但是我需要去上学。”

“再上一个月。”

宋郁想了想，又解释道，但始终保持着伸手的姿势。

最终小鸟才伸爪站了过来，被安稳地放到了地板上。

只是还在仰头看“人”。

宋郁最后还是关门了，鸟往前啪嗒啪嗒走了几步，偌大的别墅此刻显得空荡荡的。

白粼粼照理来说没有什么烦心事的，有好吃的，有好玩的，宋郁周末还会带鸟去散步。

“……”

就是这样，鸟才觉得郁闷。

为什么不开心？

不过很快他就知道原因了。

因为当天上午别墅就来了不速之客。

门口一开始是有乱按的指纹声，还有些很明显的男童吵闹的动静。

“开门开门！”

“宋郁！”

“他不在家吗？”

“他有病嘻嘻，妈妈，他为什么不去精神病院啊？”

鸟冒火了。

但此刻门开了，有个穿着干练西服的女性牵着男童的手，边打电话边进门。

“嗯进来了进来，启明，你放心，小郁就是闹脾气。”

“他不是故意把我们的指纹删掉的，这毕竟是……老宅么，我理解，反正当年爸爸也不同意我们……你看我说这些干什么？”

女人语调拿捏的很好，眉毛低垂着，在玄关那里站着，就等着电话那头的回应。

白粼粼站在隐蔽的吊灯里侧，伸着鸟头视察。

“嗯，我知道的，你这么些年辛苦了。”

“爸爸那边怎么样？醒来的概率大不大？我上周还去祈福了呢。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 14

Bai Linlin’s bead-like eyes widened into perfect circles. He arched his back and stood as straight as a pole.

*“Chirp chirp?”*
[For real?]

Song Yu couldn’t explain how, but he roughly guessed what the bird was saying, so he answered, “For real.”

Bai Linlin immediately flapped his wings and took off, using his beak to tug at Song Yu’s clothes toward the stairs. At first, the youth was confused, but after following the bird upstairs, he understood.

The bird wanted to type.

He turned on the computer.

Song Yu looked dazed, his eyelids drooping slightly as he watched the bird bustled around the keyboard.

The little ball of fluff waddled over with a series of tiny pitter-patters before using its beak to poke the display button. Its actions were exceptionally proficient.

“...”

Bai Linlin didn’t have any complex scheme in mind. He simply felt that this opportunity was too rare to pass up. While gold was nice, a bird couldn’t go out and sell it on its own. 

It was better to buy other things instead.

The bird intended to open a new notepad document and list out an inventory.

*How divine.*

However, the mouse was placed too far away. When Bai Linlin stretched out his leg as usual, he couldn't reach it at all.

“Chirp chirp?”

Song Yu expressionlessly slid the mouse over. The bird successfully gripped it and maneuvered it around.

The bedroom was bathed in bright light, and the lush green trees outside the window offered a pleasant view.

Song Yu pulled out a chair and sat down, his eyelids lowered as he watched the little bird scurry across the keyboard.

Having grown a bit recently, the bird was now about the size of a large thermos flask. 

Its tail feathers were long and exquisite.

Song Yu wasn't thinking about anything in particular; he simply sat there and watched.

Until a weight settled on his shoulder.

The bird had finished. Song Yu turned his head to look. A round bird head leaned in, almost brushing against his eyelashes.

Song Yu asked, “Done writing?”

“Chirp chirp!”

The bird’s response was resounding and energetic.

At the sound, Song Yu raised his eyes to glance at the screen, falling silent for a moment.

“Are you saying...”

“...you want an iPhone 17?”

***

Bai Linlin had never imagined Song Yu would accept everything so easily. After seeing the doctor that single time, Song Yu completely dropped the matter.

He didn't capture the bird for research either.

*A truly good person!*

Bai Linlin lived remarkably well during this period. Song Yu kept his word to the letter, not only purchasing every item on the list, but also hiring people to redecorate the room on the second floor once more.

Originally, the room held bird climbing racks, tree-nest boxes, and a few small swings.

Song Yu had workers install a few display cabinets inside—modern in design, complete with LED strip lighting and transparent acrylic shadow boxes.

The bird had been somewhat perplexed at the time.

That was until Song Yu placed the gold pendant inside and glanced sideways at the bird.

It seemed like a demonstration.

Drawing inferences from this example, the bird fetched his small bib, several packs of spicy strips, his anklets, and various other bits and pieces from the bedroom where he slept with Song Yu.

He placed them inside one by one.

Bai Linlin felt it was absolute perfection!

That day, Song Yu even took the time to help set up the bird’s phone, inserting a SIM card and editing the device's name with lowered eyes:

— *Linlin’s iPhone.*

The bird was overjoyed, hopping onto the youth's shoulder and chirping enthusiastically to express his delight.

Song Yu merely murmured without looking up, “Linlin.”

It sounded as though he were talking to himself.

The bird tilted his head in confusion. “Chirp chirp?”

Song Yu glanced sideways, not letting the bird's words fall to the ground, and replied softly, “Mm.”

The phone could even make mobile payments. Song Yu transferred fifty thousand yuan directly into the account. However, regarding the password, he found it too troublesome to set a new one, so he used his own and configured the shopping app for passwordless payments.

Bai Linlin felt as if he had ascended to heaven. He was so excited he couldn't sleep for several nights in a row, until one midnight—

The bird was rolling around inside his tissue box. Unable to sleep anyway, he began nibbling on his “bed,” gnawing it into neat strips.

The phone had been set with a “bedtime screen lock.”

A bird wasn't allowed to stay up late.

Just as Bai Linlin was about to completely dismantle his bed, he heard the sound of the blanket being rustled.

Song Yu was getting up?

The footsteps seemed to draw closer.

The bird played dead.

An unsevered strip of paper hung from his short beak.

Bai Linlin was still wondering what the human was getting up to when, in the next second, he was picked up. The unsevered paper strip was gently brushed aside.

*!*

The bird didn't dare move an inch, lying stiff like a wooden board.

Song Yu simply replaced his bed with a fresh tissue box. Only then did Bai Linlin realize that his "bed" wasn't indestructible—it was just replaced frequently...

Once back in his new bed, the bird secretly rolled over and tried to peek at what the human was doing.

Song Yu didn't go back to sleep. He merely sat in the chair. He didn't look like he was sleepwalking either; he was simply awake.

Seeming to sense a gaze, the youth cast another glance toward the tissue box.

The bird instantly shut his eyes.

Bai Linlin didn't really know why Song Yu had slit his wrists... At least right now, he couldn't discern any specific trigger.

Jiang Rui was his mother.

He had accidentally seen the messages last time.

Song Qiming was his father—the name he heard when he bumped into Jiang Rui, and further back during that phone call where Song Yu mentioned his grandfather.

Whom he had never seen.

Bai Linlin couldn't help but begin piecing together the information, though he also stifled a yawn, feeling a bit strange about his body recently.

Why wasn't he sleepy at all?

It had been going on for several days now.

Right at that moment, a desk drawer clicked open, and the human seemed to pull something out.

Bai Linlin didn't know what it was at first, but a moment later, he caught the faint metallic scent of blood.

***

Song Yu didn't understand why the bird was so clingy today. He had already reached the front door, yet it still refused to come down from his shoulder.

“It's Friday today. I'll come back early,” Song Yu explained to the bird, offering his finger.

The little bird on his shoulder seemed to have lost its wits again, merely tilting its head and staring intently at him.

“Chirp chirp.”
*Human, the bird is worried about you.*

Bai Linlin was at his wit's end. He had no idea why Song Yu engaged in self-harm when he looked completely normal during the day.

Depression...

“I'll hurry back, okay? But I need to go to school.”

“Just one more month.”

Song Yu thought for a moment and offered an explanation, all while holding his hand out in the same posture.

Only then did the little bird step onto his hand, allowing itself to be placed gently onto the floor.

Even so, it kept its head tilted up, gazing at him.

Song Yu finally closed the door. The bird took a few steps forward, his tiny feet making soft pitter-patter sounds. The vast villa suddenly felt empty and desolate.

Logically speaking, Bai Linlin had nothing to worry about. He had delicious food, fun things to play with, and Song Yu took him out for walks on weekends.

“...”

Yet that was precisely why the bird felt so gloomy.

Why wasn't the youth happy?

He soon discovered the reason.

That very morning, an uninvited guest arrived at the villa.

At first, there was the sound of someone frantically pressing the fingerprint scanner at the entrance, accompanied by the loud, clamorous noise of a young boy.

“Open up! Open up!”

“Song Yu!”

“Is he not home?”

“He's sick, hee-hee! Mommy, why isn't he in a mental hospital?”

The bird’s temper flared instantly.

The door swung open, and a woman dressed in a crisp, sharp business suit walked in, holding the boy’s hand while talking on the phone.

“Yes, we’re inside now. Qiming, don’t worry, Xiaoyu is just throwing a tantrum.”

“It’s not like he deleted our fingerprints on purpose. After all, this is... the old family estate. I understand. Besides, Father didn’t agree to us back then either... Look at me, why am I bringing this up?”

The woman controlled her tone impeccably. Her brows were lowered as she stood in the entryway, waiting for the response on the other end of the line.

Bai Linlin perched inside the concealed groove of the chandelier, poking his head out to inspect the scene.

“Yes, I know. You’ve worked hard all these years.”

“How is Father doing over there? Is there a high chance he’ll wake up? I even went to pray for his recovery last week.”

chunks.chineseText:
白粼粼仔细看了看这女人的表情，觉得很奇怪，说的话是“希望”，但眉毛却控制不住地往下走，神态分明是厌恶。

“宋阳！哎，不要乱跑，那是你哥哥的房间！”

“弄乱了哥哥要生气的。”

白粼粼：“……”

那孩子压根就没上楼，装什么？

好了，知道你是后妈了。

-

宋启明此刻就在S州那里，他刚和医生交谈完，心情还算好，他父亲的生命体征指标最近都很好，也就和自己妻子打了电话，不过听到对面的声音后就蹙了蹙眉，替人打抱不平：

“什么叫乱跑，自己家里想去哪里就去哪里！”

“宋郁今年高考完我就送他去英国读书，锦园这里到时候就让阳阳住，正好上他哥哥的高中。”

李长韵很温婉地笑了下，不过还是问了下电话那头，“是英国什么学校啊？小郁的成绩会不会跟不上？”

语气里是满满的担忧。

宋启明闻言其实愣了下，怎么会这么问？

“那怎么会跟不上？宋郁成绩一直都是校前几，托福雅思我早让他考过了，学校那边老师我都联系着呢，没什么问题。”

“我考虑过了，就让他去牛津或者剑桥，学点东西回来正好管管公司。”

李长韵有点维持不住笑容了，但电话那头还在说话，还扯到了她儿子：

“不过宋阳的成绩也要抓一抓，年纪小归小，也不能太落后了，宋郁小时候就……”

“那小郁的病不用看吗？前段时间庄大夫可是和我说了，连着一个月都没来了，估计断药很久了。”李长韵很温温柔柔地打断道，把话头给引了过去。

她还顺带环顾了四周。

锦园这地段，寸土寸金的，住的可都是南市有头有脸的人物，要是以后真住进来，小阳日后的路会好走很多。

随便一个邻居家的女孩都不错。

李长韵已经为自己七岁的儿子谋划起了婚事。

但白粼粼此刻在战术后仰，鸟爪都在用力，这人怎么突然看天花板啊？

不过好在这回那男童又跑回来，一下子扑到他妈身上，抢走了手机。

“爸爸！”

李长韵也就没再仰头看了，只是佯装生气道：“阳阳——”

手机免提开了。

“怎么啦？想爸爸没有？”

“想！”

白粼粼觉得真是晦气，但是也多亏了那孩子开了免提，才让他听到了后面的话。

“不用管宋郁，他这段时间真是无法无天了，养了个鸟，大白天和鸟自言自语的，真是离疯不远了。”

鸟躯一震。

白粼粼惶恐，这个家里没有其他人，对方怎么知道宋郁和他说话的？

有监控？

白粼粼很快冷静下来，不对，没有说他打游戏，那就说明卧室里的事对方不知道。

客厅安了？

“那要不要送医院啊？抑郁症也不是小事，学业总比不上孩子身体健康重要？”

李长韵此刻蹲下身子，拿着手机同电话那头说道，面色故作担忧。

但那头还是犹豫了：

“不用，犯不着去医院，前些年不还有幻觉什么的，估计这段时间又严重了，他吃点药就好了，不用担心他。”

李长韵闭了闭眼，她就知道是这样，把电话挂了后，面色很是难看。

说得冠冕堂皇，不过是怕抑郁症的档案被留存，从头到尾都是单独请的医生。

宋郁今年都十八了，可宋阳才七岁。

这怎么争？

抑郁症……抑郁症。

怎么不去——

李长韵意识到自己有些偏激了，深吸了一口气，起身站了起来。

宋阳在旁边扯她的衣服，李长韵只好安抚了下：

“好了好了，今天有正事的，我们要……”

“要量窗帘的尺寸！到时候装修新房子！”

男童抢答道。

但李长韵却摇了摇头，摸了摸儿子的脑袋，慢悠悠地道：

“你知道哥哥有个可爱的小鸟吗？”

白粼粼：“……”

作甚？

“要不要找它玩一玩呀？”

宋阳眼睛亮了亮，很是大声地道：

“要！”

作者有话说：

[鸽子][鸽子]：是时候让黑恶势力见识下老虎钳的威力了！

Bai Linlin observed the woman's expressions carefully and found them utterly bizarre. Her words spoke of "hope," yet her eyebrows twitched downward uncontrollably, her features plainly displaying disgust.

“Song Yang! Hey, don’t run around! That’s your brother’s room!”

“If you mess it up, your brother will be angry.”

Bai Linlin: “...”

*The kid hasn't even gone upstairs! What are you pretending for?*

*Fine, I get it now—you're the stepmother.*

***

At that moment, Song Qiming was in S State. Having just finished a conversation with the doctors, he was in a decent mood. His father’s vital signs had been very stable recently, so he had called his wife. Hearing her voice, however, he frowned, feeling indignant on her behalf.

“What do you mean, 'running around'? It's his own home—he can go wherever he wants!”

“Once Song Yu finishes his gaokao this year, I’ll send him to the UK to study. Then we’ll let Yangyang live in Jinyuan. It’ll be perfect for him to attend his brother’s high school.”

Li Changyun offered a gentle smile, though she still probed, “Which UK school is it? Will Xiaoyu’s grades be able to keep up?”

Her tone was filled with concern.

Hearing this, Song Qiming was momentarily taken aback. Why would she ask that?

“How could his grades not keep up? Song Yu has always been near the top of his class. I had him pass TOEFL and IELTS long ago, and I’ve been keeping in touch with the teachers there. There won't be any issues.”

“I’ve considered it carefully. I’ll have him attend Oxford or Cambridge. Once he learns a few things and returns, he can take over the company.”

Li Changyun’s smile became difficult to maintain. Yet the voice on the phone continued, even bringing up her son:

“Still, we need to pay attention to Song Yang’s grades too. Young as he is, he can’t fall too far behind. When Song Yu was little, he...”

“Does Xiaoyu’s illness not need treatment?” Li Changyun gently interrupted, steering the conversation back on track. “Dr. Zhuang told me a while ago that Xiaoyu hasn't shown up for a month straight. He’s probably been off his medication for a long time.”

As she spoke, she glanced around her surroundings.

Jinyuan was located in a prime district where every inch of land was worth its weight in gold. The residents here were all prominent figures in Nanshi. If they truly moved in later, Xiaoyang’s future path would be much smoother.

Even marrying a girl from a neighboring family would be a great match.

Li Changyun was already plotting a marriage strategy for her seven-year-old son.

Meanwhile, Bai Linlin performed a tactical lean-back from his perch, his claws gripping tightly. *Why did this woman suddenly look up at the ceiling?*

Fortunately, the boy ran back over and threw himself onto his mother, snatching the phone.

“Daddy!”

Li Changyun ceased looking up and merely feigned anger. “Yangyang—”

The speakerphone had been switched on.

“What’s wrong? Did you miss Daddy?”

“I did!”

Bai Linlin felt disgusted by the display, but thanks to the kid putting it on speaker, he managed to overhear the rest of the conversation.

“Don’t worry about Song Yu. He’s been completely out of line lately, raising a bird and talking to himself all day long. He’s not far from going totally insane.”

The bird’s body shuddered.

Bai Linlin was horrified. There was no one else in this house—how did they know Song Yu talked to him?

Were there security cameras?

Bai Linlin quickly calmed down. *No, he didn't mention him playing video games, which means they don't know what happens in the bedroom.*

*They installed them in the living room?*

“Should we send him to the hospital then? Depression isn't a small matter. Studies can’t be more important than the child’s health, right?”

Li Changyun squatted down, holding the phone while speaking to the other end, her expression layered with fake concern.

However, the voice on the other end hesitated:

“No need. There’s no point in sending him to the hospital. Didn’t he have hallucinations and things like that a few years ago? It’s probably just gotten worse recently. He’ll be fine once he takes his medication. Don’t worry about him.”

Li Changyun closed her eyes. She knew it would be like this. After hanging up the phone, her expression turned exceptionally grim.

Spouting such grand words, yet all he cared about was preventing a record of depression from being filed. From start to finish, he had only hired private doctors.

Song Yu was turning eighteen this year, while Song Yang was only seven.

How could her son compete?

Depression... Depression.

Why didn't he just—

Realizing her thoughts were becoming somewhat extreme, Li Changyun took a deep breath and stood up.

Song Yang tugged at her clothes from the side. Li Changyun could only soothe him, “Alright, alright. We have business today. We need to...”

“We need to measure the curtains! So we can renovate our new house later!” the boy blurted out eagerly.

Li Changyun shook her head, stroked her son’s head, and said unhurriedly, “Do you know that Big Brother has a cute little bird?”

Bai Linlin: “...”

*What are you trying to pull?*

“Do you want to go play with it?”

Song Yang’s eyes lit up, and he shouted loudly, “Yes!”
