第15章

白粼粼站在玄关那里的吊灯那里，没空搭理那一对母子，只是梳理了下目前得到的信息。

江芮，也就是宋郁妈妈，已经组建新的家庭，孩子都有两个了。

至于只在电话中出现的宋启明，应该就是宋郁的父亲，看样子也是一样，早就再婚生子了。

鸟爪子搭在灯管上，白粼粼神情严肃，心想怪不得他见不到除了阿姨之外的“成年人”。

原来都美美投入小家了。

艹！

白粼粼磨了磨喙，身上的羽毛都炸了炸，心想这都是什么不负责任的家长！

鸟歪头往客厅那里看。

女人牵着那男童，两人有说有笑的，一来一回地说话：

“哥哥房间里的东西不要弄乱噢，我们就去看看小鸟。”

“好啊好啊，它会飞是不是！”

“是呀，不太好抓呢。”

……

还真想去宋郁的卧室？

白粼粼身躯下压，整个鸟都威风凛凛，开始蓄力。

李长韵同自己儿子说完话后，温和的面色就消散了差不多，边上楼梯边盘算着事情。

华秉不能动的股份说到底就是老爷子手底下的人在干涉。

这次要是醒了……也好。

她早就看不惯那个遗产分配书了。

这次正好。

但就在这时，手边的儿子突然哭叫出了声。

“啊！妈妈！”

-

与此同时，南市一高正在举行三模考试，但宋郁却不在座位上，他被老师叫走了。

“宋郁，你最近状态很不好。”

办公室的老师坐在椅子上，抬头看了过来，眉毛微微蹙着，又认真补了句：

“老师支持你的意愿，高考你当然可以参加，你父亲毕竟还在国外，他管不到这里来的。”

宋郁面色平静，只是想起来自己的鸟，它自己在家会不会无聊。

“我没事，老师。”

班主任听到这话就直皱眉，不由自主视线下移，少年的手腕内侧有新的划痕，深浅交错，一看就是控制好力道的，她叹了口气，斟酌道：

“这样，你下午回家休息，现在的话……”

“去心理咨询室一次？你余老师也有些挂念你。”

宋郁蹙了下眉，刚想说什么，但班主任上了最后一层筹码：

“那总比你那个后妈给你找的医生好吧？”

“他还打小报告。”

“你放心，余老师不可能乱说的，他要是这么做，我早和他离婚了。”

宋郁仍然觉得自己没有什么需要咨询的，他刚想要婉拒，但下一秒——

“你难道没有什么困惑的事吗？”

-

有。

他分不清现实和幻觉，需要疼痛来刺激一下。

自秋水巷那次际遇后，他一成不变的生活有了起伏，带回来的小鸟非常聪慧。

它会点头，会开门，还会站在他肩头看自己打游戏。

但是……

“养了小鸟啊，那很好啊，怎么还状态不好了？”

这道声音很是温文尔雅。

宋郁已经来到了心理咨询室，流程是差不多的，就是闲聊，他说了自己这段时间发生的事。

余老师问完也不着急等回答，只是在整理书架，翻出来个铁盒子才走了过来，大手一挥道：

“豆豆的，都给她吃完！”

“……”

铁盒上印着大白兔，很明显是一罐奶糖，是一名叫豆豆的小朋友的。

宋郁其实不知道他的两个老师为什么性格差异这么大……却还是一对。

很奇怪。

但就在这时——

“小鸟取名字了吗？”

余老师拍了拍手，坐在了桌子对面，他相貌端正，很温和地问道。

“它有名字，粼粼。”

余老师闻言点了下头，然后自顾自地讲：

“噢，那不是你取的。”

宋郁微微怔了下，有些意外。

此刻对面的老师也在推断，心想这难道是被遗弃的小鸟，前主人过来要了？

孩子由此情绪消沉？

有太多这样的病例了，大多都是捡到流浪猫猫狗狗的，原本以为被治愈了，结果这些小动物一旦碰见原主人，立马就会扯断绳子，飞奔过去。

舍弃掉新主人。

即使旧主人遗弃了它们。

但这几乎是个死胡同，没有办法找到最优解。

余老师想了想，抬眸看向宋郁，耐心道：

“不要过于焦虑。”

“小鸟也是需要时间相处的，你和它朝夕相处，它肯定也会——”

“不是。”

宋郁眼眸垂着，修长的手指微微蜷了下，重复道：

“不是老师。”

或许是长久的无人倾诉，抑或是说了别人也不信。

宋郁那些茫然的思绪再度涌了上来，他不自觉地说了真实的情况：

“它打字告诉我名字的。”

空气一阵沉默。

余老师愣了下，身子往椅子背靠了靠，中午太阳从窗户往里照，本来暖暖的。

但他心里拔凉。

这有点棘手。

-

“我知道这很荒谬，或许是我自己看错了。”

余老师听到宋郁再度恢复成冷静的口吻就反应过来，这已经在自我保护了，他连忙肯定道：

“老师相信你。”

“那你确实看到了对吗？”

“所以手上的伤口……是想用疼痛来帮助自己确认对吗？”

宋郁神色平静，垂着眼眸，语气很轻道，“是。”

他的确尝试了。

“那分清了吗？”

宋郁听到这句话后，先是一愣，而后就是混乱，因为他……分不清。

有些时候他很容易沉浸进去，觉得一切都很正常，或许就是小鸟聪慧一些。

但有的时候，他抽离出来的时候，又觉得自己可能出现了幻觉。

鸟怎么会打游戏，怎么会买手机……

是真实的么？

还是自己想象出来的。

宋郁整个人被分成两半，一半维持岌岌可危的理智，一半开始自动合理化。

甚至分明觉得不对，但他还是买了各种各样的电子设备，还办了电话卡。

宋郁从未经历过来自外界长久的陪伴，他总是一个人，因而很容易就沉溺进去了。

鸟又没有错。

是他生病了。

金子只是个装饰品，手机也只是它想玩，airpods定制款也不贵，它只是个小鸟，为什么不能满足？

宋郁反反复复地想。

最后只是绕到原点。

是自己的问题。

和鸟无关。

“宋郁？宋郁？”

少年回了下神，最后整理了情绪，只是抬眸看向老师，平静道：

“老师，我没事的。”

“可能就是我这段时间——”

余老师连忙伸手，“打住。”

他没想到这件事的起因是一只小鸟，而且还是没有什么负面信息的好幻觉。

宋郁一直自己住。

也不知道这持续多久了……

余老师想了想，盲目否认也不合适，倒不如多问问情况。

“你的小鸟性格如何？”

宋郁愣了下，但还是很如实说道：

“很乖。”

“它很乖。”

……

此刻在锦园的鸟正在征战沙场，专门叨那男童的脸，破皮流血那都是轻得了。

诅咒哥哥去精神病院是吧？

先送你去！

鸟又一个俯冲。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 15

Perched on the chandelier near the entryway, Bai Linlin had no time to bother with the mother and son. He simply sorted through the information he had gathered so far.

Jiang Rui, Song Yu’s mother, had already formed a new family and had two children.

As for Song Qiming, who had only appeared over the phone, he was Song Yu’s father. From the looks of it, he had also long since remarried and had another child.

With his claws resting on the light fixture, Bai Linlin had a grim expression, thinking that no wonder he never saw any "adults" besides the housekeeper auntie.

Turns out they had all happily devoted themselves to their new little families.

*Damn it!*

Bai Linlin ground his beak, his feathers puffing up in anger. *What kind of irresponsible parents are they?!*

The bird tilted his head to look toward the living room.

The woman was holding the boy’s hand as they walked upstairs, chatting and laughing back and forth:

“Don’t mess up the things in Big Brother’s room, okay? We’re just going to look at the little bird.”

“Okay, okay! Can it fly?”

“Yes, it’s quite hard to catch.”

...

*They actually want to barge into Song Yu’s bedroom?*

Bai Linlin lowered his posture, looking majestic and imposing as he began gathering his strength.

After finishing her sentence to her son, Li Changyun’s gentle facade mostly dissolved. She calculated her plans while climbing the stairs.

The non-transferable shares of Huabing were ultimately being guarded by the old man's loyal subordinates.

If the old man woke up this time... that would be fine too.

She had long been displeased with that will regarding the distribution of the estate.

This time presented the perfect opportunity.

Right at that moment, her son beside her suddenly burst into a terrified screech.

“Ah! Mommy!”

***

Meanwhile, Nanshi No. 1 High School was conducting its third mock exam. However, Song Yu was not in his seat; he had been called away by a teacher.

“Song Yu, your condition recently has been very poor.”

The teacher in the office sat in her chair, looking up with her brows slightly knit, before adding earnestly, “I support your wishes. Of course you can take the gaokao. Your father is abroad after all, and he can't reach his hands over here.”

Song Yu’s expression was calm. He was only thinking about his bird—would it be bored at home alone?

“I’m fine, Teacher.”

Hearing this, the homeroom teacher frowned instantly. Her gaze involuntarily drifted downward. On the inner side of the youth’s wrist were fresh scratches, light and deep lines crisscrossing—clearly controlled with deliberate force. She sighed and spoke after careful thought:

“How about this? Go home and rest this afternoon. As for right now...”

“Why don't you visit the psychological counseling room once? Teacher Yu is also quite concerned about you.”

Song Yu’s brows knitted slightly. Just as he was about to say something, the homeroom teacher threw in her final bargaining chip:

“It’s certainly better than the doctor your stepmother found for you, isn't it?”

“That one even tattles on you.”

“Rest assured, Teacher Yu would never leak anything. If he were the type to do that, I would have divorced him long ago.”

Song Yu still felt he didn't need any counseling. He was just about to politely decline when, in the next second—

“Do you really not have anything that’s troubling you?”

***

He did.

He couldn't distinguish between reality and hallucinations. He needed pain to stimulate his senses.

Ever since that encounter in Qiushui Alley, his stagnant life had experienced ripples. The little bird he brought back was exceptionally intelligent.

It could nod, open doors, and perch on his shoulder to watch him play games.

However...

“You raised a little bird? That’s wonderful. Why is your condition still so poor then?”

The voice was refined and gentle.

Song Yu was already in the psychological counseling room. The process was much the same—just casual conversation. He related what had happened during this period.

Teacher Yu didn't rush him for answers after listening. He simply tidied up his bookshelf, pulled out a metal tin, walked over, and waved his hand grandly:

“It’s Doudou’s. Eat them all up!”

“...”

Printed on the metal tin was a White Rabbit candy logo—it was clearly a tin of milk candies belonging to a child named Doudou.

Song Yu didn't quite understand why two teachers with such vastly different personalities... were married to each other.

It was very strange.

Just then—

“Does the little bird have a name?”

Teacher Yu clapped his hands and sat down across the desk, his features handsome and upright as he asked gently.

“It has a name. Linlin.”

Hearing this, Teacher Yu nodded, then remarked as if to himself:

“Ah, so you didn't name it yourself.”

Song Yu froze for a moment, somewhat caught off guard.

Across from him, the teacher was already making deductions, thinking: *Could it be a stray bird that was abandoned, and the previous owner came back to claim it?*

*Is that why the boy is so downcast?*

There were too many cases like this. Most involved picking up stray cats or dogs. Just when the person thought they had been healed, the moment these small animals encountered their original owners, they would instantly snap their leashes and dash over.

Abandoning their new master.

Even if their former masters had abandoned them.

This was almost a dead end, with no optimal solution in sight.

Teacher Yu thought for a moment, looked up at Song Yu, and said patiently, “Don’t be overly anxious.”

“Building a bond with a little bird takes time as well. Living together day and night, it will surely—”

“No.”

Song Yu’s eyes remained lowered. His slender fingers curled slightly as he repeated, “That’s not it, Teacher.”

Perhaps it was because he had gone so long without anyone to confide in, or perhaps because no one would believe him if he spoke.

Those confused thoughts surged back up once more, and Song Yu unconsciously spoke the truth:

“It typed on a keyboard to tell me its name.”

The air fell into dead silence.

Teacher Yu was stunned. He leaned back against the chair. The midday sun shone through the window, making the room warm.

Yet his heart turned ice-cold.

This was getting a bit tricky.

***

“I know it sounds absurd. Perhaps I simply misremembered it.”

Hearing Song Yu revert to a calm tone, Teacher Yu immediately realized that the boy was already retreating into self-defense. He hastily reassured him:

“I believe you.”

“So you genuinely saw it happen, correct?”

“And the wounds on your wrist... you wanted to use pain to help yourself confirm it, right?”

Song Yu’s expression was serene. He kept his eyes cast down, speaking in a very quiet voice, “Yes.”

He had indeed tried.

“So, did you manage to tell them apart?”

Hearing this question, Song Yu was first stunned, followed by a wave of utter confusion. Because he... couldn't tell them apart.

At times, he easily immersed himself in it, feeling that everything was perfectly normal—that the little bird was simply a bit smarter than usual.

Yet at other times, when he pulled himself out, he felt he might be experiencing hallucinations.

How could a bird play games? How could it buy a phone...

Was it real?

Or was it merely a figment of his imagination?

Song Yu’s entire being was split in two: one half maintaining a precarious thread of rationality, while the other automatically rationalized everything.

Even though he clearly felt something was wrong, he still bought all kinds of electronic devices and got a SIM card.

Song Yu had never experienced long-term companionship from the outside world. He was always alone, which made it all too easy to drown in it.

The bird had done nothing wrong.

He was the one who was sick.

The gold was just a piece of jewelry, the phone was just something it wanted to play with, and the custom AirPods weren't expensive either. It was just a little bird—why shouldn't he fulfill its wishes?

Song Yu thought about it over and over again.

In the end, it always looped back to the starting point.

It was his own problem.

It had nothing to do with the bird.

“Song Yu? Song Yu?”

The youth snapped back to his senses and finally gathered his emotions. He merely looked up at the teacher and said calmly:

“Teacher, I’m fine.”

“It’s probably just that during this period—”

Teacher Yu quickly reached out his hand. “Stop right there.”

He hadn't expected the origin of this matter to be a little bird—and moreover, a positive hallucination devoid of negative information.

Song Yu had always lived alone.

He had no idea how long this had been going on...

Teacher Yu thought for a moment. Blindly denying it wasn't appropriate either; it was better to inquire more about the situation.

“What is your little bird’s personality like?”

Song Yu was taken aback, but he still answered truthfully:

“Very well-behaved.”

“It’s very well-behaved.”

...

Meanwhile, the bird at Jinyuan was currently battling on the frontlines, targeting the boy’s face with fierce pecks. Leaving a scratch or drawing blood was the lightest of injuries.

*Cursing your brother to go to a mental hospital, are you?*

*I’ll send you there first!*

The bird executed another swift dive.

chunks.chineseText:
……

“那它怎么和人互动的？是只和你亲近吗？”余老师又问。

宋郁闻言摇了摇头，很认真地道：

“它很懂事的。”

……

锦园这里乱成一片了，白粼粼在半空中灵巧地盘旋，一个迫降，爪子勾住女人的头发就往后扯。

在对方伸手的时候，立马松开飞走。

哎，打不着！

私闯民宅的小偷！

……

宋郁这边还是风平浪静，一直到心理咨询完毕，余老师用手撑着下巴思索着，好奇地问了问：

“那老师可以去家里看看那只小鸟吗？”

后面的事就很自然，班主任本来就给宋郁批假了，得知丈夫的打算后也点了点头，在办公室还给了宋郁手机。

三模考试，需要学生上交手机。

不过就在这时，一通跨国电话打了过来，对面劈头盖脸就是一顿骂。

但是不巧。

接电话的是班主任。

“宋先生，注意言辞。”

宋启明一下子尴尬了，连忙解释了事情的来龙去脉，并且问了下这个时间不应该是放学了么？

班主任蹙眉道：“就算是放学了，也不能和孩子这么讲话。”

那头一下子熄火了。

宋启明是在军区大院长大的，小时候没少被老师批评，因而现在也保留着对这个职业的尊重，在电话里老老实实地说“是是是”。

直到宋郁接了电话过来，那头才低声呵斥道：

“你的鸟怎么回事？是疯了吗？你李阿姨被咬得手臂都是口子，小阳都破相了！”

“快点回家把那东西处理了，物业逮也逮不住的……”

宋郁面色骤然变了，甚至来不及同老师告别，直接把电话挂了。

他立即往家里赶。

锦园——

白粼粼站在高处的吊灯上，身姿挺立，雄赳赳气昂昂的。

客厅有几个物业人员，拿着杆子戳，但其实很敷衍，动作慢就不说了，还离鸟很远。

“你们怎么弄得啊！”

“打下来啊！”

李长韵气得发抖道，她头发乱糟糟的，旁边的孩子脸上都是血点，旁边助理赶过来处理，勉强用棉签消了消毒。

物业人员其实都知道住户的信息，有的都是老人了，更是知道这里面的内情。

谁不知道这女的当年未婚先孕，还挺着肚子来这里要名分，那时候宋家门都不带开的，现在倒是真成“主人”了。

但是，锦园这处房产还真不是她的。

是宋郁的。

当年私生子传闻沸沸扬扬的，宋峥国气得直接绕过儿子来培养孙子，给年仅十一岁的宋郁名下添了很多不动产。

锦园就是其中之一。

但谁也没想到老爷子后面住院了，那女人真成正宫了，这现在一下变成了“家事”，搞得物业也很难处理。

敷衍几下得了。

物业人员其实也看不惯，但面上还是得说得过去，安抚了那女人几句：

“快了快了。”

“这已经在尽力了。”

白粼粼觉得，鸟一点错都没有！

这都是垃圾！

鸟替天行道而已。

不过它在吊灯上站着也有点无聊，看着那个杆子挪来挪去的，不知道怎么了，有点跃跃欲试。

伸爪子站上去了。

更高了。

物业人员一开始愣住了，后面就是此起彼伏的惊叹。

“我去，拍照拍照。”

“你别动别动。”

“嚯，它平衡性真好！”

作者有话说：

[鸽子][鸽子]：我站得最高！
chunks.englishText:
“So how does it interact with people? Is it only affectionate toward you?” Teacher Yu asked again.

Song Yu shook his head and said with absolute seriousness, “It’s very sensible.”

……

Meanwhile, back at Jinyuan Estate, chaos had broken out.

Bai Linlin hovered in midair with nimble, agile turns. Executing a sudden steep dive, its claws hooked right into the woman’s hair and yanked back hard.

The moment she reached out to grab it, the bird instantly let go and soared out of reach.

*Ha! Can’t catch me!*

*You house-trespassing thieves!*

……

On Song Yu’s end, everything remained calm and peaceful. Once the psychological consultation concluded, Teacher Yu rested his chin in his hand, lost in thought, before asking out of curiosity, “Could I drop by your home to see that little bird?”

What followed happened quite naturally. The homeroom teacher had already approved Song Yu’s leave, and upon learning her husband’s intention, she nodded in agreement. Back in her office, she returned Song Yu’s phone to him.

During the third mock exam, students were required to hand over their phones.

Just as he got it back, an international call rang through. The moment it was picked up, a barrage of furious scolding came blasting out from the speaker.

Unfortunately, it was the homeroom teacher who had answered.

“Mr. Song, mind your language.”

Song Qiming froze on the other end, instantly swallowed in embarrassment. He hurriedly explained the situation and asked why Song Yu wasn’t out of school yet at this hour.

The homeroom teacher frowned. “Even if school is over, you shouldn’t speak to a child like that.”

The fire on the other side immediately went out.

Song Qiming had grown up in a military compound and spent his childhood being reprimanded by teachers. Because of that, he retained a deep-seated respect for the profession. On the phone, he obediently stammered, “Yes, yes, of course.”

It wasn’t until Song Yu took the phone that his father scolded in a low, harsh voice, “What on earth is wrong with your bird? Has it gone mad?! Aunt Li’s arms are covered in claw marks, and Xiaoyang’s face is completely ruined!”

“Get home right now and dispose of that beast! The property management can’t even catch it—”

Song Yu’s expression turned grim. He didn’t even have time to say goodbye to his teachers before hanging up the phone.

He immediately rushed back home.

At Jinyuan Estate—

Bai Linlin stood proudly atop the high hanging chandelier, chest puffed out in full majestic posture.

Several property management workers stood in the living room holding long poles, poking lazily at the air. Their movements were sluggish, and they kept a wide berth from the bird.

“What are you people doing?!”

“Knock it down!”

Li Changyun trembled with rage. Her hair was a disheveled mess, and the boy beside her had bloody scratches across his face. An assistant who had rushed over was frantically applying disinfectant with cotton swabs.

In truth, the property management staff knew the residents’ background stories inside and out. Some of the older staff members were even more privy to the inner scandals.

Who didn't know that this woman had gotten pregnant out of wedlock years ago and showed up with a big belly to demand a place in the family? Back then, the Song family wouldn't even open the front door for her. Yet now, she actually acted like she was the lady of the house.

However, this property in Jinyuan Estate didn't belong to her at all.

It belonged to Song Yu.

When the rumors about the illegitimate child had spread like wildfire back then, Master Song Zhengguo had been so enraged that he bypassed his son entirely to raise his grandson, transferring numerous real estate properties under the eleven-year-old Song Yu’s name.

Jinyuan Estate was one of them.

Nobody had expected the old master to end up hospitalized later on, allowing that woman to officially step up as the main wife. Now, this whole mess had turned into a “family feud,” leaving the property management staff caught in a tricky situation.

Going through the motions was good enough.

The staff couldn't stand her either, but they had to maintain appearances on the surface. They offered a few half-hearted reassurances:

“Almost got it, almost got it.”

“We’re doing our absolute best here.”

Bai Linlin felt that birds did nothing wrong!

These people were all trash!

The bird was merely enforcing divine justice.

Standing on the chandelier was getting a bit boring, though. Watching that pole sway back and forth, Bai Linlin felt a sudden, inexplicable urge to try something out.

It stretched out a claw and stepped onto the top of the pole.

*Even higher now!*

The property management workers froze in surprise, followed by a chorus of hushed marvels.

“Holy crap, take a picture, take a picture!”

“Don’t move, don’t move!”

“Whoa, its balance is incredible!”

***

**Author’s Note:**
[Pigeon][Pigeon]: *I stand the highest!*

chunks.chineseText:
第16章

宋郁进门得很急，面色很冷，门口的助理见到了人还想打招呼，但被一把推开了。

“让开！”

鸟稳稳当当地站在杆子最上方，正在接受“朝拜”，下面的物业人员还在举着手机拍。

李长韵是后知后觉才发现的，起身刚想要去抓那个杆子，但已经来不及了。

白粼粼看到宋郁了，直接扑棱扑棱翅膀下来了，站在“人”的肩头，胸膛挺立。

“你没事？”

宋郁怔了下，原本因为赶路而造成的呼吸急促也被压下去了，他侧眸看向自己的肩头，很恍惚地问。

“啾啾！”

“啾啾啾啾！”

[哪里的话！]

白粼粼很是骄傲地仰了仰鸟头，然后歪歪扭扭地往靠近“人”的方向挪，贴贴，不过也就是这个距离，鸟近距离地看到了宋郁眼尾的红痣。

欸？

鸟探头。

鸟好奇。

白粼粼想叨一口，但是又想到自己叨了脏东西，有些小小的犹豫，但这个很好看。

也就在这时，对面的女人突然起身，一个猛冲过来，作势要抓——

鸟甚至都没有反应过来。

但宋郁抬手就扣住李长韵的手腕，借力打力，往后一甩。

对方几乎很是狼狈地撞上沙发边，脸上露出吃痛的表情。

宋郁一字一句地道：“请离开我家。”

高中生的力气是不小，身高也占据优势，甚至在场的几个物业和助理都没有到一米八。

氛围变得剑拔弩张。

但就在这时，一道亮光快速地闪了下。

“……”

“……”

人群中举杆子的大叔此刻正捏着手机，对着鸟拍，但他没想到闪光灯没关，脸色瞬间红了。

“咳咳咳，我我接个电话！”

大叔试图逃离现场，但客厅的女人像是彻底崩溃了，大声地指责道：

“你们就是故意的！我家孩子才多大，脸上被弄成这样，一个小畜生都抓不住……”

宋郁面色变了，他面无表情地往前走，但鸟一看局势不对，立马伸了一边翅膀拦住。

莫动。

宋郁愣住了，连带着脚步都停了，他的感官完全被唇角传来的触感占据了。

顺滑，温暖，干燥。

负面情绪都被卡住了。

直到余光看到一抹冲出去的蓝影。

一时间客厅里再度成了战场，李长韵的头发被扯得乱糟糟的，手臂又多了一道血痕，她开始拿东西砸，尽管一次也没有命中。

宋郁根本就忍不了了，刚想要动手，鸟一个迫降，又回了身边，压制住了。

“啾啾。”

下巴被鸟头顶了下。

似乎是安抚。

砰——

花瓶被摔得稀巴烂，李长韵几乎气得发抖，但她刚想再发作，玄关那里来人了。

宋郁的老师们来了，班主任蹙了蹙眉，基本问了些情况。

“受伤了去医院。”

“待在学生家里做什么？”

班主任很是不客气地对着那些围着男童的不相干人说道。

而后她才将视线移向那位“后妈”，很客套地道：

“是这样，现在是高三的关键时期，刚才宋先生也和我通了电话，我来家访。”

“不知道您有没有时间——”

李长韵当然不可能有，她面色难看地拒绝了，牵着自己的孩子走了，连带着那些华秉跟过来的人。

物业人员也自然散开了。

余老师在旁边站着，不由得吐槽了句，“这人看着就不可能同意……”

“所以让她走。”

班主任没想到宋郁家里这么多事，她蹙眉问了下：

“锦园这边不是你自己住吗？”

“你后妈怎么会来？”

别墅里乱糟糟一片，宋郁到最后也没有真的动手，闻言回了回神，只是说：

“我不知道。”

班主任想了想，“没事，我去和你父亲联系。”

其实这是不太合适的，毕竟宋家是实打实的权贵，公职人员没有必要去插手这些。

“老师，您不用——”

“我爸是你爸老师。”

班主任面无表情地道。

鸟都震惊了。

怎么还有这一层关系？

-

最后家访还是进行下去了，只不过班主任开车先走了，因为要接豆豆放学。

余老师来看看……传闻中的鸟。

碎掉的花瓶已经收拾起来了，茶几上放着新鲜的水果，还有刚泡上的热茶。

宋郁似乎是觉得还不行，又想起身去拿些东西，但被拦住了。

“好了好了，老师不是来打劫的。”

余老师语气很是无奈，不过就在好不容易把人劝着坐好了，耳边传来一阵有节奏的叨叨叨……

鸟此刻正站在那个大白兔奶糖罐子上，爪子踩在边边上，专注地用自己的喙去撬盖子。

“……”

是不是忘记自己踩在盖子上了？

余老师觉得也不是很聪明的嘛。

宋郁顺着视线看过去，没有什么犹豫，抬手就把鸟拿下来，随后打开罐子。

解决问题。

白粼粼很满意很满意，低头叼起来一块糖，刚打算给宋郁，就听到他们在说话。

“其实最近还是压力大是不是？”

“高考是可以去的，可以做两手准备，这个你不用担心。”

“你成绩一直都很好……”

鸟叼着糖，低头保持不动，打算继续听。

现在是宋郁在说话：

“我没事的老师。”

“我没有打算出国。”

鸟震惊，鸟从来不知道人有可能要出国，以至于刷得一下就抬头看过去了，叼着的奶糖也滚地上了。

“啾啾？”

脆脆的声音响起。

打断了这场对话。

宋郁怔了下，但还是心领神会地对着茶几的方向道，“我不出国。”

鸟在茶几上啪嗒啪嗒走，靠近人的身边，站定。

歪头开始看旁边的“新”人。

余老师：“……”

他还是不太相信，以至于就直接说了：

“小宋，其实我觉得鸟不太能听懂人说话。”

“它就算是鹦鹉也——”

白粼粼直接扑棱翅膀飞了起来，稳稳地站在这个中年人的肩膀上，伸着鸟头看过去。

你再说？

余老师正襟危坐，毕竟他进门的时候看到了那位“后妈”脸上的豁口。

“……”

这也是乖吗？

不过好在他学生救了他，肩头一轻，那只小鸟被拿走了。

宋郁很自然地把鸟放在了自己肩头，认真地道：

“不能这样。”

余老师微微颔首，对的，即使是宠物，也要有规矩的。

但下一秒。

“不安全的。”

“……”

余老师其实有点无奈，这不安全的是鸟吗？难道不是他吗？

那喙尖尖的，简直是一戳一个窟窿。

那么多人都抓不住。

简直是空中战斗机。

不过这都不是什么重点，余老师抬眸仔细看了下那只小鸟。

体型中等。

上他肩头还有点沉。

看样子还能听懂人话。

“……这样。”

“宋郁，我们去书房。”

-

鸟被歧视了。

白粼粼站在书房的门口，仰望着门把手，然后像个走地鸡一样来回转。

啪嗒啪嗒。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 16

Song Yu burst through the front door, his expression icy cold. The assistant near the entrance tried to greet him, but Song Yu shoved him aside without a second thought.

“Out of the way!”

The bird stood balanced atop the high pole like a king receiving homage, while the property workers below snapped photos with their phones.

Li Changyun only realized what was happening a moment late. She lunged forward to grab the pole, but it was already too late.

The moment Bai Linlin spotted Song Yu, it flapped its wings and swooped right down, landing squarely on its human’s shoulder with its chest puffed out high.

“Are you okay?”

Song Yu froze. The heavy breathing from his desperate rush home was forced down as he turned his head to look at his shoulder, asking in a daze.

“*Chirp, chirp!*”

“*Chirp chirp chirp chirp!*”

[*What are you talking about! Of course I am!*]

Bai Linlin proudly threw its head back, then waddled clumsily closer to the boy’s neck, snuggling up against him. At this close distance, the bird caught sight of the small red mole near the outer corner of Song Yu’s eye.

*Huh?*

The bird poked its head closer.

Curiosity piqued.

Bai Linlin wanted to peck at it, but remembering that it had just pecked some filthy trash earlier, it hesitated slightly. Still, that little mole looked very pretty.

Right at that moment, the woman across the room suddenly sprang forward, lunging with her hands outstretched to snatch the bird—

The bird hadn't even reacted yet.

Song Yu raised his arm, seized Li Changyun’s wrist in a firm grip, and redirected her momentum, throwing her back with a sharp shove.

She collided awkwardly with the side of the sofa, a grimace of pain twisting her face.

Song Yu uttered word by word, “Please leave my home.”

A high school boy possessed plenty of strength, and his height gave him a distinct advantage. None of the property staff or assistants present reached six feet tall.

The atmosphere grew instantly tense and explosive.

Just then, a sudden flash of light brightened the room.

“……”

“……”

An older worker holding the pole was caught red-handed holding his phone up to take a picture of the bird. He hadn't realized his flash was turned on, and his face instantly flushed bright red.

“*Cough, cough, cough!* I—I need to take a call!”

The middle-aged worker attempted to flee the scene, but the woman in the living room seemed to break down completely, shrieking accusations:

“You people are doing this on purpose! How old is my child?! Look at his face, ruined like this, and you can’t even catch a little brute—”

Song Yu’s face darkened completely. He stepped forward with a blank, cold expression, but seeing the situation escalate, the bird immediately extended a wing to block him.

*Don’t move.*

Song Yu froze, his footsteps grinding to a halt. His senses were entirely overrun by the gentle touch against the corner of his lips.

Smooth, warm, and dry.

The surge of negative emotions inside him suddenly stalled.

A moment later, out of his peripheral vision, he caught a flash of blue shooting outward.

In an instant, the living room devolved into a battlefield once more. Li Changyun’s hair was yanked into utter disarray, another bloody scratch appeared on her arm, and she began frantically throwing objects—though not a single one hit its mark.

Song Yu couldn't stand it any longer and was about to intervene when the bird executed a sudden dive, landing right back by his side to hold him back.

“*Chirp, chirp.*”

The bird nudged Song Yu’s chin softly with its head.

It almost felt like a gesture of comfort.

*BANG!*

A vase shattered into pieces on the floor. Li Changyun shook uncontrollably with rage. Just as she was about to explode again, footsteps sounded from the entryway.

Song Yu’s teachers had arrived. The homeroom teacher frowned at the chaotic scene and quickly asked about the situation.

“If anyone is injured, go to the hospital.”

“What are you all doing loitering in a student’s home?”

The homeroom teacher spoke with sharp disfavor to the uninvolved people crowding around the young boy.

Only then did she shift her gaze toward the stepmother, offering a polite yet icy tone:

“Here is the situation. This is a critical period for a third-year high school student. Mr. Song spoke with me on the phone earlier, so I came for a home visit.”

“I wonder if you have time—”

Of course Li Changyun didn't. With a horrific expression on her face, she rejected the offer, grabbed her child, and stalked off, dragging the entourage she had brought with her.

The property management staff naturally dispersed as well.

Teacher Yu, standing off to the side, couldn't help but murmur under his breath, “She clearly wasn't going to agree anyway……”

“That’s why I forced her to leave.”

The homeroom teacher hadn't expected Song Yu’s household to be such a mess. She frowned and asked, “Don't you live alone here at Jinyuan Estate?”

“Why did your stepmother show up?”

The villa was in complete disarray. Song Yu, who ultimately hadn't ended up resorting to violence, snapped back to reality and simply said, “I don't know.”

The homeroom teacher thought for a moment. “It’s fine. I’ll contact your father.”

Strictly speaking, this wasn't entirely appropriate. The Song family held immense power and influence, so public school teachers had no reason to meddle in such deep family affairs.

“Teacher, you don't need to—”

“My father was your father’s teacher,” the homeroom teacher stated flatly.

The bird was utterly shocked.

*There was even a connection like that?!*

-

In the end, the home visit proceeded, though the homeroom teacher drove off first to pick up her daughter, Doudou, from school.

Teacher Yu stayed behind to observe... the legendary bird.

The shattered vase had been cleared away. Fresh fruit was placed on the coffee table alongside a pot of freshly brewed hot tea.

Song Yu felt that wasn't quite enough and made to get up to fetch more refreshments, but he was gently stopped.

“Alright, alright. I didn't come here to rob you.”

Teacher Yu’s tone was thoroughly helpless. But just as he managed to persuade the boy to sit back down, a rhythmic *peck-peck-peck* sounded in his ear……

The bird was currently perched on top of a jar of White Rabbit creamy candies. Its claws gripped the rim while it diligently used its beak to pry at the lid.

“……”

*Did it forget its own feet are standing on the lid?*

Teacher Yu couldn't help thinking the bird wasn't particularly bright after all.

Song Yu followed his gaze, raised his hand without hesitation to lift the bird off, and popped the lid open.

Problem solved.

Bai Linlin was immensely satisfied. It ducked down, snatched a piece of candy in its beak, and was about to hand it to Song Yu when it heard them talking.

“Actually, you’ve been under a lot of pressure lately, haven't you?”

“Taking the Gaokao exam is completely fine, but you can prepare two backup plans. You don't need to worry about that.”

“Your grades have always been excellent……”

Holding the candy in its beak, the bird kept its head low and remained motionless, intent on listening closely.

Now it was Song Yu speaking:

“I’m fine, Teacher.”

“I have no intention of going abroad.”

*SHOCKED!*

The bird had never known that its human might go abroad! Its head snapped up so fast that the wrapped candy dropped right out of its beak and rolled across the floor.

“*Chirp, chirp?!*”

A crisp sound rang out, interrupting the conversation.

Song Yu paused slightly, but understanding the bird’s concern, he turned toward the coffee table and reassured it, “I’m not going abroad.”

The bird waddled across the coffee table, *patter-patter*, coming to a stop right beside its human.

Tilting its head, it began scrutinizing the "new human" in front of it.

Teacher Yu: “……”

He still found it hard to believe, so he voiced his thoughts directly:

“Xiao Song, I honestly don't think birds can truly understand human speech.”

“Even if it were a parrot, it still—”

Bai Linlin instantly flapped its wings and launched into the air, landing firmly on the middle-aged man’s shoulder. It stretched its head out to glare directly at him.

*Say that again?*

Teacher Yu sat bolt upright. After all, he had seen the bloody claw marks on that stepmother’s face when he walked in.

“……”

*Is this really what you call ‘well-behaved’?*

Fortunately, his student came to his rescue. A light touch on his shoulder, and the little bird was lifted away.

Song Yu naturally placed the bird back on his own shoulder and said earnestly, “You shouldn't do that.”

Teacher Yu nodded slightly. *Yes, even pets need boundaries and rules.*

The very next second, Song Yu added:

“It’s not safe.”

“……”

Teacher Yu felt a wave of wry helplessness. *Was the bird the one in danger here? Isn't it ME?!*

*That beak is razor-sharp—one peck could poke a hole right through someone!*

*So many adults couldn't even catch it.*

*It’s practically an aerial fighter jet.*

Still, that wasn't the main point. Teacher Yu raised his eyes to examine the little bird carefully.

Medium build.

Felt quite heavy when perched on his shoulder.

And judging by its behavior, it really did seem to comprehend human language.

“……I see.”

“Song Yu, let’s talk in the study.”

-

The bird was being discriminated against!

Bai Linlin stood outside the study door, gazing up at the door handle before pacing back and forth like a flightless chicken.

*Patter, patter.*

chunks.chineseText:
他试图去偷听，但是无济于事，书房很大，还有里侧套间。

根本就听不到。

“……”

鸟沮丧。

与此同时——

“我觉得不要用伤害自己的方式来得到所谓的‘正确’。”

“身体机能的健康是很重要的，如果这一点做不到，精神状态会更加走下坡路。”

余老师其实并不打算用一些很专业的心理知识来开导，他只是以一个长辈的身份来给出建议。

“宋郁。”

“很多人都会有弄不清楚的事，ufo，龙……或者通俗意义上的鬼怪，人们都是辨别不清楚的。”

“科学家也不能佐证真假，但他们会用伤害自己的方式来证实这些未知的存在吗？”

“不会。”

余老师很是循循善诱地给出了答案，见人又听进去的意思，更进一步道：

“就算这世界上真的有无法解释的事，那就让它存在就好了。”

“不必要争个真假，过好你当下的生活就可以了。”

宋郁微微垂着眼眸，手指往上勾了下。

……

鸟在门外等的实在无聊，回了客厅的茶几，开始自己给自己剥奶糖。

正专心致志的时候，不远处传来说话的声音。

“没事，老师这就走了。”

“中午记得吃饭。”

“我给你叫个饭吧？”

余老师很是温和，边走边和旁边的宋郁说话。

其乐融融的。

就是到客厅的时候，和剥奶糖的鸟对视了。

男人脚步一顿。

“……”

“……”

白粼粼身子下压，扑棱翅膀就飞了过来，余老师几乎是本能地往后退了一步。

但这一幕全部被鸟看到了。

？

干什么？

白粼粼稳稳当当地站在宋郁的肩头，歪头看着对面的老师。

直视我。

“啊，这小鸟确实挺通人性。”

余老师实在是找不出合适的话来夸奖，毕竟乖巧……实在是半分沾不上边。

敬畏敬畏。

“嗯，它很可爱。”

“……”

余老师到底也是没什么话说了，只是把话头转到宋郁身上，让人好好照顾自己。

大约交谈了几句。

一人一鸟这才把客人送走了。

-

与此同时。

江芮正在工作室办公，正是烦闷的时候手机收到了一条消息。

她看完之后就眉目舒展了。

狐狸精，活该遭报应。

不过宋郁那个鸟……看起来还挺聪明？

江芮像是终于想起来自己还有儿子的联系方式，切了个页面，手指在屏幕上滑动，翻到了最底部。

她微微蹙了眉，因为上次的聊天框还停留在那一串不知所以的标点符号。

这孩子误触了怎么也不知道回消息？

越大越不懂事。

江芮看了看上面的转账，也是过期了。

她面色有些不好看，但是想到小予这几天一直在闹……那些送过来的鸟都不听话，多半应付不了几天。

宋郁的这只，看起来会护主，这孩子还挺有能耐的。

江芮神色好了些，自顾自地打字：

［江芮：小郁看到妈妈消息了吗？你把你的小鸟送给妹妹好不好？］

［江芮：妈妈给你买新的，你妹妹她不太会驯小鸟。］

但此刻锦园——

人在给鸟剥恰恰瓜子，原味的，手机被随意地放在茶几上，屏幕亮着。

白粼粼很急，因为宋郁的速度很慢，鸟甚至想自己叨过来。

但是人不让。

他只能鸟爪子搭上去，但宋郁的手指一直在动，连带着鸟也在动。

差点要翻了。

白粼粼歪歪扭扭，另外一只爪子不知道什么时候按上屏幕了，弹出来的消息被误打误撞打开了。

“只能吃一点点。”

“啾啾！！”

一人一鸟辩论着，但与此同时，手机屏幕的键盘不知道什么时候被调出来了。

……

江芮那边收到了新的消息。

［宋郁：？。！？］

［宋郁：你，病？］

作者有话说：

[鸽子][鸽子]：不用谢！

It tried to eavesdrop, but it was completely useless. The study was huge, and there was an inner suite beyond the main room.

It couldn't hear a single thing.

“……”

The bird was utterly crestfallen.

Meanwhile, inside the study—

“I don't think you should use self-harm as a way to seek a so-called ‘truth.’”

“Physical health is vital. If you can’t maintain that, your mental state will only spiral downward further.”

Teacher Yu didn't intend to use overly professional psychological jargon to counsel him. He simply offered advice from the perspective of an elder.

“Song Yu.”

“There are many things in this world that people can’t fully comprehend—UFOs, dragons... or ghosts and spirits in the conventional sense. Mankind cannot definitively verify them.”

“Even scientists cannot prove their reality or falsehood, but do they harm themselves just to confirm the existence of these unknown phenomena?”

“They don't.”

Teacher Yu patiently guided him toward the answer, and seeing that the boy was taking it in, he pushed a step further:

“Even if there really are unexplainable things in this world, just let them exist.”

“There is no need to fight over what is real and what is fake. Just live your present life well.”

Song Yu lowered his eyes slightly, his fingers curling inward slightly.

……

Outside the door, the bird got bored of waiting. It waddled back to the living room coffee table and began unwrapping White Rabbit candies all by itself.

Just as it was concentrating intently, voices sounded from nearby.

“It’s fine, I’ll be taking my leave now.”

“Remember to eat lunch.”

“How about I order a meal delivered for you?”

Teacher Yu spoke warmly, walking alongside Song Yu as they stepped out.

The scene was pure harmony.

Until they reached the living room and made direct eye contact with the bird unwrapping candy on the table.

The man’s footsteps ground to a halt.

“……”

“……”

Bai Linlin lowered its body, flapped its wings, and flew straight over. Teacher Yu instinctively took a step back out of pure reaction.

And that sudden retreat was witnessed entirely by the bird.

*?*

*What are you doing?*

Bai Linlin landed firmly on Song Yu’s shoulder, tilting its head to glare at the teacher across from them.

*Look me in the eye.*

“Ah... this little bird really is quite human-like.”

Teacher Yu struggled to find appropriate words of praise. After all, "gentle and obedient" didn't apply to this creature in the slightest.

A healthy dose of reverence was required.

“Mhm, it’s very cute.”

“……”

Teacher Yu was ultimately left speechless. He simply shifted the topic back to Song Yu, telling him to take good care of himself.

After exchanging a few more words, the boy and the bird finally saw the guest out.

-

At the same time.

Jiang Rui was working in her studio office, feeling utterly annoyed when a message popped up on her phone.

As she read through it, her expression relaxed into a pleased smile.

*That vixen, serves her right for getting what was coming to her.*

*Though, Song Yu’s bird... actually sounds pretty clever?*

As if finally remembering she had her son’s contact information, Jiang Rui switched apps, her fingers sliding across the screen to scroll all the way to the bottom.

She knit her brows slightly upon seeing that the last chat log still sat on that string of meaningless punctuation marks from before.

*Why didn't this child send a proper reply after accidentally touching the screen?*

*The older he gets, the more rude he becomes.*

Jiang Rui looked at the money transfer above, which had already expired.

Her expression soured a bit, but remembering how Xiaoyu had been throwing tantrums the past few days... All those birds brought to her were disobedient and likely wouldn't last long.

Song Yu’s bird, on the other hand, seemed to actively protect its owner. The boy actually possessed some capability.

Jiang Rui’s expression softened slightly, and she typed out a message on her own terms:

[Jiang Rui: *Xiao Yu, did you see Mom’s message? How about you give your little bird to your younger sister?*]

[Jiang Rui: *Mom will buy you a new one. Your sister isn't very good at training birds.*]

Meanwhile, at Jinyuan Estate—

The human was carefully peeling sunflower seeds for the bird—original flavor. The phone was casually placed on the coffee table, its screen glowing bright.

Bai Linlin was getting impatient because Song Yu’s shelling speed was far too slow. The bird even wanted to peck at the seeds itself, but the boy refused to let it.

It could only rest a claw on his hand. But Song Yu’s fingers kept moving, causing the bird’s balance to wobble along with them.

It almost tumbled over.

As Bai Linlin teetered unsteadily, its other claw accidentally stomped onto the glowing phone screen, tapping open the pop-up notification by sheer coincidence.

“You can only eat a little bit.”

“*Chirp chirp!!*”

One human and one bird were engaged in a heated debate, entirely unaware that the phone’s touch keyboard had been activated underfoot.

……

Over on Jiang Rui’s end, new messages flashed across her screen.

[Song Yu: *?.!?!*]

[Song Yu: *Are, you sick?*]

***

第17章

宋郁垂眸看着鸟认真地叨那一个瓜子仁，圆滚滚的脑袋一动一动的，爪子还在抵住他的手指。

是让人不要动的意思。

“……”

宋郁就这么伺候着，其实后面也想通了，他不再思考那些关于鸟的“不合理”事件了。

没有意义。

余老师说的没错，与其非要执着地将事情分个对错，倒不如完全地接纳，允许生活中出现杂乱的线头。

不去探究根源。

不去辨别真假。

像那些平行空间的际遇，那些发帖人总会讲述自己遇到的无法解释的事，但他们整体的感受是负面的么？

不是。

大多是震惊和惊奇。

甚至认为这是人生中绝无仅有的经历。

宋郁很客观地自我开解，他垂眸看着茶几上毛绒绒的小鸟，面色平静，心里只有一个想法。

那是不是。

他遇见了绝无仅有的一只小鸟……

与此同时，工作室那里的江芮看到消息后一下子站了起来，面色变得很难看。

这是不是故意的？

这孩子现在是能耐了，学着拐着弯来骂人……女人当即就打算拨电话过去。

但就在这时，门口秘书说有人来了。

江芮深吸一口气，只能先作罢，毕竟工作重要，但她没想到来的人是江连成，自己的父亲。

……

“爸！你来干什么，你不知道我很忙吗？”

江芮其实是有点不满的，环着手臂看着会客沙发上的父亲，对方虽然老了，但仍然穿得文质彬彬的。

江连成闻言很是不满，还是抬头指责了几句，“你妈去世得早，我没有多管过你，但是下次不能这样。”

“你让小郁去什么满月酒？”

“你陈叔叔都直接找到我这里了！”

江芮闻言面色变得难看，“和他有什么关系？我生的孩子我为什么不能叫人过来？”

“都是我生的，宋郁的弟弟，他来看看怎么了？”

“我哪个月没给他零花钱？我亏待他了？”

“我生他也是丢了半条命的！”

气氛一下子僵住了。

江连成闻言闭了闭眼，他只是压着声音斥责道：

“那为什么还生！你就真是昏了头，那个制片人就真的——”

江芮像是气急了，转了头就打断道，“不要说了！”

房间里一片死寂，最后女人冷冷地丢出来一句。

“我不可能让宋启明看笑话。”

-

宋郁其实后面有看到了江芮的信息，但那已经是一周后了。

少年垂着眼睫看着那些聊天记录，面上没有什么情绪，只是抬手往上翻。

零星的几条对话。

每次对话前面都有转账。

五万、六万、十万。

不发钱，似乎就不能聊。

宋郁总是觉得她很忙，幼年时期他去找过江芮很多次，但每次都被扔给助理。

离婚之后，江芮创办了尚美工作室，做影视剧的后期制作，甚至还签了几个艺人。

宋郁见过江芮身边有好几个男模，不过那时候也是没空。

——妈妈很忙，等妈妈事业好起来好吗？

——小郁最乖了。

那些记忆如风一样地飘过，灰色的，在小巷子里，身着亮丽长裙的女人蹲着身子抱着自己的孩子，眉眼都是温柔的。

时过境迁。

江芮再婚，事业蒸蒸日上，怀孕，在医院里奔波。

宋郁几乎见证了他母亲的变化，从温和到戾气不止，婚姻毁了她。

但她还要生……

仿佛有密不透风的黑墙压过来，一点点地把人吞噬。

宋郁想到那个孩子的名字就作呕，以至于捏着手机的手指都收紧了。

屏幕外缘有些变色。

但就在这时，一个爪子稳稳地落在了手机上端，宋郁一下子抽离出来了。

“啾啾？”

鸟仰头，看着人。

白粼粼本来是在外头溜达的，因为宋郁让人给换了一扇门，玄关那里有挺大的一块可视屏幕。

鸟特别好奇。

因为原来的门禁系统是有人脸识别的，那新的……

有没有鸟脸识别？

白粼粼在玄关那里研究了半天，后面才反应过来门是只能识别外头的，他在里面。

“……”

遂来找人。

鸟想要录入一下鸟脸，再不济录入一下爪子上的纹路也可以。

科技应该发展到这个水平了吧？

白粼粼很是期待地想着，当然如果没有的话也不要紧，鸟有备选方案，让宋郁上大学研究这个……

那句话怎么说。

选择大于努力。

白粼粼对于自己选中的“人”非常满意，尽管“人”生了点小病，但这完全掩盖不了他的优点。

瑕不掩瑜！

对，就是这样。

不过他也不要什么别的，就想要个可以刷脸的入户门。

这样鸟就可以自由自在地出去溜达了。

“饿了？”

宋郁伸了伸手，等着鸟伸爪子过来，温和地问了下。

白粼粼：“……”

才没有。

但鸟还是屈尊降贵地伸爪子过来了，不过就是由于这段时间吃得太好了，导致他平衡有点受影响。

扑棱了几下翅膀。

宋郁蹙眉就打算把鸟拿起来，但动作进行到一半，手指被抵住了。

是鸟的一边翅膀。

“……”

白粼粼有点稍微的尴尬，不过还是稳稳地站在了人的手指上，收回了翅膀，若无其事地梳理了下羽毛。

宋郁似乎接受度变高了，看到这副场景也只是有些愣，随后把鸟放在自己肩头了。

“我要复习一下。”

“要去房间玩吗？”

宋郁换了个说辞，看着肩头的小鸟，觉得它是不是无聊了。

隔壁的房间有秋千。

小鸟应该会喜欢？

“啾啾。”

[不要。]

白粼粼拒绝了，他本来是上来拽人给他介绍新门的，但这会儿又给忘了，只是低头看了下书桌。

看书？

他还没见过宋郁学习。

鸟飞下了肩头，端端正正地站在那本要复习的书上头，羽毛蓬松。

“你要陪我？”

白粼粼一下子愣了，他是这个意思的吗？

但是已经来不及解释了，宋郁似乎完全接受了这个结论，从抽屉里拿出来个椰子壳。

挪向了鸟。

白粼粼：“……”

他还是钻进去了，然后在里头转个身子，探头看宋郁看书。

少年垂眸看得很快，也不用笔，仿佛是在扫什么课外书一样。

白粼粼震惊。

有这么复习的吗？

事实证明不仅有，宋郁效率还很快，翻完半本之后就没有再看了。

高考会出一些选拔的题目，比较难，但解题思路记住就可以了。

万变不离其宗。

宋郁把书放到一旁去，侧眸看了下椰子壳，鸟已经睡着了，羽毛蓬松，犹如一个毛绒挂件。

他没有太打扰，只是把书收了起来，不过就在这时，宋郁看到了上次齐思扬送过来的那本书。

《保姆级教程：让你的鹦鹉妙语连珠！》

封皮很是花花绿绿的。

宋郁低头看了下出版信息，发现居然没有，只有印刷的日期。

里头的内页也是花花绿绿，有的直接用的视频的截图。

“……”

Chapter 17 (Part 1)

Song Yu lowered his gaze, watching the little bird intently peck at a single sunflower seed kernel. Its round, chubby head bobbed up and down while one tiny claw remained pressed firmly against his finger.

It was clearly telling him not to move.

"..."

Song Yu simply catered to its whim. In truth, he had come to terms with things afterward; he no longer bothered overthinking the "unreasonable" anomalies surrounding this bird.

There was no point to it.

Teacher Yu had been right. Rather than obsessively trying to sort every single thing into right and wrong, it was far better to embrace it whole, allowing life to retain its tangled, messy threads.

No probing into root causes.

No discerning truth from falsehood.

It was like those encounters in parallel dimensions—the users who posted online always recounted bizarre, unexplainable things they had experienced. But were their overall feelings negative?

Not at all.

Most felt shock and wonder.

Some even considered it a once-in-a-lifetime experience.

Song Yu consoled himself with cool objectivity. He looked down at the fluffy little creature resting on the coffee table, his face serene, with only a single thought echoing in his mind.

Could it be...

That he had stumbled upon a truly once-in-a-lifetime little bird?

***

Meanwhile, over at the studio, Jiang Rui stood up abruptly after seeing the message, her face darkening.

Was this deliberate?

The boy certainly had some nerve now, learning to hurl indirect insults... She immediately prepared to dial his number.

Just then, her secretary announced from the doorway that a visitor had arrived.

Jiang Rui took a deep breath and had no choice but to drop the matter for now—work came first, after all. However, she had not expected the visitor to be Jiang Liancheng, her own father.

...

"Dad! What are you doing here? Don't you know I'm extremely busy?"

Jiang Rui was distinctly displeased. Crossing her arms, she glared at her father sitting on the reception sofa. Though getting on in years, he was still dressed immaculately and refinement oozed from his posture.

Hearing her tone, Jiang Liancheng frowned with dissatisfaction, raising a hand to chide her. "Your mother passed away early, so I never meddled much in your affairs, but you cannot act like this next time."

"Why on earth did you drag Xiao Yu to that full-month celebration?"

"Your Uncle Chen came straight to me to complain!"

Jiang Rui's expression turned ugly. "What does it have to do with him? I gave birth to the child—why can't I invite whoever I want?"

"Both are my blood! He's Song Yu's younger brother—what's wrong with him coming to take a look?"

"Which month haven't I given him pocket money? Have I mistreated him?"

"Giving birth to him nearly cost me half my life!"

The atmosphere instantly froze into an icy standstill.

Jiang Liancheng closed his eyes, suppressing his voice as he barked, "Then why did you give birth in the first place?! You really lost your mind—was that producer really worth—"

As if pushed past her limit, Jiang Rui whipped her head around and cut him off loudly, "Stop talking!"

A suffocating silence descended upon the room. Finally, the woman threw out a chilling sentence.

"I will never let Song Qiming mock me."

-

Song Yu actually saw Jiang Rui's message later on, but a full week had passed by then.

The youth lowered his eyelashes, staring blankly at the chat history. His face remained devoid of emotion as he simply swiped upward with his thumb.

A sparse scattering of dialogues.

Preceding every single exchange was a money transfer.

Fifty thousand, sixty thousand, a hundred thousand.

If money wasn't sent, it seemed no conversation could happen at all.

Song Yu had always felt she was busy. In his childhood, he had sought out Jiang Rui countless times, only to be dumped on an assistant every single time.

After the divorce, Jiang Rui founded Shangmei Studio, working in post-production for film and television, even signing a few artists.

Song Yu had seen several male models around her, though back then, she still had no time for him.

—*Mom is very busy. Wait until Mom's career takes off, okay?*

—*Xiao Yu is the most sensible boy.*

Those memories drifted past like a gray, faded breeze. In a narrow alleyway, a woman dressed in a vivid, elegant dress crouched down to embrace her child, her eyes brimming with gentle affection.

How times had changed.

Jiang Rui remarried, her career flourished, she got pregnant, and she bustled back and forth in hospitals.

Song Yu had witnessed almost the entirety of his mother's transformation—from gentle warmth to unbridled hostility. Marriage had destroyed her.

Yet she still insisted on giving birth...

It felt as though an impenetrable black wall was pressing down, swallowing him bit by bit.

Song Yu felt a sudden wave of nausea at the mere thought of that child's name, causing his fingers gripping the phone to tighten unconsciously.

The edges of the screen distorted slightly under the pressure.

Right at that moment, a tiny claw settled firmly onto the top edge of the phone, instantly snapping Song Yu out of his trance.

"Chirp chirp?"

The bird cocked its head up, staring at him.

Bai Linlin had originally been strolling around outside. Since Song Yu had gotten someone to replace the front door, there was now a rather large video intercom display near the entryway.

The bird was immensely curious about it.

Because the old lock system had facial recognition, what about the new one...

Did it have *bird-face* recognition?

Bai Linlin had spent half the day investigating near the entryway, only to realize later that the door could only scan from the outside, whereas he was on the inside.

"..."

Hence, he had come to find his human.

The bird wanted to register his bird face, or at the very least, register the pattern on his claws.

Surely technology had advanced to that level by now, right?

Bai Linlin thought with great anticipation. Of course, if it hadn't, it didn't matter—the bird had a backup plan: make Song Yu study this field when he went to university...

How did the saying go?

Choice matters more than effort.

Bai Linlin was exceedingly satisfied with the "human" he had chosen. Although the "human" had a slight mental affliction, it could not obscure his overwhelming merits.

The flaw did not tarnish the jade!

Yes, exactly that.

Besides, he didn't want anything grand—just a front door where he could swipe his face.

That way, the bird could freely go out for strolls whenever he pleased.

"Hungry?"

Song Yu extended his hand, waiting for the bird to offer a claw, and asked gently.

Bai Linlin: "..."

Not at all.

Even so, the bird deigned to extend a claw and step up. However, because he had been eating far too well lately, his balance was slightly compromised.

He flapped his wings a few times.

Song Yu micro-frowned, intending to scoop the bird up, but midway through the motion, his finger was held down.

It was pressed down by one of the bird's wings.

"..."

Bai Linlin felt a tiny prick of embarrassment, but he still stood firmly on the youth's finger, retracted his wing, and nonchalantly preened his feathers.

Song Yu seemed to have developed a higher tolerance for these oddities. Seeing this scene, he merely froze briefly before placing the bird on his shoulder.

"I need to review my lessons."

"Do you want to go to the other room to play?"

Song Yu rephrased his question, looking at the little bird on his shoulder, wondering if it felt bored.

There was a swing in the adjacent room.

The little bird would probably like it?

"Chirp chirp."

[*No.*]

Bai Linlin refused. He had originally come over to drag the boy to introduce him to the new door, but he had forgotten all about it by now, merely looking down at the desk.

Reading books?

He hadn't seen Song Yu study yet.

The bird flew off his shoulder and perched squarely on top of the review textbook, its feathers fluffed up.

"You want to keep me company?"

Bai Linlin was momentarily stunned. Was that what he meant?

It was already too late to explain. Song Yu seemed to have fully accepted this conclusion, pulling a coconut-shell nest out of a drawer.

He slid it toward the bird.

Bai Linlin: "..."

He crawled inside anyway, turned around, and poked his head out to watch Song Yu read.

The youth looked down, flipping through the pages at an astonishing speed. He didn't even use a pen, as if he were merely scanning a casual extracurricular book.

Bai Linlin was shocked.

Who on earth reviews like this?!

As it turned out, not only did he review like this, but Song Yu's efficiency was terrifyingly high. After flipping through half the book, he stopped looking at it.

The College Entrance Examination would feature a few selective, high-difficulty questions, but as long as one memorized the underlying logic, it was simple.

All variations stemmed from the same core principles.

Song Yu set the book aside and glanced sideways at the coconut shell. The bird was already fast asleep, its feathers puffed out like a plush hanging ornament.

Not wanting to disturb it too much, he quietly put the book away. Just then, however, Song Yu caught sight of the book Qi Siyang had delivered last time.

*Nanny-Level Tutorial: Turn Your Parrot Into a Fluent Talker!*

The cover was garishly colorful.

Song Yu looked down at the publication information, only to discover there wasn't any—only a printing date.

The interior pages were equally gaudy, some even using direct screenshots from videos.

"..."

Was this really reliable?

chunks.chineseText:
靠谱么？

-

与此同时，S州。

宋启明没有想到自己都一把年纪了，还能半夜接到来自小学老师的电话，整个人都有些不好。

当年军区大院，下来的老师基本都是战场上通讯员之类的，有的还是作战指挥部那里的。

上学的时候挨批评就算了。

但没想到现在还——

“启明，不是我说你，你就算是再婚了，也不能不管小郁。”

“孩子一个人住在锦园就算了，怎么能不通知就让他的后妈后弟弟过去，现在正是关键时期你知道不知道！”

电话那头的老爷子中气十足，身体看起来硬朗得很。

旁边的班主任闲着没事干，抬手给自己倒了杯茶。

宋启明只能解释道：

“我知道，我知道。宋郁他小时候闹脾气，不让长韵进家门，长韵怀着孕呢，我也没说什么，后面就搬出去了。”

“宋郁他不过来和我一起住，我也由着他了。不过是这回小阳也该上附小了，我就想着这边比较近……”

电话那头一顿批：

“荒唐！锦园那是峥国留给小郁的，他妈妈在那里住过，你让外人进去那能行吗！”

宋启明额头都有青筋了，他一把年纪了，电话那头的人更是一把年纪。

更何况对方的身份……

不能得罪。

他就不明白了，自己再婚这件事怎么就这么多人反对？

多少年了都还有偏见。

“是是是，我知道了。”

宋启明耐着性子解释，同时也为自己辩白了几句：

“老师你不用担心他上学的事，我没打算让他在国内读，外头的商科不错，英国那边的学校——”

话还没说完，对面又给否了。

“你晕头啊，华秉现在这么动荡，你把孩子送外头？这不明摆着给外界传信号呢？什么意思，这产业全给你那小的？”

“舆论造势你是一点都不顾啊！”

宋启明整个人都脑子嗡嗡的，他根本就不会和这些从过政的人打交道，一句里藏着十句的信息。

乱糟糟的。

“我没这么想，我爸这里……”

电话那头更是一顿说，甚至提及了当年宋峥国晕倒在家里的事。

“老师就教你那么几年，但实话说，三岁看大，七岁看老，启明，你要上点心，知人知面不知心。”

后面的话其实很有暗示意味了，说完就挂了。

宋启明面上没有什么表情，但其实心里已经一团乱麻，他深呼一口气，给国内打了个电话。

大约等了有好一会，电话才接。

“怎么这么久？”

对面的女声似乎是刚刚在运动，有点喘气，只是道：

“在爬楼梯，电梯坏了。”

宋启明蹙了蹙眉，“公司的？后勤是怎么管的？我现在就去问。”

但就在这时，电话那头人又立马道：

“欸好了，没事没事，不用问了，我到地方了。”

宋启明刚想再说几句，但是对方似乎很忙，说是要开会，只是匆匆补了句“爱你”。

S州的夜里很冷。

没有人陪着说话显得空荡荡的。

宋启明这会儿想起来了自己的大儿子，拨了一通电话，尽管有些许的愧疚，但眉毛已经提前蹙起来了。

他觉得还是要教育几句。

养着个会咬人的鸟干什么？

但是，没接。

而此时的锦园。

宋郁在和鸟一起看书，手机设了勿扰模式，被随意地扔在桌子的一旁。

“你要学吗？”

宋郁侧眸问了下，其实他也不太确定自己的小鸟喜不喜欢说话。

毕竟从上一次撞见打游戏……他就没怎么见过鸟说话了。

所以还是要尊重一下意见。

鸟刚睡醒，迷迷瞪瞪的，低头看着花花绿绿的书页精准提取到了一个加深的对话框。

那是网络热梗。

鸟歪了歪头，仿佛被基因代码给控住了，蹦哒了一下，语气抑扬顿挫地学舌：

“你老婆跟人跑了。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 17 (Part 2)

Meanwhile, in S City.

Song Qiming had never imagined that at his age, he would receive a late-night phone call from his primary school teacher, leaving him completely unsettled.

Back then in the military compound, the teachers who came down were mostly former signals corps or combat command staff from the battlefield.

Getting scolded during school days was one thing.

He never expected that now—

"Qiming, I don't mean to pry, but even if you're remarried, you can't just ignore Xiao Yu!"

"Leaving the boy to live alone in Jinyuan is bad enough, but how could you let his stepmother and stepbrother barge over without notice? Do you have any idea how critical a period this is for him right now?!"

The old man on the other end of the line was brimming with energy, his voice booming like a bell.

Beside him, the class teacher, having nothing better to do, raised a hand to pour himself a cup of tea.

Song Qiming could only explain meekly, "I know, I know. When Song Yu was little, he threw a tantrum and wouldn't let Changyun enter the house. Changyun was pregnant back then, so I didn't push it, and we moved out later."

"Song Yu refused to come live with me, so I indulged him. It's just that this time Xiaoyang needs to attend the affiliated primary school, and I thought it was closer on that side..."

A sharp lecture erupted from the phone:

"Absurd! Jinyuan was left to Xiao Yu by Zhengguo! His mother lived there! How could you let outsiders move in?!"

Veins pulsed violently on Song Qiming's forehead. He was getting up there in age, but the person on the other end was even older.

More importantly, the man's identity...

Was one he could not afford to offend.

He simply couldn't understand why so many people opposed his remarriage.

How many years had passed, yet the prejudice remained?

"Yes, yes, yes, I understand."

Song Qiming suppressed his temper to explain, while simultaneously trying to defend himself. "Teacher, you don't need to worry about his education. I don't plan on having him study domestically. The business programs abroad are quite good—schools in the UK—"

Before he could finish, the other side shot him down again.

"Are you out of your mind?! Huabing Group is undergoing such turmoil right now, and you want to send the boy abroad? Isn't that explicitly signaling to the outside world? What do you mean by this—are you handing all the family assets to your younger son?!"

"Do you care about public perception at all?!"

Song Qiming felt his brain buzzing. He was utterly terrible at dealing with these former political figures; every single sentence hid ten layers of unspoken meaning.

It was an absolute mess.

"I didn't think of it that way. My father's situation..."

The voice on the phone unleashed another barrage, even bringing up the incident years ago when Song Zhengguo had collapsed at home.

"I only taught you for a few years, but to be frank, you can tell what a person will become at seven by looking at them at three. Qiming, you need to wake up and pay attention. You can know a person's face, but not their heart."

The subsequent words carried heavy implications. Having said his piece, the old man hung up.

Song Qiming's face was devoid of expression, but inside, his mind was an entangled knot. Taking a deep breath, he dialed a domestic number.

After quite a long wait, the call was finally picked up.

"What took so long?"

The woman's voice on the other end sounded somewhat out of breath, as if she had just finished exercising. "I was climbing the stairs. The elevator is broken."

Song Qiming frowned. "At the company? How is logistics managing things? I'll go ask right now."

Just as he spoke, the woman quickly interjected, "Ah, it's fine, it's fine! No need to ask, I've reached my floor."

Song Qiming wanted to say a few more words, but she seemed extremely busy, mentioning she had to run into a meeting, only adding a hurried "Love you" before hanging up.

The night in S City was bitterly cold.

With no one around to talk to, the room felt hollow and desolate.

At this moment, Song Qiming recalled his eldest son. He dialed the number, and despite feeling a sliver of guilt, his eyebrows instinctively knitted together beforehand.

He felt he still needed to lecture the boy a bit.

Why keep a bird that bites people?

However, nobody answered.

***

Meanwhile, at Jinyuan.

Song Yu was reading with the bird, his phone set to Do Not Disturb and casually tossed onto the side of the desk.

"Do you want to learn?"

Song Yu asked, glancing sideways. In truth, he wasn't sure if his little bird liked to speak.

After all, since the last time he caught it playing video games... he had rarely seen it speak.

Thus, he still needed to respect its wishes.

Having just woken up, the bird was groggy and dazed. Lowering its head to look at the colorful pages, it accurately extracted a bolded dialogue box.

It was an internet meme.

The bird tilted its head, as if suddenly possessed by its genetic code. It hopped once and mimicked in an exaggerated, cadence-shifting tone:

"Your wife ran away with someone else!"

chunks.chineseText:
第18章

宋郁听到后怔了下，抬手把鸟从肩头拿了下来，由于担心它栽倒，甚至是用两个手捧下来的。

上下虚虚拢着。

刚挪到了膝上的书上，宋郁的虎口就被“挤”开了。

一个圆滚滚的鸟头正好卡在那里，歪头看过来，对视。

“……”

“不能学这种话，不礼貌。”

宋郁垂眸认真说道，眉毛微蹙，并不太赞成。

但鸟只是低了低头，好似不太在意，它的爪子稳稳地踩在人的掌心，时不时还会稍稍挪动下。

宋郁看着动来动去的小鸟头，其实有些走神，它到底有没有在听？

不过就在这时。

掌心的爪子一个用力。

“……”

白粼粼非常努力地往外拱自己的鸟头，他被卡在人的虎口中间了，缩也缩不回去，出也出不来。

叨了两口人肉。

发现人在走神。

再次使劲。

宋郁愣了下，因为他甚至能感觉到鸟的爪子在他掌心里打滑。

很用力了。

人有些抱歉，把自己的手给挪开了，鸟的“五指山”也终于消失了。

但白粼粼一个没控制好力度，直接啪唧平地栽倒了宋郁的掌心。

“……”

从哪里摔倒，就在哪里躺着。

鸟伸着鸟腿。

直接闭眼。

就在这时，上方传来一声轻笑。

-

时间很快就来到了六月，白粼粼隐约觉得自己好像是忘了一件重要的事。

但是他怎么也想不起来。

宋郁参加高考的那两天，鸟在家里非常自由，时不时去厨房叼上次网购的零食，偶尔也会在客厅里到处走动。

闲得没事就开电视看。

主要频道是国防军事，因为里面的飞机让鸟觉得有隐隐的亲和感。

都会飞。

考试最后一天下午，白粼粼照旧叼着一包薯片飞到了茶几那里，随后用爪子按住遥控器，打开了电视。

这个是番茄味道的。

好吃。

鸟低头咬住包装袋，然后往上一扯，稳当当地打开了。

随后开始品鉴。

如此美妙的生活。

鸟很满意，鸟还有一部手机，啪嗒啪嗒在茶几上走两圈，用爪子操作了下。

给下单了一杯元气啵啵奶茶。

白粼粼在门口等了一会，确定东西到了才飞到门把手上，努力用自身的重量往下墩墩。

直到门开了个缝隙。

鸟头鬼鬼祟祟地探了出去，确定没人之后才伸了伸喙，叼着那包装袋子往家里拖。

与此同时——

宋启明正在s州的公寓里接电话，电脑屏幕上正在加载新传输过来的监控画面，不过或许是网络不好，还在加载中。

“喂，到底又怎么了？”

宋启明其实心情不怎么样，原本父亲状态不错的时候，他是真的很高兴，今早医生说了预估的醒来时间后，他又有点担心。

会不会又骂他不成器？

宋启明接到公司那边的电话也没什么好态度，华秉现在就是个烂摊子，财务那里一直在出问题，要么是税务，要么是银行的账。

他就不知道手底下的人怎么干的！

电话那头是个年轻声音，支支吾吾地道：

“公司主楼的电梯坏了，但是后勤那里迟迟不修，财务也说……”

宋启明闻言整个人都要气炸了，他的衬衫都是皱巴的，下巴也有泛出来的青茬。

他在国外守着他老子。

公司就乱成这个样子？

宋启明完全就是震怒，这是开玩笑还是真的，他的私人电话是拿来说这些鸡毛蒜皮的事？

厉峰是怎么替他管的！

让个实习生过来打他的私人电话？

但就在这时——

“厉总说是他在忙，财务那边他管不着……您的私人电话是董事会那边……”

宋启明也不想听了，他反正过几天就要回国，到时候再处理这些乱七八糟的事。

不过他还是很在意一个点，拧眉道：

“电梯又坏了？”

“我先前吩咐过人去后勤通知全检了。”

但那边似乎是一愣，只是如实说：

“后勤那边说没有检查过……”

宋启明人有些恍惚，他心一下子静了下来，从小他就被父亲说转不过来弯，现下停了一会。

才问：

“谁告诉你我的私人电话的？”

“董事会的林董。”

电话挂了，公寓里安安静静的，宋启明自顾自站了一会，随后拧眉拿起手机改签了机票，没告诉现在身边的助理。

他深呼一口气，觉得真是乱糟糟一片，大半夜的，突然想起来大儿子了。

宋郁割腕过。

他其实一直都不知道具体抑郁原因，但说到底老师那通电话让他有了点愧疚之心，大半夜过来调监控。

宋启明拉开椅子，刚抬眼去看屏幕，神色一愣。

摄像头是安在电视屏幕的下方，很隐蔽，广角的，几乎可以看到整个客厅的全貌。

而此刻……

镜头里只有一个活物在行动，是那只鸟，明晃晃地站在茶几上，用爪子按着遥控器，似乎在换台，一边按来按去的，一边歪头把喙戳进奶茶薄膜里，在啜饮。

可那奶茶，和那鸟一样高。

宋启明整个身子都往后退了下，这很诡异。

是他要猝死了？

男人抬手就把屏幕给关了。

与此同时，白粼粼在用爪子换台的时候，突然发现电视下方有个红点闪了下。

欸？

鸟啪嗒啪嗒地走过去。

这边。

宋启明深呼吸一口气，觉得又不像是猝死前的幻觉，毕竟他感觉还好，没有心悸。

大约缓了一会。

他本来打算准备去休息了，但是又想要确定一下，于是就又打开了监控。

估计是看错了。

宋启明还在这么想着，此刻的电脑页面还在加载中，在夜里发着幽幽的光。

一秒，两秒。

黑屏的屏幕突然闪了一下。

然后出现了个巨大的鸟头。

“啊啊——”

宋启明被吓得脸色惨白，心脏快速地跳动，他硬撑着把电脑给关了。

呼吸都变得急促。

在他的视角下，先前那鸟还在茶几那里，结果这次直接突脸了。

这是什么东西……

怪物，怪物。

-

鸟不知道自己成了什么可怖的存在，只是歪头盯着那个小红点。

非常隐蔽。

白粼粼甚至试图去叨一口，后面才反应过来这应该是微型摄像头。

啊。

他给忘了这件事了。

白粼粼：“……”

那闪了红灯是什么意思，对面有人开机了么？

宋郁的爹？

“……”

鸟回头看了下茶几上的一堆东西，沉默了一会，随后扑棱翅膀飞了过去。

开始愤愤不平地叼着包装袋扔垃圾桶。

如此循环往复。

越想越气。

可恶的宋启明，知不知道不经他人允许安装监控是违法的？

侵犯人权！

还有鸟权！

白粼粼看电视的好心情都没了，砰砰跳跳地站在了垃圾桶的盖子上，把茶几恢复了原貌。

“……”

应该不会有事吧？

当天晚上宋郁就接到了父亲的电话，那时鸟和人正在卧室的书桌前看书。

是与填报志愿相关的。

Chapter 18 (Part 1)

Song Yu froze upon hearing those words. He raised his hands to gently lift the bird off his shoulder, cupping it loosely with both palms for fear that it might tumble over.

He enclosed it loosely top and bottom.

The moment he moved the bird over the book resting on his lap, the webbing between his thumb and index finger was forcefully pushed open.

A chubby bird head poked right out through the gap, tilting sideways to meet his gaze.

"..."

"You shouldn't learn phrases like that. It's impolite."

Song Yu looked down and spoke earnestly, his brow furrowed in mild disapproval.

The bird merely lowered its head, looking entirely unbothered. Its tiny claws stepped firmly on his palm, shifting slightly every now and then.

Looking at the wiggling little bird head, Song Yu lost himself in thought for a second. Was it even listening?

Right at that moment, however...

The claws in his palm suddenly exerted force.

"..."

Bai Linlin was trying desperately to shove his head outward. He was stuck squarely in the youth's hand; he couldn't pull back in, nor could he squeeze out.

He nipped at the human's skin twice.

Realizing the boy was zoning out, he used all his strength once more.

Song Yu snapped out of it, surprised to feel the bird's claws slipping against his palm.

It was really giving its all.

Feeling slightly apologetic, the youth moved his hand away, and the "Five-Finger Mountain" trapping the bird finally vanished.

However, Bai Linlin failed to control his momentum, tumbling face-first right into Song Yu's palm with a soft *splat*.

"..."

Falling where he tripped, he simply lay flat right there.

The bird stretched out its tiny legs.

And closed its eyes in defeat.

Above him, a soft, low chuckle resonated.

***

Time swiftly flew by, and June arrived in the blink of an eye. Bai Linlin had a vague feeling that he had forgotten an important matter, yet no matter how hard he tried, he couldn't recall what it was.

During the two days Song Yu took the College Entrance Examination, the bird enjoyed immense freedom at home. From time to time, he would fly to the kitchen to snatch snacks from the recent online delivery, or wander around the living room.

When bored, he would turn on the TV.

His channel of choice was the Military and Defense channel, mainly because the fighter jets inside gave him an instinctual sense of kin.

They could both fly, after all.

On the afternoon of the final exam day, Bai Linlin flew to the coffee table holding a bag of potato chips in his beak, as was his routine. He pressed his claw onto the remote control and turned on the TV.

These were tomato-flavored.

Delicious.

The bird bit down on the packaging, gave a sharp tug upward, and opened it cleanly.

He then began tasting his feast.

What a wonderful life.

Sufficiently pleased, the bird grabbed his smartphone, waddled around the coffee table tapping with his claw, and placed an order for a cup of Genki Boba Milk Tea.

Bai Linlin waited near the door for a while. Once he confirmed the delivery had arrived, he flew onto the door handle and used his body weight to push it down repeatedly until the door opened a crack.

Slyly poking his head out to ensure no one was in the hallway, he extended his beak, grabbed the bag, and dragged it inside.

Simultaneously—

In his apartment in S City, Song Qiming was answering a phone call while watching a newly transmitted surveillance feed loading on his computer screen. Perhaps due to a poor network connection, it was still buffering.

"Hello? What on earth is it this time?!"

Song Qiming was in a foul mood. His father's condition had originally been improving, which brought him genuine joy. However, after the doctor gave an estimated wake-up time this morning, anxiety crept back in.

Would his father wake up only to berate him for being useless again?

Song Qiming didn't have any patience left when answering calls from the company. Huabing Group was an utter mess right now; financial issues kept cropping up continuously—either tax audits or banking discrepancies.

He had no idea how the people under him were managing things!

A young voice came through the phone, stammering hesitantly, "The elevator in the main building is broken, but logistics has been delaying repairs. The finance department also said..."

Song Qiming nearly exploded with rage upon hearing this. His shirt was rumpled, and a stubble of blue-ish beard had sprouted on his chin.

He was overseas tending to his father.

Was the company collapsing into chaos like this in his absence?!

Song Qiming was thoroughly incensed. Was this a joke, or was it real? Was his private number meant for reporting such trivial nonsense?

How on earth was Li Feng managing things on his behalf?!

Sending an intern to dial his private line?!

Just then—

"Director Li said he's busy, and he doesn't oversee finance... Your private number was given by the board of directors..."

Song Qiming didn't want to listen anymore. He was returning to the country in a few days anyway, and he would handle all these messy affairs then.

However, one specific detail nagged at him. Frowning, he asked, "The elevator is broken *again*?"

"I previously instructed someone to notify logistics to perform a full inspection."

The person on the other end froze, answering honestly, "Logistics said no inspection was ever requested..."

Song Qiming felt a momentary daze as a cold stillness settled over his mind. Ever since childhood, his father had scolded him for being slow-witted. Pausing for a moment, he finally asked:

"Who gave you my private number?"

"Director Lin from the board."

The call ended, leaving the apartment deathly quiet. Song Qiming stood alone for a while before tightening his brow, pulling out his phone, and rescheduling his flight—without informing the assistant currently by his side.

He exhaled deeply, feeling as though everything was an absolute mess. In the dead of night, he suddenly remembered his eldest son.

Song Yu had slit his wrists before.

Song Qiming had never actually known the exact reason for his depression, but ultimately, the teacher's phone call had awakened a sliver of guilt within him, prompting him to pull up the surveillance feed in the middle of the night.

Song Qiming pulled back a chair and sat down. The moment he looked up at the screen, his expression froze.

The camera was installed covertly beneath the television screen. It was a wide-angle lens, capable of capturing almost the entire living room.

And at this moment...

There was only a single living creature moving within the frame—it was that bird, standing brazenly on the coffee table, pressing the remote control with its claw as if changing channels. As it pressed away, it tilted its head to puncture the sealing film of a milk tea cup with its beak, sipping away contentedly.

Yet that milk tea cup was as tall as the bird itself!

Song Qiming recoiled, his entire body shifting backward in sheer horror.

Was he suffering a stroke or sudden cardiac arrest?

The man raised his hand and slammed the screen shut.

***

At that very moment, while using his claw to switch channels, Bai Linlin suddenly noticed a tiny red light flash beneath the TV screen.

Huh?

The bird waddled over, step by step.

***

On the other side.

Song Qiming took a deep breath, realizing it didn't feel like hallucinations prior to sudden death. After all, he felt fine otherwise, with no chest palpitations.

After composing himself for a moment, he had intended to go rest, but wanting to verify what he saw, he reopened the surveillance app.

He must have misseen it.

Song Qiming reassured himself. The computer screen was still buffering in the night, emitting a faint, eerie glow.

One second, two seconds.

The black screen suddenly flashed.

And then, a massive bird face filled the entire monitor!

"AAAAAAH—!"

Song Qiming's face turned corpse-pale with fright, his heart hammering violently against his ribs. He slammed the laptop shut with all his strength, his breath coming in ragged, desperate gasps.

From his perspective, the bird had been on the coffee table a moment ago, only to launch a full-screen jump-scare the next second!

What on earth was that...

A monster! A monster!

***

The bird had no idea he had become a terrifying horror entity to someone. He merely cocked his head, staring intently at the tiny red light.

It was extremely hidden.

Bai Linlin even attempted to peck at it before realizing it was likely a miniature camera.

Ah.

He had completely forgotten about this!

Bai Linlin: "..."

What did the flashing red light mean? Had someone activated it remotely from the other side?

Song Yu's father?

"..."

The bird turned around to look at the pile of snacks cluttering the coffee table. After a moment of silence, he flapped his wings and flew over.

Resentfully, he picked up the wrappers with his beak and tossed them into the trash bin one by one.

He repeated the cycle again and again.

The more he thought about it, the angrier he became.

That despicable Song Qiming! Didn't he know that installing surveillance cameras without consent was illegal?!

An infringement on human rights!

And bird rights!

Bai Linlin completely lost his mood to watch TV. Hopping anxiously onto the lid of the trash bin, he restored the coffee table to its original spotless state.

"..."

It shouldn't cause any major trouble, right?

That very night, Song Yu received a phone call from his father. At that moment, the youth and his bird were sitting at the desk in the bedroom, looking through materials related to college application preferences.

chunks.chineseText:
“我说了我不出国。”

宋郁再度重申道，面色没有什么情绪，他手边还站着一只圆滚滚的鸟，此刻正全神贯注地偷听。

爪子都紧了紧。

白粼粼是有点担心的。

毕竟“人”还很小，万一听了家长的建议，真的不要他了怎么办？

“小郁，爸爸不是说这个的，你想在国内读，可以，都可以。”

“但你要听爸爸说，你养的那个鸟真得不能留了。”

因为是晚上，所以房间格外得安静，听筒里的声音也很清楚。

白粼粼听到了。

鸟低着头，磨了磨喙。

要是有机会见面非得叨他一口！

不，两口！

宋郁蹙了蹙眉，很直截了当地问：“有别的事么？我挂了。”

但那边却很急，甚至直接坦白了客厅那里装了监控的事，很耐着性子道：

“小郁真的，听爸爸的，你把那鸟送人也行，卖了也行，无论如何不要留了。”

“它成了精的。”

本来氛围还是很严肃的，但是在电话里传出来那句压着语气、很谨慎的话之后。

“……”

宋郁愣了下，也不知道该说什么，甚至监控那件事引起的厌恶感都被压下去了些。

“你不要不信啊，爸爸今天看监控了，你那鸟，它会开电视！”

“……”

宋郁没有回复，但那边却像是激动了起来，怕他不信，又列举了其他的。

“会用遥控器。”

“……”

“它还喝奶茶。”

“……”

白粼粼整个鸟都要黑化了，它不止要叨两口，它要叨四五六七八口！

乱说什么呢！

但他还是有点担心，仰头去看宋郁，巴巴地往人的手臂那里挪了挪。

人似乎是察觉到了目光，垂眸看了过来，刚想说些什么，但听筒那里还在继续。

“我想了想，你爷爷也和我说过类似的事，说是从军那会儿在山里遇到的……总之这肯定是妖邪！”

宋郁面色变得不愉，只是一字一句道：

“你看错了。”

“它就是个普通的小鸟。”

在挂断电话的最后一秒——

“有病就去治。”

原话还了回去，曾经宋启明也这么同他说过这句话，当着医生的面。

有些时候真奇怪，父亲这个角色总是扮演着背景板的作用，所谓的“关怀”永远是口头上的，实际上的行为是没有的。

宋郁有些时候会被宋启明骗过去，觉得他其实还爱自己，但后来才发现。

这种人的爱犹如街边的宣传单，人手一份，拿着碍事，丢了污染环境。

他不再是个孩子了。

-

房间里安安静静的，鸟说不感动是不可能的，啪嗒啪嗒在人的胳膊上走了几步。

深情对视。

宋郁回了回神，第一句就是；

“你喝奶茶了？”

鸟立即掉头，尾羽长长，一往上翘就是要起飞。

宋郁抬手就在半空中握住了。

白粼粼：“……”

为什么为什么为什么！

鸟腿无力里挣扎了两下。

最后认命了。

作者有话说：

[鸽子][鸽子]：啪嗒啪嗒走过来，低头——

啵啵。
chunks.englishText:
"I said I'm not going abroad," Song Yu reiterated, his face devoid of emotion. Beside his hand stood a chubby little bird, currently eavesdropping with complete concentration.

Its claws even tightened a little.

Bai Linlin was genuinely a bit worried.

After all, the "human" was still young. What if he took his parent's advice and really abandoned him?

"Xiao Yu, Dad isn't saying that. If you want to study domestically, fine—anything is fine."

"But you have to listen to Dad. That bird you're raising really can't be kept anymore."

Because it was night, the room was extraordinarily quiet, making the voice from the receiver crystal clear.

Bai Linlin heard it all.

The bird lowered his head and ground his beak.

If he ever got the chance to meet that man in person, he would definitely peck him once!

No, twice!

Song Yu knitted his brows and asked bluntly, "Is there anything else? I'm hanging up."

The other side panicked, going so far as to directly confess about installing surveillance in the living room, speaking with desperate patience:

"Xiao Yu, really, listen to Dad. You can give that bird away or sell it, but under no circumstances can you keep it."

"It's turned into a demon spirit!"

The atmosphere had originally been quite tense, but when those cautious, hushed words came through the line—

"..."

Song Yu froze for a moment, momentarily at a loss for words. Even the disgust caused by the surveillance camera was somewhat pushed down.

"Don't disbelieve me! Dad checked the surveillance today. That bird of yours—it knows how to turn on the TV!"

"..."

Song Yu didn't reply, but the man on the phone seemed to grow excited. Fearing Song Yu wouldn't believe him, he listed more proof.

"It knows how to use the remote!"

"..."

"It even drinks boba milk tea!"

"..."

Bai Linlin was on the verge of total blackening. He wasn't just going to peck him twice—he was going to peck him four, five, six, seven, eight times!

What utter nonsense!

Yet, he was still a little anxious. Looking up at Song Yu, he eagerly shuffled closer to the boy's arm.

Noticing the bird's gaze, Song Yu looked down, just about to speak, but the receiver continued:

"I thought about it, and your grandfather once told me something similar. He said it was an encounter in the mountains back when he was in the army... In short, this is definitely an evil demon!"

Song Yu's face darkened with displeasure as he enunciated each word:

"You saw wrong."

"It's just an ordinary little bird."

In the final second before cutting the connection—

"If you're sick, go get treated."

He threw the exact words back. Once upon a time, Song Qiming had said those exact words to him right in front of a doctor.

Sometimes it was truly strange. A father figure always played the role of a background setting; the so-called "care" was forever lip service without a single real action behind it.

Song Yu used to be fooled by Song Qiming, thinking that his father actually loved him, but only later did he realize...

The love of such a person was like street flyers—handed out to everyone. Holding onto it was a nuisance, and throwing it away polluted the environment.

He was no longer a child.

-

The room fell dead silent. It was impossible for the bird not to be moved. It took a few quick steps on the boy's arm—*clack, clack, clack*.

A deep, emotional eye-contact moment.

Song Yu snapped back to reality, and his very first sentence was:

"You drank milk tea?"

The bird immediately spun around, its long tail feathers fanning upward—a clear sign it was preparing for takeoff.

Song Yu raised his hand and plucked it right out of mid-air.

Bai Linlin: "..."

Why, why, why?!

The bird's legs twitched weakly in struggle.

In the end, it resigned itself to fate.

***

**Author's Note:**

[Pigeon][Pigeon]: Tappity-tap walking over, lowering head—

Mwah!

chunks.chineseText:
第19章

宋郁低头看着掌心的鸟，鸟头倔强地歪着，颇有几分骨气。

“你能喝奶茶么？”

宋郁换了个问法，他其实也只是担心，但奈何这段时间来鸟做出来的“出格”事太多了，一时半会他居然也没有太震惊。

只是觉得。

奶茶，不太健康。

宋郁抬手把鸟放回了自己肩头，自顾自地开始看手机，搜了些相关问答。

白粼粼这才活动了下身躯，他伸了伸翅根，很认真地反思了下自己。

怎么每次都被抓住！

这不合理！

鸟在人肩头挪了挪位置，又去低头看手机。

屏幕上显示人在打字输入：

[鹦鹉误喝了奶茶……]

宋郁看到弹出来的页面其实也很混乱，有些五花八门的视频，不过都是各种小鸟偷吃人类食物的。

没有确切地说会不会出问题。

他只好又切了软件。

白粼粼很是认真地在旁边看，发现“人”找出了微信的联系人，然后在打字。

上面显示的姓名。

——黎笙。

！！

那个讨厌的人类。

白粼粼刚想一顿啾啾啾，但没想到宋郁手指停顿了下，随后把所有输入的字全部删除了。

？

少年坐在书桌前面，暖黄的灯光打下来，显得面容少了些冷郁，眼尾的痣也若隐若现的。

宋郁只是侧头看了过来，“我不问了。”

“没事。”

人好似在和鸟说话。

又好像在和自己说话。

白粼粼确实是有些安心的，毕竟没有什么比可以“做自己”更有诱惑力了的。

他是一只有秘密的小鸟。

而“人”，看起来是可以共享秘密的对象。

白粼粼在人肩头挪了挪位置，歪头看了过去……

“啾啾。”

-

第二天一早。

宋郁就请了专业的人上门，里里外外把家里检查了一边。

最终也只是在客厅电视那里找到一个摄像头，其余位置并没有探测到。

宋启明倒是没有在这件事上骗人。

就在这时。

“你这小鸟……会说话吗？”

上门检查的人本来都在地板上收拾工具包了，但是又仰头看了好几眼雇主肩头的那只，还是没忍住问。

或许是担心被误解，这位中年人立马道：

“我女儿也想养小鸟，我看了看，应该也是鹦鹉，就是不是孩子你这种的颜色的……”

宋郁刚从冰箱里拿出一瓶水，抬手很自然地递给对方了，闻言很平和地道：

“鹦鹉需要陪伴，养宠并不能一时兴起，还是需要好好考虑。”

对面男人似乎是有些脸红，但是他搓了搓手，还是不好意思地解释：

“我知道我知道，就是我女儿一直在医院化疗，这段时间好了点，医生说能回家一段时间了，她看视频看到了鹦鹉了，说要，我就想着帮她买一个。”

“会好好养的，会好好养的。”

宋郁愣住了，他没有想到会是这样的事，但还没来得及回话，对方又自顾自地道：

“要是能说话就好了。”

“乐乐在家里也不会太无聊。”

宋郁张了张口，最后还是说了句，“抱歉，我不知道。”

对面男人也一愣，笑了，挠了挠头，“没事没事，我家孩子很乐观，医生说很有希望能配型成功的。”

“谁没个不顺心的事呢？”

男人抬手把工具包背在身上，肩背硬朗，面容宽和，临走前目光不经意地朝下看了一眼，同宋郁道：

“你也要好好生活，这么年轻，身体素质正是好的时候。”

“外头有不少好风景呢。”

或许是太久没有应对过这种纯粹的善意，宋郁几乎怔住了，只是顺着对方的视线看了下自己的手腕。

他忘了，夏天了。

遮不住。

最后还是鸟接上了话头，板板正正地学舌：

“祝你全家身体健康，无病无灾，万事顺意，天天开心！”

语气抑扬顿挫的。

很有劲儿。

男人很明显眼睛亮了起来，甚至还对小鸟作了作揖，朗声笑了笑，很感谢道：

“好好好，承小鸟吉言了！”

宋郁此刻也回了神，送人到了玄关门口，对方似乎心情不错，挥了挥手：

“那再见了？”

“再见。”

这世界上总是有形形色色的人，有自私、懦弱、卑劣的人……但也有无私、勇敢、赤诚的人。

长久地待在阴影里，偶然被拉了出来，最先感受到的不是阳光的温暖，其实是不适应。

宋郁在那人走了之后，在原地站了一会，而后抬起了自己的左手。

凌乱的疤痕。

还有细碎的划痕。

宋郁其实不是单纯地因为那个男人的话而触动，他只是恍惚地发现……自己不知道什么时候，完全忘记了疤痕。

是从哪里开始？

是几月？

正在他很混乱地思考着的时候，唇边有毛绒绒的东西顶了过来。

宋郁低头看了过去，小鸟正持之以恒地往这边贴贴，注意到自己转头后，还歪了歪头。

“啾啾？”

此刻外面日头上升，蝉鸣开始奏乐。

夏天，到了。

-

宋郁的高考成绩非常好，是在当天查分发现被屏蔽了那种，后续才得知是考了七百分以上。

不仅班主任很满意，就连宋启明都很高兴，打电话说是要大办一场升学宴。

但宋郁对此反应平平。

仿佛那是一场与他无关的狂欢。

江芮也打来了电话，言语之间也是满意，也忘了前段时间的矛盾，只是问了句：

“宋启明只是说给你办宴么？”

此刻锦园这里，宋郁在书桌前剥开心果，眉眼平静，手机就在那里放着，开了免提。

“是。”

“他没承诺别的？”

宋郁动作慢了半拍，心想又是这样，但就在这时，他的虎口处传来很痒的触感。

鸟在伸爪子上来，准备自己叨。

稳当当的。

但刚低头准备——

“没有，怎么了？”

宋郁抬手把果壳挤掉，习惯的把果肉捏到了另外一个手里，而这导致鸟伸头叨了个空。

！

白粼粼又费劲巴拉地在宋郁的手上挪动，准备到那只手去，还伸了伸翅膀以维持平衡。

与此同时。

“呵，借宴会来拉商业合作吧，老一套。”

“妈妈送你一套房子！”

江芮那边似乎是舒坦多了，连带着还有了点温情了，多问了几句宋郁的近况。

——吃没吃饭？

——有打算出去玩么？

——交朋友了么？

好似他们中间没有任何隔阂，是天底下最正常的一对母子。

宋郁垂着眼眸，都如实回答了，但面色并没有什么大的波动。

他想要等等。

看江芮还能找出什么话题。

但是没有了。

因为那边的保姆已经在叫她了，大抵是那个孩子又发病了。

两分三十秒。

挂断了。

宋郁看了下手机屏幕，没有什么意外，江芮找他永远是有事的。

总是绕不开宋启明。

永远在比。

尽管这场比赛没有奖品。

“啾啾！”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 19

Song Yu looked down at the bird in his palm. The bird's head was stubborn and tilted, showing quite a bit of backbone.

"Can you drink milk tea?"

Song Yu rephrased his question. He was actually just worried, but because the bird had done so many "outrageous" things during this period, he wasn't even that shocked anymore.

He just felt...

Milk tea wasn't very healthy.

Song Yu lifted his hand to put the bird back onto his shoulder, then picked up his phone and began searching for related Q&As on his own.

Only then did Bai Linlin stretch his body. He extended the roots of his wings and seriously reflected on himself.

How did he get caught every single time?!

This made no sense!

The bird shifted its position on the boy's shoulder and peered down at the phone screen.

The search bar showed what Song Yu was typing:

*Parrot accidentally drank milk tea...*

Song Yu saw that the results that popped up were quite chaotic, filled with all sorts of bizarre videos—though they were all about various birds sneaking human food.

None gave a definitive answer on whether it would cause health problems.

He had no choice but to switch apps.

Bai Linlin watched intently from the side, noticing that the "human" pulled up his WeChat contacts and was typing.

The name displayed on top:

—Li Sheng.

!!

That annoying human.

Bai Linlin was just about to burst into a flurry of angry chirps, but to his surprise, Song Yu's fingers paused, and then he deleted all the typed characters.

?

The youth sat before the desk. The warm yellow light shone down, softening the cold gloominess of his features, while the faint mole at the outer corner of his eye flickered in and out of sight.

Song Yu merely turned his head to look over. "I won't ask."

"It's fine."

The human seemed to be speaking to the bird.

Or perhaps speaking to himself.

Bai Linlin did feel a surge of relief. After all, nothing was more tempting than being able to "be oneself."

He was a little bird with secrets.

And the "human" seemed to be someone he could share those secrets with.

Bai Linlin shifted on the boy's shoulder, tilted his head, and looked over...

"Chirp chirp."

-

Early the next morning.

Song Yu hired professionals to come over and inspect the entire house inside and out.

In the end, they only found a single camera by the living room TV; none were detected anywhere else.

At least Song Qiming hadn't lied about that.

Right at this moment...

"Your little bird... can it talk?"

The technician who came for the inspection was packing up his tool bag on the floor, but he kept glancing up at the bird perched on his client's shoulder. Finally, he couldn't help asking.

Perhaps worried about being misunderstood, the middle-aged man immediately added:

"My daughter wants to raise a little bird too. I looked into it, and it should be a parrot as well, though not the same color as yours, kid..."

Song Yu had just taken a bottle of water from the fridge and naturally handed it over. Hearing this, he said calmly:

"Parrots require companionship. Keeping a pet shouldn't be done on a whim; it requires careful consideration."

The man opposite seemed a little embarrassed, rubbing his hands together as he explained sheepishly:

"I know, I know. It's just that my daughter has been undergoing chemotherapy in the hospital. She's been doing a bit better lately, and the doctor said she can come home for a while. She saw parrots in some videos and said she wanted one, so I thought I'd buy one for her."

"We'll take good care of it, we really will."

Song Yu froze. He hadn't expected something like this. Before he could respond, the man continued talking to himself:

"If only it could speak..."

"Then Lele wouldn't be so lonely at home."

Song Yu opened his mouth, and ultimately said, "I'm sorry, I didn't know."

The man was startled, then smiled and scratched his head. "It's fine, it's fine. My child is very optimistic. The doctor said there's a strong chance of finding a successful match."

"Who doesn't go through tough times?"

The man slung his tool bag over his shoulder. His shoulders were broad, his face kind and gentle. Before leaving, his gaze inadvertently drifted down, and he said to Song Yu:

"You should live well, too. You're so young, and your body is in its prime."

"There's plenty of good scenery out there."

Perhaps because he hadn't experienced such pure kindness in a long time, Song Yu was almost dazed. He simply followed the man's gaze and looked down at his own wrist.

He had forgotten that it was summer.

He couldn't cover it up.

In the end, it was the bird that picked up the conversation, mimicking speech in a proper, solemn tone:

"Wishing your whole family good health, freedom from sickness and calamity, smooth sailing in everything, and daily happiness!"

The cadence was vibrant and rhythmic.

Full of vigor.

The man's eyes clearly lit up. He even cupped his hands in a respectful bow toward the little bird, laughed aloud, and said gratefully:
