"Good, good, good! Thank you for the blessings, little bird!"

Song Yu snapped back to his senses and walked the man to the entrance foyer. The man seemed to be in a good mood, waving his hand:

"Well, goodbye then?"

"Goodbye."

There were always all kinds of people in this world: selfish, cowardly, and despicable people... but also selfless, brave, and sincere ones.

After staying in the shadows for too long, when suddenly pulled into the light, the very first thing one felt wasn't the warmth of sunlight, but discomfort.

After the man left, Song Yu stood in place for a while, then raised his left wrist.

Messy, jagged scars.

And tiny, scattered scratches.

Song Yu wasn't touched purely because of that man's words. He was just dazed to realize... he didn't know when he had completely forgotten about these scars.

Where did it start?

Which month?

While he was lost in chaotic thought, a fluffy little thing pressed against his lips.

Song Yu looked down. The little bird was perseveringly rubbing against him, and upon noticing that he had turned his head, it tilted its own head.

"Chirp chirp?"

Outside, the sun was rising higher, and the cicadas began their symphony.

Summer had arrived.

-

Song Yu's Gaokao results were exceptionally good—so high that his score was hidden on the day of checking, and he only found out later that he scored over 700 points.

Not only was his homeroom teacher thrilled, but even Song Qiming was overjoyed, calling to say he wanted to throw a grand celebratory banquet.

But Song Yu remained indifferent.

As if it were a revelry that had nothing to do with him.

Jiang Rui also called, her words filled with satisfaction. Having forgotten their previous conflict, she merely asked:

"Song Qiming only said he's throwing a banquet for you?"

Currently in Jinyuan, Song Yu was peeling pistachio nuts at his desk, his expression calm. The phone sat nearby on speaker.

"Yes."

"He didn't promise anything else?"

Song Yu's movements slowed by a beat, thinking: *It's like this again.* But right at that moment, a ticklish feeling came from the web between his thumb and index finger.

The bird was extending its claw, preparing to peck at the nut itself.

Steadily standing.

But just as it lowered its head to peck—

"No. Why?"

Song Yu raised his hand to squeeze off the shell, habitually transferring the nut meat into his other hand, which caused the bird to peck at thin air.

!

Bai Linlin scrambled with great effort across Song Yu's hand, trying to get to the other side, stretching his wings to maintain balance.

Meanwhile:

"Heh, using the banquet to pull in business partnerships—same old trick."

"Mom will buy you an apartment!"

Jiang Rui seemed much more relieved on her end, and even showed a trace of warmth, asking a few extra questions about Song Yu's recent life.

—Have you eaten?

—Do you plan to go travel?

—Have you made any friends?

It was as if there were no rift between them, as if they were the most normal mother and son in the world.

Song Yu lowered his eyes and answered truthfully, but his expression remained flat.

He wanted to wait.

To see what other topics Jiang Rui could come up with.

But there were none.

Because the nanny on the other end was already calling her—most likely the child had thrown another fit.

Two minutes and thirty seconds.

Hung up.

Song Yu looked at the phone screen, completely unsurprised. Whenever Jiang Rui reached out to him, it was always for a reason.

It was always tied to Song Qiming.

Always competing.

Even though this competition offered no prize.

"Chirp chirp!"

chunks.chineseText:
宋郁回了回神，低头看向了桌面，这才发现自己把果仁捏在掌心了，旁边的鸟正在仰头看着自己，一副到底要怎样的表情。

“……”

“不好意思。”

其实时间久了，宋郁也能发现点问题，他的小鸟会学舌，但是不太爱说话。

于是“人”问了下。

鸟正在沉浸式进食，圆滚滚的脑袋动来动去的，像个小和尚。

“可以和我说话的。”

宋郁又轻声道。

白粼粼吃完了，扑棱扑棱翅膀就准备——

这次甚至还没有起飞。

直接被握住了。

“……”

宋郁是真的不明白，小鸟上次分明对那个上门的服务人员说话了，还是吉祥话。

为什么不和他说话？

“啾啾啾。”

白粼粼伸了伸鸟腿，试图往上拱，拱不出去，往下缩，缩不出去。

这到底是怎么逮的！

“是不喜欢我么？”

宋郁垂眸看着鸟，很平静地问。

白粼粼：“……”

不是！

不是不是！

其实是因为鹦鹉学舌的声音有点“瓜”，闷闷的，而且有种莫名其妙的“抑扬顿挫”。

白粼粼觉得和自己原来的“人声”有点差别。

显得笨笨的。

况且在宋郁面前打游戏那次……他辱骂了人机队友，这虽然是正义之举，但严重损坏了鸟的正面形象。

简而言之。

鸟有包袱。

但现在来不及解释了。

“宋-郁。”

少年眼底泛起了些涟漪，抬眼看着手里的小鸟，它知道自己的名字。

“喜-欢。”

白粼粼实在是没办法了，只能很认真地说话，闷头闷脑的，鸟爪都缩成一团了，有点羞耻。

但就在他觉得这总不会有问题了的时候——

“听不到。”

“……”

人，不要太过分了。

-

而江芮这边则是带着“女儿”去了躺医院，旁边还是那个保姆，总之又是做了一趟检查。

医生蹙了蹙眉，问了下：

“孩子父亲呢？”

江芮面无表情地道：“他没空，母亲在不就行了？”

医生只好叹了口气，很诚恳地劝道，“这个基本治疗不了，这孩子暴虐的性子是基因里带着的，同时，几乎是板上钉钉了。”

“应当是遗传父亲那里的。”

“我是建议不要再要孩子了。”

就诊室内一片死寂。

保姆在后面的椅子上，抱着那个好不容易睡着的孩子，一直低着头。

医生拿着报告解释：

“不然很可能还出现些类似的问题，隐性基因是不好筛出来的，有很多疾病是有潜伏期的。”

“我知道了。”

江芮面无表情地道，似乎没怎么在意，只是提着自己的包出了就诊室。

等到回了家中。

保姆还是照常去隔壁房间照看孩子，江芮在卧室换了睡袍，低头看了看那封请柬。

——升学宴。

日期都定下来了。

宋启明终于舍得回国了？

-

半个月后。

白粼粼这段时间莫名觉得很困，有时候站在宋郁肩头都会栽下来。

羽毛本来就蓬松。

在掌心更是成了个“球”。

鸟不知道是自己吃了太多垃圾食品了还是怎么的，最近胃口也变差了。

QQ糖也不吃了。

奶酪棒也不啃了。

形势实在是很严峻，以至于宋郁在发现后立即给带到了黎笙所在的异宠医院，但检查结果却是一切正常，甚至还长胖了几克。

“……”

宋郁没有什么办法，只能猜测是鸟前几天打游戏太晚了的缘故，不过还是一直守着，大多是放在肩头，偶尔会滑到衣襟上，鸟头就卡在人的锁骨那里。

圆滚滚的，睡梦里还在咂巴咂巴喙。

而此时另一边的南市小巷里。

一只灰扑扑的信鸽飞得是有气无力，最后在路边的高压线上停下来了，脖子上还挂着个小包袱，整个鸟都怨气冲天。

它迷路了。
chunks.englishText:
Song Yu snapped out of his thoughts and looked down at the desk, only to realize he had been holding the nut kernel in his palm. The bird beside him was looking up at him, wearing an expression that practically demanded: *Well? What are you doing?*

"..."

"Sorry."

In fact, over time, Song Yu had noticed something: his little bird could mimic speech, but it didn't like to talk much.

So the human asked softly.

The bird was immersed in eating, its round head moving back and forth like a little monk.

"You can talk to me," Song Yu said gently once more.

Bai Linlin finished eating, fluttered his wings, and prepared to—

This time, before he could even take off...

He was caught directly in a hand.

"..."

Song Yu truly didn't understand. The little bird had clearly spoken to the service technician who visited last time, and even spoke words of blessing.

Why wouldn't it talk to him?

"Chirp chirp chirp."

Bai Linlin stretched his bird legs, trying to nudge upward, but couldn't squeeze out; he tried to shrink downward, but couldn't slip free either.

How on earth did he keep getting caught like this?!

"Do you dislike me?" Song Yu looked down at the bird, asking very calmly.

Bai Linlin: "..."

No!

Absolutely not!

Actually, it was because the parrot's mimicking voice sounded a bit foolish—muffled, and with an inexplicable, dramatic cadence.

Bai Linlin felt it was quite different from his original human voice.

It made him sound dumb.

Besides, that time he played games in front of Song Yu... he had insulted his bot teammate. Although it was a righteous act, it severely damaged his image as a dignified bird.

In short:

The bird had an image to maintain.

But now there was no time to explain.

"Song—Yu."

Ripples surfaced in the youth's eyes. He looked up at the little bird in his hand. It knew his name.

"Like—you."

Bai Linlin had no choice. He could only speak seriously in a muffled, earnest voice, his claws curling into a ball out of sheer embarrassment.

But just as he thought there couldn't possibly be any problem now—

"Can't hear you."

"..."

Human, don't go too far!

-

Meanwhile, on Jiang Rui's end, she took her "daughter" to the hospital, accompanied by the nanny. In short, they underwent another round of tests.

The doctor frowned and asked, "Where is the child's father?"

Jiang Rui said expressionlessly, "He doesn't have time. Isn't it enough that the mother is here?"

The doctor could only sigh, advising sincerely, "This is basically untreatable. This child's violent temperament is coded in her genes, and at this point, it's practically set in stone."

"It should be inherited from the father's side."

"I strongly recommend not having any more children."

Silence fell over the consultation room.

The nanny sat on the chair behind her, holding the child who had finally fallen asleep, keeping her head lowered the entire time.

The doctor held the report and explained:

"Otherwise, similar issues are very likely to recur. Recessive genes are difficult to screen out, and many diseases have incubation periods."

"I understand," Jiang Rui said emotionlessly, seemingly not caring much. She simply picked up her purse and walked out of the room.

Upon returning home:

The nanny went into the adjacent room to care for the child as usual. Jiang Rui changed into a bathrobe in her bedroom and looked down at an invitation card on the table.

—Celebration Banquet.

The date had already been set.

Has Song Qiming finally deigned to return to the country?

-

Half a month later.

Bai Linlin felt strangely sleepy during this period. Sometimes, even while standing on Song Yu's shoulder, he would tip right over.

His feathers were already fluffy to begin with.

Perched in the palm, he turned into a complete "ball."

The bird didn't know if it was because he ate too much junk food or what, but his appetite had also worsened recently.

He didn't want gummy candies.

He didn't nibble on cheese sticks either.

The situation was so dire that as soon as Song Yu noticed, he immediately brought him to the exotic pet hospital where Li Sheng worked. However, the checkup results showed everything was normal—he had even gained a few grams.

"..."

Song Yu had no other choice and could only guess that it was because the bird had stayed up too late playing games a few days ago. Still, he kept close watch over him, mostly letting him perch on his shoulder, though occasionally the bird would slide down onto his collar, its head nestled against his collarbone.

Round and chubby, still smacking its beak in its sleep.

Meanwhile, in a narrow alley in Nanshi City...

A dusty grey homing pigeon was flying listlessly. Finally, it perched on a high-voltage power line by the roadside, a tiny bundle hanging around its neck, radiating resentment.

It was lost.

chunks.chineseText:
第20章

信鸽在高压线上歇了一会脚，四处探头看了看，这地方的路是怎么修的？

歪歪扭扭的。

中央那里就横平竖直的，信鸽扑棱了下翅膀，又试着去闻了闻味道，这是它导航的一个重要参考因素。

严肃jpg.

“烤肉烤肉！一块五一串！走过路过不要错过！”

“蓝莓冰沙摇摇乐，九块九超值五百毫升，送南市古楼冰箱贴！”

“芋泥奶油小蛋糕，免费品尝……”

街边的声音此起彼伏，伴随着各种交错的香气，美食街这里车水马龙的，人员流动非常大。

信鸽：“……”

事已至此，先吃饭吧。

风尘仆仆的信鸽伸了伸翅膀，飞到了一个非常隐蔽的拐角处，过了一会，里面出来一个穿着邮局制服的青年，很熟练地来到了摊子面前。

“老板，我要免费品尝的芋泥小蛋糕。”

“……”

-

与此同时的锦园，白粼粼终于睡醒了，在宋郁的衣襟边边挂着，张了张肉色的小短喙。

打了个哈欠。

有点懵。

晚上了？

宋郁垂眸看到鸟醒了，用瓶盖接了点水，低头去喂，他的视角下只能看到圆滚滚的鸟头。

动来动去的。

看着总算是有点精神了。

白粼粼这才发现自己睡到宋郁身上去了，鸟爪子都在对方的衣服里，唯一露出来的就是个鸟头。

“……”

他努力地往上拱了拱，想要出来，但是看到“人”递过来水之后，又发现确实是有点渴了。

开始老老实实地小口啜饮。

是白开水。

鸟品鉴了一会，咂巴咂巴喙，然后斜眼看到了桌子上一瓶饮料。

“啾！”

当即就是仰着鸟头。

宋郁其实有点不解，但在低着头看鸟，怎么不喝了？

直到——

“脉-动。”

板板正正的声音传来。

鸟眼圆圆的，很是睿智。

“……”

宋郁最后给鸟开了那瓶功能饮料，抬手倒在了瓶盖里，他看了眼瓶身。

水蜜桃味的。

鸟似乎很喜欢，刚被放到桌上就啪嗒啪嗒走了过去，低头一顿喝。

还伸了伸翅根。

很满意了。

宋郁面色温和，只是抬手拿了手机发了个消息。

那边很快就回了：

[黎笙：醒了？那让它吃点东西，补充点营养。]

[黎笙：不过也真是奇怪，体征很是正常，这么爱睡觉的一只小鸡。]

鸟丝毫不知道自己又被讨厌的人类说了“小鸡”，只是非常认真地在喝水，尾羽长长的，随着低头的动作一动一动的。

宋郁本来是打算起身去楼下拿点滋养丸的，那是鹦鹉的主食，比较健康，他觉得还是要吃那个。

不过人还只是刚起身，衣角就传来一阵阻力，他低头一看，鸟在用力地叼着自己的衣服。

往反方向拽。

爪子都在桌面上打滑。

宋郁愣了下，是不想他走么……

少年心里有一阵暖流淌过，不由得停下了动作。

但就在这时，鸟确认“人”不走了之后，就松开了喙，转身啪嗒啪嗒走到一袋子夏威夷果面前。

伸了鸟腿。

踩上面。

宋郁：“……”

-

不过好在最后是恢复了正常，鸟除了那天吃得东西多了点，没有什么异常。

宋郁这才放下心来，不过另外一件事又来了，是关于那个“升学宴”。

宋启明甚至一大早过来打电话：

“待会八点你陈叔去接你，有备好的衣服，你也长大了，宴会上都是有头有脸的人物……”

总之是说了一堆。

少年面色冷淡，甚至在漫不经心地想着，如果现在拒绝，宋启明会不会就虚伪不下去了。

这分明是一场商业宴会。

“升学”只是装饰。

但就在这时——

“不能给你爷爷丢脸。”

宋郁其实后面没有在听了，只是觉得手腕有些生疼，他侧眸看了眼窗外。

阴雨绵绵。

天气也不好。

手机里面还有断断续续的声音：

“宋郁，时间很紧的，你收拾齐整点，林董记得不记得……”

“定制的衣服给你送到临近的酒店了，陈叔过来接你。”

“……你妈妈今天也过来，搞不好还要带那个制片人……我真是服了她了。”

分明是隔着电话线，但是宋郁却好像看到了宋启明那张不耐烦的脸。

他的父母，提及对方，永远都是互相诋毁。

宋郁闻言笑了下，“你不也要带李长韵？”

何必这么双标。

电话那头愣了下，随即就是低声的斥责：

“宋郁，你怎么说话的？”

“你知不知道我这次回国——”

话音倒是停下了，对面似乎很忙，最后甚至没来得及生气，只是重新强调了下时间。

挂了。

三分零一秒。

外面天色还是阴沉沉的，雨线在玻璃上划出一道道痕迹，像是凌乱的伤疤。

宋郁看了下外面的天空，神色平静，不知道在想什么。

就在这时。

“啾啾啾。”

门口传来一阵催促的鸟叫声，还伴随着爪子在门板上划拉的动静。

宋郁转身看过去，这才发现卧室门不小心关了，于是快步走了过去。

门刚开了缝隙，一个毛绒绒的鸟头就挤了进来，顺带伸进来一个爪子。

啪——

很有劲了。

宋郁俯身蹲下，其实蹙了蹙眉，因为鸟不知道从哪里又叼过来一袋子零食。

松子。

“……”

白粼粼真是越来越觉得“人”好用了，现在连拆封包装袋这种活都不想干了，通通都给“人”来做。

人很聪明的。

鸟低头松开了喙，那袋子半斤重的松子就躺在地板上。

“……”

“……”

对视ing。

鸟又伸了伸鸟腿，示意了一下，然而人不为所动。

？

白粼粼索性直接用头去拱，把零食又推到人跟前，还啪嗒啪嗒走了几步。

人，去剥。

宋郁实在没有办法，只能同它解释，“我今天要出门，时间不太够。”

“晚上回来再吃行么？”

白粼粼还在仰着头，心里还有些小小的失望，他是计算好了的，这么些松子，刚好够人早上剥完。

下午还有核桃的。

排满了。

宋郁把手伸了过去，鸟歪了歪头，还是抬腿上来了，顺带点了点头。

很宽容大度了。

“时间不会太长，我下午就回家，到时候再——”

“啾啾。”

宋郁的话被打断了，下巴有很顺滑的触感，鸟很用力地顶了过来。

与之伴随的还有干燥谷物的味道。

像小鸡。

宋郁侧眸看了过去，才发现鸟正在看地板上的那袋子松子。

“我的错。”

“我忘记了。”

人道了歉，这毕竟是鸟从一楼叼上来的，很费劲的，应该拿起来，而不是让零食躺在地上。

宋郁抬手把东西拿了起来，这才获得了肩头这只的点头，随后去了书桌那里。

本来是想要交代一些事项的，但是后知后觉也就离开几个小时。

好像也没必要。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 20 (Part 1)

The homing pigeon rested its feet on a high-voltage wire for a bit, tilting its head to look around. How on earth were the roads in this place constructed? 

They were all crooked and winding.

Only the center section ran straight and true. The pigeon fluttered its wings and tried to sniff the air—scent was a crucial reference factor for its navigation system.

*Serious.jpg.*

"Barbecue, barbecue! One yuan fifty a skewer! Step right up, don't miss out!"

"Blueberry slushie Shake-Shake! Nine point nine for a super-value five hundred milliliters! Comes with a free Nanshi Ancient Tower fridge magnet!"

"Taro cream mini cakes! Free samples..."

Voices rose and fell along the street, accompanied by a rich tapestry of interwoven aromas. The food street was bustling with traffic, a chaotic surge of moving people.

The homing pigeon: "..."

*Since things have come to this, let's eat first.*

The travel-weary pigeon stretched its wings and flew into an extremely obscure, hidden corner. A moment later, a young man wearing a postal service uniform emerged, walking adeptly over to the stall.

"Boss, I'd like the free sample taro mini cake."

"..."

***

Meanwhile, back at Jinyuan, Bai Linlin had finally woken up. Hanging by the edge of Song Yu's collar, he opened his tiny, flesh-pink beak and let out a yawn.

He felt a bit dazed.

Was it night already?

Song Yu lowered his gaze and saw that the bird was awake. He poured a little water into a bottle cap and leaned down to offer it. From his angle, all he could see was the round, chubby bird head wriggling back and forth.

It seemed the little creature had finally regained some energy.

Only then did Bai Linlin realize he had fallen asleep right on top of Song Yu. His claws were buried inside the youth's clothes, leaving only his head exposed.

"..."

He struggled to inch his way up, wanting to break free. But when he saw the "human" handing him water, he realized he actually was quite thirsty.

He settled down and began sipping obediently in tiny gulps.

It was plain boiled water.

The bird sampled it for a moment, smacking his beak, and then squinted sideways at a bottle of drink sitting on the desk.

"Chirp!"

He immediately threw his head back.

Song Yu was actually a little puzzled. He stared down at the bird—why did it stop drinking?

Until—

"Mai... Dong."

A flat, rigid voice sounded.

The bird's eyes were wide and round, gleaming with supreme wisdom.

"..."

In the end, Song Yu opened that bottle of functional drink for the bird, tipping it to pour some into the cap. He glanced at the label on the bottle.

Peach flavor.

The bird seemed to like it very much. The moment he was placed onto the desk, he pattered right over, dipping his head to drink ravenously.

He even stretched out the bases of his wings.

Thoroughly satisfied.

Song Yu's expression was gentle as he picked up his phone to send a message.

A reply came back quickly:

[Li Sheng: It's awake? Then let it eat something to get some nutrients.]

[Li Sheng: But it really is strange. Its vital signs are completely normal. What a sleep-loving little chick.]

The bird had no idea he had just been called a "little chick" by that annoying human again. He was drinking his water with absolute focus, his long tail feathers swaying up and down with every dip of his head.

Song Yu had originally intended to go downstairs to grab some nourishing pellets—the staple food for parrots, which was healthier. He felt it was better for the bird to eat those.

However, as soon as he stood up, he felt a tug on his clothes. He looked down and saw the bird biting tightly onto his garment, pulling with all his might in the opposite direction.

His little claws were even sliding across the desk surface.

Song Yu froze. Did it not want him to leave...?

A warm current flowed through the youth's heart, and he couldn't help but freeze in place.

Right at that moment, though, the bird confirmed that the "human" wasn't leaving, released its beak, turned around, and pattered over to a bag of macadamia nuts.

He extended one bird leg.

And stepped squarely on top of it.

Song Yu: "..."

***

Fortunately, everything returned to normal after that. Aside from eating a bit more that day, the bird showed no other abnormalities.

Only then did Song Yu set his mind at ease. However, another matter soon presented itself—the so-called "graduation banquet."

Song Qiming even called early in the morning:

"Uncle Chen will pick you up at eight. There are clothes prepared for you. You're grown up now, and the banquet will be filled with prominent figures..."

In short, he rattled on and on.

The youth's face remained cold and indifferent. He even thought casually to himself: *If I refuse right now, will Song Qiming be unable to maintain his hypocritical facade any longer?*

This was blatantly a business banquet.

"Graduation" was merely the wrapping paper.

Right then—

"You mustn't embarrass your grandfather."

Song Yu wasn't really listening anymore; he only felt a dull ache in his wrist. He turned his head slightly to look out the window.

A continuous, gloomy drizzle.

The weather was terrible as well.

The voice over the phone continued intermittently:

"Song Yu, time is tight. Tidy yourself up properly. Do you remember Chairman Lin..."

"The tailored suit has been sent to the nearby hotel for you. Uncle Chen is coming to get you."

"...Your mother is coming today too. She might even bring that producer... I'm honestly fed up with her."

Even across a telephone line, Song Yu could almost see Song Qiming's impatient face.

Whenever his parents mentioned each other, it was always with mutual slander.

Hearing this, Song Yu let out a faint chuckle. "Aren't you bringing Li Changyun as well?"

Why hypocritically hold double standards?

The line went silent for a moment, followed by a low-voiced rebuke:

"Song Yu! How dare you speak to me like that?"

"Do you have any idea why I came back to the country this time—"

The voice cut short. The person on the other end seemed extremely busy; in the end, he didn't even have time to stay angry, merely reiterating the time once more.

Then he hung up.

Three minutes and one second.

Outside, the sky remained overcast and dreary. Streams of rain etched tracks across the windowpane like messy, jagged scars.

Song Yu looked out at the sky, his expression serene, though it was impossible to tell what he was thinking.

Just then—

"Chirp, chirp, chirp!"

An urgent burst of bird chirps came from the doorway, accompanied by the sound of claws scratching against the door panel.

Song Yu turned around and realized the bedroom door had accidentally closed. He walked over quickly.

The moment the door cracked open, a fluffy bird head squeezed its way in, along with a single claw that stomped down—

*Clack!*

Quite forceful.

Song Yu crouched down, his brow furrowing slightly when he saw that the bird had somehow dragged over another bag of snacks.

Pine nuts.

"..."

Bai Linlin found the "human" increasingly useful. Now he didn't even want to perform tasks like tearing open snack packages, delegating them entirely to the human instead.

Humans were very smart.

The bird dipped his head and released his beak, leaving the half-pound bag of pine nuts resting on the floor.

"..."

"..."

*Staring contest in progress.*

The bird extended a leg again, gesturing toward it, but the human remained unmoved.

*?*

Bai Linlin simply used his head to nudge it, pushing the snacks closer to the human, taking a few pattering steps forward.

*Human, shell them.*

Left with no choice, Song Yu could only explain to him, "I have to go out today. There isn't enough time."

"Can we eat them when I get back tonight?"

Bai Linlin kept his head raised, feeling a tiny bit disappointed. He had calculated it all out—this amount of pine nuts would take the human just long enough to shell all morning.

There were walnuts scheduled for the afternoon, too.

His schedule was packed!

Song Yu extended his hand. The bird tilted his head, but ultimately stepped onto it anyway, giving a brief nod.

Eminently generous and magnanimous.

"It won't take too long. I'll be home this afternoon, and then we can—"

"Chirp, chirp."

Song Yu's words were cut off as a smooth, sleek texture pressed firmly against his chin—the bird had nudged against him with considerable force.

Along with it came the dry, earthy scent of grains.

Just like a little chick.

Song Yu glanced sideways and realized the bird was staring at the bag of pine nuts on the floor.

"My fault."

"I forgot."

The human apologized. After all, the bird had dragged this all the way up from the first floor with great effort. It should be picked up, not left lying on the floor like trash.

Song Yu reached out and picked the item up, earning a satisfied nod from the creature on his shoulder before carrying it over to the desk.

He had originally intended to explain a few instructions, but then realized he would only be gone for a few hours.

There didn't seem to be any need.

chunks.chineseText:
宋郁肩头一轻，鸟在桌子上伸了伸翅膀，又开始歪头梳理羽毛。

蓝羽长长。

很好看。

也就在这时，门口有汽车的引擎声，外面的雨似乎还有点下大的征兆。

白粼粼看了看外头，心想这个天气出去？

是那个升学宴？

“……”

选的都是什么日子？

不过鸟也听到了院子外面汽车引擎的声音，他啪嗒啪嗒站在窗台上，倒是认真地往下看了看。

库里南。

我去！

白粼粼是一个物质的小鸟，他立马扑棱翅膀飞到宋郁的肩头，表示自己也要出门。

鸟要坐豪车。

谁同意，谁反对？

白粼粼自己给自己“全票通过”，但是在走到玄关的时候被宋郁“一票否决”了。

“外面下雨了，在家等我好么？”

“我很快就回来了。”

门最后还是关上了。

-

宴会的地址在南市一家有名的五星级酒店，地点在琅山，风景秀丽，且实行的是会员制。

车子在盘山公路上开着，宋郁在副驾上坐着，面色没什么表情。

“小郁有想好报考什么大学吗？”

司机其实也觉得氛围有点沉闷，试图找个话题聊聊。

他原来是负责接送碧波湾那对母子的，其实很少来锦园这里，上次见这孩子还是好几年前。

也是有些感慨。

原配孩子就是优秀。

“没有。”

宋郁没有什么兴致聊天，只是侧眸看着窗外，还在下雨。

“啊，那慢慢考虑，这事也急不得。”

司机也很理解，虽然有些尴尬，但还是很温和地道，顺带打了个方向盘。

右转。

但就在这时——

挡风玻璃突然传过来一阵闷响，一道灰扑扑的影子被甩了出去。

宋郁蹙了蹙眉，车子也急刹了。

司机其实有点慌张，毕竟这不是他的车，解开安全带的时候还在自言自语：

“这撞到什么了，车窗不会……”

宋郁没有过多思索也下了车，外面的风不算太大，但有些雨丝，衬得人面容更加冷白。

“不用检查车，我会和我父亲说。”

“看下周围有没有小动物。”

司机愣了下，随即就照做了，其实刚才的动静不算小，约莫是个鸟之类的。

但挡风玻璃上也没有血，所以也找不到具体的痕迹。

大约耽搁了五分钟左右，车子还是开走了，因为实在找不到。

而与此同时——

盘山公路上多了一只“走地鸡”，信鸽被撞得头昏眼花的，啪嗒啪嗒地在马路牙子上走。

“……”

没事的。

怎么可能会有鸟一直倒霉呢？

下一秒。

呜呜呜呜！

它要告到中央！

-

锦园。

白粼粼实在是闲的没事，就在别墅里乱溜达，最后还是回到了宋郁的卧室。

本来是打算开一局游戏的，但是站在书桌上的时候莫名想起来第一次进来的场景。

欸……

这个桌子上？

鸟左右环顾了下，爪子啪嗒啪嗒地响，后来终于发现问题了。

那张合照不见了。

白粼粼其实并不知道宋郁好了没有，鸟看了看窗外，发现还在下雨，想去看看楼下。

几个小时的话？

应该很短？

白粼粼扑棱了下翅膀，打算站在那个书立上，那个位置正好能看到路边的车。

要是库里南回来了。

宋郁就到家了。

鸟等待ing。

但出师不利，白粼粼刚扑棱翅膀腾飞起来，爪子还没有站稳那个书籍的角，那书直接往外翻了。

？

难道是鸟太沉了吗？

不可能！

但那本书已经从竖着变成横着了，两个铁制的书立中间显得很是突兀。

白粼粼试图复原，叼着那个书角，本意是往上提一下，结果一下子扯出来了。

页面都翻了出来。

2013年5月6日，阴。

……

白粼粼立马抬爪盖住，把鸟头一撇。

不能看不能看。

日记这种东西就应该锁在柜子里！

干什么放在桌面上啊？

但随着时间一点一滴地推移，鸟头正在以十分缓慢的速度下移……

2013年5月6日，阴。

[爸爸妈妈离婚了，我不太懂。是我的生日礼物吗？]

白粼粼反应过来的时候，他已经爪子踩着页面，低头认真看了。

没有办法。

他真的很想知道宋郁因为什么生病，毕竟他的父母……其实是都在的。

怎么会……

鸟也很担心。

但这本日记其实压根就写的不全，2013年就这一篇，后面全是些乱涂乱画。

黑色线条图，交缠在一起，很压抑的感觉。

白粼粼用鸟爪子翻了翻，看到后面的另一篇日记。

2014年12月3日。

[奶奶在一个很冷很狭窄的床上睡觉，我去陪她，但爷爷把我抱出来了。]

白粼粼愣住了，这父母离婚一年之后就……

那时候才几岁？

2018年3月6日。

[我的爸爸在抱另一个孩子。]

2018年4月7日。

[爷爷问我为什么不爱说话，我不知道说什么，但想起来一件事，问爸爸还会结婚么，爷爷说永远不会。]

2018年11月2日。

[妈妈结婚了。]

白粼粼几乎不想看下去了，没什么别的原因，实在是很难受。

小孩子单纯直白的记录……更能扯人的心。

但就在鸟试图用喙把日记本给合上的时候，纸张却因为惯性开始快速地翻动。

其实大部分都是空白，或者是无意义的黑线，直到一个新的时间节点到来。

2023年6月7日。

[我见到了我父亲的孩子，他是没有结婚，但在和别人生活，真可笑。]

白粼粼这才反应过来，这个时候的宋郁是上高中了，已经很近了。

页面还在慢慢地往下翻动着，因为写的句子很短，甚至不需要特意截停。

2024年1月4日。

[我的父亲在书房商讨如何更改爷爷出事前留下的遗产分配书。但我不想要财产，我想死。]

2024年3月5日。

[想死。]

2024年7月2日。

[割腕失败了，宋启明说我会影响股市，败坏爷爷的产业。]

2024年8月2日。

[妈妈，拒绝来看我。]

2024年10月2日。

[江芮说我是装的。]

日记本什么时候合上的都不知道，白粼粼整个鸟都完全炸毛了。

这父母……还不如没了呢！

什么玩意儿！

他要气死了！

-

与此同时，琅山。

宋郁在人群中很是亮眼，西服革履，面容优越，但就是神色很冷。

华秉在南市还是有一定影响力的，不仅是它的商业地位，还有宋家的影响力。

宋峥国的人脉很广，以至于各行各业都有，甚至还有匿名的“赠礼”，是一副古画。

骏马奔腾，形神兼备，看着像是一副真迹。

其实宋启明是有点挂不住脸的，对方不来，说明看不上他，但是偏偏又送了这么用心的礼。

说明是很肯定宋郁这个小辈的。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 20 (Part 2)

The weight on Song Yu's shoulder vanished. The bird stretched its wings on the desk and tilted its head to begin preening its feathers.

Its blue feathers were long and sleek.

Very striking.

Right at that moment, the roar of a car engine echoed from the gate outside. Rain signs suggested the drizzle might be turning heavier.

Bai Linlin looked outside, thinking to himself: *Going out in this weather?*

*Is it for that graduation banquet?*

"..."

*What a terrible day to pick!*

However, the bird also heard the engine idle outside the courtyard. Pattering over to stand on the window sill, he peered down quite earnestly.

A Cullinan.

*Holy crap!*

Bai Linlin was a materialistic little bird. He immediately fluttered his wings and flew straight onto Song Yu's shoulder, indicating that he wanted to go out too.

This bird was riding in a luxury car today.

Who agreed, and who opposed?

Bai Linlin passed the motion with a self-declared "unanimous vote," but upon reaching the entryway, he was slapped with a "single-vote veto" by Song Yu.

"It's raining outside. Wait for me at home, okay?"

"I'll be back very soon."

In the end, the door clicked shut.

***

The banquet venue was located at a famous five-star hotel in Nanshi, situated on Mount Lang. The scenery was breathtaking, and the venue operated strictly on a membership basis.

The car drove up the winding mountain road. Song Yu sat in the front passenger seat, his face devoid of expression.

"Xiao Yu, have you thought about which university you want to apply to?"

The driver felt the atmosphere was a bit suffocating and tried to find a topic to chat about.

He had originally been responsible for driving the mother and son over at Bibo Bay, rarely coming to Jinyuan. The last time he had seen this child was several years ago.

He couldn't help feeling a bit nostalgic.

The first wife's child really was outstanding.

"No."

Song Yu had no interest in chatting, merely gazing out the window where the rain continued to fall.

"Ah, then take your time considering it. There's no rush with these things."

The driver was understanding enough. Though somewhat awkward, he spoke gently as he turned the steering wheel.

A right turn.

Right at that moment—

A dull thud suddenly echoed against the windshield, and a dusty gray shadow was hurled outward.

Song Yu furrowed his brow as the car slammed on its brakes.

The driver panicked a little. After all, this wasn't his personal car. Unbuckling his seatbelt, he muttered to himself:

"What did we hit? The window couldn't be..."

Song Yu stepped out of the car without overthinking it. The wind outside wasn't too strong, but fine rain washed over his face, accentuating his cool, pale complexion.

"No need to inspect the car. I'll tell my father."

"Check around to see if there's a small animal."

The driver froze for a second, then quickly complied. The commotion just now hadn't been small; it was probably a bird or something similar.

However, there was no blood on the windshield, so no concrete trace could be found.

After delaying for about five minutes, the car eventually drove off since nothing could be located.

And simultaneously—

On the winding mountain road, there was now a "ground chicken." The homing pigeon had been hit so hard its head was spinning, pattering dazedly along the curb.

"..."

*It's fine.*

*How could a bird possibly be this unlucky all the time?*

The next second:

*Waaaaah!*

It was going to report this straight to Headquarters!

***

Jinyuan.

Bai Linlin was bored out of his mind, wandering aimlessly around the villa before finally returning to Song Yu's bedroom.

He had originally planned to start a game, but as he stood on the desk, he inexplicably recalled the scene when he had entered the room for the very first time.

*Eh...?*

*On this desk...?*

The bird looked left and right, his claws tapping *patter-patter* against the surface, before finally discovering the problem.

That framed group photo was gone.

Bai Linlin didn't actually know if Song Yu had recovered or not. Looking out the window, he saw it was still raining and felt like checking downstairs.

If it was just a few hours...

It should be quick, right?

Bai Linlin fluttered his wings, planning to land on top of the bookend. From that vantage point, he could see cars on the road clearly.

If the Cullinan returned, then Song Yu would be home.

*Bird waiting in progress.*

However, luck was not on his side. Just as Bai Linlin fluttered his wings and took off, his claws failed to secure a stable grip on the corner of a book, causing the volume to flip outward.

*?*

*Could it be that the bird is too heavy?*

*Impossible!*

The book had already shifted from standing vertically to lying horizontally, looking extremely jarring between the two iron bookends.

Bai Linlin attempted to restore it to its original position. He clamped his beak onto the corner of the book, intending to pull it upward, but accidentally pulled it open instead.

The pages flipped wide open.

*May 6, 2013. Overcast.*

...

Bai Linlin instantly slammed a claw over the page and jerked his bird head away.

*Can't look, can't look.*

*Diaries should be locked away in a cabinet!*

*Why leave it out on the desk?!*

Yet, as time ticked by second by second, the bird head began to lower at an agonizingly slow pace...

*May 6, 2013. Overcast.*

[*Mom and Dad got divorced. I don't really understand. Is this my birthday present?*]

By the time Bai Linlin snapped back to reality, his claw was already pressing down on the page, his head lowered as he read intently.

He couldn't help it.

He really wanted to know why Song Yu was ill. After all, his own parents... were actually both around.

How could...

The bird was deeply worried too.

However, this diary wasn't comprehensive at all. There was only this single entry for 2013, followed by endless scribbles and chaotic doodles.

Thick black lines tangled together, radiating a suffocating sense of oppression.

Bai Linlin used his bird claw to flip through the pages, catching sight of another entry further back.

*December 3, 2014.*

[*Grandma is sleeping on a very cold, very narrow bed. I went to keep her company, but Grandpa carried me out.*]

Bai Linlin froze. Just one year after his parents' divorce...

How old was he back then?

*March 6, 2018.*

[*My father is holding another child.*]

*April 7, 2018.*

[*Grandpa asked me why I don't like to talk. I didn't know what to say, but I remembered one thing and asked if Dad would get married again. Grandpa said never.*]

*November 2, 2018.*

[*Mom got married.*]

Bai Linlin almost didn't want to keep reading. For no other reason than it was painfully heartbreaking.

The pure, straightforward records of a young child... possessed an even greater power to tear at one's heartstrings.

Just as the bird attempted to use his beak to shut the diary, inertia caused the paper pages to flip rapidly.

Most of them were blank or filled with meaningless black scrawls, until a new timestamp emerged.

*June 7, 2023.*

[*I met my father's child. He didn't get married, but he's living with someone else. How laughable.*]

Only then did Bai Linlin realize that Song Yu had entered high school by this point—this was already very recent.

The pages continued to drift downward slowly. Because the sentences were brief, there was no need to deliberately stop them.

*January 4, 2024.*

[*My father is in the study discussing how to alter the inheritance distribution document Grandpa left before his accident. But I don't want the property. I want to die.*]

*March 5, 2024.*

[*Want to die.*]

*July 2, 2024.*

[*Slitting my wrists failed. Song Qiming said I would affect the stock market and ruin Grandpa's business.*]

*August 2, 2024.*

[*Mom refused to come see me.*]

*October 2, 2024.*

[*Jiang Rui said I was faking it.*]

He didn't even know when the diary had finally snapped shut. Bai Linlin's entire bird plumage puffed up completely in absolute fury.

These parents... were worse than having none at all!

What absolute garbage!

He was going to burst from anger!

***

Meanwhile, at Mount Lang.

Song Yu stood out brilliantly amidst the crowd. Clad in a tailored suit, his features were exquisite, yet his expression remained ice-cold.

Huabing Group possessed significant influence in Nanshi, owing not only to its commercial stature but also to the legacy of the Song family.

Song Zhengguo possessed an extensive network of connections spanning various industries. Someone had even sent an anonymous "gift"—an ancient painting.

Galloping steeds, alive with form and spirit—it looked like a genuine masterpiece.

Song Qiming actually felt quite embarrassed. The sender's absence proved they looked down on him, yet they had gone through the trouble of sending such a thoughtful, lavish gift.

It clearly demonstrated their immense approval of the younger generation—Song Yu.

chunks.chineseText:
几乎不用想，这肯定是他父亲的故交，还是不能得罪的行当。

宋启明面色其实有些难看，但还是维持住了场面，到底还是扯着笑陪完了客人。

宴席的规格很高，整场下来其实没有什么差错。

江芮压根就没有关心身边的丈夫，只是远远地看着宋启明，心想待会好戏就开场了。

“还有别的事么，我在这里好像不合适。”

旁边的丈夫问了句。

但江芮只是用手指敲了敲膝盖，侧头看了过去，很平静地道：

“再合作一次怎么样？”

“有个不错的新闻。”

……

宋郁其实没有任何想要待下去的意思，他在偏厅待着，垂眸在解自己的袖扣。

大厅上方的水晶灯一个配件都要成百上千，光线都是奢靡的，折射出好几层光。

少年身姿挺立，眉骨优越，眼窝处有浅浅的阴影。

“我怎么知道他提前回国了！”

“他连升学宴这事都没告诉我。”

“韵韵……”

那是李长韵的声音，还伴随着一个陌生的男声，似乎很亲密，在不远处的走廊那里传来，很明显要往这里来。

宋郁微微抬了下眉，似乎觉得可笑，但并不关心，抬步就打算离开，但就在准备走内侧的门的时候。

拉开——

“……”

对面是宋启明。

事情总是很是光怪陆离，门外，是他与他父亲，门内，是所谓的继母和正在出轨的副总。

奢靡的光线下，里面响起女性的啜泣与粘稠的接吻声，破门而入似乎是下一秒的事情。

宋郁没有想到的是，他的母亲居然也在，甚至请了记者过来，拍摄了相关的照片。

后续的场面几乎无法控制，只是让人觉得混乱与失序。

“你是有病吗？拍照有什么意思吗？”

“江芮！”

昔日的夫妻情分早就散得一干二净，留下来的只有纯粹的恨。

他的母亲好似多年大仇终于得报，只是反问：

“这条新闻发出去，你猜猜华秉要损失多少？”

“噢，对了，你应该关心的是，你那个小儿子，是不是你好兄弟厉峰的了。”

他的父亲也不甘示弱，讽刺道：

“你又过得很好吗？生了个只会暴走的超雄，还掩人耳目把性别改成女的，你就高尚了？”

“江芮，被自己肚子的肉揍的时候好受么？”

宋郁面色平静，他只是知道这个升学宴是个噱头，大抵是为了交际，但没想到还有这么一出戏码。

偏厅的外人都走了，那对出轨的男女也被私人保镖押走了。

奢靡的宴会厅里，只有他们一家人。

和和美美。

宋郁拉了把椅子，面无表情地坐下了。

……

“不好意思，我已经有二胎了，不劳你费心。”

江芮气得手指发抖，但还是反怼了过去。

但是宋启明立即反问：

“那你上次去医院干什么，筛什么？色盲？你以为你靠国外精子库就能生出来好的了？”

“真可惜，你的色盲基因仍然是有百分之五十的概率遗传给二胎的。”

江芮直接反唇相讥：

“那怎么了？我生的一定是我的孩子，你呢？像个哈巴狗一样养着别人的孩子？”

“你可笑不可笑啊哈哈。”

宋启明面色变了，最后仿佛是气急了，把桌上的东西全部推下去了。

高脚杯多是装红酒的，摔倒地上，四分五裂，深色的液体犹如血一样地淌开。

宋郁看着地上的场景，不知为何觉得前所未有的舒坦，好似身体的脏血也这么流了出去。

-

白粼粼气得脑瓜子嗡嗡，他已经记下小本本了。

宋启明是吧？

江芮是吧？

啄死你们！

白粼粼真是越想越气，以至于连游戏都不想打了，只是在桌子上来回啪嗒啪嗒走。

也就在这时，窗户外面突然传来规律的咚咚声，似乎有什么东西在敲。

鸟抬头看过去，愣了下。

因为他从来没见过这么磕碜的鸽子。

鼻青脸肿的。

“啾啾？”

[你好？]

但也就是这句示好，似乎让那只信鸽确认了什么，它直接往前飞了。

白粼粼其实有点着急，因为这是有窗户的，这只信鸽再撞一下，恐怕伤势会更严重。

但此时神奇的事发生了。

窗户像是变成了水的波纹，那只信鸽很容易就进来了，甚至开始口吐人言：

[白粼粼，妖怪编号247，尚未化形，贫困补助已到。]

说罢就凭空而出一个信封，慢悠悠地飘了下来。

[好好阅读。]

这句话说完，信鸽就要掉头离开，但不知道这次怎么回事，咣得一声撞了上去。

“……”

白粼粼心想要不还是给它开下窗户，但就在这时，信鸽第二次尝试终于顺利地通过了，不过飞得歪七扭八的。

应该是撞得不轻。

鸟这才低头看了看那个信封，底色是暗色的，有流动的金纹。

？

什么东西。

白粼粼现在莫名能理解宋郁了，他对超出理解范围的事……也有点无措。

这是什么？

鸟伸了爪子，用喙拆开了信封，抽出来了一张纸，上面的文字如同金沙一样在流动着。

白粼粼其实根本看不懂，因为这些字……不像是汉字，但就在这时，这些字体突然浮了起来。

在半空中旋转，成一个完美的弧线。

最后直接进入了鸟的脑海里。

白粼粼还没反应过来，喙里叼着的那张纸就成了灰烬。

一秒，两秒。

他的身躯突然开始变大，体内像是有一股力量在乱窜，爪子都开始劈叉。

轰隆——

书桌塌了。

有一阵灰尘荡了起来。

白粼粼就在粉尘中初见“雏形”，身子膨胀到一米多高，鸟脸懵逼，爪子在地板上滑出很深的痕迹。

“……”

更糟糕的是，楼下传来了汽车的引擎声。

鸟试图躲避，但是随着门口的脚步声越来越近，鸟崩溃地发现，他藏不住。

太大了。

宋郁其实很消沉，他很累，现在只想回卧室睡一觉，以及看看自己的小鸟。

但刚一推门——

“……”

巨大的鸟站在他的房间，羽毛蓬松，胸膛挺立，爪子有些拘谨地在打滑。

他大抵是病得更重了。

白粼粼其实很是紧张兮兮的，但是他看到宋郁苍白的脸色之后，又莫名生出了点护犊子情绪。

以至于脑子抽了下，他伸开了翅膀，迟疑地问了问：

“要、要埋一下吗？”
chunks.englishText:
Without a second thought, this was clearly an old acquaintance of his father, and someone in a profession he couldn't afford to offend.

Song Qiming’s expression was actually quite unsightly, but he managed to maintain appearances, forcing a laugh to entertain the guests until the end.

The banquet was held to high standards, and on the surface, the entire event proceeded without a hitch.

Jiang Rui couldn't care less about the husband beside her. She simply stared at Song Qiming from afar, thinking to herself that the good show was about to begin.

“Is there anything else? It doesn't seem appropriate for me to stay here,” her husband asked from beside her.

Jiang Rui merely tapped her fingers against her knee, turned her head to look at him, and said calmly, “How about another collaboration?”

“I have a great piece of news.”

……

Song Yu had no desire to linger in the slightest. He stayed in the side parlor, eyes cast downward as he unbuttoned his cufflinks.

Every crystal accessory on the grand chandeliers above the main hall cost hundreds or thousands of dollars. The light they emitted was decadent, refracting in multiple dazzling layers.

The youth stood tall and slender, his brow bone prominent, casting a shallow shadow over his eye sockets.

“How was I supposed to know he came back early?!”

“He didn't even tell me about this graduation banquet.”

“Yunyun……”

That was Li Changyun’s voice, accompanied by a unfamiliar male voice that sounded intimate. Coming from the hallway nearby, they were clearly walking this way.

Song Yu raised an eyebrow slightly, feeling it was ridiculous, yet he didn't care. He turned to leave through the inner door.

He pulled it open—

“……”

Facing him was Song Qiming.

Life was always full of bizarre coincidences. Outside the door stood him and his father; inside the door were his so-called stepmother and the cheating vice president.

Under the extravagant lights, a woman’s sobs and wet, sticky kissing noises echoed from inside. Someone bursting through the door seemed like it would happen the next second.

What Song Yu hadn't expected was that his mother was actually there too—she had even brought reporters to take photos.

The scene that followed quickly spiraled out of control, chaotic and full of disorder.

“Are you sick in the head?! What’s the point of taking photos?!”

“Jiang Rui!”

Their past affection as husband and wife had long vanished into thin air, leaving behind nothing but pure, unadulterated hatred.

His mother looked as though a grudge held for years had finally been avenged. She simply shot back, “When this news hits the press, guess how much Huabing will lose?”

“Oh, right. What you should really worry about is whether that precious younger son of yours actually belongs to your good brother, Li Feng.”

His father refused to back down, sneering sarcastically, “And you think you’re living so great? You gave birth to an XYY supermale who can do nothing but rage out, and you even covered it up by changing his legal gender to female! You think that makes you noble?”

“Jiang Rui, how does it feel being beaten up by the flesh of your own womb?”

Song Yu’s face remained calm. He had known all along that this graduation banquet was just a stunt, likely held for networking, but he hadn't expected such a drama to unfold.

All the outsiders in the side parlor had left, and the cheating couple had been dragged away by private bodyguards.

In the lavish banquet hall, only their family remained.

Harmonious and loving.

Song Yu pulled out a chair and sat down without an expression.

……

“Sorry to disappoint, but I already have a second child. You don't need to trouble your head over it.”

Jiang Rui was trembling with rage, but she still snapped back.

However, Song Qiming instantly retorted, “Then what did you go to the hospital for last time? What were you screening for? Color blindness? You think you can give birth to something good just by relying on a foreign sperm bank?”

“Too bad! Your color blindness gene still has a fifty percent chance of being passed down to your second child!”

Jiang Rui spat back instantly, “So what? The child I give birth to is guaranteed to be mine! What about you? Raising someone else's kid like a lapdog?”

“Aren't you ridiculous? Haha!”

Song Qiming’s expression turned terrible. In the end, driven to a fit of fury, he swept everything off the table.

Most of the goblets held red wine. Falling to the floor, they shattered into pieces, the deep red liquid spreading like blood.

Looking at the mess on the ground, Song Yu felt an unprecedented sense of relief for some reason, as if the dirty blood in his own body had drained out along with it.

-

Bai Linlin was so angry his little head was buzzing, and he was already taking notes in his mental ledger.

Song Qiming, right?

Jiang Rui, right?

I’ll peck you both to death!

The more Bai Linlin thought about it, the angrier he got, so much so that he didn't even want to play games anymore. He just paced back and forth on the desk, his feet making sharp *patter-patter* sounds.

Right at that moment, a rhythmic tapping suddenly sounded from outside the window, as if something were knocking.

The bird looked up and froze.

Because he had never seen such a battered pigeon.

It was beaten black and blue, swollen all over.

“Chirp chirp?”

[*Hello?*]

Yet it was precisely this friendly greeting that seemed to confirm something for the carrier pigeon. It flew straight forward.

Bai Linlin was actually a bit anxious. There was a window pane there; if the pigeon crashed into it again, its injuries would only get worse.

But right then, a magical thing happened.

The window pane seemed to ripple like water, and the carrier pigeon passed through easily, even opening its beak to speak in human tongue:

[*Bai Linlin, Yaoguai Registration No. 247, unformed. Poverty subsidy has arrived.*]

With those words, an envelope materialized out of thin air and floated down slowly.

[*Read it carefully.*]

Having delivered its message, the carrier pigeon turned around to leave. But for some reason, *CLANG!* It crashed straight into the glass this time.

“……”

Bai Linlin thought he should probably open the window for it, but just then, the carrier pigeon succeeded on its second attempt, flying out smoothly—though its trajectory was completely crooked and wobbly.

That hit must have hurt badly.

Only then did the bird lower his head to look at the envelope. Its background was dark with flowing golden patterns.

?

What is this?

For some reason, Bai Linlin could suddenly understand Song Yu now... He was also a bit at a loss when facing things beyond his comprehension.

What was this?

The bird extended a claw, used his beak to tear open the envelope, and pulled out a sheet of paper. The characters written on it were flowing like golden sand.

Bai Linlin couldn't understand it at all, because these words... didn't look like Chinese characters. But right at that moment, the characters suddenly floated into the air.

They rotated midair, forming a perfect arc.

Finally, they shot straight into the bird’s mind.

Before Bai Linlin could react, the paper in his beak turned to ash.

One second, two seconds.

His body suddenly began to expand, and a surge of energy went wild inside him. Even his claws began to splay wildly.

*BOOM—*

The desk collapsed.

A cloud of dust billowed into the air.

In the middle of the dust, Bai Linlin’s "true form" made its debut. His body swelled to over a meter tall. With a bewildered face on a giant bird, his claws dragged deep gouges across the floorboards.

“……”

To make matters worse, the sound of a car engine echoed from downstairs.

The bird tried to hide, but as the footsteps outside the door drew closer and closer, he realized in sheer panic—he couldn't hide at all.

He was way too big!

Song Yu was actually feeling very down. He was exhausted and only wanted to go back to his bedroom to sleep and check on his little bird.

But the moment he pushed the door open—

“……”

A gigantic bird stood in his room, its feathers fluffy, its chest puffed out, its claws sliding nervously on the ruined floorboards.

He must really be getting sicker.

Bai Linlin was actually extremely nervous, but seeing Song Yu’s pale face, a strange protective instinct welled up inside him.

To the point where his brain short-circuited. He spread his wings and asked hesitantly:

“D-Do you... want to bury your face in here?”

chunks.chineseText:
第21章

宋郁几乎怔住了，他撑着门把手，苍白的脸上满是不可思议，很恍惚地问：

“粼粼？”

卧室里的“巨鸟”似乎有点羞涩，爪子很内敛地往里收了下，但仍然挡不住被踩烂的地板。

咳咳。

白粼粼的翅膀还在伸着，保持着一个敞开的状态，此刻有些小小的尴尬。

人，你最好是顺着这个台阶下来。

不然的话！

“你好大……”

白粼粼还没来得及思考下一步的对策，门口那里就传来一句很轻的话。

像是单纯的感叹。

宋郁顺手把门关上了，窗外的天色还是很阴沉，乌云密布的，导致卧室的光线也很暗。

他迈步往边走，面色又恢复了没有波澜的样子，只是昏昏沉沉的。

“人”像是彻底接受了，也像是从来没有在意过，只是如往常一样说了句：

“我回来了。”

白粼粼看到对方越走越近，其实也摸不准这是什么意思，宋郁他……

扑通。

胸口一重。

“……”

昏暗的房间里，一只庞大的鸟处在正中央，圆滚滚的身躯完全挡住了身前的人。

少年后面什么话都没有说，只是把脸埋了进来，抬手很轻地攥住了鸟的羽毛。

像是在拥抱。

外面不知何时起风了，把院子里的落叶都刮了起来，零星地打在了二楼的窗户上。

卧室里没有开灯。

很昏暗。

白粼粼一点也不敢动，直到外面天空突然轰隆一声，电闪雷鸣。

房间被照亮了一瞬间，宋郁恰好在那个时候侧过了脸。

少年的侧轮廓非常优越，在光线明暗之间形成了阴影，垂着的眼眸里没有什么情绪。

哗啦——

雨似乎变大了，窗户玻璃上的水珠串成了线，最后成了大片大片的雨幕。

屋外狂风骤雨。

屋内安稳宁静。

不知道过了多久。

鸟始终站得稳稳当当，胸膛甚至还挺得更高了，收拢了下翅膀，盖住人。

骄傲.jpg

-

南市亲子鉴定中心。

宋启明的西服都变得不修边幅了，扣子都掉了几颗，垂眸看着手上的报告，气得额头都冒出来了青筋了。

宋阳已经七岁了。

他不是七个月了。

李长韵个贱人。

宋启明气得呼吸都生疼，要不是他这次提早回来，估计要被蒙在鼓里一辈子。

好啊好啊。

他这么费心费力地培养宋阳，结果到头来是别人的种！

但更糟糕的还在后面，公司那里传来了消息，说是一家新闻媒体直接曝光了捉奸的照片，舆论大起。

宋启明在鉴定中心直接都失控了，直接踹了一角旁边的休息椅。

结果疼得龇牙咧嘴。

男人又喘着粗气看手机上的新闻：

[华秉老总宋启明戴惊天绿帽，疑为昔日好兄弟养了七年孩子……]

草！

手机被砰得一声摔到了地上。

好，好。

江芮够狠。

全南市都他妈知道他被绿了！

但是也不能解决问题，公司那里还有事，宋启明深吸一口气决定叫秘书过来给他送手机。

结果刚一摸兜。

看到了地上的碎片。

宋启明闭了闭眼，仿佛是彻底崩溃了，扇了自己好几巴掌。

最后拿上新手机已经是下午了，他坐在车上，点着烟，整个人仿佛是苍老了十岁。

此刻S州那里打来了电话：

“宋先生么？”

“很高兴告诉您一个好消息的，您的父亲在凌晨清醒了过来……”

宋启明整个人都愣住了，他先感受到的不是喜悦，而是一种莫大的惶恐，以至于说话都有点结巴：

“好、好，我知道了。”

他甚至用了中文，直到那边很困惑地问：

“先生？抱歉我听不懂你在说什么。”

“您什么时候有空回s州这里，医院仍然有一些交代的事项……”

听筒里的声音还在继续，但宋启明已经把手机放在一旁了，整个人都不好了。

他抬手捂住了脸。

怎么办？华秉一堆烂摊子，宋阳又不是他亲生的……

当初父亲就坚决反对他结婚，他是口头答应了，但是在出事之后他就——

宋启明觉得自己完了。

但是就在这时，他突然想起来了宋郁。

-

锦园这边。

一人一鸟抱着好长时间，其实久了还有点不好意思。

宋郁后知后觉这真的不是幻觉，才清醒了下，但脸上其实已经有了被压出来的红印。

他长相偏冷。

眼下看着有点莫名的反差感。

“……”

白粼粼其实说不尴尬是不可能的，鸟故技重施，试图梳理羽毛。

但是刚一伸翅膀，把床头柜的台灯给掀翻了。

沉默是今晚的康桥。

宋郁并不在意这点动静，只是看着鸟久久不能回神，脖子还残留着余温。

胸膛的羽毛非常蓬松，有种谷物的味道。

像是有麦浪翻涌。

并且，宽广。

鸟的翅膀甚至能完全覆盖住“人”。

宋郁没办法再自动合理化了，他不得不轻声问：

“粼粼是妖怪么？”

会打游戏会认字，还会吃各种各样的零食。

一切都好像有了合理的解释。

鸟很伟岸地站在对面，很斟酌地道：

“……好像是。”

宋郁愣了下，如果说刚刚进门的时候没有听清，那么现在就是完全确定了。

它的声音变了，“小”的时候是瓮声瓮气的、带着点抑扬顿挫。

但现在的则是更透彻，像是山涧的清泉，叮叮咚咚。

很阳光的样子。

是少年的嗓音。

宋郁不由得条件反射：

“那怎么不变人？”

“……”

白粼粼心想这又不是他能控制的，爪子在地板上划拉了两下，有些郁闷，但是地板崩了。

？

非要这样让他难堪吗？

“地板质量的问题，不用管。”

宋郁立刻这么道，没有任何犹豫。

鸟这才舒坦了，仰了仰头，很是矜贵的收回了自己爪子。

但就在这时，楼下传来了汽车的引擎声，宋郁面色一变，抬步去了窗户那里，果不其然看到了来人。

——宋启明。

-

这会已经晚上六点钟了，天色很是阴沉，雨水此刻已经停了，地面是被风刮下来的落叶。

宋启明迈步从车里出来，抬眼看了看楼上，发现没有灯亮还有些意外？

这孩子回来就睡了？

宋启明蹙了蹙眉，但还是起身去门口输指纹了，但就在这个时候，门口开始警报：

［指纹错误！］

［指纹错误！］

宋启明一开始还以为系统坏了，于是转而去输密码，结果还是：

［密码错误！］

［密码错误！］

男人这才后知后觉，锦园这边的门给换了，他气得不行，但是还是在门口拿出了手机，开始给宋郁打电话。

而此刻房间内。

巨大的鸟无处安放，只能先待在卧室，问就是太大卡门，白粼粼出不去。

“他来干什么？”

鸟不太满意地道，他已经看了那本日记，对于宋启明这个人类的印象直线下降。

想直接叨死对方。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 21

Song Yu was completely stunned. Holding the door handle, his pale face was full of disbelief. He asked in a daze, "Linlin?"

The "giant bird" in the bedroom seemed a bit bashful. It pulled its claws inward in a modest posture, but that still couldn't hide the floorboards it had crushed.

*Ahem.*

Bai Linlin’s wings were still spread wide, holding an open posture, which felt a bit awkward at the moment.

*Human, you’d better take the exit strategy I’m offering you.*

*Otherwise!*

"You're so big..."

Before Bai Linlin could think of his next move, a soft whisper came from the doorway.

It sounded like a simple exclamation.

Song Yu closed the door behind him. The sky outside the window was still dark and gloomy, covered in thick clouds, making the light inside the bedroom very dim.

He walked over, his face returning to its expressionless state, though he seemed groggy and lightheaded.

The "human" seemed to have completely accepted it—or perhaps he had never cared in the first place—and simply said as usual, "I'm back."

Seeing him walking closer and closer, Bai Linlin couldn't gauge what he meant. Song Yu...

*Thump.*

A weight settled on his chest.

“……”

In the dim room, a massive bird stood right in the center, its round, plump body completely blocking the person in front of it.

The youth didn't say another word after that. He simply buried his face in the feathers, raising his hands to softly clutch the bird's plumage.

It was like a hug.

Wind picked up outside at some point, sweeping up the fallen leaves in the courtyard and rattling them against the second-floor window.

No lights were turned on in the bedroom.

It was very dark.

Bai Linlin didn't dare move at all. Not until a sudden clap of thunder crashed outside, accompanied by a flash of lightning.

The room lit up for a split second, and Song Yu happened to turn his face to the side at that exact moment.

The youth’s side profile was remarkably handsome, forming sharp shadows between light and dark. There was no emotion in his lowered eyes.

*Pitter-patter—*

The rain seemed to grow heavier. The water droplets on the glass merged into streams, eventually turning into a massive curtain of rain.

Violent wind and torrential rain raged outside.

Inside the room, it was peaceful and tranquil.

No one knew how much time had passed.

The bird stood firm and steady the entire time, even puffing its chest up higher. It brought its wings inward, covering the person completely.

*Proud.jpg*

-

Nanshi Paternity Testing Center.

Song Qiming’s suit had become untidy, several buttons missing. Staring down at the report in his hands, blue veins bulged on his forehead in rage.

Song Yang was already seven years old.

He wasn't seven months old!

That bitch, Li Changyun!

Song Qiming’s chest burned with every breath he took. If he hadn't returned early this time, he probably would have been kept in the dark for the rest of his life!

Fine! Fantastic!

He had poured so much time and effort into raising Song Yang, only for the boy to turn out to be someone else's bastard!

To make matters worse, news arrived from the company saying that a media outlet had directly exposed the photos of the affair, causing public opinion to explode.

Song Qiming completely lost his composure right there in the testing center. He kicked a waiting chair nearby in fury, only to grimace in pain.

Breathing heavily, the man checked the news on his phone:

[Huabing CEO Song Qiming Cuckolded in Shocking Scandal; Allegedly Raised Good Brother's Child for Seven Years...]

Fuck!

He smashed his phone onto the ground with a loud bang.

Fine, fantastic!

Jiang Rui was ruthless enough!

Now all of Nanshi fucking knew he had been cheated on!

But smashing the phone didn't solve his problems; there were still matters at the company. Song Qiming took a deep breath and decided to call his secretary to bring him a spare phone.

Yet the moment he reached into his pocket—

He saw the shattered pieces on the floor.

Song Qiming closed his eyes, as if suffering a total mental breakdown, and slapped himself several times across the face.

It wasn't until late afternoon that he finally got hold of a new phone. Sitting in his car, smoking a cigarette, he looked as if he had aged ten years.

At that moment, a call came in from S-State:

"Is this Mr. Song?"

"I am pleased to inform you of some good news. Your father regained consciousness early this morning..."

Song Qiming froze entirely. What he felt first was not joy, but an overwhelming dread—so much so that he stammered when he spoke:

"G-Good, I understand."

He had even spoken in Chinese, until the voice on the other end replied in confusion:

"Sir? I'm sorry, I don't understand what you're saying."

"When will you be available to return to S-State? The hospital still has some matters to go over with you..."

The voice in the receiver continued, but Song Qiming had already put the phone down, feeling completely derailed.

He raised a hand to cover his face.

What was he supposed to do? Huabing was a complete mess, Song Yang wasn't his biological son...

Back then, his father had fiercely opposed his marriage. He had agreed verbally, but after the accident, he had—

Song Qiming felt he was finished.

Just then, however, he suddenly remembered Song Yu.

-

Over at Jinyuan.

The human and the bird had been hugging for a long time. So long, in fact, that it was getting a bit embarrassing.

Song Yu realized post-facto that this really wasn't a hallucination. When he pulled back, a faint red pressure mark was left on his face.

His features leaned toward cold and sharp, making the mark look oddly contrasting.

“……”

It was impossible for Bai Linlin not to feel awkward. The bird resorted to his old trick, attempting to preen his feathers.

However, the moment he extended a wing, he knocked over the lamp on the nightstand.

Silence was the night's bridge.

Song Yu didn't care about the noise. He simply stared at the bird, unable to snap out of his daze for a long time, the lingering warmth still felt on his neck.

The feathers on the bird's chest were extremely fluffy, carrying a scent like grain—like rolling waves of wheat.

And it was broad.

The bird’s wings could completely cover a human.

Song Yu could no longer rationalize this away. He had no choice but to ask softly, "Is Linlin a yaoguai?"

He could play video games, read words, and eat all kinds of snacks.

Everything suddenly had a logical explanation.

The bird stood majestically opposite him, deliberating before speaking:

"...Seems like it."

Song Yu paused. If he hadn't heard clearly when he first walked in, now he was absolutely certain.

Its voice had changed. When it was "small," it sounded muffled and squeaky, with a bouncy rhythm.

Now, however, the voice was crisp and clear, like a mountain spring babbling over rocks—bright and sunny.

It was the voice of a teenage boy.

Song Yu couldn't help but ask out of reflex, "Then why don't you turn into a human?"

“……”

Bai Linlin thought to himself: *Like I can control it!* He scraped his claws twice on the floor in frustration, only for the floorboards to crack even further.

?

*Must you embarrass me like this?*

"It's a floor quality issue. Don't mind it," Song Yu said immediately without a moment's hesitation.

Only then did the bird feel appeased. He tilted his head up and pulled back his claws with great dignity.

Right at that moment, the sound of a car engine echoed from downstairs. Song Yu’s expression changed. He stepped over to the window and, sure enough, saw the newcomer.

—Song Qiming.

-

It was already six in the evening. The sky was gloomy, the rain had stopped, and the ground was littered with leaves blown down by the wind.

Song Qiming stepped out of his car. Looking up at the second floor, he was a bit surprised to find no lights on.

*Did this kid go straight to sleep after coming back?*

Song Qiming frowned, but he still walked up to the front door to scan his fingerprint. Just then, the door lock beeped an alarm:

[Incorrect Fingerprint!]

[Incorrect Fingerprint!]

At first, Song Qiming thought the system was broken, so he switched to entering the passcode instead. The result was still:

[Incorrect Passcode!]

[Incorrect Passcode!]

Only then did the man realize post-facto that the lock at Jinyuan had been replaced. Furious, he pulled out his phone by the door and dialed Song Yu's number.

Meanwhile, in the bedroom upstairs:

The gigantic bird had nowhere to go and could only stay in the bedroom. If anyone asked, he was too big and stuck at the door—Bai Linlin couldn't get out.

"What is he here for?" the bird asked, thoroughly displeased.

Having already read that diary, his impression of the human named Song Qiming had plummeted straight to rock bottom.

He wanted to peck the guy to death directly.

chunks.chineseText:
鸟嫉恶如仇。

宋郁闻言怔了下，眉眼都变得温和，只是起身去坍塌的书桌那里拿了那袋子松子，顺带把水也提过来了。

他安抚道：

“没事，他被绿了，宋阳不是他的儿子。”

“无非是来找找存在感。”

白粼粼闻言鸟眼都亮了亮，一副吃瓜的表情，宋郁见状只好把宴会的事说了说。

他略去了那些不好的情绪，只是把“事”提了出来，说完才反应过来。

原来置身事外来看……

竟然这么荒唐。

“活该！”

鸟对此下了宣判词，但就在这时宋郁的手机响了，楼下那人电话来了。

少年蹙了蹙眉，他想起来一件事，宋启明在监控里看到了鸟在客厅里吃东西。

这件事要解决掉。

不然后患无穷。

宋郁接了电话，把手机放到了耳边，但看到鸟圆圆的眼睛，一副好奇的样子。

“……”

他开免提了。

鸟很满意，高兴地伸了伸翅根。

“小郁，家里门换了？来给爸爸开个门。”

“是睡着了吗？”

宋郁对于听筒里传来的慈父语气没有任何反应，只是觉得可笑，以往这个语气只在宋阳那里出现。

“我十八了。”

“不是七岁。”

宋郁很平静地提醒，电话那头的人似乎是抽了口气，似乎是气得没边了，但最后听筒里传来的还是：

“好了，不要挖苦爸爸了。”

“给爸爸开个门好不好？外面起风了。”

宋启明低声下气的，在门口站着，定制的西服都被风刮的落叶打湿了，手背都有些被冻红了。

自己家里进不去。

他真是可悲。

但屋漏偏逢连夜雨，就在这时路边不知何时多了个打伞的邻居，看到此情此景，打招呼道：

“启明？哟，回家了？”

“这怎么不进门呢？”

“没带钥匙啊？”

宋启明气得眼皮抽动，但偏偏还不能不理，锦园里的邻居全部都是有头有脸的，当年还都和自己父亲交好，他只能故作不在乎，赔着笑道：

“对，对，孩子睡着了，我给他打个电话。”

邻居心里跟明镜一样，牵着狗也不走了，只是又道：

“那是挺麻烦的。”

邻居像是很理解，但话锋一转，又道：

“欸，启明，我前几天见你媳妇带着孩子来过一次，不如给你媳妇打电话啊。”

“小郁这刚高考完，肯定要放松放松的，孩子睡得沉，问大人多快呀。”

动之以情，晓之以理。

宋启明笑不出来了。

“你那小的是不是该上小学了呀？哎呦，我那天看到了，长得确实像你。”

宋启明闻言没办法了，只能同对方说了实情，面色很是难看。

邻居一听，邻居惊讶。

“哎呀，没事没事，这……这我也不知道。”

最后潇洒离去。

与此同时，电话里才传来少年的声音。

“你来干什么？”

宋启明只能好声好气地道：“爸爸知道你心里有怨气，这么些年你受委屈了。”

“但给爸爸个机会好么？”

“我前段时间就查出来端倪了，这不是提前回国了？你放心小郁，我们家里的产业半分都不会分出去的，都只会留给你。”

电话那头还是寂静。

宋启明是真的没招了，拿着手机在门口转圈，裤腿上都沾了泥水。

最后想起来什么，又道：

“对了小郁，家里的那个鸟，爸爸实在不放心，给爸爸开开门好不好？我带你去酒店住，你爷爷原来有过道士的朋友……”

就在这会儿，电话那里打断了。

“你是来道歉的？”

宋启明一愣，立马抓住这个松口的机会，连忙道：

“是是，爸爸给你道歉。”

“让爸爸进门好么？”

电话里许久没有动静，最后只是说：

“你等一下。”

-

宋启明从来没有这种等待的焦灼感，搓了搓手，大约等了有五分钟，门终于开了。

里面的少年面色冷淡，一身白衬衫，袖口微微挽着，平视看了过来。

“进来吧。”

宋启明蹙了蹙眉，心里想着这孩子实在是越大越不懂事，但是余光扫到了那截有纵深疤痕的手腕，又什么话都说不出来了。

房子里面很昏暗，他忍不住道：

“怎么家里不开灯？”

前面的少年连头也没有回，语气很是凉薄：

“我自己一个人住，开那么多灯做什么？”

宋启明被怼得没话说，最后跟着来到了客厅那里，耳边此刻传来一句：

“坐。”

宋启明只能先坐在沙发上，他好几年没来过锦园了，一时半会有些拘谨。

“要喝什么？”

宋启明刚想摆手说不用，但后知后觉回过味了，这难道不也是他家？

这孩子把他当客人？

男人面色变得铁青

但是由于客厅没有开灯，零个人看到。

宋郁只是开了餐厅那里的灯，打开冰箱准备拿瓶水，但是手刚放上去，犹豫了……

水蜜桃气泡水，鸟爱喝。

果蔬汁三合一，鸟爱喝。

蜜桃乌龙茶，鸟爱喝。

“……”

宋郁想了想，最终拿了角落里的一瓶矿泉水，然后关上了冰箱门。

他走到沙发那里，很客气地把水放在茶几上，坐在了宋启明较远的对面，微微抬了抬下巴，道：

“给你打开了。”

宋启明一开始还有些欣慰，但是少年下一句就是：

“道歉吧。”

宋启明愣住了，这怎么和说话的？

但是他又想到自己是来干什么的，也只是忍了忍，再怎么样这也是自己亲生的。

于是把水放下，很苦口婆心地道：

“爸爸这些年是对你有些忽略，但是吃的穿的，总归没有缺你的吧？”

宋启明又开始搬出来“说教”的那一套，牵强附会地扯东扯西，但永远不会承认自己错了。

对面的少年听了一会，随后平静地问：

“说完了么？”

宋启明深吸一口气，身子前倾，手肘撑着膝盖骨，再次试图拉近关系：

“爸爸的确有做的不到位的地方，原谅爸爸好不好？”

宋郁坐在对面，逆光让他的脸陷入了阴影，几乎看不出来什么表情。

他只是在想。

怎么会有人变得那么快，白天还那么颐指气使，晚上就开始演父子情深？

只能是亲子鉴定书出来了……

但单凭这个还不够。

宋郁垂着眼眸想了想，突然反应过来了，李长韵曾经挑衅过他，说是宋启明已经结扎了，以后的家产都会留给更‘正常’的孩子。

原来如此。

也就在这时，对方又开始说话：

“小郁，你那个鸟呢？爸爸不是骗你，估计真的是个邪物。”

“现在收拾收拾东西，和爸爸去酒店住。”

宋启明俨然一副好父亲的样子，实际上他只是想赶紧打好关系，免得让老爷子回国看到这不和的场面。

宋峥国就算是不动手，也能让别人抽他……

“你可以去看下心理医生。”

客厅里光线昏暗，对面的少年面不改色地道。

宋启明皱眉，当即就是反驳：
chunks.englishText:
The bird hated evil with a burning passion.

Song Yu was stunned for a moment upon hearing this. His expression softened as he stood up, walked over to the collapsed desk to retrieve the bag of pine nuts, and brought the water along as well.

He coaxed gently:

"It's fine. He was cheated on—Song Yang isn't his son."

"He's just here trying to assert his presence."

Hearing this, Bai Linlin's bird eyes lit up, wearing an expression full of gossiping excitement. Seeing this, Song Yu had no choice but to recount what had happened at the banquet.

He omitted his own negative emotions and simply stated the facts. Only after finishing did he realize...

Looking at it as an outsider...

It was truly that absurd.

"Serves him right!"

The bird pronounced its verdict. But right at that moment, Song Yu's phone rang—a call from the man downstairs.

The youth frowned. He remembered something: Song Qiming had seen the bird eating in the living room on the surveillance footage.

This matter had to be resolved.

Otherwise, it would cause endless trouble down the line.

Song Yu answered the phone and held it to his ear, but then saw the bird's round, curious eyes staring back at him.

"..."

He turned on the speakerphone.

The bird was very satisfied and happily stretched the bases of its wings.

"Xiao Yu, did you change the locks at home? Come open the door for Dad."

"Are you asleep?"

Song Yu had no reaction to the loving father tone coming from the speaker; he merely found it laughable. In the past, this tone was reserved exclusively for Song Yang.

"I'm eighteen."

"Not seven."

Song Yu reminded him calmly. The person on the other end of the line seemed to gasp, seemingly furious beyond belief, but in the end, what came through the speaker was still:

"Alright, stop mocking your father."

"Open the door for Dad, okay? It's getting windy outside."

Song Qiming spoke humbly, standing at the door. His tailored suit was dampened by rain-slicked fallen leaves blown by the wind, and the backs of his hands were slightly red from the cold.

Locked out of his own home.

He was truly pathetic.

To make matters worse, a neighbor holding an umbrella appeared out of nowhere by the roadside. Seeing this scene, the neighbor greeted him:

"Qiming? Oh, you're back home?"

"Why aren't you going inside?"

"Forgot your keys?"

Song Qiming's eyelids twitched with anger, yet he couldn't ignore them. The neighbors in Jinyuan Estate were all prominent figures who had been on good terms with his late father. He had no choice but to feign nonchalance and offer a forced smile:

"Yes, yes. The kid fell asleep, so I'm calling him."

The neighbor saw through him completely, standing there holding his dog's leash without moving, and said with a chuckle:

"Well, that sure is inconvenient."

The neighbor pretended to be sympathetic, but then pivoted:

"Hey, Qiming, I saw your wife here with the kid a few days ago. Why don't you call your wife?"

"Xiao Yu just finished his college entrance exams, so he definitely needs to relax. Kids sleep deeply—asking an adult would be so much faster!"

Appealing to reason and emotion.

Song Qiming's smile faltered completely.

"Is your younger one about to start primary school? My goodness, I saw him the other day—he really looks just like you!"

Hearing this, Song Qiming had no choice but to tell the neighbor the truth, his face dark and ugly.

The neighbor listened, feigning utter shock.

"Oh dear, it's fine, it's fine... I—I had no idea."

With that, the neighbor sauntered away contentedly.

At the same time, the youth's voice finally came through the phone.

"What are you here for?"

Song Qiming could only say coaxingly, "Dad knows you harbor resentment in your heart, and that you've suffered over all these years."

"But give Dad a chance, okay?"

"I discovered the truth a while ago, which is why I returned to the country ahead of schedule. Rest assured, Xiao Yu—not a single cent of our family assets will be given away. Everything will be left solely to you."

The other end of the line remained dead silent.

Song Qiming was truly out of options. He paced in circles at the door with his phone in hand, his pant legs splashed with muddy water.

Finally, remembering something, he added:

"By the way, Xiao Yu, about that bird at home—Dad is really worried about it. Open the door for Dad, alright? I'll take you to stay at a hotel. Your grandfather used to have friends who were Taoist priests..."

Right then, the phone line interrupted him.

"Are you here to apologize?"

Song Qiming froze, instantly seizing this opening, and hurriedly said:

"Yes, yes, Dad is apologizing to you."

"Will you let Dad in?"

Silence hung over the line for a long time before the youth finally said:

"Wait a moment."

-

Song Qiming had never experienced such anxious impatience. He rubbed his cold hands together, and after waiting for about five minutes, the door finally opened.

Inside stood the youth with a cold expression, wearing a white shirt with the cuffs rolled up slightly, looking straight at him.

"Come in."

Song Qiming frowned, thinking to himself that this child was becoming increasingly sensible-less as he grew older. But out of the corner of his eye, he caught sight of the long, deep scar on Song Yu's wrist, and all his reprimands died in his throat.

The house was dark inside. He couldn't help saying:

"Why aren't the lights on at home?"

The youth walking ahead didn't even turn his head, his voice exceedingly cold:

"I live here alone. Why turn on so many lights?"

Choked into silence, Song Qiming followed him into the living room, where a single word reached his ears:

"Sit."

Song Qiming had no choice but to sit down on the sofa first. Having not stepped foot into Jinyuan Estate for several years, he felt somewhat awkward and stiff.

"What do you want to drink?"

Song Qiming was just about to wave his hand and say no need, when he belatedly realized—wasn't this his home too?

This kid was treating him like a guest?

The man's face turned livid.

However, because the living room lights weren't turned on, zero people saw it.

Song Yu only turned on the light in the dining area and opened the refrigerator to grab a bottle of water. But the moment his hand touched a bottle, he hesitated...

Peach sparkling water—the bird liked to drink that.

3-in-1 Fruit and Vegetable juice—the bird liked that.

Peach Oolong tea—the bird liked that too.

"..."

Song Yu thought for a moment, finally grabbed a plain bottle of mineral water from the corner, and shut the refrigerator door.

He walked over to the sofa, politely placed the water on the coffee table, sat down on the opposite side at a considerable distance from Song Qiming, tilted his chin slightly, and said:

"I opened it for you."

Song Qiming initially felt a touch of gratification, but the youth's next sentence was:

"Apologize."

Song Qiming froze. What kind of tone was this to use with one's father?

However, remembering his purpose for coming, he suppressed his annoyance. No matter what, this was his biological son.

So he set the water down and said earnestly, preaching like a well-meaning parent:

"Dad might have neglected you a bit over these years, but when it comes to food and clothing, you never lacked anything, right?"

Song Qiming brought out his old lecturing routine once more, making forced analogies and talking in circles, but refusing to ever admit he was in the wrong.

The youth across from him listened for a while, then asked calmly:

"Are you finished?"

Song Qiming took a deep breath, leaned forward with his elbows resting on his knees, and tried once more to close the distance:

"Dad indeed fell short in some areas. Forgive Dad, alright?"

Song Yu sat opposite him. Positioned against the light, his face was cast in shadow, making his expression almost unreadable.

He was merely thinking.

How could someone change so fast? Arrogant and domineering during the day, yet putting on an act of deep fatherly affection by night?

It could only mean the paternity test results were out...

But that alone wasn't enough.

Song Yu lowered his eyelids in thought and suddenly realized—Li Changyun had once taunted him, claiming that Song Qiming had already undergone a vasectomy, and that all future inheritance would go to a more 'normal' child.

So that was why.

Right at that moment, the man spoke again:

"Xiao Yu, where is that bird of yours? Dad isn't lying to you—it's likely an evil entity."

"Pack your things now and come stay at a hotel with Dad."

Song Qiming posed completely as a good father. In truth, he just wanted to patch things up quickly so the Old Master wouldn't see this harmonious facade cracked upon returning from abroad.

Even if Song Zhengguo didn't beat him personally, he could easily order others to thrash him...

"You should go see a psychiatrist."

In the dimly lit living room, the youth opposite him said without batting an eye.

Song Qiming frowned and immediately shot back:

chunks.chineseText:
“不可能错，爸爸就是看到了，绝对没错。”

“也许是幻觉。”

宋启明闻言直接摆手，反复地申明：

“不可能，爸爸是年纪大了，又不是眼睛瞎了。”

宋郁蹙了蹙眉，他没有想到这种人会这么坚定地相信自己，即使这明显是有违背常理的。

自负的另一面……是自信么？

他想了想，只能去实行B计划。

宋郁抬手把茶几上的水递了过去，似乎很是关心：

“你冷静一点，先喝口水。”

宋启明本来是有点烦躁的，但是抬眼一看，自己儿子给递水了。

心里又舒坦了。

总算是懂点事。

宋启明本来就挺口干舌燥的，仰头喝了一大半，刚抬手放下瓶子，对面就又道：

“你有没有想过，我有抑郁症，万一就是遗传你的呢？”

“你说的情况无非是幻觉，我经历过很多次。再说了，当时你不是在熬夜么？”

宋郁面色平静，只是看着剩余瓶子里的水，思考着药量到底够不够。

“胡说八道！”

宋启明眉头拧得更深了，但他不由自主地回忆了下那天的事，光怪陆离，鸟在开电视……

“那录像呢？至少要有证据，不要在我这里发疯。”

宋郁试探了下。

宋启明莫名觉得头有点晕，抬手拍了拍额头，他本来就很疲惫，眼下这种感觉更重了，但还是回答了：

“哎，那就保存七天，没有了……”

宋郁放下心来。

这样就好办得多。

只要归结为“幻觉”就可以了，用足量的安眠药让他睡过去，以此来证明“晕厥”。

大概拉扯了十几分钟。

药效上来了。

宋郁在旁边时不时地说上几句：

“现在什么社会了，怎么可能有妖鬼之类的东西？”

“是你压力太大出现幻觉了。”

“你是不是不知道自己生病了？”

“像幻觉幻听都是很正常的。”

“严重的躯体化甚至会无意识的晕倒。”

客厅特地没有开灯，为的就是让所有东西都看不清楚，并且光线昏暗也有利于助眠。

宋郁靠在沙发上，后面就没有再说了，因为宋启明看样子已经不太清醒了。

对方的手肘撑着膝盖骨，脸埋在手掌里，像是睡着了。

宋郁也不想应付下去了，起身就打算去楼上。

鸟还在等他。

但就在这时——

“不对！”

宋启明突然站了起来，对着空气说了这么一句话，神智都不太清明。

只是像喝了假酒一样，看向宋郁，开始摆手，道：

“小郁，爸爸不会有错的。”

“那、那绝对不正常……那鸟在哪里？”

“我我去一看就知道了。”

宋启明晃晃悠悠的，说完还摇了摇头，倒是真的上楼去了。

并且由于身高腿长，他几乎没花费多长时间就到了二楼。

宋郁其实愣了一会。

因为他放了两倍的安眠药。

这都药不晕？

宋启明前进的路上遭到了阻碍，但他意识不清，以为是儿子来抱他，甚至反手搭肩过去了。

哽咽道：

“今天爸爸是真的伤心啊……”

“那个贱女人。”

宋郁觉得神经病，他一把给推开了，脑子也乱糟糟的。

也就在这时。

卧室门开了。

宋启明本来正哭诉着，看到动静抬头一看。

巨大的鸟在门口站着，居高临下。

宋启明愣住了。

下一秒，这东西开始口吐人言：

“听说你老婆跟人跑了？”

宋启明本来就意识不清，大脑混混沌沌的，耳边的声音像是开了混响。

听听听说你老婆跟人跑了了……

你你老婆跟人跑了……

婆跟人跑跑了……

三D环绕立体音效，直击心灵。

宋启明吓得不轻，冷汗直流，第一反应是拉着宋郁去挡。

还扯得是那个受伤的手腕。

白粼粼：？

怒气值上升99%。

鸟一个挥翅膀——

啪唧。

宋启明直接被掀飞了两米远，撞到了二楼的栏杆处，物理晕过去了。

一个平A而已了。

哼哼。

-

等到把宋启明搬到客房之后，已经是晚上十点钟了。

宋郁拍了拍手，觉得剩下的事应该没问题了，于是就回了卧室。

处理另外一件事。

“这不能变小么？”

宋郁看着房间里坍塌的书桌、碎掉的地板还有角落里被压扁的“纸巾盒”……

倒不是嫌乱，只是担心一个问题：

他的小鸟怎么睡觉？

白粼粼此刻正站在人的身后，犹如一堵墙，很诚恳地道：

“不会这个。”

“那会什么？”

“说话。”

“……”

鸟收了收翅膀，不愿意承认自己作为一个妖怪，只能变大一号的惨淡事实。

宋郁想了想，只是道：

“没事的，粼粼应该可以修炼的吧？”

“你试试。”

白粼粼也想起来了，那种什么文艺作品里常出现的桥段，吸收天地灵气。

鸟点了点头。

闭眼。

感受。

“……也不会。”

事情棘手了起来。

一人一鸟有些愁。

直到白粼粼伸了伸翅根，鸟眼圆圆，很是着急地往书桌那里走。

左右摇摆。

像个企鹅。

鸟在坍塌的书桌里翻了翻，叼出来一张灰扑扑的信封。

宋郁愣了下，这是什么？

白粼粼这才把下午的事原原本本地说了出来。

不过鸟还是有私心的，没有把上辈子是人的事说出来。

咳咳。

被卡车撞死实在是不太体面。

宋郁蹙了蹙眉，他看了看那个信封，暗红色的纸，金纹像是在流动。

上面有个编号：247。

“所以你看完信就变大了？”

“嗯嗯。”

宋郁从头到尾都是和鸟一起站着的，没有坐下，只是很认真地分析：

“那大概就是信鸽说的那样，它想要帮助你化形。”

宋郁边说边习惯性地侧头，但是这个时候鸟不在肩头。

视野里一片白茫茫……

蓝羽和尚的整体颜色是渐变的，胸前正好是白色，或者说是夹杂着点灰。

鸟不知道是变大的缘故还是怎么，颜色更分明了，干干净净，一尘不染。

像是变“新”了。

“可是我没有变人……”

鸟有些沮丧。

宋郁这才回了回神，收会了自己的目光，但是还是不由自主想起来之前的触感。

很舒服。

毛绒绒的。

他闭了闭眼，努力克制住自己不去想，只是又问：

“那还记得信的内容么？”

白粼粼本来是想说不知道的，但此刻脑海里却像是突然成像了一样，那些漂浮着的文字开始排列组合，分明不认识，但却好像自动知道了意思。

“……请及时前往南市遂安区槐河路24号报道，务必携带中央下发的‘通行证’，开展融入人类社会培训……”

白粼粼说完之后愣住了，这都是什么？

宋郁蹙了蹙眉，又问：

“有说时间吗？”

白粼粼回想了下，发现好像没有，摇了摇头。

“落款是什么？”
chunks.englishText:
"There's no way I'm wrong! Dad saw it with his own eyes. Absolutely no mistake!"

"Perhaps it was a hallucination."

Hearing this, Song Qiming waved his hand vigorously and repeatedly declared:

"Impossible! Dad may be getting old, but I'm not blind."

Song Yu frowned. He hadn't expected someone like him to believe so firmly in his own perception, even when it clearly defied common sense.

The other side of conceit... is confidence?

He thought for a moment and realized he had to execute Plan B.

Song Yu raised his hand and passed the water on the coffee table over, appearing very concerned:

"Calm down a bit. Have a sip of water first."

Song Qiming was originally quite irritable, but looking up, he saw his son offering him water.

His mood brightened again.

Finally showing a bit of filial piety.

Song Qiming's mouth was indeed quite dry. He tilted his head back and gulped down more than half of it. Just as he set the bottle down, the youth across from him spoke again:

"Have you ever considered that since I have depression, what if I inherited it from you?"

"The situation you described is nothing more than a hallucination. I've experienced it many times. Besides, weren't you staying up late back then?"

Song Yu's face remained placid, but his eyes were fixed on the water left in the bottle, calculating whether the dosage was sufficient.

"Nonsense!"

Song Qiming's brow furrowed even deeper, yet he couldn't help recalling what happened that day—so bizarre, a bird turning on the TV...

"What about the footage then? You need evidence at least. Don't go crazy on me here."

Song Yu probed.

Song Qiming inexplicably felt a wave of dizziness. He raised a hand and patted his forehead. He was already exhausted, and now that feeling weighed even heavier, yet he still answered:

"Sigh, it's only saved for seven days, then it's gone..."

Song Yu felt relieved.

That made things much easier.

It would suffice to chalk it up as a "hallucination," using a sufficient dose of sleeping pills to knock him out and thus simulate a "fainting episode."

They went back and forth for about ten minutes.

The sedative kicked in.

Beside him, Song Yu chimed in every now and then:

"What era are we living in? How could there be monsters or ghosts?"

"You're under too much stress and experiencing hallucinations."

"Do you not realize you're sick?"

"Things like visual and auditory hallucinations are perfectly normal."

"Severe somatization can even cause unconscious fainting spells."

The living room lights had been intentionally left off so that everything remained obscure, and the dim light also served to promote sleep.

Song Yu leaned back against the sofa and stopped talking, as Song Qiming appeared to be barely conscious.

The man rested his elbows on his knees, burying his face in his hands as if asleep.

Song Yu didn't want to deal with him any longer. He stood up, intending to go upstairs.

The bird was still waiting for him.

Just then—

"Not right!"

Song Qiming suddenly stood up and slurred out those words to the empty air, his consciousness thoroughly blurred.

Like someone drunk on cheap liquor, he stumbled as he looked at Song Yu, waving his hand, and stammered:

"Xiao Yu, Dad can't be wrong."

"That... that is definitely abnormal... Where is that bird?"

"I—I'll go take a look and I'll know."

Staggering unsteadily, Song Qiming shook his head after speaking and actually began trudging upstairs.

Thanks to his tall stature and long legs, he reached the second floor in almost no time.

Song Yu was actually stunned for a moment.

He had put a double dose of sleeping pills in that water.

Even that couldn't knock him out?

Song Qiming encountered an obstacle on his path, but in his delirious state, he thought his son was coming to hug him. He even slung an arm over Song Yu's shoulder.

Choking up, he wept:

"Dad was truly heartbroken today..."

"That cheap woman..."

Song Yu thought he was out of his mind. He shoved him away, his mind feeling chaotic as well.

Right at that moment.

The bedroom door swung open.

Song Qiming was in the middle of weeping and complaining when he raised his head at the sound.

A colossal bird stood at the doorway, looming over him from above.

Song Qiming froze.

In the next second, the creature began to speak in human tongue:

"I heard your wife ran off with someone else?"

Song Qiming was already barely conscious, his brain muddled and groggy. The voice echoing in his ears sounded like it had a heavy reverb filter applied.

*I—I—I heard your wife ran off with someone else...*

*Your—your wife ran off...*

*...wife ran off...*

A 3D surround-sound effect that struck directly at his soul.

Scared out of his wits, Song Qiming broke into a cold sweat. His first instinct was to grab Song Yu as a shield.

And he happened to yank right on the injured wrist.

Bai Linlin: ?

Rage bar soared by 99%.

With a single sweep of the bird's wing—

*THWACK.*

Song Qiming was sent flying two meters away, slamming straight into the second-floor railing before suffering a physical blackout.

It was just a basic attack.

*Hmph.*

-

By the time they hauled Song Qiming into the guest room, it was already ten o'clock at night.

Song Yu dusted off his hands, feeling that the rest of the situation was under control, so he headed back into the bedroom.

Time to deal with another matter.

"Can't you shrink back down?"

Song Yu looked at the collapsed desk, the cracked floorboards, and the squashed "tissue box" in the corner of the room...

He wasn't complaining about the mess, but rather worrying about one problem:

How was his little bird going to sleep?

Bai Linlin was currently standing behind him like a wall, answering with complete sincerity:

"Don't know how."

"Then what can you do?"

"Talk."

"..."

The bird tucked in its wings, unwilling to admit the dismal reality that, as a spirit monster, its only ability was to turn into a larger version of itself.

Song Yu thought for a moment and simply said:

"It's alright. You should be able to cultivate, right, Linlin?"

"Give it a try."

Bai Linlin remembered as well—the cliché trope common in fiction about absorbing the spiritual energy of heaven and earth.

The bird nodded.

Closed its eyes.

Sensed its surroundings.

"...Don't know how to do that either."

Things were getting tricky.

The human and the bird both felt troubled.

Until Bai Linlin stretched its wing joints, its round eyes widening as it waddled urgently toward the collapsed desk.

Waddling side to side.

Like a penguin.

The bird rummaged through the collapsed desk and pulled out a dusty envelope in its beak.

Song Yu was stunned for a moment. What was this?

Only then did Bai Linlin recount the afternoon's events in full detail.

However, the bird still had its own selfish reservation and didn't mention having been a human in its past life.

*Ahem.*

Getting hit and killed by a truck was really not very dignified.

Song Yu frowned. He examined the envelope—it was made of dark red paper with golden patterns that seemed to flow across it like liquid.

On it was a serial number: 247.

"So you grew big right after reading the letter?"

"Mm-hmm."

Song Yu had been standing with the bird the entire time without sitting down. He analyzed seriously:

"Then it's probably just as the carrier pigeon said—it wants to help you assume human form."

As Song Yu spoke, he habitually tilted his head to the side, but the bird was no longer perched on his shoulder.

His field of vision was filled with a vast expanse of white...

The overall color of the Blue-Feathered Monk parakeet was a gradient; its chest happened to be white, or rather, white mixed with a touch of gray.

Whether due to its enlarged size or something else, the colors on the bird were even more distinct—immaculately clean and spotless.

It was as if it had been renewed.

"But I didn't turn human..."

The bird felt a bit crestfallen.

Only then did Song Yu snap back to reality and pull back his gaze, though he couldn't help recalling the tactile feeling from earlier.

It felt very pleasant.

Fluffy and soft.

He closed his eyes, trying hard to restrain his thoughts, and simply asked again:

"Then do you remember the contents of the letter?"

Bai Linlin was originally going to say no, but at that moment, an image suddenly formed in its mind. The floating words rearranged themselves into sentences; though they were unfamiliar characters, its mind automatically understood their meaning.

"...Please report to No. 24 Huaihe Road, Sui'an District, Nanshi City in a timely manner. Be sure to bring the 'Pass' issued by the Central Authorities to undergo training for integration into human society..."

Bai Linlin froze after speaking. What on earth was all this?

Song Yu frowned and asked again:

"Did it specify a time?"

Bai Linlin thought back, realized there didn't seem to be one, and shook its head.

"What was the sign-off?"

chunks.chineseText:
鸟的脑海里浮现出一串烫金的大字。

——妖怪管理局。

-

此刻已经午夜了。

宋郁想了想，还是决定一切事情明天再说，也不知道这封信是好是坏。

他点了外卖。

祥云楼的外送服务，十个菜，糖醋排骨、四喜丸子、肉羹汤、紫薯糕、清炒芸豆、凉拌晶丝……

总之琳琅满目。

宋郁其实还是犹豫了下，买了点五谷杂粮，一共五斤。

进可攻，退可守。

只是变大一号。

一样养。

但是鸟似乎还心心念念着那袋子松子，仍然伸了伸爪子，像是不知道自己变大了。

递给人。

要剥。

白粼粼其实还是有点形象包袱的，他也不知道自己什么时候恢复，他的羽毛蓬蓬的。

万一吃酒楼饭菜沾上油了？

不好不好。

鸟要完美形态。

宋郁也不打算去床上休息，只是把被子铺到了地上，让他的小鸟有软的地方可站。

“困吗？”

鸟圆圆的眼睛眨了眨，翅根微微拢起个弧度，羽毛开始以直观地速度变蓬松。

爪子收了收，直接进入休息状态，成为一个巨大的毛球。

宋郁就坐在旁边，衬衫起了褶皱，袖子也是挽着的，但丝毫没有颓废的样子。

他很年轻。

宋郁靠着墙，优越的脸在暖色的灯光下显得轮廓分明，有力的小臂搭在屈起的膝盖。

漫不经心，但又相当细致地在剥松子。

旁边还有一个奶糖空罐子，里头全是白白净净的果仁。

慢慢地堆成了小山。

翌日清晨。

外头的雨早就停了，窗户外面树木翠绿，生机盎然。

卧室里其实还是杂乱无章，但是在一侧的角落里……

一人一鸟睡得安稳。

相互倚靠。

少年的脸颊上还有一缕小小的羽毛，宋郁醒过来的时候才发现自己身上盖着翅膀。

很暖和。

宋郁低头一看，发现罐子里的果仁吃得干干净净。

与此同时脚边多了一袋子核桃。

“……”

宋郁动作很轻地起身了，回头看了下还在睡的小鸟。

它很大。

但还是他的小鸟。

宋郁弯腰靠过去，轻轻地贴了贴小鸟的脑袋。

是妖怪就好了。

福寿绵长。

平平安安。

-

宋启明醒过来的时候正躺在客房上，整个人都在急促的呼吸。

他几乎做了一夜的噩梦。

全是那只巨鸟！

要么是被啄眼睛，要么是被叨得没一块好肉……

宋启明从床上坐起来，抬手就是捂住了自己的脸，上下捋了下。

很恍惚。

不行，不行，得赶紧走。

但是正当他打开客房门的时候，发现外面一切如常，宋郁在餐厅吃早饭。

看到人出来了，还问了句：

“爸，你醒了？”

“吃饭么？”

宋启明疑神疑鬼的，走到自己儿子面前，问了句：

“那只大鸟呢？”

“在你卧室？”

宋郁面色困惑，只是不解地问：

“你在说什么？”

宋启明比划了下，甚至还有点心悸，回看了下楼上。

但那里一切如常，甚至拐角的绿植都还在原位置。

“不、不是有个大鸟？它把我扇飞了。”

宋启明自己说出来都愣住了，这太离谱了，任谁听都是不信的。

他也觉得很奇怪。

不由自主地看向楼上——

再去看一次？

宋郁在椅子上坐着，其实想好了对策，如果宋启明再去卧室一次。

那就再扇晕一次。

循环往复。

他就不信他不怀疑自己。

“爸爸昨天怎么睡着的？”

宋启明最终还是坐在了餐桌对面，抬手按了按眉心，开口询问道。

“你和我说着说着就开始用手撑着脸，好像很疲惫，过了会就睡着了。”

宋郁很平静地道。

“我怎么觉得——”

宋郁直接抬眸看过去，面色冷淡，其实还有几分嫌弃。

宋启明一下子有些不愉，这不就是把他当成神经病？

可是。

他拧了拧眉，还是觉得奇怪，为什么自己做了个被巨鸟扇飞的梦？

“不行，小郁，我还是得看看——”

就在这时。

楼上传来了一阵“啾啾啾”的声音。

门缝被挤开，一只圆滚滚的小鸟扑棱翅膀飞了下来，稳稳地站在了宋郁的肩膀上。

鸟头歪了歪。

宋郁其实有点意外，但面色还是维持住了镇定，只是抬眸看向了宋启明，冷声道：

“你看到了？”

“我不明白你到底想做什么？”

“先是说些无厘头的话，说我的小鸟会开电视喝奶茶……你是疯了么？”

“现在又要怎么样，控诉我的小鸟打你？它还没有一个保温杯大。”

一条条控诉砸了过来，宋启明也恍惚了，觉得自己脑子可能真出问题了。

他看了看宋郁肩头的那只鸟。

确实很普通。

“啾啾？”

宋启明摆了摆手，深吸一口气，此刻硬是没忘了主线任务，只是对宋郁道：

“好好好，不要生爸爸的气。”

“我现在就走。”

说完，宋启明就真的离开了，只是边走边喃喃自语：
