Chapter 27 (Part 1)

It was already past twelve noon when they arrived home. Full and satisfied, the bird perched on the bedroom desk, flipping through his little red booklet.

Bai Linlin pressed a claw against the page to carefully inspect their photo. His bird head looked a bit too big, honestly—if only it could be Photoshopped a little.

Most of the photo captured their upper bodies: the young man on the left, the bird on the right.

One had a faint flush on his face, while the other had pulled his wings tight against his body.

Stamped below was an official seal:

*Nanshi Bureau of Demon Management.*

Bai Linlin was still quite pleased. After all, the human he chose was clearly the handsomest of them all—the other little demons had looked at him with literal sparkles in their eyes.

The bird lifted his chin slightly, puffing up with pride.

With a swipe of his claw, the red booklet snapped shut.

Holding the certificate in his beak, the bird hopped off the desk and waddled pitter-patter toward the doorway. Faint sounds of running water occasionally drifted out from the bathroom; Song Yu had gone to shower as soon as they got back.

The bird stole a quick glance at the bathroom door, then continued carrying his booklet forward.

*Time to store this away properly.*

Bai Linlin felt utterly blissful. This sprawling villa, this handsome human, those delicious taro paste cakes... his bird life was truly complete!

The bird nudged his beak through the gap in the door, squeezed out of the bedroom, and waddled onward until he paused, tilting his head up to look at the door of his own room.

Flapping his wings, he flew up onto the doorknob.

-

Song Yu emerged from the bathroom after changing into fresh clothes, only to find the desk empty. Frowning, he called out, "Linlin?"

The bedroom was silent; the bird wasn't there. Song Yu glanced around, not even waiting to dry his hair before heading out to look for him.

Fortunately, the clues were obvious: the door to the adjacent room was slightly ajar. He pushed it open.

Inside, the bird was holding his certificate in his beak, pacing back and forth as he pondered which acrylic display box to put it in, admiring his growing "collection."

There was his little gold lock.

There were electronic devices.

And a whole assortment of bird nests, tiny outfits, and small toys.

Belatedly realizing his human had arrived, Bai Linlin flapped his wings and flew over, landing firmly on Song Yu’s shoulder.

Having an official certificate was pretty great after all.

Now Song Yu couldn't raise any other birds!

Bai Linlin was already daydreaming about installing a new door at home in the future—one with a claw-print scanner. Yes, and facial recognition for birds, too.

That would be perfect.

"You want to put it away?" With damp hair clinging to his temples, Song Yu turned his head and asked in a gentle voice.

The bird offered the booklet over.

Song Yu reached out to take it. As he looked down at it, a faint flush crept across his face once more.

Still, the photo had turned out very well.

The bird looked huge and fluffy.

Song Yu lightly brushed his finger against the bird in the picture, his lips curving into a subtle smile.

"You want to keep it in these cabinets?"

"Might not be secure enough."

Saying that, Song Yu carried the bird up to the third floor and retrieved a safe from the storage room.

The house held quite a few items.

Right in front of the bird, Song Yu entered the passcode, unlocked the safe, and pulled out several shiny gold bars.

The bird: *!!*

Song Yu didn't actually know how long those had been sitting there. His grandmother had bought them when he was very young, and he barely remembered them. He simply set the gold bars down on the desk.

The little bird on his shoulder immediately scrambled down, planting his claws right on top of the gold bars while shooting a wary glance toward the second-floor window.

"How about giving this safe to you?"

Sitting in the chair, Song Yu looked down at the registration certificate and asked warmly.

"Chirp, chirp!"

*(OK!)*

Bai Linlin craned his neck to watch as the human placed the booklet inside. Just as Song Yu was about to close the safe, he hesitated for a moment and decided to change the code:

"20250417."

"Can you remember that?"

Bai Linlin froze for a second before realizing what the date meant—it was the day he had first arrived at this home. He promptly nodded his bird head.

With the certificate safely stored away, Song Yu carried the safe into the bird's room. As for the original gold bars, he found a hidden compartment drawer and tucked them inside instead.

After all, his bird loved gold.

Next came the "metal" ring, which was currently hanging around the bird's neck, having shrunken down considerably.

Song Yu set the bird on the floor, crouched down, and frowned with concern. "Does your neck hurt?"

Bai Linlin thought for a moment and replied candidly, "Doesn't really feel like anything..."

"So you still can't control your size?"

They had actually asked about this at the bureau. The Doberman demon had mentioned that demons indeed possessed the ability to expand their size, though he found the issue rather bizarre.

In truth, Song Yu was still holding out a bit of hope. His little bird wasn't stupid; he should be able to get the hang of it.

"Want to give it a try?" the youth asked again.

The bird stood on the floor, craning his head to look up at him, the shape-stabilizing metal ring still hanging around his neck. He pulled his claws close together, feeling rather uncertain himself.

Song Yu crouched low and used a finger to hook off the tiny "necklace." Yet the moment it came off—

Nothing happened.

Bai Linlin was somewhat surprised as well. He stretched the roots of his wings, spun around on the floor, and looked up again.

"Looks like it's fine—"

Before Song Yu could finish his sentence, *POOF!* The bird suddenly blew up into a majestic, towering giant once more, instantly cracking a floor tile beneath his feet.

The human stared up at the bird.

"..."

"..."

Song Yu didn't really understand whether an F-rank demon power was considered high or low. What if—just what if—the scale went all the way down to Z-rank?

That would make his bird somewhere in the upper-middle tier!

Not wanting to stress the bird out too much, Song Yu stood up and consoled him: "It's alright. Didn't they mention an allowance? You just need to complete one mission to get it, and by then you'll probably learn how to control it."

The bird was thoroughly unresigned.

He attempted with all his might to exert control...

After all, most of the "missions" at the bureau were taken by guardianless demons seeking human currency; only a tiny fraction were done to claim demonic power stipends... because normal demons could already shapeshift!

*!*

Bai Linlin had zero intention of going to work every single day! He had suffered enough from wage-slavery in his past life! He was a little bird now! A little bird who owned his very own iPhone!

The bird grew furious.

He began channeling his strength.

Standing across from him, Song Yu's expression gradually turned to sheer bewilderment, because the giant bird before him was currently... shrinking step by step.

And he was doing it with his eyes squeezed tightly shut.

It gave off a strong *Angry Birds* vibe.

Song Yu couldn't hold back a soft chuckle—a sound the bird caught immediately. The second he shrunk back to normal, he hopped onto the youth's pant leg and started snapping viciously at the thin air around him.

"Sorry, sorry."

Song Yu apologized quickly, crouching down to scoop the bird up into his hands.

Puffed up with anger, Bai Linlin tucked in his wing roots and forcefully spun his body sideways, presenting nothing but a plump, round back.

"So you've learned how to do it. That's wonderful."

Song Yu turned the bird back around with his hands. He was about to ask more, but the moment the bird's claws touched down, he whipped around again like a spring-loaded chicken toy.

"..."

So the human picked him up again and set him straight.

The bird snapped his head away again.

The corners of Song Yu's lips twitched upward into a faint smile as he repeated the motion, turning the bird around once more.

The bird turned away again.

After several rounds of this loop:

The bird: "..."

Fuming with indignation, Bai Linlin opened his beak to bite him, but unexpectedly caught hold of something this time—the human's soft, tender fingertip.

Tug.

*Huh?*

Tug again.

"Not angry anymore?"

Song Yu looked down at the little bird in his palm, letting him nibble on his finger with complete focus.

The bird nibbled intently without so much as raising his head, leaving only a round, fluffy crown on display.

Song Yu had never seen a little bird with so much personality before and couldn't help muttering, "Linlin seems just like a human."

At those words, the bird's entire body shuddered!

Bai Linlin instantly froze, standing at attention in extreme guilt. He coughed inwardly, tucked his wings tightly against his body, and articulated with absolute rigor:

"I am a little bird."

*Little birds don't go to school! Little birds don't work jobs! Little birds don't wake up early! Little birds don't have to pretend to be adults!*

Bai Linlin flapped his wings, waddled around on the floor for a few laps, and then turned his head back with utmost gravity to reply:

"Will you keep raising me forever?"

Song Yu frowned slightly, unsure why he was asking such a question, and simply asked, "Are you planning to pick a different guardian?"

The bird: "..."

*Did he mean it like THAT?!*

chunks.chineseText:
白粼粼往前伸爪子走了几步，刚想仰头解释，但下一秒——

“不可以。”

“我们领过证了。”

空气一阵安静。

宋郁反应过来自己说了什么也愣了下，总之是有点奇怪，他蹙了蹙眉，但又不想解释。

鸟宛若个发条鸟。

不动了。

宋郁刚想要抬手把鸟拿起来，可是就在这时，空气中传来点羽毛磨擦的动静，几乎没过几秒钟……

一只巨大的鸟又站在对面了。

“……”

少年愣了下，刚想要问问怎么了，但鸟已经转了身子，靠着墙去面壁了。

-

后来得出结论，情绪激动也会控制不好，白粼粼最后还是认认真真地戴上那个“金属”环了。

不过还是很害羞。

说得什么话！

鸟的清白都没有了！

不过下午还是要出去，白粼粼站在宋郁肩头看了看玄关的置物架，那里都是一些出行的OOTD的单品和套装。

“因为医院的变数比较大，不确定是否还在重症监护室，我们先去探探位置。”

宋郁侧眸同鸟解释了下，其实这一天是有点劳顿的，上午才从槐河路回来，中午也就休息了一个多小时。

但是这么变大变小恐怕对它不好，还是尽快解决掉为好，只要妖力足够化形就可以了。

及格，就可以。

宋郁是个很开明的监护人。

白粼粼闻言点了点头，他觉得也是，早完成早下班，不过他看了看置物架……

“啾啾啾！”

[要这个！]

宋郁抬眸看了过去，发现是一件蓝色格子披风。

但那个其实有点厚，里面有毛毛。

这是物业中午送过来的快递，刚挂上没多久。

宋郁还是劝了下，耐心道：

“那个会热，要不要换一个？帽子行么？”

“背带也可以。”

白粼粼闻言像是应激了一样，他才不要穿情趣内衣！

好几个带子，还穿过鸟腿……

不要！

“啾啾啾啾啾。”

[不不不不。]

鸟又伸了伸爪子，就要那个蓝色的披风，没办法，宋郁只能给它扣上。

白粼粼有点喘不过气来，但还是去照了照镜子，蓝色正好和他的羽毛颜色一样，很搭得好不好？

披风是带帽子的。

有点像侠客。

宋郁抬眸看着镜子里的小鸟在他肩头转了个圈圈，眉眼温和。

算了。

热了再脱了。

-

最后是坐着车子出门的，鸟戴了脚环，在人的肩头上打哈欠。

空调特地打得很低，司机都在前面冷得直摸手臂，但是没办法，加了一百块。

这个温度刚好适合穿了厚披风的鸟。

大约三十分钟后，一人一鸟抵达南市第一人民医院。

宋郁下了车之后就把挎包拉链打开了，意思不言而喻。

鸟：“……”

“医院人流量大，万一有病毒传染了就不好了。”

“进来。”

白粼粼没有办法，只好扑棱了两下翅膀，他本来打算飞下去的，但是看了看这个高度……

开始伸鸟腿。

宋郁：“……”

白粼粼最后还是被放到挎包里了，黑乎乎的，圆滚滚的身体被两根修长的手指禁锢着。

鸟试图挣脱，但是发现人的手指伸到他的胸口了，开始叨叨叨。

但没有用。

黑漆漆的环境下有扣子解开的声音。

白粼粼被脱得干干净净，反应过来的时候身上已经没有披风了。

与此同时，鸟仰头一看，发现人的手正在往上抽，随之而来的是拉链的声音。

宋郁一边抬步往里走，一边单手拉挎包的额拉链，打算留个三指宽的扣子。

但就在走进大厅的时候，掌心突然被顶了下。

宋郁低头一看，包里探出来一颗圆滚滚的鸟头。

正在四处张望。

“……”

鸟被人用手指按下去了。

-

其实来医院也不仅仅只是为了找“乐乐”，还有另外一件事，宋郁想去看看阿姨和她的孩子。

已经提前联系过了，于是直接去的病房楼，顺带在医院的超市里买了些果篮和礼品。

“一共七百五十六。”

宋郁抬手把付款码递了过去，根本就没有关心多少钱，只是时刻用余光看自己的包。

期间还对视了下。

鸟在仰头看，鸟眼圆圆的，爪子似乎是劈了叉，一副蓄力的样子。

“……”

好在是提着东西找到了病房。

阿姨看到后很是高兴，眼眶都是含着热泪的，她甚至都忘了说自己孩子的近况，只是拉着宋郁的手给同病房的人介绍：

“这我带过的孩子，可优秀了，考的是南市的A大！”

病房里的人和陪护的家属都看了过来，也是一阵羡慕。

“多好一孩子啊。”

“真不错！”

“我家孩子要是能考上，那可是烧高香了。”

病房里热热闹闹的，都是祝贺的话，倒是比那个“升学宴”要真诚得多。

宋郁很温和地问，“弟弟怎么样？”

阿姨这才发现自己忘了最重要的事，拉着宋郁的手到了外边，一边擦泪一边道：

“做了手术的，在胸口开的刀……好在是很顺利，医生说在修养几天就能出院了。”

“小宋，阿姨不会忘了你的恩情的，一定会还你的救命钱的。”

白粼粼在包里待着，也想要出来，原来是先来找阿姨。

鸟也在！

鸟也在！

“没事的，孩子身体健康才是最重要的。”

“好，阿姨知道了，那小宋最近怎么样？不要不开心……”

正在交流的时候。

刺啦——

一颗毛绒绒的鸟头冒了出来。

刚想要打招呼。

但是被宋郁给扣住了，掌心拢着，挡得严严实实。

此刻正有人从电梯里出来，手里还提着给病号买的饭，过来的时候，还往这边看了一眼。

“我们病房又出院一个，真好啊。”

“就是说，医院这地方还是少来为好……”

“你家孩子怎么样了？”

有渐渐远去的交谈声音。

宋郁松了口气。

阿姨也有些意外，不过也是等到人走了才说话，垂眸看着少年虎口处探出来的一个肉色短喙，很是高兴地道：

“小鸟也来看我了？”

白粼粼不由得想要啾啾两声，但被人很及时地捏住了喙。

？

打断施法。

最后还是去了楼梯间，阿姨甚至还回了次病房，拿出来了旺仔小馒头。

白粼粼卡着鸟头在包里，很是专注地啃啃啃……

“是，叫粼粼。”

“它八个月了，是前段时间带去体检了。”

宋郁不厌其烦地和每个人介绍他的小鸟，眉眼温和，左手仍然是在围着鸟头，保持着半拢着的动作。

“真好……小鸟也很乖。”

阿姨也是很欣慰，又问了问宋郁最近身体怎么样。

鸟吃完了，闲着也是闲着，钻到包里一顿拱，最后终于顶着披风的帽子出来了。

歪歪的。

人，快看！

阿姨看到后又是一阵惊叹，连说了好几句“好看好看”、“小鸟穿什么都好看”。

不过最后还是蹙了蹙眉：

“这个天气穿有点热了。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 27 (Part 2)

Bai Linlin took a few steps forward with his claws, just about to tilt his head up to explain, when in the very next second—

"You can't."

"We're already registered."

Silence fell over the room.

Song Yu snapped back to reality and froze, realizing how strange his words sounded. He knitted his brows slightly, yet felt disinclined to offer an explanation.

The bird stood there like a wound-up toy bird, completely motionless.

Just as Song Yu reached out to pick him up, the rustle of feathers swished through the air. In a matter of seconds...

A gargantuan bird was once again standing opposite him.

"..."

The youth stared in surprise and was just about to ask what had happened, but the bird had already turned around and pressed himself against the wall to face it in absolute shame.

-

It was later concluded that emotional agitation also led to a loss of size control. In the end, Bai Linlin obediently put the "metal" ring back on.

He was still burning with embarrassment, though.

*What kind of phrasing was that?!*

*My birdly innocence is totally gone!*

Regardless, they still had to head out in the afternoon. Standing on Song Yu's shoulder, Bai Linlin glanced at the entryway storage rack, which held various stylish OOTD items and outfits for going out.

"Since things at the hospital can be unpredictable and we're not sure if he's still in the ICU, we'll go scout out the location first," Song Yu explained, turning his gaze toward the bird. It had been quite a tiring day; they had only returned from Huaihe Road this morning and had rested for barely an hour at noon.

However, shrinking and expanding unpredictably like this couldn't be good for the bird. It was better to resolve the issue as quickly as possible. As long as his demonic power reached the threshold required for human transformation, that would be enough.

A passing grade was all he needed.

Song Yu was a very open-minded guardian.

Bai Linlin nodded in agreement. He felt the same way—finish early, knock off early. But as he scanned the shelf...

"Chirp, chirp, chirp!"

*(I want this one!)*

Song Yu looked up and saw that the bird was pointing at a blue plaid cape.

However, it was actually quite thick, lined with plush fur inside.

It was a package delivered by property management at noon, hung up not long ago.

Song Yu tried to dissuade him, reasoning patiently, "That's going to be too hot. Want to pick something else? How about a hat?"

"A harness works too."

Hearing the word "harness," Bai Linlin reacted as if he'd been triggered. He refused to wear what looked like spicy bird lingerie!

All those straps crisscrossing around his bird legs...

No way!

"Chirp, chirp, chirp, chirp, chirp!"

*(No, no, no, no, no!)*

The bird extended his claw again, insisting on the blue cape. Having no choice, Song Yu buttoned it onto him.

Bai Linlin felt a bit smothered, but he still went to look in the mirror. The blue matched his feather color perfectly—couldn't be a better fit!

The cape came with a hood, giving him the sleek look of a martial arts hero.

Song Yu watched through the mirror as the little bird did a full spin on his shoulder, his eyes softening.

*Oh well.*

*If he gets too hot, I'll just take it off later.*

-

In the end, they left by hailing a car. The bird wore his leg band and yawned lazily on the youth's shoulder.

The air conditioning in the car was set extraordinarily low—so cold that the driver in the front seat kept rubbing his arms. But there was no helping it; Song Yu had tipped an extra hundred yuan.

This chilling temperature was just right for a bird wearing a thick plush cape.

Roughly thirty minutes later, the boy and the bird arrived at Nanshi First People's Hospital.

Upon stepping out of the car, Song Yu unzipped his shoulder bag, his intentions crystal clear.

The bird: "..."

"The hospital is crowded. It won't be good if you catch a virus or infection," Song Yu reasoned softly. "Get in."

Bai Linlin had no choice but to flap his wings twice. He had originally intended to fly down into it, but assessing the depth...

He began stretching out a long bird leg instead.

Song Yu: "..."

Ultimately, Bai Linlin was picked up and placed inside the cross-body bag. It was pitch-black inside, his plump, round body held gently in place by two long, slender fingers.

The bird tried to break free, but realized the human's fingers were slipping under his chest, so he started pecking repeatedly.

It was useless.

In the pitch darkness, the sound of buttons unsnapping echoed softly.

Before Bai Linlin could react, he was stripped clean, his cape gone.

At the same time, the bird looked up to see the human's hand drawing upward, accompanied by the zipping sound of the bag.

As Song Yu walked inside, he used one hand to zip up the bag, intending to leave a gap three fingers wide for ventilation.

However, right as he stepped into the main lobby, his palm was suddenly nudged from below.

Song Yu looked down to see a round bird head popping out from the bag, craning its neck to look around in curiosity.

"..."

The bird head was promptly pressed back down by a finger.

-

Coming to the hospital wasn't solely to find "Lele"—there was another matter as well. Song Yu wanted to visit his former nanny auntie and her child.

Having contacted her in advance, he headed straight for the inpatient building, stopping by the hospital supermarket along the way to pick up fruit baskets and gift sets.

"That will be seven hundred and fifty-six yuan total."

Song Yu showed his payment QR code without caring about the amount, his eyes constantly tracking his bag out of the corner of his eye.

At one point, their eyes met.

The bird was craning his neck upward, eyes round, claws seemingly stretched out into a split as if charging up power.

"..."

Fortunately, he found the ward while carrying the gifts.

When the aunt saw him, she was overcome with joy, her eyes welling with warm tears. She even forgot to share her child's condition at first, instead pulling Song Yu by the hand to introduce him to everyone in the room:

"This is the boy I used to care for! He's so exceptional—got accepted into Nanshi's A University!"

The other patients and family members in the room turned to look, murmuring in admiration.

"What a fine young man."

"Truly impressive!"

"If my kid could get into that school, I'd burn incense to thank the gods!"

The ward bustled with warm, hearty congratulations—immeasurably more genuine than that awkward "college acceptance banquet."

Song Yu asked gently, "How is my little brother doing?"

Only then did the aunt realize she had forgotten the main thing. Taking Song Yu's hand, she stepped outside into the hallway, wiping her tears as she said, "He had surgery—cut right into his chest... thankfully, it went smoothly. The doctor said he can be discharged after a few more days of rest."

"Little Song, Auntie will never forget your kindness. I will definitely pay back the lifesaving money you lent us."

Bai Linlin, tucked inside the bag, wanted to come out too. So they had come to see the auntie first!

*The bird is here too!*

*The bird is here too!*

"It's no problem at all," Song Yu said smoothly. "The child's health is what matters most."

"Right, Auntie understands. How have you been lately, Little Song? Don't be unhappy..."

As they spoke:

*Zip—*

A fluffy bird head popped right out.

He was just about to greet her—

—only to be swiftly cupped by Song Yu's hand, masked from view entirely.

Someone stepped out of the elevator holding takeout food for a patient, glancing toward them as they walked past.

"Another patient discharged from our ward today, that's great."

"Seriously, the less time spent in a hospital, the better..."

"How's your kid doing?"

Their voices faded into the distance.

Song Yu let out a soft sigh of relief.

The auntie was somewhat surprised, but waited until the passersby were gone before speaking. Looking down at the fleshy pink short beak poking out from between the youth's thumb and index finger, she beamed with delight.

"The little bird came to visit me too?"

Bai Linlin couldn't help wanting to chirp twice in response, but his beak was promptly pinched shut by his human.

*?*

*Casting interrupted!*

They eventually moved to the stairwell. The aunt even went back into the ward to grab a pack of Wang Zai mini mantou biscuits.

With his bird head poking through the top of the bag, Bai Linlin nibbled away with intense concentration—*munch, munch, munch...*

"Yes, his name is Linlin."

"He's eight months old. I took him for a checkup a while ago."

Song Yu patiently introduced his little bird, his expression gentle, while his left hand remained cupped loosely around the bird's head.

"That's wonderful... Such a well-behaved little bird."

The aunt felt deeply comforted and asked how Song Yu's health had been lately.

Having finished eating, the bird had nothing better to do, so he squirmed around inside the bag until he emerged, wearing the cape's hood over his head.

It was askew.

*Human, look!*

Seeing this, the aunt let out another gasp of admiration, repeating endlessly, "So handsome, so handsome! This little bird looks good in anything!"

Though in the end, she couldn't help knitting her brows slightly:

"Though it might be a bit too hot to wear that in this weather."

chunks.chineseText:
宋郁这才解释道：

“市面上没有卖鹦鹉夏天穿的小披风，这是冬天保温的，它今天觉得好看才穿的……”

“阿姨给做！”

宋郁很温和地笑了下，顺着话头说了下去：

“那您还愿意来家里工作吗？”

“还是我和小鸟，我聘您，不是我父亲。”

白粼粼后面也是热得发晕，展示完就把披风给弄下来了，仰头看着他们。

阿姨闻言一时半会不知道说什么，只是道：

“不行不行，孩子，我借了你的钱，我再来赚你的钱，这怎么行？”

宋郁垂眸想了想，又道：

“那没办法了，请的新阿姨都不喜欢小动物，我也做不好饭，只能天天点外卖了。”

阿姨闻言又心急：

“不行不行！”

“我给你送！”

少年抬眼看了过去，面色很是诚恳。

“小宋，你这样我是真的很过意不去……”

宋郁垂眸道：

“阿姨，我爷爷醒了他如果知道有这么一个照顾我的长辈也会高兴的，更何况您还对我的小鸟这么好。”

“我已经成年了，有家里分红的，完全付得起您的工资。”

阿姨一下子什么话都说不出来了。

-

鸟又获得了一瓣耙耙柑，在包里自顾自地吃，上面的人还在交谈，不过说到了正事。

“行，这个没问题，叫乐乐是吧，人民医院这里病区也就那么几个，我打听打听就知道了。”

阿姨一口应了下来，之后就是劝人赶紧回家去，医院不是什么好地方，人来人往的。

宋郁这才带着鸟出了医院，算是完成了两件事，道路旁边车水马龙，摆着几个摊子。

等到叫的车来的时候，人手上已经多了两个袋子。

凡是经过，片甲不留。

这个时间已经四五点了，司机估计是有些困乏，打了个哈欠，对后座问：

“去哪？”

“南心公园。”

-

与此同时公寓里。

那个孩童已经爬上了飘窗，抬手打开了窗户，对着外面的小鸟笑了下。

“一起玩。”

外面的伯劳鸟盯了这小孩一会儿，然后跳到了窗户边沿，看着地板上那些被剖了身体的同族。

它也就看了几秒，转而继续看这个孩子。

世界物竞天择，猎人捕猎，圈养牲畜……都是正常的。

未开智的动物之间也有食物链。

它一直都知道。

谁都想生存下去，这无可厚非，可是，为什么要虐杀？

恃强凌弱，很愉悦么？

年纪小就是为非作歹的挡箭牌了么？

圆圆的小鸟看着这孩子伸手过来抓，很轻巧地跳开了。

房门外有大人的声音。

“太太这样下去迟早会出事的，你看我的胳膊……”

“我睡着的时候被刀片划醒的，他已经按住我的脖子了。”

房内这孩子还在慢慢地跟着鸟，手里更是紧紧地攥着工笔刀，有点兴奋的感觉了。

001站定不动，盯着这个满脸黑血的孩子。

管理局守则：

1、为促进人妖和谐相处，灰色任务惩罚力度应该适中，不宜引起人类社会的舆论。

2、一切行动应当优先保证自身安全。

……

那男童抬手就抓住了闯入的小鸟，拿着工笔刀就打算往眼珠子上剜开，从这里可以把躯干弄开。

动物的脑子他知道了……那人的呢？

男童又兴奋了起来，开始粗喘着气，一声不吭的，甚至停了下动作，回头看了看门口。

像是也知道外面有大人。

不过就在他回头的时候——

眼前一片漆黑。

随即就是刺痛。

“啊啊！”

……

夜晚的黄昏很好，南心公园中央已经有了娱乐活动。

一只黑棕白相交的小鸟飞到了不远处的树杈子上，熟练地把叼来的东西叉在一旁的凸起来的木棍上。

两个。

像糖葫芦。

001本来是准备吃了算了的，但是又觉得反胃。

“……”

公园里已经热闹了起来，它扑棱翅膀飞到了另外一棵树上，本来是想看看下面的人在干什么。

结果看到了一个摄像机。

“……”

001出于礼貌没有动。

那老大爷高兴极了，一脸认真地同旁边的观鸟搭子介绍道：

“你看看，这可是伯劳鸟，凶残着呢。”

“有这么厉害？”

老大爷摆摆手，觉得说不通，但刚想举起来摄像机再拍一张的时候，却在树杈子上找不到了鸟的身影。

与此同时，公园一个监控死角处，出来了一身黑的少年，个子不高，约莫就一米七出头。

“他”在很认真地数自己的钱，手指夹着一个破破的布包，闷闷地自言自语：

“五块、十块、二十……”

001觉得很伤心，它又在月底花完了自己的工资，就剩下这点了。

它想吃烧烤。

要吃羊肉、牛肉、大茄子……

还有猪腰子。

黑衣少年很是郁闷，揣着自己的钱四处张望，烧烤摊子这个点应该开了。

001四处张望了下，看到了具体的位置就过去了，一路上反反复复地劝说自己。

就吃十块钱的。

明天再吃十块钱的。

撑到下个月！

但是走到摊子口的时候——

“你来啦？不太巧噢，有个人全买走了，明天来吧。”

老板已经在收摊了。

001震惊。

是谁！

就在这时老板还指了指方向：“真的，要有我肯定给你留着，但那年轻人全买走了，他还带着只鸟，那叫一个吵，啾啾啾不知道在说啥。”

001攥着自己那几张钞票，懵懵地看着不远处的人。

它的串串……

-

宋郁在公园人行道上走着，见周遭没有什么人，才温声劝道：

“不能吃太多了，管理局那边不是说了，会导致气息混浊，对你化形也不是很有助益。”

鸟不服：

“它们都排队吃小蛋糕！”

“……”

监护人：“人家化形了。”

鸟圆滚滚的脑袋一撇，思考了下，反驳道：

“我会变大”

“……”

宋郁正有一搭没一搭和自己肩头的小鸟辩论的时候，余光突然注意到旁边的公共座椅把手上蹲着个黑衣少年。

像是画面断了帧，下一秒突然出现的。

宋郁不由得停了脚步，侧头看了过去。
chunks.englishText:
Song Yu then explained:

"There aren't any tiny summer capes for parrots on the market. This is meant for winter warmth, but he thought it looked pretty today, so he insisted on wearing it..."

"Auntie will make one for him!"

Song Yu smiled very gently and followed her lead:

"Then would you still be willing to come work at our house?"

"It's still just me and the little bird. I'm hiring you, not my father."

Bai Linlin was dizzy from the heat later on; once he finished showing off, he pulled the cape off and looked up at them.

Hearing this, the aunt didn't know what to say for a moment, only managing:

"No, no, child. I borrowed your money; how could I take your money as salary again? That won't do!"

Song Yu lowered his eyes in thought, then added:

"Then there's no other way. Any new housekeeper I hire won't like small animals, and I can't cook well either, so I'll just have to order takeout every day."

Hearing this, the aunt panicked again:

"No, no!"

"I'll bring food for you!"

The youth looked up, his expression thoroughly sincere.

"Little Song, if you do this, I'll really feel too guilty..."

Song Yu lowered his eyes and said:

"Auntie, when my grandfather wakes up and learns there's an elder like you looking after me, he'll be happy too. Besides, you're so good to my little bird."

"I'm already an adult, and I receive dividends from the family estate. I can fully afford your salary."

The aunt was instantly left speechless.

-

The bird had obtained another segment of a Baba mandarin orange and was happily eating inside the bag. The people above were still talking, but they had moved on to serious business.

"Alright, no problem. His name is Lele, right? There are only a few ward areas in the People's Hospital. I'll ask around and find out in no time."

The aunt readily agreed, and then urged him to hurry home, saying the hospital wasn't a good place with so many people coming and going.

Only then did Song Yu carry the bird out of the hospital, having accomplished two tasks. Traffic bustled along the roadside, flanked by several street stalls.

By the time the ride he called arrived, he already held two extra bags in his hands.

Wherever he passed, not a single stall was spared.

It was already four or five in the afternoon. The driver was likely a bit drowsy and let out a yawn, asking the back seat:

"Where to?"

"Nanxin Park."

-

Meanwhile, in the apartment.

The young boy had climbed onto the bay window, raised his hand to open it, and smiled at the little bird outside.

"Let me play with you."

Outside, the shrike stared at the child for a moment, then hopped onto the window ledge, looking at its slaughtered kin lying on the floor inside, their bodies opened up.

It only looked for a few seconds before returning its gaze to the child.

In the natural world, natural selection ruled—predators hunted, livestock was kept captive... It was all normal.

Even among unawakened animals, there was a food chain.

It had always known this.

Everyone wanted to survive, and there was nothing wrong with that. But why torture and slaughter?

Was it truly so exhilarating to bully the weak relying on brute strength?

Was being young an absolute shield for committing evil?

The round little bird watched as the child reached out to grab it, lightly hopping out of reach.

Voices of adults came from outside the room.

"If Madam goes on like this, something terrible will happen sooner or later. Look at my arm..."

"I was woken up by a razor blade slicing into me while I was asleep. He was already pressing down on my neck!"

Inside the room, the child was still slowly trailing the bird, a utility knife gripped tightly in his hand, a hint of excitement surfacing in his expression.

001 stood still, staring at the child whose face seemed bathed in dark blood.

Bureau Guidelines:

1. To promote harmonious coexistence between humans and demons, punishment severity for grey-zone missions should be moderate and avoid provoking public outcry in human society.

2. All actions must prioritize personal safety.

...

The boy reached out and snatched the intruding little bird, raising the utility knife with the intent to gouge out its eyes—from there, he could slice open the torso.

He already knew what an animal's brain looked like... What about a human's?

The boy grew excited again, breathing heavily and silently. He even paused his movements and glanced back at the door.

It seemed he knew there were adults outside.

However, just as he turned his head—

Pitch blackness consumed his vision.

Followed by a searing, excruciating pain.

"Aaaagh!"

...

The evening twilight was lovely, and recreational activities were already underway in the center of Nanxin Park.

A small bird with a mix of black, brown, and white feathers flew onto a nearby tree branch, expertly skewering the items in its beak onto a protruding stick nearby.

Two of them.

Like candied hawthorns on a stick.

001 had originally intended to just eat them, but felt nauseated by the thought.

"..."

The park was lively now. Flapping its wings, it flew to another tree, intending to see what the people below were doing.

Instead, it spotted a camera.

"..."

Out of politeness, 001 did not move.

The old man was overjoyed, earnestly introducing the bird to his bird-watching buddy beside him:

"Look at that! That's a shrike—fierce little things, they are."

"They're really that formidable?"

The old man waved his hand, feeling it was hard to explain. But just as he raised his camera to take another shot, the bird's silhouette was gone from the branch.

At the same time, in a camera blind spot within the park, a youth clad entirely in black emerged. He wasn't very tall, just barely over 170 centimeters.

"He" was earnestly counting his money, a worn cloth bag pinched between his fingers, muttering glumly to himself:

"Five yuan, ten yuan, twenty..."

001 felt very sad. Once again, it had spent its entire salary before the end of the month, leaving only this bit left.

It wanted to eat street barbecue.

It wanted mutton, beef, big eggplants...

And pork kidneys too.

The youth in black was extremely depressed. Clutching his money, he looked around—the barbecue stall should be open at this hour.

001 scanned the surroundings, spotted the location, and walked over, repeatedly persuading itself along the way.

Just spend ten yuan today.

And another ten tomorrow.

Hold out until next month!

However, when it reached the stall—

"Ah, you're here? What bad luck—someone bought everything up! Come back tomorrow!"

The vendor was already packing up the stall.

001 was shocked.

Who was it?!

Just then, the vendor pointed in a direction: "Seriously! If I had any left, I'd definitely save some for you, but that young man bought out the whole stock. He was even carrying a bird—so noisy, chirping away, no idea what it was saying."

001 clutched its few banknotes, staring blankly at the figure not far away.

Its skewers...

-

Song Yu was walking along the park footpath. Seeing no one around, he gently advised:

"You shouldn't eat too much. Didn't the Bureau say it would cloud your spirit energy and wouldn't help your shapeshifting?"

The bird refused to accept it:

"They all queue up to eat cake!"

"..."

The guardian replied: "They've already mastered shapeshifting."

The bird turned its plump head away, thought for a moment, and refuted:

"I can grow big!"

"..."

While Song Yu was casually debating back and forth with the little bird on his shoulder, his peripheral vision suddenly caught sight of a youth in black perched on the armrest of a public bench nearby.

It was as if frames had dropped from a video—he had appeared out of nowhere in an instant.

Song Yu couldn't help stopping in his tracks, turning his head to look.

chunks.chineseText:
第28章

宋郁其实有点意外，因为他没有见过有人能蹲在公共座椅把手上的，还保持平衡得这么好。

鸟也好奇，这谁？

但就在这时，对面的少年灵巧地跳了下来，走到了一人一鸟跟前。

001个子不高，需要仰视，直直地盯着人。

宋郁：“……”

白粼粼眯了眯鸟眼，他虽然没有什么当妖怪的经验，但是就凭那个闪现，足以证明这人不太正常。

鸟刚想叼着人的衣领让他走开。

“它，是妖怪。”

少年伸了伸手，指着宋郁肩头的这只圆嘟嘟的肥鸟道。

白粼粼：“……”

宋郁环顾了下四周，刚想要确定下有没有人听到，但是回头的时候却发现那少年不见了。

低头。

黑衣少年蹲在他面前，盯着那个烧烤袋子。

专注ing。

宋郁有些无所适从，但他还是问了句：

“呃，你要吃吗？”

黑衣少年刷得一下抬头，眼睛像是骤然亮了起来。

“可以吗？”

001话虽然是这么说，但是手已经伸到了袋子里，抓住了一根竹签。

宋郁：“……”

最后找了没人的公园石椅坐下了，对面的少年似乎是饿了很久了，拿着串就开始吃了起来，再次确定了下：

“不要钱吧？”

白粼粼此刻站在桌子上，来回啪嗒啪嗒地走，非常好奇这“人”是什么身份，怎么会一眼看出来他是妖怪的？

宋郁抬手把鸟拿了回来，放到肩头，这才同对面的少年道：

“不要。”

“但你为什么那么说？”

他其实有些戒备，毕竟管理局那边是夜晚活动，白天那些妖怪大多是在监护人身边，或者是不化形。

这少年什么身份？

001头也不抬地伸手，指了指旁边的鸟，确切地说是脖子上的“金属”环。

“不是管理局发的吗？”

“……”

宋郁没话说了，他没想到是这个“项链”的事，不过就在这时，那黑衣少年似乎是觉得吃得不方便，皱了皱眉头。

下一秒。

一只羽毛蓬松的小鸟出现在桌面了，眼周的羽毛是黑色的，翅膀则是上棕下深，短喙尤为锋利，此刻它正在一个爪子固定木棍，然后用喙卖力地撕羊肉。

孜然味的。

小鸟吃得非常专心。

宋郁：“……”

白粼粼也很好奇，于是扑棱翅膀从人的肩头下来了，站在了那只吃串串的鸟旁边，立正。

低头打量。

“啾啾？”

[你是什么品种的？]

白粼粼其实有些想法，这只鸟看起来比自己小一点，个头也不太大的。

是妖怪……

那收了当小弟如何？

鸟心里越想越觉得合适，还伸了伸爪子把烧烤袋子推了过去，他很大方的。

“你为什么不说人话？”

001吃完了烧烤里的所有肉，然后又化形成了黑衣少年，低头看着桌上的那只同族道。

白粼粼：“……”

他现在是只鸟！口吐人言很违和好不好？更何况是复杂句。

但他还没来得及解释——

“你不会化形吗？”

“你戴的那个稳定器，是幼鸟才会用的。”

001非常直白地指了指，面色很是平静，但是唇边全是酱料。

白粼粼：“……”

吐出来！给我吐出来！

“它就是幼鸟，它还不到一岁。”

宋郁很平和地补充道。

001不解：“不对。”

“鸟类的岁数不是这么算的，它十个月的话，就可以交｜配了。”

“找对象。”

石桌上的鸟石化了，宋郁也愣住了，但这还没完，因为少年的下一句是：

“你是它的交配对象吗？”

-

南市急救中心。

江芮面色惨白，听着医生的话更是觉得胆战心惊，对方也是匪夷所思：

“这……没有见过这种情况，一般八九十年代的时候有过野鸟进房间啄食刚出生没多久的小孩眼睛的案例。”

“但你家这个……年纪很大了。”

“按道理来说是完全可以挣开的，鸟才多大？”

医生觉得邪门，但是也确实没什么办法，只能告知术后的注意事项。

但就在这时病房里传来一阵惨叫，是一个护士的声音，很快许多人都围了上去。

医生赶过去的时候，那实习的护士的手臂已经被那孩子咬得很深了，都渗出来血了。

江芮愣愣地站在门口，只是觉得可怕，她不该生的……害人害己。

-

南心公园。

“这有什么？我们鸟类不看物种的。”

001不能理解面前的一人一鸟，丹顶鹤就喜欢的它的饲养员，这有什么的？

喜欢就是喜欢。

宋郁被噎得不知道说什么，但到底是硬生生岔开话题了，只是道：

“那你可以和我的小鸟交朋友，它刚到管理局报道……”

白粼粼已经石化很久了，不过这个时候恢复了，他没忘记正事，于是啪嗒啪嗒走到这只鸟的面前，认真问：

“你要当我的跟班吗？”

人震惊，刚想捂住鸟嘴。

但对面的少年只是面色茫然，问：“什么是跟班？”

白粼粼反应了下，心想也是，当老大是需要给跟班好处的。

鸟低头环顾了四周，发现也没有什么好东西，突然看到了空的烧烤袋子。

Bingo！

白粼粼伸了爪子过去，仰头看向这个黑衣少年，很正经地道：

“咳咳，这个，当跟班的话，有免费的烧烤吃……”

鸟话都没有说完。

001很自然地变成了那只小雀的模样，爪子啪嗒啪嗒地走过去，眼神专注，抬头问：

“真的吗？”

鸟：“……真的。”

001立即道：“好的，我是你的跟班。”

宋郁其实几次都想要打断，他总觉得这样不太对，但是看着石桌上的两只鸟毛绒绒的样子，还是忍了。

当老大……也没什么。

行。

后面的事就很自然了，两只鸟约定了下周去管理局培训的时候见面，顺带交流了下吃烧烤的心得体会。

宋郁：“……”

001临走前还有些不放心，又啪嗒啪嗒地走到那只大一点的蓝羽小鸟面前，嘱咐道：

“一定要记得给我带。”

“要加麻加辣的。”

宋郁就这么看着他的小鸟挥了挥翅膀，还仰了下头，很是打包票的样子。

“没问题！”

-

最终这个小插曲才算过去，南心公园这个时候人已经很多了，大多是中老年人，估计是要跳广场舞。

宋郁其实等了有一会儿，但是还是没有发现售卖鹦鹉的鸟贩子，于是只好先去附近的一家24小时营业银行了。

鸟说拿手机有些不方便，它要钞票。

红色的那种。

宋郁简单取了一万，觉得大概是够用一个月的，于是在二十分钟后回到了南心公园。

而这时，公园雕像的左侧那里已经围起来了人。

还有阵阵喝彩的声音。

一人一鸟走了过去，这才看到了中间的情形：
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 28

Song Yu was actually quite surprised, because he had never seen anyone who could perch on the armrest of a public bench while maintaining such perfect balance.

The bird was curious too. Who was this?

Right at that moment, the youth across from them nimbly hopped down and walked up to the pair.

001 wasn't tall, so he had to look up, staring straight at the human.

Song Yu: "..."

Bai Linlin narrowed his bird eyes. Although he didn't have much experience being a demon, that single teleportation flick was enough to prove this person was far from normal.

Just as the bird was about to grab the youth's collar with his beak to make him back off—

"That's a demon."

The youth reached out a hand, pointing at the plump, fluffy bird sitting on Song Yu's shoulder.

Bai Linlin: "..."

Song Yu looked around to make sure no one had overheard. But when he turned back, the youth was gone.

Glancing down.

The youth in black was crouching right in front of him, staring intently at the bag of barbecue.

Focusing hard.

Song Yu felt a bit at a loss, but he still asked:

"Uh... would you like some?"

The youth in black snapped his head up, his eyes instantly lighting up.

"Can I?"

Even as 001 said this, his hand had already reached into the bag and grabbed a bamboo skewer.

Song Yu: "..."

In the end, they found a quiet stone bench in the empty park and sat down. The youth across from them looked as though he had been starving for a long time, devouring the skewers instantly. He checked once more:

"This is free, right?"

Bai Linlin stood on the table, pacing back and forth with pitter-patter steps, intensely curious about this "person's" identity. How could he tell at a single glance that he was a demon?

Song Yu lifted the bird back onto his shoulder before speaking to the youth:

"It's free."

"But why did you say that earlier?"

He was actually somewhat on guard. After all, the Bureau operated at night, and during the daytime, most demons either stayed beside their guardians or refrained from shapeshifting.

What was this youth's identity?

Without even raising his head, 001 reached out and pointed at the bird—or more precisely, at the "metal" ring around its neck.

"Isn't that issued by the Bureau?"

"..."

Song Yu was rendered speechless. He hadn't expected it to be because of this "necklace." Just then, the youth in black seemed to feel it was inconvenient to eat in human form and furrowed his brows.

In the very next second.

A small bird with fluffy feathers appeared on the tabletop. The plumage around its eyes was black, its wings were brown fading into dark shades, and its short beak was extraordinarily sharp. At the moment, it was using one claw to pin down the wooden stick while tearing furiously into the mutton skewer with its beak.

Cumin-flavored.

The little bird was eating with absolute concentration.

Song Yu: "..."

Bai Linlin was full of curiosity as well. Flapping his wings, he hopped down from Song Yu's shoulder, stood next to the skewer-eating bird, and drew himself up straight.

He leaned down to inspect it.

"Chirp chirp?"

[What species are you?]

Bai Linlin actually had some thoughts. This bird looked slightly smaller than him, and its size wasn't huge either.

Since it's a demon...

How about taking him in as a minion?

The more the bird thought about it, the more fitting it seemed. He even extended a claw to push the bag of barbecue over. He was very generous.

"Why aren't you speaking human language?"

Having finished all the meat on the skewer, 001 transformed back into the youth in black, looking down at his fellow avian on the table.

Bai Linlin: "..."

He was a bird right now! Speaking human language out loud as a bird would be totally unnatural, wouldn't it? Let alone complex sentences!

Before he could explain—

"Can't you shapeshift?"

"That stabilizer you're wearing is only used by fledgling birds."

001 pointed it out bluntly, his face completely calm, though sauce was smeared all around his lips.

Bai Linlin: "..."

Spit it out! Spit out my barbecue!

"He is a fledgling bird. He's not even a year old yet," Song Yu added peacefully.

001 was puzzled: "That's not right."

"That's not how bird age works. If he's ten months old, he can already mate."

"Find a partner."

The bird on the stone table petrified. Song Yu froze as well. But that wasn't all, because the youth's next sentence was:

"Are you his mating partner?"

-

First Emergency Center of Nanshi.

Jiang Rui's face was deathly pale. Listening to the doctor's words made her heart tremble with fear, while the doctor was equally baffled:

"This... I've never seen a case like this. Usually back in the eighties or nineties, there were cases of wild birds flying into rooms to peck at the eyes of newborn infants."

"But your child... is already so old."

"Logically speaking, he should have been able to break free easily. How big can a bird be?"

The doctor felt it was eerily bizarre, but there was truly nothing he could do except explain the post-surgery precautions.

Just then, a blood-curdling scream came from inside the ward—it was a nurse's voice. Soon, many people gathered around.

By the time the doctor rushed over, the intern nurse's arm had already been bitten deeply by the child, blood oozing out.

Jiang Rui stood blankly at the doorway, feeling only horror. She shouldn't have given birth to him... It was harming others and destroying herself.

-

Nanxin Park.

"So what? We birds don't care about species."

001 couldn't understand the human and bird in front of him. A red-crowned crane could fall in love with its human keeper—what was so strange about that?

Love was love.

Song Yu was choked into silence, but ultimately managed to force a change of subject, saying:

"Then you can be friends with my little bird. He just reported to the Bureau..."

Bai Linlin had been petrified for a long time, but now he finally recovered. Remembering his main objective, he trotted over to the bird with pitter-patter steps and asked seriously:

"Do you want to be my henchman?"

Song Yu was shocked and wanted to cover the bird's beak.

However, the youth across from them merely looked confused and asked: "What's a henchman?"

Bai Linlin took a moment to realize—right, being a boss means giving benefits to your henchmen.

The bird lowered its head and looked around, realizing there was nothing good nearby. Suddenly, his eyes fell on the empty barbecue bag.

Bingo!

Bai Linlin extended a claw, looked up at the youth in black, and said with solemn gravity:

"Ahem, well... if you become my henchman, you get free barbecue to eat..."

Before the bird could even finish.

001 naturally reverted into the little bird's form, trotting over with pitter-patter claw steps, eyes fixated, and looked up to ask:

"Really?"

Bird: "...Really."

001 immediately said: "Okay, I'm your henchman."

Song Yu had wanted to interrupt several times, feeling that this wasn't quite right. But seeing the two fluffy birds standing on the stone table, he held back.

Being a boss... wasn't a big deal anyway.

Fine.

What followed unfolded naturally. The two birds made an appointment to meet next week when they went to the Bureau for training, exchanging their insights and experiences regarding barbecue along the way.

Song Yu: "..."

Before leaving, 001 was still a bit uneasy. It trotted over to the slightly larger blue-feathered bird with pitter-patter steps and instructed:

"You must remember to bring me some."

"Extra spicy and extra numb."

Song Yu watched as his little bird fluttered its wings and tossed its head back, looking like he was guaranteeing it with absolute certainty.

"No problem!"

-

Only then did this little episode come to an end. Nanxin Park was quite crowded by now, mostly with middle-aged and elderly people, presumably gathering for square dancing.

Song Yu actually waited for a while, but still found no sign of bird vendors selling parrots. Thus, he had no choice but to head to a nearby 24-hour bank first.

The bird had said that carrying a phone was inconvenient and that he wanted cash.

The red ones.

Song Yu withdrew ten thousand yuan, thinking it should be enough for a month, and returned to Nanxin Park twenty minutes later.

By this time, a crowd had gathered to the left of the park statue.

Cheers and applause echoed in waves.

The human and bird walked over, only then witnessing the scene at the center:

chunks.chineseText:
一只虎皮鹦鹉在走滚轮，喙里还叼着一个小秤砣，摇摇晃晃的，好几次脑袋都往下坠了，硬生生抬起来的。

“好！好！”

“真厉害呀！”

周遭的人都是看客，绝大多数是中年男人，凑热闹的，有几个注意到了身后的少年，不由自主地看向对方肩头的蓝羽鹦鹉。

“欸，这儿也——”

宋郁面无表情地看了过去，表情很冷。

那男人这才讪讪地扭头了，不自在地搓了搓手。

不过这里人多眼杂的，宋郁还是拉开了自己的挎包，这会鸟也很乖，立马飞进去了。

和人民币贴贴。

鹦鹉表演还在继续，那是个穿着不修边幅的男人，手里拿着一个小棍，一边点烟一边冲旁边的人炫耀：

“瞅瞅，这我驯得不错吧！”

“这小玩意儿真不错。”

话音刚落下，场地里的虎皮鹦鹉就累得不行，直接翻了，周遭的人立马“嘘”了一声。

有个带着孩子的妈妈蹙了蹙眉，还是拉着走了，低声说了句，“造孽……”

那男人一看就蹙了眉，抬手拿小棍子就去敲，虎皮鹦鹉躲不开，身上的羽毛也很稀疏，捱了两下后，又去站那个滚轮了。

周遭的人又留下来不少。

到了最后的环节。

鹦鹉踩着滚轮走到了靠近人群的外围，伸着脑袋学舌：

“恭喜发财，红包拿来！”

“恭喜发财，红包拿来！”

……

身后有个男人拿着盒子就走过来了，有的人借口说没带钱，男人就拿出来了二维码。

五块十块的，人数一多，约莫也是有三位数的。

宋郁站在人群后面，冷眼看着这一切，包里的小鸟乖乖的，只是在把鸟头贴在布料上，在听外面的动静。

“小兄弟，也赏个脸呗？”

宋郁无动于衷。

男人立马道：“你瞅瞅，球球也辛苦一天了，它要是赚不够的话，晚上连水都没得喝嘞。”

语气是非常调侃的，这人还叼着半截烟，伸手指了指后方的鸟。

不远处有个要走的中年男人大声笑道：

“真是胡扯！吓小孩啊！”

面前的男人眼睛狭长，个子偏矮，闻言对着不远处的人大声道：

“万一我没骗呢，瞧你说的！”

宋郁从包里拿出来了钱，一张一百块的。

这男人立马喜笑颜开，连带着刚才那点微妙的恶意都消散了，“成成成，赏脸啊。”

正在他要转身收拾东西走的时候，身后的少年说话了：

“我能买了你这只鹦鹉么？”

宋郁走了过来，很平静地商量。

但男人却头也不抬地摆手，含糊不清地道：

“不卖不卖，老子好不容易驯好的。”

“五百。”

男人闻言动作顿了下，仰头看了过来，笑着道：

“你出五百？虎皮鹦鹉市场价知道吗？这东西值不了这么些钱。”

宋郁蹙眉：“所以卖么？”

“你不会心疼那鸟吧？”

男人觉得可笑，摆了摆手，“就一小畜生。”

但是宋郁坚持道：“我买。”

此时公园天色已经暗下来了，男人闻言也是觉得有意思，没再收拾东西了，只是站了起来，叉着腰吊儿郎当地道：

“我-不-卖！”

“多少钱都不出，告诉你吧，我不差钱，就乐意看别人捧场。”

“该干什么就干什么去。”

男人翻了个白眼，抬手扯了下手里的链子，尽头那里的小鹦鹉根本就没有反应过来，直接一顿滚，灰头土脸的。

宋郁面色愈发地冷了，没有要让开的意思，只是道：

“一千。”

男人愣住了，但还是皱眉：“说了不卖，我驯鸟也是有时间成本的。”

“两千。”

男人手里的动作停了，不可置信地看了过来，眯了眯眼，道：

“不卖。”

“五千。”

男人心脏都有点加速了，但他还是迟疑地道：

“我还是不卖，我看你能加到哪里去。”

宋郁很平静地看过去，“六千。”

男人这次真是吞了口口水，真不少了，他再驯一只也不是不行，但是他又觉得对面这小孩可以再出高价，眯了眯眼，迟疑道：

“不卖……”

宋郁转头就打算走了。

不过就在这时，这男人急了，上去就拦住了，开始道：

“六千成成成，别走啊。”

宋郁转而看了过来，很平和地告知：

“这个价我不买。”

男人真是觉得后悔，他试着问：

“那……那五千也行。”

“不买。”

形势颠倒。

男人服了，他又不想错过这个机会，伸了伸手指，比了个数：

“四千，四千行吧？”

宋郁很平静地看向地上的虎皮鹦鹉，面无表情地道：

“我不太懂行情，但你不说了么，它不值这个价。”

“你养得羽毛也不好，眼神看着也呆……”

这男人此刻是真急了，弯腰拿着那鹦鹉起来了，很认真地反驳：

“我这日夜不停地驯的，它聪明得很好不好？小孩，你要是真有钱就付过来，别整这一套一套的。”

宋郁抬眸看了过去，平静地道：

“两千。”

价格其实相当高了，那男人也是见好就收了，把拴着鹦鹉的脚链递了过去，然后一脸不耐烦地扯自己脖子上的收款码。

“我给现金。”

男人其实有点愣，谁出门带一堆现金，但他还真看到了少年从包里拿出一沓人民币，数了二十张。

宋郁递过去的时候神色淡淡的，看着对面的人用车钥匙的蓝光灯照纸钞真假，问了句：

“我能走了么？”

男人一边叼着根新烟看钱，一边朝外摆了摆手，还喃喃了几句：

“真有实力……”

-

南心公园里照样还是热热闹闹的，这会儿甚至有唱戏的班子过来了，吹拉弹唱的，也围起来了人。

男人刚赚了不少钱，心里正是飘着的时候，围着看了过去，腰包里放着一沓钱。

天黑了，公园的灯老旧，照明范围也不大，因而谁也没有注意到后面有一只走地鸡悄悄靠近。

“哎唱得真不错啊。”

“你别说，就是！”

……

鸟左右环顾，有点紧张，但又很兴奋的感觉，小心地飞了起来，爪子扣住那个腰包，在嘈杂的弹唱中把拉链给弄开了。

全是成卷的钞票，男人还用皮筋绑了下。

白粼粼：好！

鸟叼着钱就出来了，沉甸甸的，鸟一顿飞。

宋郁其实很担心，在不远处一直看着半空中，虽然是妖怪不错，可他的小鸟目前只会变大用翅膀扇人而已。

还是很弱小的。

但是看了好一会，人也没看到鸟飞回来的迹象，本来都要着急了，直到在路灯下看到一个伸着翅膀狂走的“小鸡”。

左右摇摆，一顿冲刺。

叼着一沓人民币。

宋郁立马俯身蹲下，刚伸过去手，鸟就啪嗒啪嗒走了上来，一路攀爬至肩头。

“啾！”

挺胸抬头。

宋郁正好接过那一沓钱，低头看了下，除了那两千块，还有好多五块十块的……

“……”

还有意外收获。
chunks.englishText:
A budgerigar was running inside a wheel, holding a small iron weight in its beak. Tottering back and forth, its head drooped down several times before forcing itself back up.

"Nice! Bravo!"

"That's impressive!"

The surrounding crowd were mostly onlookers, predominantly middle-aged men joining in the fun. A few noticed the teenager standing behind them and involuntarily glanced at the blue-feathered parrot perched on his shoulder.

"Hey, look over here too—"

Song Yu looked over expressionlessly, his gaze icy.

Only then did the man turn back sheepishly, awkwardly rubbing his hands together.

Since it was crowded and chaotic here, Song Yu unzipped his shoulder bag. The bird was very sensible this time, immediately flying inside.

Snuggling right up against the cash.

The parrot performance continued. The street performer was an unkempt man holding a small stick, puffing on a cigarette while boasting to the crowd:

"Look at that! Pretty well-trained, huh?"

"This little thing is really something."

Just as those words left their mouths, the budgie in the center couldn't handle the exhaustion anymore and collapsed right over. The crowd instantly let out a chorus of boos.

A mother leading a child frowned and pulled her kid away, muttering under her breath, "What a sin..."

Seeing this, the man frowned, raising his small stick to strike the bird. The budgie couldn't dodge in time; its feathers were already sparse. After taking two hits, it dragged itself back up to stand on the wheel again.

A good portion of the crowd stayed.

Then came the final stage.

Stepping on the wheel, the parrot rolled toward the outer edge near the crowd, stretching out its head to mimic speech:

"May you be prosperous! Hand over the red envelopes!"

"May you be prosperous! Hand over the red envelopes!"

……

A man behind the performer came over carrying a collection box. Some people excused themselves saying they had no cash, so the man pulled out a QR code.

Five-yuan bills, ten-yuan bills—with enough people, it added up to roughly three figures.

Song Yu stood at the back of the crowd, watching coldsightedly. The little bird in his bag stayed quiet, pressing its little head against the fabric to listen to the noise outside.

"Hey kid, why not show some support too?"

Song Yu remained impassive.

The man immediately urged, "Look, Qiuqiu worked hard all day. If it doesn't earn enough, it won't even get a drop of water to drink tonight."

He spoke in a heavily mocking tone, half a cigarette dangling from his lips as he pointed toward the bird behind him.

Not far away, a middle-aged man who was leaving called out loudly with a laugh:

"What utter nonsense! Trying to scare a kid!"

The performer had narrow eyes and a short stature. Hearing this, he shouted back at the departing man:

"What if I'm not lying? Listen to you talking!"

Song Yu pulled money out from his bag—a single hundred-yuan note.

The performer instantly beamed, any subtle malice vanishing into thin air. "Alright, alright, thanks for the generosity."

Just as he turned around to pack up his stuff to leave, the youth behind him spoke up:

"Can I buy this parrot from you?"

Song Yu walked over, negotiating in a calm tone.

But without even looking up, the man waved a hand, mumbling vaguely:

"Not selling, not selling. It took me a lot of damn work to train this thing."

"Five hundred."

Hearing this, the man paused his hands, looked up, and chuckled:

"You're offering five hundred? Do you know the market price for a budgie? This thing isn't worth that much money."

Song Yu frowned: "So are you selling?"

"You're not feeling sorry for a bird, are you?"

The man found it hilarious and waved his hand dismissively. "It's just a little beast."

But Song Yu insisted: "I'm buying it."

Dusk had settled over the park. The man found this amusing and stopped packing. He stood up, resting his hands on his hips lazily:

"I—am—not—selling!"

"I wouldn't sell it for any amount of money. Let me tell you, I'm not short on cash. I just like watching people cheer me on."

"Go mind your own business."

The man rolled his eyes and yanked the chain in his hand. The little parrot at the end had no time to react and tumbled into a roll, left looking completely disheveled and covered in dirt.

Song Yu's face turned even colder. He showed no intention of moving aside, simply stating:

"One thousand."

The man froze, but still scowled: "I said I'm not selling. Training a bird costs time, you know."

"Two thousand."

The man stopped what he was doing and looked over in disbelief, squinting his eyes: "Not selling."

"Five thousand."

The man's heart accelerated slightly, but he hesitated:

"I'm still not selling. Let's see how high you can go."

Song Yu looked at him calmly: "Six thousand."

This time, the man actually swallowed his saliva. That was a substantial sum. It wasn't like he couldn't just train another one. But he figured this kid across from him might be willing to go even higher. He narrowed his eyes and hesitated:

"Not..."

Song Yu turned around to leave.

Seeing this, the man panicked, rushing forward to block him:

"Alright, six thousand it is! Don't go!"

Song Yu turned back and informed him placidly:

"I won't buy at that price."

Regret washed over the man. He tried asking:

"Then... then five thousand works too."

"Not buying."

The tables had turned.

The man relented. Not wanting to miss out on this opportunity, he held up his fingers to show a number:

"Four thousand. Four thousand is fine, right?"

Song Yu looked down calmly at the budgie on the ground and said without expression:

"I don't know much about the market rate, but didn't you say it isn't worth that much money?"

"Its feathers are in poor condition, and its eyes look dull..."

Now the man was genuinely anxious. He bent down, picked up the parrot, and refuted earnestly:

"I trained this thing day and night! It's sharp as a tack, alright? Kid, if you really have the money, pay up. Stop giving me all this runaround."

Song Yu lifted his gaze and said evenly:

"Two thousand."

That price was actually quite high. Knowing when to cut his losses, the man handed over the leg chain attached to the parrot, then pulled out the payment QR code from around his neck with an annoyed expression.

"I'll pay in cash."

The man was momentarily stunned. Who carries a wad of cash when going out? But he really did see the youth pull out a stack of RMB from his bag and count out twenty bills.

Song Yu's expression remained indifferent as he handed the money over. Watching the man shine the blue light of a car key flashlight onto the notes to check for counterfeits, he asked:

"Can I go now?"

Holding a freshly lit cigarette in his mouth, the man inspected the cash while waving him off with his free hand, muttering under his breath:

"Damn, he's actually loaded..."

-

Nanxin Park was still bustling with activity. At this hour, an opera troupe had even arrived, playing wind and string instruments while singing, attracting a crowd around them.

Having just made a small fortune, the man was feeling smug and walked over to watch the show, a fat stack of cash tucked inside his fanny pack.

It was dark now, and the old park lamps had a limited lighting radius. Consequently, no one noticed a "ground chicken" stealthily sneaking up from behind.

"Ah, that's some fine singing!"

"Tell me about it! Sure is!"

……

The bird glanced left and right, appearing a little nervous yet extremely excited. It carefully took flight, latched its claws onto the fanny pack, and unzipped it amid the noisy musical performance.

It was stuffed with rolled-up banknotes, which the man had even bound with rubber bands.

Bai Linlin: *Great!*

The bird flew off with the cash in its beak. It was heavy, causing the bird to wobble mid-flight.

Song Yu was actually very worried, watching the night sky from a short distance away. Although Bai Linlin was indeed a demon, right now his little bird could only grow big and slap people with its wings.

It was still quite weak.

But after watching for a while, Song Yu didn't see any sign of the bird flying back. He was just about to get anxious when, under the glow of a streetlamp, he spotted a "little chicken" sprinting forward with its wings outstretched.

Swaying side to side, executing a full-on dash.

Clutched in its beak was a stack of RMB.

Song Yu immediately crouched down. The moment he reached out his hand, the bird waddled up with pitter-patter steps and scrambled all the way up to his shoulder.

"Chirp!"

Chest puffed out, head held high.

Song Yu caught the stack of cash and glanced down. Aside from his two thousand yuan, there were plenty of five-yuan and ten-yuan bills...

"..."

An unexpected bonus.

chunks.chineseText:
夜色朦胧，一人一鸟在相互贴着，边走边说话：

“啾啾啾！”

[快夸我！]

“粼粼真棒。”

“那是！”

-

最后回到家里已经是晚上八点半了，路上还去了趟黎笙的医院，稍微检查下那只虎皮鹦鹉，好在是一切没事。

这才提着笼子回了家。

鸟很大方，让球球去他的房间，里面有非常豪华的爬杆和秋千。

宋郁在门口俯身蹲下，把手机屏幕对着自家小鸟，温声道：

“烧烤没有吃成，再点一次，嗯？”

白粼粼非常满意！

就说选择大于努力！

人根本就不用调。

鸟在门口伸着爪子一顿操作，给自己点了两百块钱的，然后才去了自己房间。

……

这只虎皮鹦鹉正站在一个栖杆上，爪子在推一个挂着的编织球，一直来回推，像是刻板行为一样。

鸟扑棱翅膀飞了过去，端端正正地站在球球跟前。

球球：“……”

挡到球了欸。

“啾啾啾啾啾啾。”

[你好，我是粼粼。]

球球低着头，往旁边挪了挪，没有吭声。

“啾啾啾啾！”

[我是粼粼。]

鸟又往那边挤了挤，歪着头去再次介绍自己。

虎皮鹦鹉偏了偏头，很郁闷的样子。

把脑袋抵住了旁边的铁笼子，羽毛被弄成一捋一捋的。

“啾啾啾啾……”

[你家好大。]

白粼粼愣住了，他忘记了，不是所有小鸟都像他这么幸运。

鸟有些拘谨地在栖杆上调整了下爪子，解释了下：

“啾啾啾……”

[我是后来才遇见的我的……“人”的，最开始我也过得不好。]

球球歪头看了过来，好奇地道：

[真的？]

白粼粼：[真的，我一开始都要被贱卖了，让我配种来着的……]

鸟真诚。

鸟实在。

鸟很认真地安慰道：[所以一切都要向前看，下一站的风景或许不错呢？]

[我的人可以帮你找到个不错的主人。]

房间里响起此起彼伏的啾啾啾。

球球渐渐的也没有那么自卑了，它只是不解地问：

[不是主人吗？你为什么叫人？]

白粼粼：[……他就是我的人。]

[好吧。]

[怪怪的，我在电视剧里看到狂徒是这么喊的。]

球球直言不讳。

大约过了十多分钟，宋郁过来了，很温和地把自己的小鸟接了回来，然后看向那只小虎皮：

“这边有鸟粮，这个地方是水，你好好休息。”

球球看了看这个人，觉得确实长得好看，感叹了下：

[你的人不错。]

鸟超有面子：[是吧！]

[你不吃饭吗？]

[……我、我外面吃。]

这么一来一回的，宋郁一句也听不懂，只知道两只小鸟在叽叽喳喳。

他神色淡了下来，但还是等着，终于过了几分钟，球球自己飞去吃饭了。

人和鸟这才离开这个房间。

-

等到吃完烧烤，已经晚上十一点多了。

宋郁想了想，还是睡前洗了个澡，顺带帮鸟也洗了，这次他有经验得多。

用买的小澡盆，大概就三十多厘米，还有个迷你淋浴头，鸟立马羽毛蓬松了，在里面认真地扑棱。

像个打湿了的毛球。

不过就在人去拿恒温箱的时候，鸟又出去了。

白粼粼抽空去看了下球球，鸟头从门缝里挤开，观察了下，那只虎皮鹦鹉正在站着睡觉。

鸟安心了。

宋郁看到的就是鸟圆滚滚的后半身，长长的尾羽，爪子都还有着潮气，在地板上打了个滑.

“……”

白粼粼正在专心致志地拔出来自己的鸟头，但还没怎么用力就腾空了，反应过来的时候已经被毛巾包住了。

“回去睡觉。”

卧室——

白粼粼的纸巾盒已经殉了。

接下来面临一个问题，睡哪里？

鸟看了看小小的椰子壳，又看了看人宽阔的大床。

鸟的心中自有判断。

于是就在宋郁擦完头发转身的时候，看到了床上仰躺着的某只。

两个爪子朝天，鸟眼已闭上。

好似睡着了。

“……”

宋郁只能撑着手臂过去，很温和地道：

“不行，你现在太小了，我会压到你的。”

白粼粼充耳不闻，侧了身子，继续闭眼。

像个甜筒躺在枕头上。

宋郁没有办法，抬手就握住了鸟，刚想拿起来就察觉到掌心有爪子滑动的触感，鸟非常用力地在蹬，最终一个弹射——

像小炮弹一样摔在了软软的枕头上。

鸟一定要睡床！

白粼粼一个弹跳，站得板板正正的，据理力争道：

“我压不死的，我是妖怪！”

“不行的话，我就去其他房间的——”

宋郁没有任何犹豫：“好。”

白粼粼没有想到人这么容易就答应了，还愣了下，不过达成目的就好了。

晚上十一点五十五。

人鸟安寝。

宋郁睡得很是安静，从头到尾都没有动过，枕头旁边是小鸡，在四仰八叉地睡着，爪子把那个小毯子早踹开了。

时间在一点一滴地流逝……

白粼粼无意识地翻身，朦朦胧胧觉得有些硌得慌，伸了伸爪子，一顿乱伸，隐约听见一声闷响。

但鸟没太在意。

翌日清晨，外面阳光正盛，万里无云。

卧室里的少年却迟迟醒不过来，像是梦魇了一样，呼吸都很困难，身体也完全动不了。

宋郁甚至以为自己又犯病了，直到一个用力挣脱，他开始大口大口地呼吸，眼前的场景也逐步从模糊变得清晰。

羽毛……全部都是羽毛。

甚至挡住了卧室的吊灯，人愣住了。

硕大的鸟头压在他的脖子，卡得正正好。

宋郁：“……”

他试图把他的小鸟先推开，但不知道是因为乱动还是怎么的。

轰隆——

床塌了。
chunks.englishText:
Under the hazy night sky, the youth and the bird leaned close, talking as they walked:

"Chirp chirp chirp!"

[Praise me, quick!]

"Linlin is amazing."

"You bet!"

-

It was eight-thirty in the evening by the time they finally returned home. On the way, they took a detour to Li Sheng's animal hospital to get the budgie checked out. Thankfully, everything was fine.

Only then did they carry the cage back home.

The bird was very generous, letting Qiuqiu stay in its room, which was equipped with a luxurious climbing perch and swings.

Song Yu crouched down at the doorway, pointing his phone screen toward his little bird, and asked softly:

"We didn't get to eat barbecue earlier. Shall we order it again, hm?"

Bai Linlin was immensely satisfied!

As they say, choice matters more than effort!

Human training was completely unnecessary.

Standing at the doorway, the bird operated the phone with its claw, ordering two hundred yuan worth of food for itself before heading to its own room.

……

The budgie was perched on a rod, its claws repeatedly pushing a hanging woven ball back and forth, almost like a stereotypical, compulsive behavior.

Fluttering its wings, Bai Linlin flew over and stood upright in front of Qiuqiu.

Qiuqiu: "..."

*Hey, you're blocking my ball.*

"Chirp chirp chirp chirp chirp chirp."

[Hello, I'm Linlin.]

Qiuqiu lowered its head, shuffled slightly to the side, and remained silent.

"Chirp chirp chirp chirp!"

[I'm Linlin.]

The bird squeezed closer, tilting its head to introduce itself again.

The budgie tilted its head, looking rather gloomy. It pressed its head against the adjacent iron cage, its feathers ruffled into messy tufts.

"Chirp chirp chirp chirp..."

[Your house is so big.]

Bai Linlin froze. He had forgotten that not all little birds were as fortunate as him.

Feeling a bit awkward, the bird adjusted its claws on the perch and explained:

"Chirp chirp chirp..."

[I met my... "human" later on. I didn't have a good life at first, either.]

Qiuqiu tilted its head and looked over, asking curiously:

[Really?]

Bai Linlin: [Really. In the beginning, I was almost sold off cheap to be used for breeding...]

The bird was sincere.

The bird was honest.

The bird comforted it earnestly: [So you have to look forward. Maybe the scenery at the next stop will be nice?]

[My human can help you find a good master.]

The room echoed with a continuous chorus of chirps.

Gradually, Qiuqiu grew less self-conscious. It simply asked in confusion:

[Isn't he your master? Why do you call him your human?]

Bai Linlin: [...He's just my human.]

[Alright.]

[It sounds weird. I saw villainous thugs call people that on TV.]

Qiuqiu spoke bluntly.

After about ten minutes, Song Yu walked over, gently picked up his little bird, and then looked at the small budgie:

"There's bird food over here, and this is water. Get a good rest."

Qiuqiu looked at the human, feeling that he was indeed handsome, and remarked:

[Your human is pretty nice.]

Bai Linlin felt immensely proud: [Right?!]

[Aren't you going to eat?]

[...I-I'll eat outside.]

Back and forth they went, though Song Yu couldn't understand a single word, hearing only the two little birds chirping endlessly.

His expression softened into a mild calm, but he waited patiently. Finally, after a few minutes, Qiuqiu flew over to eat on its own.

Only then did the youth and the bird leave the room.

-

By the time they finished eating the barbecue, it was already past eleven at night.

After a moment's thought, Song Yu decided to take a bath before bed and washed the bird along the way. He was much more experienced this time.

Using a small tub he bought—about thirty centimeters wide—along with a mini showerhead, the bird's feathers instantly fluffed up as it splashed around energetically inside.

Like a soggy ball of fluff.

However, while the human went to grab the drying incubator, the bird snuck out again.

Taking advantage of the moment, Bai Linlin went to check on Qiuqiu. Pushing its head through the door crack to observe, he saw the budgie sleeping while standing on its perch.

The bird felt relieved.

What Song Yu saw upon returning was the bird's round rear end, long tail feathers, and damp claws sliding slightly on the wooden floor.

"..."

Bai Linlin was intently pulling his head back out, but before he could exert much force, he felt himself lifted into the air. By the time he reacted, he was already wrapped in a towel.

"Go back to sleep."

In the bedroom—

Bai Linlin's tissue box was officially out of commission.

Now faced with a question: where to sleep?

The bird looked at the tiny coconut shell house, then at the human's spacious big bed.

The bird had its own priorities.

Thus, when Song Yu dried his hair and turned around, he saw a certain bird lying flat on its back on the bed.

Two feet sticking up into the air, bird eyes tightly shut.

Pretending to be fast asleep.

"..."

Song Yu could only lean forward, supporting himself with his arms, and said gently:

"No. You're too small right now. I might crush you."

Bai Linlin turned a deaf ear, rolled onto his side, and kept his eyes closed.

Lying on the pillow like an ice cream cone.

Out of options, Song Yu reached out to pick up the bird. But just as he held it, he felt claws kicking frantically against his palm. The bird scrambled with all its might, executing a final catapult launch—

Landing like a tiny cannonball right onto the soft pillow.

The bird was determined to sleep on the bed!

Springing up, Bai Linlin stood perfectly upright and argued his case with utmost righteousness:

"I won't be crushed to death, I'm a demon!"

"If you won't let me, I'll just go sleep in another room—"

Song Yu didn't hesitate for a single second: "Okay."

Bai Linlin hadn't expected him to agree so easily and froze for a moment. But as long as he achieved his goal, it was fine.

11:55 PM.

Human and bird turned in for the night.

Song Yu slept very quietly, remaining completely still from start to finish. Beside his pillow, the "little chicken" slept sprawling in all directions, having kicked away its tiny blanket long ago.

Time ticked away...

Unconsciously rolling over, Bai Linlin hazily felt something lumpy pressing against him. He stretched out his claws, flailing blindly until a faint thud echoed in the room.

But the bird didn't pay much attention to it.

The next morning, bright sunlight streamed outside under a clear, cloudless sky.

Yet the youth in the bedroom struggled to wake up. It was as if he were trapped in a nightmare—breathing felt heavy and difficult, and his body was entirely immobilized.

Song Yu even thought he was having a relapse of his illness, until he summoned his strength to break free. Gasping for air, the scene before his eyes gradually shifted from blurry to clear.

Feathers... everywhere were feathers.

They even blocked out the ceiling light of the bedroom. Song Yu froze in shock.

A massive bird head was resting squarely against his neck, wedging him firmly in place.

Song Yu: "..."

He attempted to push his little bird off first. However, whether due to the sudden movement or something else—

*BOOM—*

The bed collapsed.

chunks.chineseText:
第29章

宋郁下巴微微仰着，呼吸都是张着口的，手还在保持着半举的状态。

也不知道是推还是不推。

只是面色泛红，被压得血气上涌，冷郁的眼睛都有些无措。

但或许是动静太大了，吵到了他的小鸟，胸口处的鸟头动了动，似乎是往他肩窝里又拱了拱。

“……”

宋郁想了想，不动了。

他使劲地抬了抬自己的手臂，去摸鸟的羽毛，用微不可察的语气道：

“睡吧。”

小鸟的羽毛是干燥温暖的，有种天然的谷物味道，宋郁的手在摸的同时，也不自觉地靠近……

白粼粼睡得昏天黑地，梦里像是回到了自己的出租屋，怀里还有那个从孤儿院就一直带着的小熊玩偶。

很喜欢，一直抱着。

白粼粼很久没有梦到过去了，昏黄的房间，他睡得踏实又心安，朦胧中是觉得忘了什么，只是一直在贴着自己的玩偶。

院长会不会想他呢？

还有老师，还有那些他的“弟弟妹妹”们……

鸟很依恋很依恋，拱得愈发投入，直到床的另一角也塌了。

“……”

白粼粼醒了，很震惊地挪开了自己的身躯，低头一看。

人被他压得面色都红了，还喘着气，领口都散了。

鸟做了什么？

宋郁其实还条件反射地护了下硕大的鸟头，后知后觉好像没必要，直到现在——

“你醒了？”

他刚问完这句话，身上的鸟像是突然回神了，伸着翅根就下了床，站在了墙角那里，面壁。

白粼粼是真的脸红了。

鸟愧疚，鸟不安。

宋郁撑着手臂去看不远处，微微蹙了下眉，生气了？

他起身走了过去，没再管身后的废墟，只是顺手捡起了地板上的“稳定器”，走到鸟身边，很认真地道：

“是床质量不好，用得很久了。”

“我的错。”

白粼粼觉得也是，但是爪子还是并了并，有些羞涩。

“饿不饿？”

鸟不由自主得扭了下头。

开饭了?

宋郁面色这才温和了起来，抬手过去，终于看他了。

“没事的，嗯？”

“我让人来换新的。”

白粼粼怔怔的，然后爪子挪动了下，情到深处地把鸟头靠了过去，没太注意到人打了个趔趄。

大鸟依人。

-

最后还是叫了人上门送新的床，红木家具的，不过工作人员安装的时候还有些纳闷……

上次书桌坏了。

这次床坏。

这家人这么激烈？

工作人员不由得多看了宋郁几眼，很快又打消了自己的想法，看着不像是有对象的。

养宠物根本就没这空。

不过他还是抵不住好奇，问了下，“……这是怎么弄坏的啊？”

“没有别的意思，主要是我真没见过坏得这么彻底的床，两三百斤的胖子也不至于……”

鸟：“……”

宋郁咳嗽了几声，其实也不知道怎么解释，好在这个时候手机电话来了。

他正好出门去接电话了，留下鸟在卧室里监工。

来电是阿姨，那边还有些嘈杂，似乎人来人往的。

“小宋，阿姨找到了，我一说人家就有印象，还问了问你的情况。”

“乐乐配上型了，已经转到普通病房了。”

“你要是今天有空……”

宋郁没有想到会这么快，立马回复道：“阿姨我待会就过去。”

等到十五分钟后，卧室的床已经安装好了，相当结实的那种。

宋郁送走工作人员之后就先关上了卧室门，让鸟变大上去试试。

这次的床定制得非常大，很宽，床垫也很软，鸟有些犹豫。

“会不会踩坏？”

白粼粼询问了下，但是已经伸爪子上去了，很矜贵的样子。

“不会，只是原来的那个很旧了，没有粼粼还没有机会换新。”

宋郁非常认真地说。

好在这次的床非常的结实，纹丝不动，鸟的自信心恢复了，很快又变成小号模样，飞上了人的肩头。

“我觉得质量可以的。”

“应该是真的红木。”

鸟质检员如是说。

最后才准备出门，顺带拿了鸟包去带隔壁的球球，那只小虎皮精神状态好多了。

宋郁用手机叫了个车，在十五分钟抵达了南市第一人民医院的地铁口。

那里果然站着原来的大叔，对方仍然是一副宽厚可亲的样子，抱着自己的女儿在说话，见到来人了才道：

“真的是你啊孩子。”

宋郁快步走了过来，气息还有些不稳，视线不由得看向了那个面色苍白的女孩子，约莫也就五六岁的样子。

抱着她爸爸的脖子。

有点害怕。

“我叫宋郁，之前没来得及说，阿姨她……”

大叔温和地笑了笑，“说了说了，我一开始以为客户来医院找我维修了，没想到是这么一回事。”

“鹦鹉我确实还没买，这不孩子前段时间一直在医院么……”

小女孩正贴着爸爸的脸，不太懂为什么来了个陌生人，但是就在这时她突然注意到了那个挎包。

拉链的位置鼓鼓的，像是有什么东西在动。

“对的，因为正好救了一只小鹦鹉，它现在没处可去，有些领养人也不是很好……”

“那真的挺不好意思的，毕竟我们也不是什么熟人……”

成年人在交流，鸟在蓄力一钻，很快黑色的挎包拉链处多了一颗圆滚滚的鸟头。

白粼粼四处张望，看到了小女孩，歪了下头。

“啾啾？”

宋郁低了下头，发现鸟出来后立刻抬手把鸟头按了进去，白粼粼视野一片漆黑，只能听到外面隔了一层布的声音。

“不是这只……”

最后大约是交谈了十多分钟，事情的原委才算是清楚了，大叔也明白意思了，不过他还是道：

“那这只小鸟会不会有心理问题啊？在上一人那里受了欺负。”

小虎皮在鸟包里探头探脑的，伸出喙在透明壳上叨了一下，歪头看外面的人。

“这个我……”

宋郁其实并不太清楚，他有些担心任务上的适配人是不是完全对的，毕竟这个小虎皮不是幼鸟，也有过前主人，即使是受到嫌弃也是正常的。

但此刻大叔却说：“那乐乐以后要好好照顾小鸟啊。”

鸟包放在地上，大叔正抱着女儿蹲了下来，用外套给自己孩子挡风，让她看小鸟。

“爸爸，彩色的，好看。”

白粼粼此刻在挎包里安安分分的，听到这话歪了歪鸟头，低头看自己的翅根。

蓝的也好看的！

后面的事情就很顺利了，大叔坚持要给一百块钱，推拒不得宋郁就接受了，不过顺便把提前准备的棉花娃娃礼物送出去了。

任务完成了。

历时不到两天。

一人一鸟找了个隐蔽的角落，翻出来了那个小木牌，上面的信息果然全部消失了，出现了一个红色的勾。

白粼粼虽然在这件事上没有出什么力，但还是很高兴的，用鸟头拱了一下人的下巴。

“啾啾！”

宋郁侧眸看了过来，也很温和地道：

“我们回家。”

-
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 29 (Part 1)

Song Yu’s chin was tilted slightly upward, his lips parted as he panted softly. His hands remained frozen in midair, half-raised.

He couldn't tell if he was supposed to push the bird away or not.

His face was flushed red from the heavy weight crushing down on him, sending blood rushing to his cheeks. His usually cold, distant eyes held a rare trace of flustered helplessness.

Perhaps the commotion had been a bit too loud, disturbing the little bird resting on his chest. The round head shifted, snuggling deeper into the crook of Song Yu’s neck.

“……”

Song Yu thought about it for a moment, then decided to lie still.

Straining to lift his arm, he gently stroked the bird’s soft feathers, his voice barely audible:

“Go to sleep.”

The little bird’s plumage was dry and warm, carrying a natural, faint scent of sweet grain. As Song Yu stroked the feathers, he unconsciously leaned closer...

***

Bai Linlin was sleeping like a log. In his dream, he seemed to have returned to his small rented room, tightly hugging the little teddy bear he had kept ever since his days at the orphanage.

He loved it dearly, holding it tightly in his arms.

It had been a long time since Bai Linlin last dreamt of the past. In that dimly lit, warm room, he slept deeply and peacefully. In his hazy state, he felt as though he had forgotten something, yet he simply kept nuzzling against his plush toy.

*Would the director miss him?*

*What about the teachers? And all his younger 'brothers and sisters'...?*

The bird was immensely attached, snuggling with deeper and deeper devotion—until the other corner of the bed completely collapsed.

*CRASH.*

“……”

Bai Linlin snapped awake. Shocked, he scrambled his massive body back and looked down.

The human beneath him was crushed so hard his face was beet red, wheezing for breath, his collar completely disheveled.

*What... what did the bird just do?!*

Song Yu had actually acted on reflex to shield the giant bird’s head, only realizing a moment later that it probably hadn't been necessary. But now—

“You’re awake?”

The moment Song Yu asked the question, the giant bird on top of him seemed to snap out of its daze. Extending its wing-joints, it frantically scrambled off the bed, rushed to the corner of the room, and stood there facing the wall.

Bai Linlin’s face was burning with shame.

The bird felt guilty. The bird felt deeply unsettled.

Song Yu propped himself up on his elbow to look over, his brows knitting slightly. *Is he angry?*

Ignoring the ruined mess behind him, Song Yu got up, casually picked up the "Stabilizer" off the floor, and walked over to the bird. He said with utmost sincerity, "It’s because the bed was bad quality. It was very old."

"It’s my fault."

Bai Linlin actually agreed, but he still shuffled his claws together, feeling thoroughly embarrassed.

"Are you hungry?"

The bird’s head snapped toward him instinctively.

*Is it time to eat?!*

Only then did Song Yu’s expression soften. He reached out his hand, finally meeting the bird's gaze.

"It’s okay, alright?"

"I’ll have someone bring a new one."

Bai Linlin froze. Then, moving his claws, he affectionately leaned his massive bird head against Song Yu, completely oblivious to the fact that the force almost knocked the young man off his feet.

A giant bird acting like a delicate maiden.

***

In the end, they called a furniture store to deliver a brand-new solid rosewood bed. However, the installation workers couldn't help but feel a little baffled as they set it up...

*Last time, the study desk broke.*

*This time, the bed broke.*

*Is this household really that wild?*

The worker couldn't help but steal a few extra glances at Song Yu, though he quickly dismissed his own wild thoughts. The young man didn't look like he had a partner at all.

Someone keeping pets usually didn't have time for that sort of thing anyway.

Still, unable to curb his curiosity, the worker asked, "...How exactly did this break?"

"I don't mean anything by it, but I’ve honestly never seen a bed destroyed so thoroughly. Even a three-hundred-pound guy wouldn't cause this..."

The bird: “……”

Song Yu coughed a few times, at a total loss for how to explain. Fortunately, his phone rang just in time.

Taking the opportunity to step outside, he went to answer the call, leaving the bird behind in the bedroom to supervise the construction.

The caller was Auntie. The background sounded quite noisy, with people bustling about.

"Little Song, I found them! The moment I brought it up, the girl's father remembered you and even asked about your situation."

"Lele matched with a donor! She’s already been transferred to a general ward."

"If you're free today..."

Song Yu hadn't expected things to move so quickly. He immediately replied, "Auntie, I’ll head over right now."

Fifteen minutes later, the new bedroom bed was fully installed—an exceptionally sturdy piece of craft.

After seeing the workers off, Song Yu closed the bedroom door and instructed the bird to turn big and test it out.

This custom-made bed was massive and wide, with a plush mattress. The bird hesitated slightly.

"Will I break it if I step on it?" Bai Linlin asked, though he had already tentatively stretched a claw out, looking quite refined and regal.

"You won't," Song Yu said with complete seriousness. "The previous one was just very old. If Linlin hadn't come, I wouldn't have had the chance to replace it."

Fortunately, this new bed was remarkably sturdy and didn't budge an inch. Restoring his confidence, the bird quickly shrank back to his miniature form and flew up onto Song Yu’s shoulder.

"I think the quality is good," the bird inspector pronounced. "It should be real rosewood."

With that, they prepared to head out, bringing along the bird carrier to pick up Qiuqiu from next door. The little parakeet was in much better spirits now.

Song Yu hailed a ride on his phone, arriving at the subway entrance of Nan City First People’s Hospital fifteen minutes later.

Sure enough, the middle-aged man from before was standing there. He still carried a warm, approachable aura, holding his daughter and chatting softly. Seeing Song Yu approach, his face lit up. "It really is you, kid."

Song Yu walked over quickly, his breathing slightly uneven. His eyes naturally fell upon the pale little girl, who looked to be around five or six years old.

She was hugging her father’s neck, looking a bit shy and scared.

"My name is Song Yu. I didn't get a chance to introduce myself last time. Auntie mentioned..."

The uncle gave a warm smile. "She told me, she told me! At first, I thought a client was coming to the hospital to look for me for repairs. I had no idea it was about this."

"I really haven't bought a parrot yet. After all, the kid’s been staying in the hospital lately..."

The little girl pressed her cheek against her father’s, not quite understanding why this stranger was here. But right at that moment, her eyes caught sight of the shoulder bag.

The zippered pocket was bulging, as if something inside was moving.

"Yes, because I happened to rescue a little parrot. It has nowhere to go right now, and some of the adopters weren't very suitable..."

"Then I’m really grateful. After all, we aren't even acquaintances..."

While the adults were conversing, the bird inside the bag was summoning all its strength for a squeeze. Soon, a round bird head popped out from the zipper of the black shoulder bag.

Bai Linlin looked around, spotted the little girl, and tilted his head.

"Chirp chirp?"

Song Yu glanced down, saw the bird peeking out, and immediately pressed his hand against the bird's head, shoving it back inside. Bai Linlin’s vision plunged into darkness; he could only hear the muffled voice from outside through the layer of fabric.

"Not this one..."

After about ten minutes of conversation, the full story was finally clarified, and the uncle understood the situation completely. Still, he asked with concern, "Will this little bird have any behavioral issues? Since it was mistreated by its previous owner."

Inside the bird carrier, the little parakeet poked its head around, tapping its beak against the transparent plastic shell as it tilted its head to look at the people outside.

"That, I..."

Song Yu wasn't entirely sure. He was somewhat worried whether the task's matched adopter was truly a perfect fit. After all, this little parakeet wasn't a baby bird and had already belonged to a previous owner; even if it harbored some wariness, it would be entirely normal.

But right then, the uncle turned to his daughter and said, "Then Lele has to take really good care of the little bird from now on, okay?"

The uncle squatted down with his daughter beside the bird carrier, using his jacket to shield her from the wind as he encouraged her to look at the bird.

"Daddy, it’s colorful! So pretty!"

Inside the shoulder bag, Bai Linlin had been behaving himself. Hearing those words, he tilted his bird head and looked down at his own wings.

*Blue is very pretty too!*

Everything went smoothly after that. The uncle insisted on giving Song Yu a hundred yuan as a fee. Unable to refuse, Song Yu accepted it, but presented the cotton plush doll he had prepared in advance as a gift for the little girl.

The task was complete—taking less than two days in total.

The young man and the bird found a secluded corner to pull out the small wooden token. Sure enough, all the text on it had vanished, replaced by a bright red checkmark.

Although Bai Linlin hadn't contributed much to this task, he was still thrilled. He nudged Song Yu’s chin enthusiastically with his head.

"Chirp chirp!"

Song Yu looked over, his eyes exceptionally gentle. "Let's go home."

chunks.chineseText:
管理局培训的时间是在周末，一般开门是午夜，要错开人类的高峰期。

宋郁一直在准备东西，毕竟它的小鸟上次只是报道，这次要去培训，或多或少是要交际的。

他想了想，还是要给其他的小妖怪带点东西，打好关系。

一楼的餐桌上摆满了吃的，剥壳的坚果、百香果味的酸奶、玉米肠、抹茶味奥利奥……

但这些都不是人带的。

是鸟坚持不懈从厨房的零食柜里叼出来的。

宋郁从楼上下来的时候就看到了满桌子的东西，他蹙了蹙眉，觉得这太重了，刚想制止，但就在这时门铃响了。

白粼粼还在桌子上用爪子清点数量，这个这个这个……应该能收七八个小弟吧？

那带的越多，岂不是小弟越多？

鸟又转了个身子，打算再去叼……

但就在刚起飞的时候，被一股神秘力量控制住了，爪子在半空中徒劳地蹬了下。

宋郁把鸟放到另一侧，顺带把外卖放到了桌上，是加麻加辣的烧烤，还额外点了生菜和葱，老板送了点小饼和酱料，很齐全了。

白粼粼站在大理石桌子上，愣了下，他给忘了，不过也没事，反正人记着的。

香气飘飘……

鸟啪嗒啪嗒地走了过去，仰头悄咪咪地看了下人，很好，在看手机。

白粼粼一个趁其不备，低头就要——

被虎口卡住鸟头了。

宋郁蹙眉看了下信息，面色微冷，因为短信是宋启明发过来的。

[小郁，是爸爸亏待你了，原谅爸爸好不好。]

[你爷爷说的对，我是无能，不是个好父亲……]

后面一堆废话。

宋郁一看就知道他是喝多了，把手机给按灭了。

他的手指传来一股痒痒的触感，低头看，鸟正在爪子蹬着手指，一个劲地拔鸟头。

“……”

宋郁松开了，鸟一个用力，啪唧坐在了餐桌上，仰头看过来，神色有些拽拽的。

“不能吃这个，你不是要给朋友的么？”

白粼粼本来是想要反驳什么的，但是后面又觉得有损风度，算了，本来想偷偷啃一口的。

鸟一个弹跳站了起来，收了收翅膀，假装无事发生地走开。

不吃就不吃。

宋郁虽说是不让带这么多，但是他想了想毕竟是第一次去那里培训，也就还是拿了包，把桌上的东西装进去了。

坚果，放进去。

酸奶，放进去。

玉米肠，放进去。

卫龙辣条，放……

宋郁侧眸看了过去，发现正在不遗余力地叼新的东西塞包里。

一趟接一趟的。

“……”

白粼粼没过一会就把包塞满了，站在零食尖尖上仰头看人。

鸟眼圆圆。

僵持。

宋郁：“好吧。”

鸟大获全胜。

-

最后出门是开车去的，是请的代驾，宋郁在前段时间已经完全恢复了自由用家里资源的能力。

无非是调一辆车。

很简单的事。

“遂安区xx小区。”

司机缓缓启动了车子，不过他还是好奇地看了下车内后视镜：

一个相貌优越的少年，肩头一只肥鸟，另一侧是一大包零食，至于为什么能确定是零食，主要是因为果冻掉出来了，那只鸟还兢兢业业地往里塞……

午夜，很诡异就是说。

大约二十分钟后。

车子抵达了目的地，司机手机很快就收到了钱，比预计的多了五十，是打赏。

他不由得又问了后座：

“待会还回去吗？我下半夜还接单。”

“不了，谢谢。”

司机只好遗憾地走了。

车内只剩下人和鸟了，宋郁这才侧头嘱咐道：

“管理局的人说了，培训的话我去是不合适的，别的妖怪也不带监护人的，你自己可以吗？”

“我在门口等你。”

鸟点了点头，还挥了下翅膀。

没问题.jpg

宋郁眉眼温和了些，他本来打算下车去送一下的，但是被鸟拒绝了。

“我自己下去吧。”

“上次就被那群小妖怪说了，我才不是巨婴！”

宋郁闻言没什么反应，只是眉目冷了冷，不过还是问：

“那你能拿得动这个包么？”

“很重。”

白粼粼丝毫没有察觉到什么潜台词，只是非常灵巧地站在宋郁的手背上，催促人给自己开车门。

等到打开了。

鸟用爪子把稳定器拿了下来，立马开始变大，很轻松地就叼走了那袋子零食。

“……”

宋郁抿了抿唇，刚想要说走得慢一些，鸟已经转头了，摇摇摆摆的，像个小企鹅。

人是一直看着鸟进门之后才收了目光。

宋郁不知道怎么了，心情有些不好，不过就在这时电话来了，他低头一看直接关机了。

-

与此同时。

宋启明正在S州医院的心理科外徘徊，他这几天都状态不好，倒不是说是被老爷子打的……

主要还是心理问题。

他整个人颓废不堪，眼底乌青一片，只是低头看了看手机，还是没接。

宋启明其实本来也没抱太大指望，他儿子只会觉得他有病。

可是。

可是……

就在这时，一个护士前来提醒轮到他了，宋启明这才进了问诊室。

对面是一个金发碧眼的心理咨询师，本来还是很惬意地喝下午茶，但看到一张亚洲面孔的时候，立马坐直了。

“先生……”

心理咨询师试探地询问道：

“你遇到了什么问题？”

她脑中闪过了一系列网上说的亚洲原生家庭伤痛，已经做好充分的心理准备。

“我一直做噩梦，我睡不好。”

心理咨询师放松警惕，噢，那还好。

但下一秒。

“我的梦里总有一只身高将近两米的巨鸟，它总是日夜不停地追我，用翅膀扇我……”

心理咨询师：“……”
