The bird got straight to the point: "Go like my post."

***

In the adjacent room.

A tiny sparrow was perched on the table, holding a wooden skewer with its claws, its beak completely smeared with sauce. Hearing the demand over the phone, it tilted its head.

It didn't quite understand.

In the end, the other side gave up on explaining, simply stating: "Come to my room."

001 naturally shifted into its human form, standing by the table with the skewer still pinched in its hand, before diligently eating the last piece of meat.

It had originally intended to head straight over to find 247. However, at that exact moment, the windowpane vibrated in a rhythmic pattern. The youth in black tilted his head slightly, spotting a surge of golden threads dozens of meters away.

A notification from the Bureau.

He raised a hand and swiped sideways. A floating, shimmering golden screen appeared before him, displaying the Red-crowned Crane on the other end.

The Crane asked, "The system shows the mission is complete. How did 247 perform?"

001 replied, "Excellently."

The Crane was sitting in his office screen-side, clearly working overtime. Hearing this, he narrowed his avian eyes suspiciously, "Really?"

001 stated flatly, "Truly excellent."

The Crane grunted, "Cut the nonsense. Tell me honestly how the mission was completed, and whether it impacted public opinion in human society."

"Did you explain the Bureau's regulations to it?"

The black-clothed youth maintained an impassive expression: "It won't cause any public backlash. The background check showed that the human had been caught secretly filming female passengers on the subway four times, earned five thousand yuan reselling pornographic materials on campus, received three disciplinary actions for cheating, and was finally expelled for disguising himself as a dorm manager to infiltrate the female dormitories."

"Bureau 749 always manages to locate these humans... how strange."

Knowing the conversation was straying, the Crane didn't dwell on it, simply lecturing without raising his head, "This is a city, after all—the main domain of humans. Naturally, the screening of individuals on the Gray List must go through their hands, just as the list of demons must go through ours."

chunks.chineseText:
“记得把章程告诉247，对了，还没和我说怎么完成的？它怎么行动的？”

空气一时安静了下。

001有些犹豫，但最后还是如实地说了，具体内容是：

“247……先膨大……起到一个震慑的作用……掀起阵阵劲风……任务目标惊恐万分……最后晕厥。”

丹顶鹤：“……”

也、也行。

丹顶鹤本来是想要直接收了视讯的，但是刚一抬头，看到了黑衣少年身后的装潢。

这什么地方？

“你去哪了001？”

黑衣少年闻言一愣，然后砰得一下变成小雀，半空中的妖力屏幕为了照到对象，只能视角往下。

丹顶鹤的屏幕里只剩下地板了。

“……”

这001，越来越像247了。

丹顶鹤摇摇头，最后也没说什么，只是要求道：

“让它好好的学习，最近749局的人到处巡视，少出去闲逛……”

最后那块浮在半空中的波纹屏幕消失了，房间里安安静静的，地板上的灰棕色小雀松了一口气，然后才啪嗒啪嗒地朝着门口走去。

-

白粼粼已经等了好长时间了，他本来都打算去隔壁找001了，扑棱翅膀从床上下来，啪嗒啪嗒地走到门口，刚用爪子扒拉开一个门缝，一个灰棕色的鸟头就拱了进来。

成功会面。

“过来过来。”

蓝羽小鸟说完就朝着里面走，对着门外的那只小雀挥了挥翅膀。

“快看我发的vlog！”

白粼粼说完这话就扑棱翅膀飞到了桌上，用爪子推了推手机，示意对方过来看。

灰棕色小雀低着鸟头仔细看，伸着爪子尝试去碰屏幕，但是又悬着，觉得有点新奇……

白粼粼啪嗒啪嗒绕着小雀走了几步，歪头去看反应，鸟眼圆圆的。

震惊了吧！

不过就在这时，001好奇地问：

“怎么没有你的监护人？”

白粼粼咳咳了两下，很认真地解释道：

“不行，他是人类，他不能露脸。”

“我们是鸟，鸟无所谓的。”

001不理解，蓬了蓬毛，问：

“为什么？”

白粼粼想了想，又补充道：“我们如果化形了，最好也不要放到社交媒体上。”

001有些困惑，化形成人类的模样也是不能在网上露脸的？

桌上蓝羽小鸟很是认真地教导，啪嗒啪嗒地来回走，以二十三年的做人经验告诉它：

“人类很会扒人类的信息的，你放一张照片，无论配文如何，总会有神经病找茬的。”

“所以最好不要发照片。”

001泡完温泉浑身都很舒服，又蓬了蓬毛，身子下压，胸前得羽毛把爪子盖住了，它很认真地听讲。

“但我们是鸟的话，就完全不同了！”

蓝羽小鸟此刻神采奕奕，开始高谈阔论：

“鸟，会飞但可以选择不飞。”

“鸟，可以穿衣服也可以不穿。”

“鸟，可以抽风也可以安静。”

001不太懂。

但247好像很开心的样子。

“你知道这是什么吗？”

蓝羽小鸟啪嗒啪嗒走过来，很是挺胸抬头地道。

001：“是什么？”

“自由！”

-

包厢。

“妖怪修行的法子你知道吗？”

这么几个问题下来，宋郁拿着橘子的手微微用力了点。

他不知道。

道士见状只是摇摇头，随后又从桌上拿了冰可乐喝了一口，然后才道：

“在历史上的典籍里，妖怪修成人形是相当不易的，一般就两条路子，要么积德行善，要么吃人。”

“所以话本里怎么讲，既有狐狸报恩书生这样的痴情桥段，又有妖怪作祟、全家殒命的剧情。”

宋郁面色平静，只是在听着。

“发展到现在，它们愈发开智了，甚至出现了妖怪管理局，别说，办得是有模有样，甚至它们可以同人类一起协作行动。”

道士说到这里，眯了眯眼，对着少年道：

“你是不是觉得妖怪很好？”

“至少从我说到现在。”

宋郁抬眸看了过去，不太明白意思，但还是讲了自己的想法：

“生命是平等的。”

道士闻言直接一噎，心想这孩子还真是正，和峥国一个样子，从军的时候自己干粮不够了还会喂一些瘦骨嶙峋的野猫。

“对，这没错。”

老头只是叹了口气，最后也不绕弯子了，直接道：

“我是想让你在信任妖怪的同时，也要知道它们客观存在的‘危险’。”

“A级妖怪其实就是化形，目前的数量已经不少了，这其实还比较好管理，因为大多数都是像南市这种有监护人的小型妖怪。”

“但真正可怕的是S级和S级以上的，它们会幻化成各种各样形态，你想一想，你的亲人、朋友……甚至上司，可能是个非人之物。”

“还会拟声、制造幻觉……你知道我们749局处理的都是些什么事件吗？”

宋郁修长的手指转了下掌心的柑橘，只是抬起眼眸道：

“管理局的妖怪没有去帮你们么？”

“……”

这话一出，又一阵沉默。

道士突然觉得口有些干，咳嗽了几下，然后抬手去拿冰可乐，但是低头一看，全是冰块了。

“这这……”

老头又给放回去了，最后才回复道：

“是，确实是来帮的。”

宋郁语气很平和地道：

“那它们不是可怕，是强大。”

道士：“……”

他就不信了。

老头双手放在膝盖上，深吸一口气，最后看向旁边的少年，伸出手指道：

“那总有一个事情你得注意点。”

“这个是管理局的S级妖怪……或者说你认为的好妖怪都会做的事。”

宋郁捏着那个柑橘，转了一圈，面色还是古井无波。

“它们上了S级的妖怪，就不再把人类当成监护人了，而是将其视为择偶的对象。”

宋郁愣了下。

道士见终于有反应了，立马乘胜追击，站在道德制高点上抨击：

“它们妖怪为了一己私欲，甚至会强迫人类同他们一起所谓的‘修行’，这实际上是个骗局！”

宋郁侧头看了过来，暗沉的眼眸里微微动了下，问：

“什么意思？”

道士这下终于挺直腰板了，这孩子果然是反应过来了，他神清气爽的，摆了摆手道：

“孩子我一会儿慢慢和你讲，它们真的是太过分了，我得去和喝个水，口有些干……”

面前的少年直接起身了，拿起来杯子就道：

“我来。”

-

而此刻房间里两只小鸟正齐齐趴在桌面上，爪子往后伸着，探头探脑地看着手机屏幕。

“你不觉得我整的视频很好吗？”

001歪了歪鸟头，闻言很认真地道：

“非常好。”

蓝羽小鸟用翅膀托着鸟头，很不明白地道：

“那怎么不是爆款呢？”

“都没几条评论。”

001只是学着伸出来翅膀，用前面飞羽撑着鸟头，发觉很是舒服……

它是怎么发明的？
chunks.englishText:
"Remember to pass the protocols on to 247. Oh, and you still haven't told me how it was completed. How did it act?"

The air fell silent for a moment.

001 hesitated slightly, but in the end, it truthfully recounted the specifics:

"247... first expanded... serving a deterrent effect... whipping up gusts of wind... the target was terrified out of their wits... and finally fainted."

The Red-crowned Crane: "..."

Well, that... that worked too.

The Red-crowned Crane had originally intended to cut the video call right then and there, but as it looked up, it caught sight of the interior decoration behind the black-haired youth.

What kind of place was this?

"Where did you go, 001?"

Hearing this, the black-haired youth froze, then with a *poof* turned into a little sparrow. To keep the subject in frame, the magical energy screen in mid-air could only tilt its perspective downward.

The Red-crowned Crane's screen was left with nothing but the floor.

"..."

This 001 was acting more and more like 247.

The Red-crowned Crane shook its head and didn't press further, only demanding:

"Make sure it studies properly. Personnel from the 749 Bureau have been patrolling everywhere lately, so tell it to roam around less..."

With that, the rippling screen floating in the mid-air vanished. The room fell quiet once more. The grey-brown sparrow on the floor let out a sigh of relief, then *patter-patter* trotted toward the door.

-

Bai Linlin had been waiting for a long time. He had originally planned to go next door to find 001. Flapping his wings, he hopped down from the bed, *patter-patter* walked to the door, and just as he used his claws to pry open a crack in the door, a grey-brown bird head poked right in.

A successful rendezvous.

"Come over, come over."

After saying this, the blue-feathered little bird waddled back inside, waving a wing at the sparrow outside the door.

"Quickly, look at my vlog!"

Having said that, Bai Linlin flapped his wings and flew onto the table, using his claws to nudge the phone, signaling the other to come look.

The grey-brown sparrow lowered its bird head to examine it closely, extending a claw to tentatively touch the screen, but then hovered it in mid-air, feeling rather intrigued...

Bai Linlin *patter-patter* circled the sparrow a few times, tilting his head to observe its reaction, his bird eyes round.

Shocked, weren't you!

Just at that moment, however, 001 asked curiously:

"Where is your guardian?"

Bai Linlin coughed a couple of times and explained very earnestly:

"No, he's a human. He can't show his face."

"We're birds, so it doesn't matter for us."

001 didn't understand. It fluffed up its feathers and asked:

"Why?"

Bai Linlin thought for a moment, then added, "Even if we transform into human forms, it's best not to post ourselves on social media."

001 was somewhat perplexed. You couldn't show your face online even after transforming into a human's appearance?

On the table, the blue-feathered little bird gave a very earnest lecture, pacing back and forth with a *patter-patter*, imparting twenty-three years of human-living experience:

"Humans are exceptionally good at digging up other humans' information. No matter how nice the caption is, if you post a photo, some lunatic will always find something to pick on."

"So it's best not to post photos."

001 felt completely relaxed all over after soaking in the hot spring. It fluffed its feathers again, lowered its body so that the feathers on its chest covered its paws, and listened intently to the lecture.

"But if we're birds, it's completely different!"

At this moment, the blue-feathered little bird was full of spirit and began to expound grandly:

"A bird can fly, but can choose not to fly."

"A bird can wear clothes, or choose not to wear any."

"A bird can act crazy, or stay quiet."

001 didn't quite understand.

Yet 247 seemed thoroughly delighted.

"Do you know what this is?"

The blue-feathered little bird *patter-patter* trotted over and stated quite proudly, puffing out its chest.

001: "What is it?"

"Freedom!"

-

In the private dining booth.

"Do you know the methods by which spirits and demons cultivate?"

After several such questions, Song Yu applied a little extra pressure to the tangerine in his hand.

He did not know.

Seeing this, the Daoist priest merely shook his head, picked up a can of iced cola from the table to take a sip, and then said:

"According to historical texts, it is exceptionally difficult for spirits to cultivate into human form. Generally, there are only two paths: either accumulate virtue and perform good deeds, or eat humans."

"That's why folktales are told the way they are—you have affectionate tropes of foxes repaying the kindness of scholars, alongside plots of demons wreaking havoc and destroying entire families."

Song Yu's expression remained calm as he simply listened.

"As time has evolved, they have grown increasingly enlightened, even giving rise to a Spirit Management Bureau. And let me tell you, it's run quite professionally; they can even collaborate and take action alongside humans."

At this point, the Daoist priest narrowed his eyes and addressed the youth:

"Do you think demons are wonderful?"

"At least from what I've told you so far."

Song Yu raised his eyes to look over, not entirely catching the implication, but still voiced his own thoughts:

"All lives are equal."

Hearing this, the Daoist priest choked on his breath, thinking to himself that this kid really was upright. He was cut from the same cloth as old man Zheng; when he was in the military and his own rations ran low, he would still feed skinny, starving stray cats.

"Right, that's true enough."

The old man merely sighed and stopped beating around the bush, cutting straight to the chase:

"What I want is for you to trust demons, but at the same time, recognize the 'danger' they objectively pose."

"Grade A demons are essentially those who have attained human form. Their numbers are already quite significant now, though they are actually easier to manage because most of them are small-scale demons with guardians, just like the one in Nanshi."

"But what's truly terrifying are Grade S and above. They can morph into all sorts of forms. Just think about it—your relatives, friends... even your boss, might be a non-human entity."

"They can also mimic voices and create hallucinations... Do you have any idea what kind of cases our 749 Bureau handles?"

Song Yu twirled the tangerine in his palm with his slender fingers, merely lifting his eyes to ask:

"Didn't the demons from the Bureau help you?"

"..."

As soon as these words left his mouth, another silence descended.

The Daoist priest suddenly felt his mouth go a bit dry. He coughed a couple of times, then raised a hand to grab his iced cola, only to look down and find it reduced entirely to floating ice cubes.

"This, this..."

The old man put it back down, finally replying:

"Yes, they do come to help."

Song Yu said in a very even tone:

"Then they aren't terrifying. They're powerful."

The Daoist priest: "..."

He refused to believe this.

Resting both hands on his knees, the old man took a deep breath, looked at the youth beside him, and pointed a finger as he said:

"Well, there's at least one thing you must watch out for."

"This is something Grade S demons from the Bureau—or rather, the 'good demons' you think so highly of—will all do."

Song Yu squeezed the tangerine, rolling it around, his expression as unruffled as an ancient, still well.

"Once they reach Grade S, they no longer treat humans as guardians. Instead, they view them as prospective mates."

Song Yu froze.

Seeing that he finally had a reaction, the Daoist priest immediately pressed his advantage, launching an attack from the moral high ground:

"Those demons, driven by selfish desires, will even coerce humans into undergoing so-called 'cultivation' with them. It's actually a scam!"

Song Yu turned his head to look over, a slight ripple stirring in his dark, heavy eyes as he asked:

"What do you mean?"

Only then did the Daoist priest straighten his back. The kid had finally caught on! Feeling refreshed, he waved a hand and said:

"Kid, I'll explain it to you slowly in a moment. They are truly going too far. I need to go get some water; my throat feels a bit dry..."

The youth sitting before him stood up immediately, picked up a cup, and said:

"I'll get it."

-

Meanwhile, back in the room, the two little birds were sprawled flat side-by-side on the table, stretching their claws backward and peeking curiously at the phone screen.

"Don't you think the video I put together is fantastic?"

001 tilted its bird head, and upon hearing this, answered very earnestly:

"Fantastic."

Supporting its bird head with a wing, the blue-feathered little bird asked with utter bewilderment:

"Then why isn't it a viral hit?"

"There are hardly any comments."

001 merely learned to extend its wing, using its primary remiges to prop up its head, and found it quite comfortable...

How had it ever invented this posture?

chunks.chineseText:
鸟类休息一般都是站着的，把羽毛蓬松起来，爪子收进去就算完事。

从来没有这么趴着过。

001鸟眼亮亮的，愈发仰望旁边的蓝羽小鸟了，身子往旁边挤了挤。

“欸！”

“又多了一条评论，快过来看快过来看。”

白粼粼立马伸翅膀招呼旁边的小鸟，然后用喙戳了下那个评论区，很是期待。

最好是“真好看”、“太有品了”、“没见过这么潮流的小鸟”之类的话。

鸟爪子在后面晃了晃。

但是刚一打开——

那个评论是一个官号，前缀是南市动物园……后面是闲云野鹤。

发的内容是：

[247 001？]

两个小鸟五雷轰顶，尤其是那只蓝羽的，直接弹跳站起来了，啪嗒啪嗒来回走，喃喃道：

“怎么可能？再怎么巧也不至于……”

“坏了。”

001懵懵的，也跟着站了起来，伸了伸翅膀，摇了摇鸟头。

白粼粼闭了闭鸟眼，想起来是怎么回事了，宋郁给丹顶鹤送了手机，那里面是带着电话卡，而他的手机里……好巧不巧是存了这个号码的。

可恶的软件！

谁让你推荐给通讯录的妖了！

-

那边小鸡急得团团转，这边人还在继续打探。

“人类可以修行？什么是骗局？”

宋郁刚把水杯递过去，就直接地问了。

道士本来要喝上一口的，但是为了说话就又放下了，很是义正词严地道：

“人类是可以修行，但从来都不会长生，顶多只是寿元长一些，但也不会超得太多。”

“之所以说是骗局，那是因为妖怪它们一旦看中某个人类，就绝不更换目标，即使那个人类已经成家结婚，它也要等到离婚，这完全就是捕猎的姿态。”

“对于人类寿命短暂的情况，它们会强制地……同化。”

宋郁手指微微勾了下。

道士还在继续：

“具体它们怎么操作的，我们不太清楚，但是一般这种和S级妖怪绑定的人类基本上是完全失了神智的，他们的立场会偏向于妖怪，这完全就是昏了头的么！一成伴侣就……”

道士一回头，发现个特殊例子。

这还不是伴侣就——

老头皱了皱眉，于是决定从另外一个角度去切入：

“说是跟着一起修行，其实上只是妖怪的一厢情愿，它们会把妖力硬生生地过渡到人类的身上，不管是否能够承受得住，根据749局的一些档案显示，这些人类的血液样本和普通人都不一样了……体检都会是问题。”

“并且他们会变得异常占有欲高，这相当不正常。”

宋郁听了一些，只是道：

“好像没有坏处。”

道士红温了。

“这怎么可能？他们会直接和妖怪同生共死，一辈子保持容貌年轻，亲人、父母、朋友……一个个地远去，只有妖怪陪伴在身边。”

“会逐步脱离人类社会的！”

宋郁垂着眼眸，道：

“确实很可怕。”

-

房间里两只小鸟还在看着手机屏幕，既不敢删除，也不敢回复。

但就在这时，白粼粼脑子突然转起来了，直接道：

“这是丹顶鹤的号？”

001羽毛蓬松，站在旁边，点了点鸟头，补充道：

“听说是的，它的饲养员会每天发一些它的视频，打扮得很漂亮的。”

白粼粼：！

两个小鸟立马挤在一块偷偷看丹顶鹤的视频号了，主要是看一下那个饲养员长什么样子。

视频大多是一些日常，都是很亲昵的互动，只有零星几个露脸的画面。

白粼粼：“鼻梁挺高。”

“但好像没宋郁高。”

001歪了歪鸟头。

“眼睛也挺好看的。”

“他没有红痣哎。”

001：“……”

反正最后是看了将近半小时的视频，一直等到了门把手拧动的声音，宋郁回来了。

灰棕色小雀非常熟练地扑棱翅膀飞了起来，停在了门口的位置，仰头看了下这个人类，似乎是在观察。

宋郁低头：“……”

小雀啪嗒啪嗒地走出门了，然后回头看了下房间里的蓝羽小鸟，模仿着上次新学的眨眼。

一爪子把门踹上了。

白粼粼：？

房间里这回只剩下一人一鸟了。

“宋郁！”

桌面上的蓝羽小鸟扑棱翅膀飞了起来，但在要靠近的时候，自然而然地变成了一个少年，快步地跑了过来。

白粼粼到了跟前就低头去拿对方手里的提子，但是手腕被反手扣住了，他懵了下，直到上方传来声音：

“还没有洗。”

宋郁垂眸看着“人”，盯着那个唇瓣，它一张一合，就要抱怨了。

“我的错。”

白粼粼愣住了，连带着眼睛都变得圆圆的，这……这不要搞得他很坏的样子。

“少年”往后走了两步，但手腕又被硬生生地拉过来了。

“我去给你洗，好不好？”

白粼粼心想这有什么好通知的，但还是矜持地点了点头。

然后他就被牵到了桌子边，没来得及反应就被单手抱了上去，白粼粼整个人都僵了一下，手放在宋郁的肩头，面色有些泛红。

“……你不要老是。”

“橘子吃吗？”

白粼粼：“吃。”

人照旧给鸟剥着，放到干净的纸巾上，果肉上的白丝都剔干净了。

“我去洗提子，坐在这里，嗯？”

白粼粼抽空点了点头，把橘子瓣放进了嘴巴里，又满意了，晃了晃腿。

宋郁起身去房间里的小厨房的时候，其实抽空看了下手机的回复，那只侏儒兔回消息回得很慢。

他看了下。

果不其然好几条短的语音。

[左边的是提子。]

一分钟后。

[难道是错的？]

[那我选右边。]

三分钟后。

[还是错的？]

[我选左边。]

就这么纠结了很久，大约有半个钟头，宋郁看到后直接回复了句:

[正确。]

本来已经过了好长时间，但是那边却像是一直看着手机一样，立马就发过来了消息：

[当然，我们妖怪很聪明的！]

宋郁后面只是把提子洗了，拿着盘子回去了，心里隐隐约约有个猜想。

-

最后在温泉山庄待了大约有三天，之后就返程了，不过在上高速的时候出了点状况。

导航显示前面的桥断了。

外面的雨水下得很大，劈里啪啦的，两只小鸟趴在车窗里面，好奇地看来看去，宋郁在服务区和爷爷通电话：

“没事，粼粼状态很好。”

鸟闻言扑棱翅膀飞了过来，很有精神地叫了一声：

“啾！”

电话那头才放心了些，只是说了现在的情况：

“南市也在下雨，气温突然变了，冰雹雨，估摸着是连着好几天，路况恐怕不好，要不找个不在雨带的城市歇脚几天吧。”

“安全第一。”

宋郁只是单手扶着方向盘，蹙眉问：

“那您在家可以吗？”

“怎么不可以？家里一切都好。”
chunks.englishText:
Birds generally rested while standing upright, fluffing up their feathers and tucking their claws away to call it a day.

They had never sprawled out flat like this before.

001's bird eyes shone brightly. Its admiration for the blue-feathered little bird beside it grew even deeper, and it nudged its body a bit closer.

"Hey!"

"Another comment just came in! Come quick, come look."

Bai Linlin immediately stretched out a wing to summon the little bird beside him, then used his beak to poke at the comment section, full of eager anticipation.

Ideally, it would be comments like "So pretty," "Exquisite taste," or "I've never seen such a trendy little bird."

His bird claws waved in the background.

However, the moment he opened it—

The comment was from an official account. The prefix was Nanshi Zoo... followed by Leisurely Clouds and Wild Cranes.

The content posted was:

[247? 001?]

Both little birds felt as though they had been struck by lightning, especially the blue-feathered one, which sprang straight up into the air, *patter-pattered* back and forth, and muttered:

"How is this possible? No matter how much of a coincidence, it shouldn't..."

"We're doomed."

001 looked bewildered. It stood up as well, stretched its wings, and shook its bird head.

Bai Linlin closed his bird eyes tight as he remembered what had happened: Song Yu had given the Red-crowned Crane a smartphone, preloaded with a phone card, and on his own phone... through sheer malicious coincidence, he had this exact number saved.

Curses upon this software!

Who asked you to sync recommendations with contacts' demons?!

-

While the little chick was pacing back and forth in a frantic panic over there, the human here was continuing his probing inquiries.

"Humans can cultivate? What kind of scam is this?"

As soon as Song Yu handed over the water glass, he posed the direct question.

The Daoist priest had been about to take a sip, but set the cup back down in order to speak, striking a very righteous and stern pose:

"Humans can indeed cultivate, but they can never attain immortality. At most, their lifespans are extended, but they still won't exceed the limit by too much."

"The reason I call it a scam is because once a demon sets its sights on a particular human, it will never change its target. Even if that human is already married with a family, the demon will wait until they divorce. This is entirely the posture of a predator."

"As for the issue of human lifespans being short, they will forcibly... assimilate them."

Song Yu's fingers curled slightly.

The Daoist priest continued:

"We aren't entirely clear on the specifics of how they pull this off, but generally speaking, humans bound to Grade S demons completely lose their minds. Their loyalties lean toward the demon—they're completely out of their depth! Once they become partners..."

The Daoist priest turned around and caught sight of a rather peculiar living example.

This kid wasn't even a partner yet, and already—

The old man frowned and decided to approach it from a different angle:

"They call it cultivating together, but in truth, it's entirely the demon's wishful thinking. They will forcibly channel their demonic energy into the human body, regardless of whether the human can bear it. According to some case files from the 749 Bureau, the blood samples of these humans are completely different from ordinary people's... even routine medical check-ups become a problem."

"Moreover, they develop an exceptionally high sense of possession, which is completely abnormal."

Having heard this much, Song Yu merely remarked:

"Sounds like there are no disadvantages."

The Daoist priest turned beet red.

"How can that be possible? They live and die together with the demon, maintaining a youthful appearance for a lifetime, while relatives, parents, and friends... drift away one by one, leaving only the demon to keep them company."

"They gradually become completely alienated from human society!"

Dropping his gaze, Song Yu said:

"It does sound rather terrifying."

-

Back in the room, the two little birds were still staring at the phone screen, daring neither to delete the comment nor to reply.

At that moment, however, Bai Linlin's brain suddenly whirred into gear. He blurted out:

"Is this the Red-crowned Crane's account?"

001 stood nearby with fluffed-up feathers, bobbed its bird head, and added:

"I heard it is. Its zookeeper posts videos of it every day, and it's dressed up quite prettily."

Bai Linlin: !

The two little birds immediately huddled together to sneak a peek at the Red-crowned Crane's video blog, focusing primarily on what the zookeeper looked like.

Most of the videos were daily routines featuring deeply affectionate interactions, with only a scattering of frames showing a face.

Bai Linlin: "The bridge of his nose is quite high."

"But it doesn't seem as high as Song Yu's." 001 tilted its bird head.

"His eyes are quite nice-looking, too."

"He doesn't have a red mole, though."

001: "..."

In any case, they ended up watching the videos for nearly half an hour, right up until the sound of a doorknob turning signaled that Song Yu had returned.

The grey-brown sparrow practicedly and smoothly flapped its wings, taking flight to land right by the doorway. It tilted its head up to study the human, seeming to observe him.

Song Yu lowered his gaze: "..."

The little sparrow *patter-pattered* out the door, then turned back to look at the blue-feathered little bird inside the room, mimicking the newly learned wink from before.

With a single paw, it kicked the door shut.

Bai Linlin: ?

Now, the room was left with only one human and one bird.

"Song Yu!"

The blue-feathered little bird on the table flapped its wings to fly up, but as he neared, he instinctively transformed into a youth and hurried over.

Just as Bai Linlin reached him and lowered his head to grab a green grape from the other's hand, his wrist was suddenly caught in a reverse grip. He froze in bewilderment until a voice came from above:

"You haven't washed them yet."

Song Yu lowered his gaze to look at the "human," staring at those lips parting and closing as if about to complain.

"My fault."

Bai Linlin was stunned, his eyes rounding into circles. This... this wasn't fair, making it look like he was the unreasonable one!

The "youth" took two steps backward, but his wrist was firmly pulled right back along with him.

"I'll go wash them for you. How's that?"

Bai Linlin thought to himself, *Why on earth do you need to report this to me?* But he still nodded with dignified restraint.

Then, before he could react, he was led over to the table and picked up with one hand to be set upon it. Bai Linlin stiffened all over, resting his hand on Song Yu's shoulder, his face blushing slightly.

"...Stop always doing..."

"Do you want a tangerine?"

Bai Linlin: "Yes."

As usual, the human peeled it for the bird, placing the segments onto a clean tissue after carefully pulling away all the bitter white pith.

"I'm going to wash the grapes. Sit right here, okay?"

Taking advantage of a moment's break, Bai Linlin nodded, popped a tangerine segment into his mouth, and felt instantly content, swinging his legs back and forth.

When Song Yu got up to head to the small kitchenette in the room, he actually took a moment to check his phone replies. That dwarf rabbit was replying to messages terribly slowly.

He took a look.

Sure enough, there were several short voice messages.

[The grapes are on the left.]

A minute later.

[Could it be wrong?]

[Then I choose the right.]

Three minutes later.

[Still wrong?]

[I'll pick the left.]

After stewing in such indecision for a long time—about half an hour—Song Yu saw it and replied directly:

[Correct.]

Even though quite a bit of time had passed, the person on the other end seemed to have been staring at their phone the entire time, instantly firing back a message:

[Of course, we demons are very smart!]

After that, Song Yu simply washed the grapes, picked up the plate, and headed back, a faint, hidden guess forming in his heart.

-

They ended up staying at the hot spring resort for about three days before setting off on the return journey. However, they ran into a bit of trouble when getting onto the highway.

The navigation system showed that the bridge ahead was broken.

The rain outside was pouring heavily, pattering down relentlessly. The two little birds pressed their heads against the car windows, looking around curiously while Song Yu spoke to his grandfather on the phone from the rest stop:

"It's fine, Linlin is in great condition."

Hearing this, the bird flapped its wings and flew over, chirping spiritedly:

"Chirp!"

Only then did the person on the other end of the line relax slightly, though he shared the current situation:

"Nanshi is raining too, and the temperature has plummeted—it's a freezing hail storm. It's expected to last several days, and road conditions are likely terrible. Why don't you find a city outside the rain belt to rest for a few days?"

"Safety first."

Steering the wheel with one hand, Song Yu furrowed his brow and asked:

"Will you be alright at home?"

"How could I not be? Everything is fine at home."

chunks.chineseText:
人还在打电话交流着，鸟闲得没事干，于是就歪头梳理羽毛了，兢兢业业的。

直到——

“应该会绕道桐城，那里离得很近，到时候也方便直接回南市……”

白粼粼的动作顿了一下。
chunks.englishText:
While the human was still conversing on the phone, the bird had nothing better to do, so it tilted its head and began preening its feathers, working with utmost diligence and dedication.

Until—

"We should be able to detour through Tongcheng. It's quite close from there, and it will be convenient to head straight back to Nanshi when the time comes..."

Bai Linlin's movements abruptly paused.

chunks.chineseText:
第46章

车子很快就抵达了桐城，宋郁找了个规格不错的酒店，照样是开了两个房间，不过当时前台是有些困惑的，在处理的时候提醒了下：
　　“先生，一个人订两个房间是可以的，但是如果有第二人入住的话，麻烦您让您的朋友前来登记信息。”
　　宋郁只是面色平和地道：
　　“我一个人。”
　　最后还是很顺利地来了房间，001毛绒绒的，下了地就化成少年模样，看向对面的监护人，伸出双手。
　　面无表情的。
　　宋郁：“……”
　　但是他还是把房卡递了过去，顺便交代了下：
　　“走廊还是有监控的，你还是稍微——”
　　砰！
　　地面上多了只叼着房卡的小雀，啪嗒啪嗒地朝着门口走，很是不在意地朝着身后的人挥了挥翅膀。
　　全然一幅“不必多言”的样子。
　　-
　　001拱开酒店的门，圆滚滚的脑袋从缝隙里探出来，它看了看走廊尽头的摄像头。
　　眯了眯鸟眼。
　　周遭有流动着的金纹，已经慢慢成了形……
　　但就在这时——
　　“桐城其实还不错，风景挺好的，要我说来这里养老也可以。”
　　“是啊是啊。”
　　一堆人走了过去。
　　浩浩荡荡的，无一人注意到地板上的小雀。
　　001鸟头下压：“……”
　　一秒，两秒。
　　最后走廊里多了一只贴着墙根走的小雀，喙里还叼着房卡，一摇一摆的。
　　……
　　与此同时，房间里面的一人一鸟正在收拾东西。
　　确切地来说，是人在单方面地收拾东西，鸟站在行李箱边的锁扣上监工。
　　白粼粼其实在想事情，他环顾了下四周，又看了看窗外……
　　这里居然也有桐城。
　　他其实之前都没有想过这些事，毕竟自己是个孤儿，读完大学刚工作一年就挂了，这说出去实在不好听，或许都没有人给他收……
　　这怎么这么emo呢？
　　白粼粼不由得想要伸爪子刨地板，但是他忘记了自己站在行李箱的边沿处，于是一个用力过猛，翅膀开始扑棱——
　　宋郁很适时地递过去了手指，鸟爪稳稳地扣住了，沉甸甸的。
　　“怎么了？从下车之后就闷闷的？”
　　“不高兴，要讲。”
　　白粼粼闻言收了收翅膀，心想这是不能说的秘密，怎么可能轻而易举地说出来。
　　不讲不讲。
　　他试图收回来自己的鸟爪，但就在这时，爪子被一个指腹压住了。
　　鸟：？
　　白粼粼震惊，仰着鸟头就看过去了，但对上的就是个垂着眼眸看着他的少年，没有什么大的表情，只是专注，暗色的瞳孔里只倒映出了一只蓝羽小鸟。
　　“啾啾！”
　　白粼粼生气了，一下子那点emo情绪都消散了，开始蓄力往后拉，鸟头低着，全然进了状态。
　　拔河ing。
　　双方准备就位。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 46

The car quickly arrived in Tongcheng. Song Yu found a fairly decent hotel and, per usual, booked two rooms. However, the front desk clerk looked somewhat puzzled at the time and offered a polite reminder during the processing:
　　"Sir, it's fine for one person to book two rooms, but if there is a second guest checking in, please have your friend come over to register their information."
　　Song Yu merely replied with a calm expression:
　　"Just me."
　　In the end, he reached the room without a hitch. As soon as fluffy 001 touched the floor, it transformed into the shape of a youth and looked over at its guardian opposite, extending both hands.
　　Utterly expressionless.
　　Song Yu: "..."
　　Still, he handed over the room card, taking the opportunity to instruct:
　　"There are still surveillance cameras in the hallway, so you should probably—"
　　*Bang!*
　　A little sparrow with a room card in its beak now occupied the floor, *patter-pattering* its way toward the door, casually waving a wing back at the person behind it.
　The picture of a "no need for further words" attitude.
　　-
　　001 nudged open the hotel door, poking its round head out through the crack to inspect the security camera at the far end of the corridor.
　　It narrowed its bird eyes.
　　Flowing golden patterns rippled in the surrounding air, slowly forming shape...
　　Just at that moment, however—
　　"Tongcheng is actually not bad at all, the scenery is quite nice. If you ask me, coming here to retire wouldn't be bad either."
　　"Yeah, yeah."
　　A group of people walked past.
　　Swarming right through in a mighty procession, not a single one of them noticed the little sparrow on the floor.
　　001 lowered its bird head: "..."
　　One second, two seconds.
　　By the time they passed, there was simply a little sparrow hugging the base of the wall, waddling along with the room card clamped firmly in its beak.
　　……
　　Meanwhile, inside the room, the human and the bird were packing their things.
　　To be precise, the human was unilaterally packing things, while the bird stood guard on the edge of the suitcase lock.
　　Actually, Bai Linlin was lost in thought. He surveyed his surroundings, then glanced out the window...
　　To think there was also a Tongcheng here.
　　He hadn't really thought about such things before. After all, he had been an orphan, kicking the bucket just a year after graduating college and starting work. Saying it out loud sounded truly miserable; perhaps no one would have even collected his remains...
　　Why on earth was he feeling so emo all of a sudden?
　　Involuntary, Bai Linlin felt an urge to scratch at the floorboards with his claws. However, he forgot that he was standing right on the edge of the suitcase lid, and with one overly forceful movement, his wings began to flap wildly—
　　With perfect timing, Song Yu extended a finger, and the bird's claws gripped it firmly, feeling heavy and solid.
　　"What's wrong? You've been so glum ever since we got out of the car."
　　"If you're unhappy, you need to talk about it."
　　Hearing this, Bai Linlin pulled back his wings, thinking to himself that this was a secret that could never be told—how could he possibly blurt it out so easily?
　　I won't tell, I won't tell.
　　He tried to retract his bird claws, but at that exact instant, his toes were pinned down by a pad of a thumb.
　　Bird: ?
　　Shocked, Bai Linlin tilted his bird head up to look, only to meet the gaze of the youth looking down at him. The youth wore no grand expression, only deep focus, his dark pupils reflecting solely the image of a blue-feathered little bird.
　　"Chirp chirp!"
　　Bai Linlin grew angry. In an instant, all those emo feelings evaporated. He dug his heels in and pulled backward with all his might, lowering his bird head as he went into full combat mode.
　　Tug-of-war *ing*.
　　Both parties prepared in position.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第一回合，鸟开始先往前站了站身子，然后一个用力往后墩墩，身上的羽毛都蓬松了一圈。
chunks.chineseText: 第一回合，鸟开始先往前站了站身子，然后一个用力往后墩墩，身上的羽毛都蓬松了一圈。
chunks.englishText: Round One: The Bird Takes a Step Forward First, Then Bumps Backward with All Its Might, Fluffing Its Feathers Out in a Full Circle.

chunks.chineseText:
第二回合，鸟开始……

人类弃权，松开了手。

白粼粼一下子因为惯性往后倒去，但宋郁已经伸出来手了，托得稳稳当当，鸟来了个后空翻，懵懵的。

只是仰头看着人。

“粼粼如果什么都和我讲就好了。”

宋郁只是很温和地道。

-

浴室里有着水流的声音，房间里的“少年”坐在行李箱上，伸着长腿拿着一个耙耙柑在吃，唇瓣都弄得湿漉漉的。

白粼粼在走神。

就是不能讲的，这怎么能讲？

他现在是妖怪。

他不是人了。

他只是一个小鸟。

宋郁养的小鸟而已。

白粼粼再三给自己肯定了下，然后低头看了看自己的手，人手……

妖怪其实是不错的。

“少年”把果皮放到了一旁，很认真地回顾了下自己前半生，从桐城的孤儿院里出来，上公立小学，公立中学，然后考上京市一所中等211的院校，报考已经走下坡路的计算机专业。

上班……死了。

白粼粼想到这里，很生气地侧了下头，如果再给他一次生命他也不要上班了，他宁可去乡下种地！

分明就是压榨，明晃晃地打压！

不就是因为他没有父母！

白粼粼想到这里就很憋屈，他后来就那么被创死了，也不知道那个丧良心的公司倒闭了没有。

还有那些神经病的老板和同事……

“少年”咬了咬唇，低着头，总觉得难受，或许是“故地重游”，尽管有可能只是“重名”，但是他还是——

从孤儿院走出来上大学的时候，老师同他说要好好念书，争取之后找好工作，再也不要回桐城看他们。

可是。

白粼粼歪了歪头，有些郁闷地扯了扯自己的衣服角，可是他英年早逝，二十三岁就没了，老师们肯定会觉得他丢人的吧？

他其实没有父母之类的感情，有的只是对孤儿院的眷恋，毕竟连名字都是那里的老师取得……

很想，回去看一看。

这里的桐城……万一是自己曾经生活过的桐城呢？

白粼粼不由得看了看窗外。

-

宋郁从浴室里出来的时候，看到的就是窗台上站着一只圆滚滚的小鸟，很专注地眺望远方。

“……”

宋郁蹙了蹙眉，抬步走了过去，抬手把他的小鸟拿了起来，放到了自己的肩头。

“不冷么？有风。”

鸟其实还没太反应过来就站在了人的肩头，伸了伸翅膀，很认真地道：

“不冷的。”

宋郁闻言只是唇角微微向上抿了下，轻声道：

“好。”

“但我们刚才过来的时候淋了些雨，要去洗澡么？”

白粼粼爪子站得稳稳当当的，点了点鸟头，最后一人一鸟去了浴室，里面的水蒸气很多，烟雾缭绕的。

蓝羽小鸟犹如个毛球在人的掌心一个劲地翻腾，非常认真与专注。

爪子都使了点劲。

——他是个小鸟。

——他是个小鸟。

——他是个小鸟。

白粼粼低着鸟头，开始进行一番自我开悟，以前的事是过往云烟了……不要再去确定什么了。

-

而与此同时，001正在隔壁房间吃烤串，用爪子把着签子，鸟头一左一右地来回挪动，把肥瘦相间的牛肉都给炫掉了。

吃完这个，又开始吃烤虾。

灰棕色小雀忙忙碌碌的，一个爪子在桌面上啪嗒啪嗒地敲着，有种淡淡的幸福感。

不过就在这时——

窗外又传来熟悉的震动感，有金线从很远的地方涌动过来……

001这次很警觉，立马把串串放下，规规矩矩地在地板上站好，用翅膀一挥。

面前再度多了一个金纹流动着的屏幕，里面是面无表情的丹顶鹤，质问道：

“001。”

“你们两个是出去做任务，还是出去郊游？”

“我发了评论当没看到是吧？”

地板上的小雀喙上还有蘸料，很拘谨地收了收翅膀，有些不知所措。

但好在是对面也没有为难什么，只是问了一件事：

“749局上次来的那个专员，根据妖力追踪来看，是去了一个温泉度假山庄，别和我装了，视频都显示位置了。老实和我说，有没有碰见他？”

001闻言愣了下，它化成了人形的模样，很是认真地摇了摇头，回复道：

“我和247没有遇见。”

丹顶鹤在屏幕里面似乎是思索了下，喃喃地说了几句“那应该是没有威胁”之类的话，最后才重新看了过来，说起来了别的事：

“247毕竟还没有成年，你作为指导，还是多多看顾一下。”

“另外，它的监护人曾经反映过它睡着的时候会自己化形成人类的事，这应该是妖力不稳的缘故，但当时我没空处理这件事，这次正好你在，好好的观察一下。”

地面上的灰棕色小雀一愣，提出了自己的困惑：

“这怎么观察？”

丹顶鹤：“247睡着的时候观察啊。”

“它和它监护人一起睡觉。”

丹顶鹤喝茶的动作一顿，眯了眯鸟眼。

噢，是么？

-

浴室。

蓝羽小鸟此刻正站在洗手台面上，张着肉色的短喙在咬袭击的劲风，爪子分明已经很用力地抓地了，但还是在均匀地往两侧滑开。

宋郁在抬手给他的小鸟吹风，用手指微微抵住了那个圆滚滚的身躯，好让它不被吹跑。

“好了。”

电吹风被关上了，放在了一旁，宋郁抬手伸了下手指。

白粼粼很是从善如流地上来了。

桐城这里虽然是没有下暴雨，但是外面还是有淅淅沥沥的小雨的，基本白天是出不去的，宋郁就带着他的小鸟去了桌子那里，拉开了椅子，像他们在家里的卧室那样。

“不开心的话，要不要买东西？”

少年侧了侧头，看着旁边的小鸟，很温和地建议道。

白粼粼歪了歪头，其实不太明白宋郁为什么能看出来他的情绪变化，其实也没有不开心……

鸟扑棱翅膀下来了，站在了桌子上，仰头看着人。

白粼粼其实在想，要不要和宋郁说一声，他出去一趟？

他去看看那个孤儿院还在不在……

有点挣扎。

“可以和我讲的。”

“怎么了？”

对方的声音简直像是蛊惑一样，白粼粼甚至控制不住往前走了一步，羽毛蓬松。

宋郁只是道：“粼粼。”

“相信我好吗？”

心理防线降至最低，最后——

“我……我不开心是因为……”

白粼粼几乎都要说出来了，但是爪子一不小心踩到了手机，那种凉凉的触感一下子让鸟精神了。

不行！

不行不行不行！

白粼粼硬生生地把话转了个弯，说道：“是因为我的账号……没人点赞……”

宋郁愣了下，他并不知道这件事。

十分钟后。

蓝发“少年”站在地板上，一只手很自然地搭在宋郁的肩头，另外一只手在打开手机屏幕。

app打开，切到“我的主页”，里面只有一个视频。
chunks.englishText:
Round two: the bird starts...

The human forfeited and let go.

Bai Linlin tumbled backward from the inertia, but Song Yu had already extended his hand, catching him with perfect stability. The bird turned a backflip in midair, completely bewildered.

He just looked up at the human with a dazed expression.

"It would be nice if Linlin told me everything," Song Yu said very gently.

-

In the bathroom, the sound of running water echoed. In the main room, the "youth" sat on top of the suitcase, stretching out his long legs while eating a Baba mandarin orange, his lips glistening wet.

Bai Linlin was lost in thought.

He simply couldn't tell him—how on earth could he?

He was a demon beast now.

He wasn't human anymore.

He was just a little bird.

Just Song Yu's little bird.

Bai Linlin reaffirmed this to himself again and again, then lowered his head to look at his hands... human hands...

Being a demon beast wasn't so bad, actually.

The "youth" placed the fruit peel to the side and seriously reflected on the first half of his life. Leaving the orphanage in Tongcity, attending a public elementary school, a public middle school, then getting admitted to a mid-tier 211 university in Capital City to major in computer science—a field already on the decline.

Then working... and dying.

When Bai Linlin thought of this, he jerked his head aside in annoyance. If he were given another life, he would never work a day job again; he'd rather go to the countryside to farm!

It was pure exploitation, blatant oppression!

Just because he had no parents!

Bai Linlin felt deeply aggrieved thinking about it. He had been rammed to death by a car just like that. He didn't even know if that heartless company had gone bankrupt yet.

And those psychotic bosses and colleagues...

The "youth" bit his lip and lowered his head, feeling miserable inside. Perhaps it was because he was "revisiting an old place," even if it might just be a city sharing the same name. Still, he couldn't help but—

When he had stepped out of the orphanage to go to university, the teachers told him to study hard, strive to land a good job, and never come back to Tongcity to see them again.

And yet.

Bai Linlin tilted his head, tugging at the corner of his clothes in frustration. But he had died young at twenty-three. His teachers would surely think he was an embarrassment, wouldn't they?

He didn't really have feelings toward parents or family; all he had was an attachment to the orphanage. After all, even his name was given to him by the teachers there...

He really wanted to go back and take a look.

What if this Tongcity... was the same Tongcity he used to live in?

Bai Linlin couldn't help looking out the window.

-

When Song Yu stepped out of the bathroom, what met his eyes was a round little bird standing on the window sill, gazing intently into the distance.

"..."

Song Yu knit his brows slightly, walked over, and lifted his little bird, placing it on his shoulder.

"Isn't it cold? There's a breeze."

The bird hadn't quite realized what was happening before it was already perched on the man's shoulder. Stretching its wings, it said very earnestly:

"It's not cold."

Hearing this, the corners of Song Yu's lips curled up slightly, and he murmured softly:

"Alright."

"But we got caught in a little rain on the way over. Shall we take a bath?"

Bai Linlin stood firmly on his claws and nodded his little bird head. In the end, one person and one bird went into the bathroom, where thick steam curled and swirled in the air.

The blue-feathered bird was like a pom-pom, tumbling incessantly in the man's palm with intense focus and dedication.

His claws even exerted a bit of force.

—He was a little bird.

—He was a little bird.

—He was a little bird.

Lowering his bird head, Bai Linlin began a round of self-enlightenment. The past was like scattered clouds and fading smoke... no need to go looking for answers anymore.

-

Meanwhile, in the neighboring room, 001 was eating barbecue skewers. Holding the stick with its claws, its bird head shifted left and right as it devoured all the marbled beef.

After finishing that, it started on the grilled shrimp.

The small grey-brown sparrow was busily occupied, tapping one claw on the table with a subtle sense of bliss.

Just then—

A familiar vibration rippled from outside the window, and golden threads surged over from a great distance...

This time, 001 was on high alert. It immediately set down its skewer, stood neatly on the floor, and waved a wing.

Before it appeared a screen glowing with swirling golden runes. On it stood a red-crowned crane with an expressionless face, demanding:

"001."

"Are you two out on a mission or out on a picnic?"

"You saw my comments and pretended not to, didn't you?"

The little sparrow on the floor still had sauce on its beak. It tightly drew in its wings, feeling quite flustered and at a loss.

Fortunately, the other party didn't make things difficult for it. He merely asked about one thing:

"According to demon power tracking, that special investigator from Bureau 749 who came last time went to a hot spring resort. Don't play dumb with me—the video showed the location. Tell me honestly, did you run into him?"

001 froze upon hearing this. Transforming into human form, it shook its head very seriously and replied:

"247 and I didn't meet him."

The red-crowned crane seemed to ponder inside the screen, muttering a few words like "Then there shouldn't be any threat," before looking back and bringing up another matter:

"After all, 247 hasn't reached adulthood yet. As its mentor, you should keep a closer eye on it."

"In addition, its guardian once reported that it occasionally transforms into a human in its sleep. This is likely due to unstable demon power. At the time, I didn't have time to address it, but since you're there now, observe it carefully."

The grey-brown sparrow on the floor was taken aback and voiced its confusion:

"How do I observe that?"

Red-crowned crane: "Observe 247 while it sleeps, of course."

"It sleeps with its guardian."

The crane paused mid-sip of its tea and narrowed its bird eyes.

Oh? Is that so?

-

In the bathroom.

The blue-feathered bird was currently perched on the sink counter, its short flesh-pink beak snapping at the strong wind blowing at it. Though its claws were clutching the surface with all their strength, it was still sliding outward evenly to both sides.

Song Yu raised his hand and used a hairdryer to dry his little bird, lightly propping up that round little body with a finger so it wouldn't be blown away.

"All done."

The hairdryer was switched off and set aside. Song Yu extended a finger.

Bai Linlin smoothly hopped on.

Although it wasn't pouring in Tongcity, a gentle drizzle still pattered outside, making it impossible to go out during the day. Song Yu took his little bird to the desk, pulled out a chair, just like they used to do in their bedroom at home.

"If you're feeling down, do you want to buy some things?"

The youth tilted his head slightly, looking at the little bird beside him, making a very gentle suggestion.

Bai Linlin tilted his head. He didn't quite understand how Song Yu could tell his mood had changed. He wasn't really feeling down...

Flapping its wings, the bird hopped down onto the desk and looked up at the man.

Bai Linlin was actually wondering if he should tell Song Yu that he wanted to go out for a bit.

To see if that orphanage was still there...

He felt a bit conflicted.

"You can tell me."

"What's wrong?"

The man's voice sounded almost alluring. Bai Linlin couldn't even control himself from taking a step forward, his feathers fluffing up.

Song Yu simply said, "Linlin."

"Trust me, okay?"

With his mental defenses dropping to their lowest, finally—

"I... I'm unhappy because..."

Bai Linlin almost blurted it out, but his claw accidentally stepped on a smartphone. The cold touch instantly snapped the bird back to its senses.

No!

No, no, no!

Bai Linlin forced his words to take a sharp turn: "It's because... nobody liked my post!"

Song Yu was stunned for a moment; he hadn't known about this.

Ten minutes later.

The blue-haired "youth" stood on the floor, one hand casually resting on Song Yu's shoulder while the other unlocked the phone screen.

He opened the app and switched to "My Profile," where there was only a single video.

chunks.chineseText:
白粼粼一开始的确是为了找个借口，但后面就真的有点郁闷了，伸着纤长的手指道：

“都没有多少人给我点赞。”

“我觉得我弄得很好了。”

宋郁抬手把那个手机拿了起来，垂眸看到了那个昵称，不由得轻笑了下。

[粼粼大王]

白粼粼一下子就不高兴了，这怎么还笑他？他抬手就要去拿回来自己的手机，但是宋郁往旁边一挪，没够到。

鸟生气了。

眼睛圆圆地看着椅子上的人。

白粼粼按着宋郁的肩头，在接力，身子就往那边倾，抬手执着地去抢，闷闷地道：

“给我。”

“宋郁！”

语气瓮声瓮气的。

宋郁垂着眼眸，看着那个距离很近的耳垂，一时半会走了神，以至于手自动地往前挪了下，让“少年”够到了。

但白粼粼拿到了重心也不稳了，直接栽下去了，眼看着肘关节就要磕到椅子扶手了……

腰被稳稳地托着了，白粼粼像是被挂住了，他懵懵的，刚像侧头看过去，但身子像是被转了下。

宋郁很自然地抬手用力，把“少年”揽到了自己怀里，放在腿上，用手臂围着，完全无视那个目光，抬手把“少年”手里的手机给抽了出来。

“啊……”

白粼粼几乎发出了点气音，想要去阻止，但是看到宋郁在眉目认真地单手打开了那个视频后，又默默地安静了下来。

扁了扁唇。

等到人看完了，鸟才开始控诉：

“我剪辑的是不是很好！”

“你看我和001的照片，不好看吗？”

宋郁就这么坐着，看着那个侧脸逐步向自己靠近，脸颊上的绒毛都看得到。

“好看。”

“很好看。”

白粼粼得到了肯定很是满意，抬了抬下巴，然后转头看向了宋郁，但就在目光交汇的一瞬间，对方微微垂了眼眸。

“因为这个不开心？”

宋郁托着“少年”的腰，问了问。

“对！”

宋郁闻言只是觉得可爱，不过想到什么，才抬眼看了过去，眉眼有些微微舒展。

“为什么没有我，粼粼。”

“只有你的朋友么？”

白粼粼愣了下，这怎么和001问一样的问题，他只好又把先前的理论说了一遍。

宋郁理解了下：“是为了保护我？”

白粼粼：“……”

“少年”歪了歪头，他觉得哪里不对，但是又说不上来，宋郁的确不露面比较好的，他是华秉的独孙……再加上母亲之前在文娱那里工作，总归是不好的……

这么说，好像也没错。

“唔。”

白粼粼想了想，点头了。

鸟很心细的，不用夸奖。

“只是因为这个不开心？”

宋郁抬眸问了问，语调沉稳自然。

“……是。”

宋郁抬手操作了下，投进去将近五万块，之后就把手机放下了，很温和地道：

“会有流量的，会有很多人给粼粼点赞。”

“少年”眼睛亮了亮，抬手就想要去拿手机去看数据，但是手腕被扣住了。

宋郁只是问：

“心情好些了么？”

-

下午的时候，外面天气还是很阴，白粼粼在床上打游戏，用的宋郁的手机。

毕竟他再注册新号还要过新手教程，很不划算的，更何况宋郁的里面几乎是全皮肤。

不用白不用。

“少年”其实换了件衣服的，藏蓝色的棉质长袖，盖住半个手背，很暖和。

宋郁则是在桌子那里看笔记本电脑，基本上全是一些数据图和折线图，全部是华秉的一些内部信息。

氛围倒是很安静。

白粼粼许久没有这样用手打过游戏了，窝在床边，身子靠着枕头，舒舒服服的……

他甚至有种回到过去的感觉。

就是有点渴了。

白粼粼一边目光专注地看着手机页面，一边抬手去床头那里摸索，但是碰到了个微凉的手指。

“啊？”

宋郁已经把杯子拿走了，换成了温水，然后才递了过来，不是对着手，而是直接抵到了唇边。

白粼粼刚刚还在等待“复活”，现在已经活了，他很认真地在操作，打算等“死”了再去喝水。

但是他的下巴被扳回来了。

“嗯……”

“我现在不渴了，我忙着——”

宋郁抬手把那个手机抽了出来，抬手就直接接管了，在把杯子递给床上的“人”之后，就是开始双手去操作了。

白粼粼一下子眼睛变亮了，拿着杯子就开始喝水，唇瓣被润得湿湿的，凑过去看手机页面。

一杀。

二杀。

三杀。

……

团灭。

白粼粼一下子高兴了起来，本来是逆风的，现在直接推塔到高地了，他不自觉地抬手搭在了宋郁的肩头，相当专注。

直到胜利！

好好好。

白粼粼一点也没有被代打的羞耻感，全然欣赏着自己的MVP，宋郁只是替他完成了最后一击而已。

“开心了？”

“昂。”

白粼粼仰头看着人，眼睛亮亮，浅蓝色的发尾有个自然的弯儿，活像是橱窗里的娃娃。

宋郁心里泛起一阵涟漪，最后只是道：

“那粼粼高兴了的话。”

“能不能告诉我一些事？”

-

隔壁房间。

001在说完那句话后，丹顶鹤的脸上就出现了谜一样的笑容，然后咳咳了几声，开始道：

“那据你的观察……这个监护人怎么样？”

001思考了下：

“有钱。”

丹顶鹤微微颔首。

“长得很好。”

丹顶鹤也很赞同。

“对247很好。”

丹顶鹤心想同道中妖，只是对着屏幕里的灰棕色小雀道：

“所以，你得出了什么结论？”

001毛绒绒，其实有点茫然，但还是很斟酌地回答道：

“247的监护人……是个高级的人类？”

丹顶鹤直接一拍翅膀，板上钉钉地道：

“没错！”

然后下一句——

“所以，你一定要看住247，让它务必在成年之前到了S级，然后立即让它深度绑定它的监护人，不能让对方给跑了……”

001的目光从茫然，到恍惚，最后到坚定。

没错。

要让247拿下这个人类。

-

房间里。

“少年”往床后面缩了下，很警觉的样子，想问什么？

白粼粼不知道自己这副样子其实很“此地无银三百两”，但好在是对方没太在意，只是坐在了床边，问：

“为什么非要到S级？”

宋郁语气很正常，像是从没和那道士谈过话一样，很有求知欲地问：

“S级和其他级的妖怪有什么不同？”

“粼粼做任务不是很辛苦吗？”

白粼粼愣了下，没想到是说这个的，他一下子放松了，只是顺着本心道：

“S级可以做很多事……反正我就是要变成S级！”

宋郁只是伸过来了手。

仿佛被某种底层代码给控住了，白粼粼很自觉地伸过去了手，但反应过来已经晚了，对方握住他的腕骨就是一拉，硬生生给带到身边去了。

“粼粼这么上进，我也要上进。”
chunks.englishText:
At first, Bai Linlin really had just been looking for an excuse, but later on, he genuinely felt a bit sullen. Extending a slender finger, he said:

"Not many people gave me likes at all."

"I think I edited it really well."

Song Yu raised his hand to pick up the phone. When his gaze fell on the nickname, he couldn't help but let out a soft chuckle.

[King Linlin]

Bai Linlin instantly grew displeased. Why was he laughing at him? He reached out to snatch his phone back, but Song Yu shifted to the side, causing him to miss.

The bird was angry.

His round eyes glared at the man sitting on the chair.

Pressing his hand on Song Yu's shoulder for leverage, Bai Linlin leaned his body over, persistently reaching out to grab it, muttering sulkily:

"Give it to me."

"Song Yu!"

His tone was muffled and aggrieved.

Song Yu lowered his eyes, looking at the earlobe in close proximity, drifting off for a moment. As a result, his hand automatically moved forward, allowing the "youth" to reach it.

However, once Bai Linlin got it, he lost his center of gravity and tumbled straight down, his elbow on the verge of banging into the armrest of the chair...

His waist was caught in a firm support. Bai Linlin felt as if he were suspended in midair, bewildered. He was about to turn his head to look, but his body was spun around.

Song Yu naturally exerted force with his arm, pulling the "youth" into his embrace and setting him on his lap, encircling him with his arm. Completely ignoring that gaze, he raised his hand and slipped the phone out of the "youth's" hand.

"Ah..."

Bai Linlin let out a tiny breath, wanting to stop him. But seeing Song Yu open the video with one hand, his expression serious and focused, he silently quieted down.

He pursed his lips.

Once the man finished watching, the bird began its grievance:

"Didn't I edit it really well?!"

"Look at the photos of me and 001—don't they look good?"

Song Yu sat there, watching the profile of his face gradually draw closer to his own, until even the soft peach fuzz on his cheek was visible.

"They look good."

"Very good."

Obtaining validation, Bai Linlin was thoroughly satisfied. He raised his chin, then turned his head to look at Song Yu. But the moment their gazes met, the other man slightly lowered his eyes.

"You were unhappy because of this?"

Song Yu held the "youth's" waist and asked softly.

"Yes!"

Song Yu found it cute upon hearing this. But remembering something, he looked up, his brow relaxing slightly.

"Why am I not in it, Linlin?"

"Is it only your friends?"

Bai Linlin froze. Why was he asking the exact same question as 001? He had no choice but to repeat his previous logic.

Song Yu pondered for a moment: "To protect me?"

Bai Linlin: "..."

The "youth" tilted his head. He felt something wasn't quite right, but couldn't put his finger on it. It really was better for Song Yu not to show his face. He was the only grandson of Huabing... plus his mother used to work in the entertainment industry, so showing his face wouldn't be good...

Put that way, it didn't seem wrong.

"Mm."

Bai Linlin thought about it and nodded.

Birds were very thoughtful; no need to praise him.

"You were unhappy just because of this?"

Song Yu looked up and asked, his tone steady and natural.

"...Yes."

Song Yu tapped the screen a few times, putting in nearly fifty thousand yuan to boost the post, then set the phone down, saying very gently:

"It will get traffic now. Many people will give Linlin likes."

The "youth's" eyes lit up, and he reached out to grab the phone to check the stats, but his wrist was held fast.

Song Yu merely asked:

"Feeling better now?"

-

In the afternoon, the weather outside remained overcast. Bai Linlin was lying on the bed playing games on Song Yu's phone.

After all, if he registered a new account, he'd have to go through the beginner tutorial again, which wasn't worth it. Besides, Song Yu's account had almost all the skins unlocked.

Might as well use it.

The "youth" had actually changed his clothes into a dark blue cotton long-sleeved shirt that covered half the back of his hands, looking very cozy and warm.

Meanwhile, Song Yu was at the desk looking at his laptop, which was mostly filled with data charts and line graphs—all internal information regarding Huabing.

The atmosphere was quiet and peaceful.

It had been a long time since Bai Linlin had played a game with human hands like this. Snuggled by the bed, leaning against the pillow, he felt comfortable and relaxed...

He even felt a sense of returning to the past.

He was just a bit thirsty.

While keeping his eyes glued to the phone screen, Bai Linlin reached out toward the nightstand to feel around, but his fingers brushed against a slightly cool hand.

"Ah?"

Song Yu had already taken the cup away, refilled it with warm water, and handed it back—not to his hand, but directly against his lips.

Bai Linlin had been waiting to "respawn" just a moment ago, but now he was alive again. He was operating his character with intense focus, intending to drink water after he "died."

However, his chin was gently turned back.

"Mm..."

"I'm not thirsty right now, I'm busy—"

Song Yu reached out, took the phone away, and directly took over the game. After handing the water cup to the "person" on the bed, he began playing with both hands.

Bai Linlin's eyes instantly sparkled. Holding the cup, he began taking sips of water, his lips becoming glistening and moist. He leaned over to look at the screen.

First kill.

Double kill.

Triple kill.

...

Aced!

Bai Linlin was instantly delighted. They had been at a disadvantage earlier, but now they had pushed all the way to the enemy base. Unconsciously, he rested his hand on Song Yu's shoulder, utterly engrossed.

Until victory!

Nice, nice, nice!

Bai Linlin felt not a shred of shame over having someone play for him, fully admiring his MVP title. Song Yu had merely landed the final blow for him.

"Happy now?"

"Mm-hmm."

Bai Linlin looked up at him, his eyes glowing bright, the ends of his light-blue hair curving naturally like a doll in a display window.

A ripple stirred in Song Yu's heart, but in the end he merely said:

"Then, since Linlin is happy..."

"Could you tell me a few things?"

-

Next door.

After 001 uttered those words, an enigmatic smile appeared on the red-crowned crane's face. After coughing a couple of times, he began:

"So, according to your observations... how is this guardian?"

001 thought about it:

"Wealthy."

The red-crowned crane nodded slightly.

"Very good-looking."

The red-crowned crane agreed deeply.

"Very good to 247."

The red-crowned crane thought, *A fellow demon of culture,* and said to the grey-brown sparrow on the screen:

"So, what conclusion have you drawn?"

001, fluffy and round, was actually a bit bewildered, but answered very carefully:

"247's guardian... is a high-level human?"

The red-crowned crane slapped his wing down, settling the matter with finality:

"Spot on!"

Then followed up with:

"Therefore, you must keep an eye on 247. Make sure it reaches Rank S before reaching adulthood, and then immediately have it deeply bind its guardian. Don't let the guy run away..."

001's expression shifted from confusion to daze, and finally to firm conviction.

That's right.

They must help 247 score this human.

-

Inside the room.

The "youth" shrank back on the bed, looking extremely vigilant. What did he want to ask?

Bai Linlin didn't realize how much his behavior screamed "guilty conscience," but luckily the other man didn't mind. He simply sat down at the edge of the bed and asked:

"Why do you insist on reaching Rank S?"

Song Yu's tone was completely normal, as if he had never talked to that Taoist master before, asking with a strong desire for knowledge:

"How are Rank S demon beasts different from other ranks?"

"Isn't doing missions very exhausting for Linlin?"

Bai Linlin was stunned. He hadn't expected him to bring this up. He instantly relaxed and simply spoke his mind:

"Rank S can do a lot of things... Anyway, I just have to become a Rank S!"

Song Yu merely extended his hand.

As if controlled by some underlying code, Bai Linlin instinctively reached his hand out to him. But by the time he realized it, it was too late. The man grabbed his wrist bone and pulled, tugging him right to his side.

"Since Linlin is so ambitious, I need to be ambitious too."

chunks.chineseText:
宋郁手上的力道不轻不重，刚好够禁锢住“少年”，他说完这句话，只是低头看着“人”。

视线交汇。

白粼粼匆匆地偏开了，随即就是往外抽手腕，面色都有些泛红，只是道：

“随你便。”

但就在这时，上方传来一句：

“我给粼粼办个身份证好不好？”

白粼粼闻言眼睛都亮了，直接不挣了，只是凑过去问：

“真的吗？这个可以弄吗？”

宋郁看着“少年”的脸：“可以。”

“只是……”

白粼粼着急：“只是什么？”

“你要上宋家的户口。”

-

雨是在晚上停的，白粼粼脸上的温度也稍稍降了些，上户口这种话……听起来怪怪的。

不过有了身份证就好了。

这样他就可以化形乘坐人类的高铁、飞机了……这样子去哪里都没有限制的。

白粼粼其实是有些小小的期待的，那到时候他可以去确定一下有没有自己上过班的公司，有没有那个讨厌的同事……

以及现在。

桐城……到底是不是自己的故乡。

“宋郁，我们出门一趟吧？”

大约十五分钟后，一人一鸟出现在了隔壁的门口，带上了001。

宋郁其实一开始对于这个出门的提议是否了的，因为毕竟晚上了，而且外面气温也很低，不太适合小鸟出来。

但是没办法。

它非要出来散步。

最后只能带着两只小鸟出了门，两个都套上了羊羔绒的小披风，看着着实很洋气。

宋郁原本出门是打算在酒店绕一圈就回去的，但是肩头传来了指挥声，说要去开车。

他虽有不解，但还是照做。

问了下：“粼粼要去哪里？”

他的小鸟今天很有主见。

“平阳路，建设广场。”

白粼粼其实很斟酌地给了个地名，然后找补道：

“据说那里有很美味的串串香！”

001眼睛亮了亮，扑棱翅膀飞到了蓝羽小鸟的旁边，挤了挤，眼神示意：

——真的？

宋郁没有任何怀疑，直接开车就去了，大约二十分钟的车程，他们就抵达了目的地。

这里其实很是萧条，路边只有一个破旧的地铁站，两侧也没有什么门面，甚至摄像头都是坏了几个。

001：“……”

宋郁只是侧眸问了问肩头的这只，“是不是记错地址了？”

也就在这时，肩头的这只直接化形了，地面上多了个长相优越的“少年”，浅蓝色的头发，穿着一件不太合身的外套，仰头很是一本正经地道：

“没有，他那个店其实就在附近，我看了帖子的，我先去那边看看，你们——”

白粼粼刚要抬步走开，手腕就被一把扣住，这个力道已经是不舒服了，像是铁钳一样，他被一把带了回来。

身后的人只是温文尔雅地道：

“粼粼，不要离开我的视线。”

作者有话说：

[鸽子][鸽子]：大家晚上好！（啪嗒啪嗒走过来，翅膀放在胸口，优雅鞠躬）
chunks.englishText:
The strength in Song Yu's hand was neither too heavy nor too light—just enough to restrain the "youth." After saying this, he simply looked down at the "person."

Their gazes locked.

Bai Linlin hurriedly looked away, immediately pulling his wrist backward, his face flushing slightly as he grumbled:

"Suit yourself."

Right at that moment, a voice came from above:

"How about I get Linlin an ID card?"

Upon hearing this, Bai Linlin's eyes lit up. He stopped struggling immediately and leaned in to ask:

"Really? Can you actually get one?"

Song Yu looked at the "youth's" face: "I can."

"It's just..."

Bai Linlin grew anxious: "Just what?"

"You'll have to be registered under the Song family's household registry."

-

The rain stopped in the evening, and the warmth on Bai Linlin's face cooled down a bit. Being registered under a household registry... sounded a bit strange.

Still, having an ID card would be great.

That way, he could transform into human form and take high-speed trains and airplanes... He wouldn't be restricted from going anywhere.

Bai Linlin was actually looking forward to it a little. When the time came, he could go check if the company he used to work for was still there, and if that annoying colleague was still around...

And right now.

Tongcity... whether it really was his hometown or not.

"Song Yu, let me take a trip out, okay?"

About fifteen minutes later, one person and two birds appeared outside the neighboring door, bringing 001 along.

Song Yu had actually rejected the proposal to go out at first, because after all, it was night, and the temperature outside was quite low, making it unsuitable for a little bird to go out.

But there was no helping it.

It insisted on going out for a walk.

In the end, he could only bring the two little birds out. Both of them were bundled in fleece capes, looking exceedingly stylish.

Song Yu had originally intended to just walk a lap around the hotel before heading back, but instructions came from his shoulder, telling him to drive.

Though puzzled, he complied.

He asked, "Where does Linlin want to go?"

His little bird was very opinionated today.

"Pingyang Road, Construction Plaza."

Bai Linlin carefully gave a location, then quickly added a cover-up:

"Word has it there's super delicious chuanchuan xiang skewer hotpot over there!"

001's eyes sparkled. Flapping its wings, it flew right next to the blue-feathered bird, squeezing in and nudging with its eyes:

—*Really?*

Song Yu didn't suspect a thing and drove straight over. After about a twenty-minute drive, they arrived at their destination.

This area was actually quite desolate. There was only an old, dilapidated subway station on the roadside, no storefronts on either side, and even a few security cameras were broken.

001: "..."

Song Yu looked sideways at the bird on his shoulder and asked, "Did you get the address wrong?"

Just then, the bird on his shoulder transformed on the spot. A remarkably handsome "youth" appeared on the ground, with light blue hair, wearing a slightly ill-fitting jacket. Looking up, he said with utmost seriousness:

"No, that shop is actually nearby. I read about it in a post. I'll go check over there first, you guys—"

Bai Linlin was just about to step away when his wrist was grabbed firmly. The grip was tight enough to be uncomfortable, like iron pliers, yanking him back.

The person behind him said with gentle elegance:

"Linlin, don't leave my line of sight."

Author's Note:

[Pigeon][Pigeon]: Good evening, everyone! (Pitter-patters over, places wings over chest, bows elegantly)

chunks.chineseText:
第47章

白粼粼计划失败，他本来是打算这次出门去看看那个孤儿院在不在的，结果宋郁实在是……看得太紧。

他说完那句话后，手腕就没有被松开过。

“……”

最后绕着这么破旧的地铁站口走了一圈，也没有找到什么买吃的小店。

白粼粼其实是有点尴尬的，但是旁边的人只是道：

“是那个帖子发布错的信息了，我们换个路线好不好？”

宋郁带着“少年”回了车上，重新看了导航，找到了最近的一家小店，是专门卖麻辣烫和串串香的。

符合他的小鸟的要求。

001完全不知道一人一鸟的暗潮汹涌，它只是化形之后好奇地看着周围，它还没有进过人类开的小店，之前都是路边摊子解决问题的。

白粼粼被一路牵着，其实几次都张了张口，但还是什么都没说。

直到坐在了小桌子上。

001没心没肺地坐在对面，仰头看着小店贴在墙上的巨大菜单。

懵懵的。

因为认识的字不多。

“松开吧……”

对面的一人一鸟在轻声说着话。

“怎么了？我握得不舒服？”

“很多人的，你、你别牵了。”

001还在专心致志地看菜单，眼睛又亮又圆的，它认得里面的“肉”，它要吃那个！

“好，为什么不看我，粼粼。”

“……我没有。”

001高高兴兴的，它歪了歪头，看到了隔壁桌子的串串香，有土豆、海带、鱼豆腐……散发着阵阵的香气。

要吃要吃！

于是就在对面一人一鸟氛围拉扯的时候，一道四平八稳的声音传了过来：

“什么时候，开饭。”

宋郁这才回了回神，连带着旁边的白粼粼都有些面色泛红，他差点忘了001的存在了。

最后还是菜单上的都点了一遍，没过一会老板娘就端着一盘子沾满蘸料的串串拿了过来，顺带说了句：

“麻辣烫一会儿就好啊。”

“两个正常的，一个加麻加辣的。”

老板娘很是风风火火的，这个时候小店正值下班时间，虽然店内没有多少人，但是外卖生意还是很多的，说完就把笔插在自己围裙口袋里，又去忙了。

黑衣少年抓着串串的签子就开始吃，眼睛都眯了眯，人类真的好会做食物！

白粼粼没有办法，他只能先吃饭，不过宋郁一直看着他的话……那001会不会有办法？

他其实就想去看看有没有孤儿院。

当时死得太仓促，他本来就很多年没有回桐城了，转生成鸟后更是一堆事，宋郁的家事，自己变成了妖怪……还有化形。

白粼粼不得不承认，他有在刻意地去回避，甚至有电子设备后也没有去查过相关的事，因为上辈子实在是遗憾太多。

原本可以一直这样下去。

直到现在。

“不饿么？”

宋郁侧眸看着“少年”，问了问，掌心还残留着对方皮肤的温度。

气氛其实有点微妙。

但奈何001是个木头，唇边残留着些酱料，闻言很认真地看向白粼粼，闷声闷气地道：

“我可以帮忙的。”

“……”

好在最后在小店还是顺顺利利地吃完饭了，尽管期间白粼粼试图给001以眼神信号，让对方帮助他把宋郁支开，但黑衣少年全然忘我了，压根就没有抬过头。

三十分钟后。

宋郁把“人”带回了酒店，进门就直接抱到了桌边，没有任何犹豫地问：

“怎么了？”

“不要和我生气，好不好？”

白粼粼其实压根都反应不过来，他的手只是条件反射地抵在对方的肩膀上，这才刚进门……

他都不知道宋郁是怎么卡的时间。

进酒店的时候他是用的本体，进门才打算化形的……就刚幻化出来，再睁眼就到了桌边了。

“……”

白粼粼甚至空间都很小，他仰着头去看人，最后只能说出来一句：

“我没有生气。”

宋郁只是垂着眼眸道：

“那为什么在小店不看我。”

白粼粼一下子面色都红了，他这说的什么话，什么叫“不看他”，这也要问，那不就是自己有点心虚吗？

“……我，我没有！”

咬死不认。

宋郁只是用手拢着“人”的腰，低头看着“少年”的表情，一丝一毫的变化都收入眼里，在说谎。

他的小鸟，有秘密。

还不和他讲。

“是么？”

房间里静悄悄的，白粼粼实在是顶不住那个眼神了，立马就要偏开头，刚想化成本体，耳边就传来很轻的叹气。

宋郁只是把“少年”的手拿了过来，握着，低着头解释：

“粼粼，我没有要限制你的自由。”

“你想去哪里都可以的，但不要单独去可以么？”

宋郁很自然地挤过了“少年”的手指缝，十指扣住了，掀起眼皮看了过来，很平静地道：

“你知不知道你还很小。”

“我总归是不放心的。”

白粼粼面色愣了下，他的手被扣着，心里很乱，他不小的……

宋郁这么说，那让他怎么坦白？

鸟可以被接受，变成妖怪的鸟也可以被接受，但是……芯子是人的，会接受吗?

白粼粼完全陷入了思维怪圈，唇瓣都抿了下，他不知道怎么办，二十三岁相比于十八岁……实在是差的太多了。

一旦被发现。

那自己做鸟时候的事……岂不是会被看成脑子有病？

成年人是不被宽容的。

他早就知道这个道理了。

白粼粼越想越无措，以至于神色都显露出来了，甚至磕磕巴巴地说了句：

“我……”

“我让你养我……是不是不对。”

宋郁手上的力道都微微加深了，面色微冷，只是道：

“怎么会这么想，谁和你说的？”

白粼粼只是低着头，“没人和我说。”

-

最后晚上还是休息了。

白粼粼变成了本体，毛绒绒的，这次没有在宋郁的肩头去睡，而是窝在枕头边边。

鸟在想事情。

放不下。

白粼粼其实在想他有没有帮助到宋郁什么，好像……也只是陪着而已。

反倒是自己，吃得日渐圆润。

鸟闷闷的，把鸟头插进了翅根里，自己缩成了个毛球。

他想好了，要是什么时候“人芯”的事暴露了，宋郁吓到了，他就走。

妖怪管理局应该有收容流浪妖怪的地方，001就没有监护人的。

白粼粼闷闷地给自己铺好了后路，完全没有察觉到身后的目光……

宋郁不可能睡着。

他的小鸟不来他的身边。

为什么？

时间一点一滴地过去，外面凉风阵阵，似乎又下起了小雨，城市里的灯光从窗户里照了进来，床上有了一些动静。

宋郁垂眸看着床边的“少年”，手臂撑着，低头靠近，但在快要触碰的一瞬间，他停了。

白粼粼睡得很沉，完全没有醒来的征兆，脖子上还挂着一个黑绳串着的平安牌，那是爷爷前段时间去寺里捎回来的，桃木的，驱邪避灾。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 47

Bai Linlin’s plan had failed. He had originally intended to use this outing to check if the orphanage was still there, but Song Yu kept... far too tight a watch on him.

Ever since Song Yu uttered those words, he hadn't let go of Bai Linlin's wrist for a single second.

"..."

In the end, after circling the run-down subway entrance, they failed to find any small shops selling food.

Bai Linlin actually felt a bit embarrassed, but the person beside him merely said:

"The post must have provided the wrong information. How about we change our route?"

Song Yu led the "youth" back into the car, rechecked the navigation, and located the nearest small eatery—one that specialized in Malatang and Chuanchuan Xiang spicy skewers.

It perfectly suited his little bird's cravings.

001 was entirely oblivious to the turbulent undercurrents between the man and the bird. After taking human form, it simply looked around with wide, curious eyes. It had never been inside a shop run by humans before, as street stalls had always been its go-to solution.

Having been held by the hand all the way here, Bai Linlin parted his lips several times, but ultimately said nothing.

It wasn't until they sat down at a small table.

001 sat opposite them without a care in the world, tilting its head up to stare at the massive menu posted on the wall.

It looked utterly dazed.

Simply because it didn't recognize many Chinese characters.

"Let go..."

Across the table, the two were speaking in hushed tones.

"What's wrong? Is my grip uncomfortable?"

"There are so many people... D-don't hold my hand."

001 was still staring intently at the menu, its eyes round and bright. It recognized the character for "meat"—it wanted to eat that!

"Alright. Why aren't you looking at me, Linlin?"

"...I am."

001 tilted its head happily and spotted the skewers on the neighboring table—potatoes, kelp, fish tofu... all wafting enticing aromas.

Want to eat! Want to eat!

And so, just as the tension between the man and the bird opposite reached a delicate deadlock, an utterly steady, monotone voice drifted over:

"When... do we eat?"

Only then did Song Yu snap back to reality. Even Bai Linlin beside him felt his face flush red—he had almost forgotten 001's existence.

In the end, they ordered everything off the menu. Before long, the landlady bustled over with a tray of skewers dripping with savory sauce, adding in passing:

"The Malatang will be ready in a moment!"

"Two regular, one extra numb and extra spicy."

The landlady moved with brisk efficiency. It was off-work rush hour, so although there weren't many dine-in customers, takeout orders were flooding in. Saying no more, she stuck her pen back into her apron pocket and bustled off to work again.

The black-clothed youth grabbed a bamboo skewer and began eating, its eyes squinting in pure bliss. Humans really knew how to make food!

Left with no choice, Bai Linlin could only eat first. But if Song Yu kept watching him like this... would 001 have a way to help?

He really just wanted to check if the orphanage was still there.

He had died too abruptly in his past life. He hadn't returned to Tongcheng in years, and after reincarnating as a bird, a flurry of events had swept him up—Song Yu's family affairs, his own transformation into a demon... and then taking human form.

Bai Linlin had to admit that he had been deliberately avoiding it. Even after acquiring electronic devices, he had never searched for anything related, simply because his past life held far too many regrets.

Things could have continued like this forever.

Until now.

"Not hungry?"

Song Yu glanced at the "youth," asking softly, the warmth of the other's skin still lingering in his palm.

The atmosphere was undeniably subtle.

Unfortunately, 001 was an absolute blockhead. With sauce smeared around the corners of its mouth, it looked seriously at Bai Linlin upon hearing the question and muttered in a muffled voice:

"I can help."

"..."

Fortunately, they finished their meal smoothly at the shop. Even though Bai Linlin tried signaling 001 with his eyes to draw Song Yu away, the black-clothed youth was completely absorbed in eating and didn't lift its head even once.

Thirty minutes later.

Song Yu brought the "person" back to the hotel. The moment they stepped through the door, he carried him straight over to the table and asked without hesitation:

"What's wrong?"

"Don't be mad at me, okay?"

Bai Linlin couldn't even react in time. His hands merely pressed against Song Yu's shoulders out of pure reflex. They had only just entered...

He didn't even know how Song Yu timed it so precisely.

He had been in his original form when entering the hotel, intending to transform only after getting into the room... But the moment he manifested his human form and opened his eyes, he was already pulled right up against the table.

"..."

The space was extremely cramped. Bai Linlin tilted his head up to look at him, ultimately squeezing out only one sentence:

"I'm not mad."

Song Yu merely lowered his gaze and said, "Then why didn't you look at me in the shop?"

Bai Linlin's face flushed bright red in an instant. What kind of question was that? What did he mean by "didn't look at him"? Asking such a thing—wouldn't admitting to it just make him look guilty?

"...I-I didn't!"

He refused to admit it to the death.

Song Yu simply gathered the "youth's" waist in his hands, looking down at his expression, catching every single minute change in his features. He was lying.

His little bird was hiding a secret.

And refusing to tell him.

"Is that so?"

The room fell dead silent. Bai Linlin truly couldn't handle that intense gaze any longer. Just as he was about to turn his head away and revert to his bird form, a very faint sigh reached his ear.

Song Yu pulled the "youth's" hand over, holding it tight, and lowered his head to explain:

"Linlin, I'm not trying to restrict your freedom."

"You can go anywhere you want, but can you please not go alone?"

Song Yu naturally slid his fingers through the gaps of the "youth's" hand, interlocking their ten fingers. He raised his eyelids, looking over, and said with utter calm:

"Do you have any idea how young you still are?"

"I just can't bring myself to rest easy."

Bai Linlin froze. His hand was locked in Song Yu's, his heart in complete disarray. He wasn't young...

With Song Yu putting it like that, how was he supposed to confess?

A bird could be accepted, and a bird that turned into a demon could be accepted, but... a soul that belonged to an adult human—would that be accepted?

Bai Linlin was trapped in a logic loop, biting his lower lip. He didn't know what to do. Twenty-three compared to eighteen... was simply too vast a difference.

Once discovered...

Wouldn't everything he did while being raised as a bird... be seen as him being out of his mind?

Adults are never granted leniency.

He had known this truth long ago.

The more Bai Linlin thought, the more helpless he felt, so much so that the distress broke onto his face, causing him to stammer out:

"I..."

"Is it... wrong for me to let you raise me?"

The force in Song Yu's hands tightened slightly, his expression turning faintly cold as he demanded:

"Why would you think that? Who said that to you?"

Bai Linlin merely lowered his head. "Nobody said anything to me."

-

In the end, they still retired for the night.

Bai Linlin turned back into his fluffy, small bird form. This time, instead of sleeping on Song Yu's shoulder, he curled up at the very edge of the pillow.

The bird was deep in thought.

Unable to let it go.

Bai Linlin was actually pondering whether he had been of any help to Song Yu... It seemed he had done nothing but keep him company.

On the contrary, he himself had grown plumper by the day.

Glumly, the bird buried his head into the crook of his wing, shrinking into a little ball of fluff.

He had made up his mind: if the truth about his "human core" ever came to light and frightened Song Yu away, he would leave.

The Demon Management Bureau ought to have a shelter for stray demons. 001 didn't have a guardian, after all.

Bai Linlin gloomily paved his fallback plan, completely unaware of the gaze fixed upon him from behind...

There was no way Song Yu could sleep.

His little bird refused to come to his side.

Why?

Time ticked away, second by second. Outside, cold gusts of wind blew as a light drizzle began to fall once more. City lights filtered through the window pane, casting faint illumination as subtle rustlings sounded from the bed.

Song Yu looked down at the "youth" lying at the edge of the mattress, propping himself up on one arm to lean closer. But the moment before touching him, he stopped.

Bai Linlin was fast asleep, showing no signs of waking. Around his neck hung a peach wood peace talisman strung on a black cord—something Grandpa had brought back from a temple a while ago to ward off evil spirits and disasters.

chunks.chineseText:
“少年”浑身上下全部都是宋家买的衣服，被养得很是温润健康。

宋郁只是抬手微微扳回来了“人”的下巴，再次倾身，抵了抵额头。

“唔……”

外面开始下起来了阵雨，房间里昏暗温暖，床上隐约有些动静。

宋郁抬手给“人”盖上了被子，眼皮微微垂着，没什么大的情绪，只是把那截腰揽了过来，低头看着在枕头上熟睡的“少年”。

“粼粼。”

很轻的语气。

-

在隔壁相拥而眠的时候，001正在认认真真地蹲在椅子上，看着酒店里的大号电视，手里拿着遥控器，很是专注。

它还是头一次出来住酒店，人类真的好厉害，又能做出来美食，又能造这么好的房子。

001环顾了下四周，非常满意，但就在这时，走廊里传来一些交谈的声音。

“是，按规定来说是不能一个人开两间房的，但是那位说是给他的小鸟住，加了不少钱。”

“但系统显示308里面一直有电力耗费……不太像是小鸟，会不会有人进来入住了？”

“那能加多少钱啊？通知老板了吗？我就请假一天而已，这再有钱也不能——”

“一万。”

“……”

经理和前台站在了门口，一阵相顾无言，最后很默契地没有去打扰309的那位住户，他们只是敲了下308的门，来确保没有可疑人员入住就行。

只要没有开，那就是小鸟在。

但是，门开了。

两个人类顿时起了鸡皮疙瘩，然后下一秒，地板上站着一只毛绒绒的小雀，在仰头看了过来。

“……”

“……”

-

001其实对这种情况接受良好，面对人类的注视，它昂首挺胸的，因为他们都拿着手机。

可以拍的。

鸟不介意。

但是最后这两个人行为很奇怪，捂住下半张脸，小心地关上了门，走掉了。

001这才又化形成了黑衣少年的模样，然后继续去椅子上看电视，不过就在这个时候，窗外又来了一条金色纹路，不过这次不是视讯，而是文本信息：

[人类这个时间段一般不会有什么活动，我还是很担心，现在去看一下247的妖力情况，是否有提前化形的情况。]

[记录给我。]

是丹顶鹤的消息。

001想了想，确实也是，控制不住化成人形的话……相当危险。

它看向了窗户……

-

309房间里很是安安静静的，行李箱也是敞开的，里面全部都是些衣服，除了几件黑灰白是宋郁的，其余的全部都是另外一个“人”的。

此刻床上只有清清浅浅的呼吸声。

灰棕色的小雀就是在这个时候从窗户玻璃穿进来的，它探头探脑的，收了收翅膀，然后往床边那里看。

“嗯……”

白粼粼睡觉的时候会不自觉地发出些气音，大多是因为想要转身或者是做梦了，但他本人不知道。

灰棕色小雀这下听到了熟悉的声音，啪嗒啪嗒在窗台上走了两步，刚想要探出鸟头看看，但就在这时——

“粼粼？”

001直接立正了，爪子紧了紧，身躯一个劲地往后仰，力图让窗帘挡住自己。

床边那里还有些动静。

“怎么了？”

是那个监护人的声音，语气非常轻，像是在哄一样。

001闭了闭鸟眼，而后又等了一下，确保那边没什么动静了，才偷偷地探了下鸟头，想要看看247是什么形态。

它抬起翅膀，调动起来妖力，准备一边探测一边……

“……”

宋郁正阴冷地看着这边。

001：“……”

灰棕色小雀不由得往后退了一步，有点尴尬，这这这，是丹顶鹤让它来探测的，只能是睡着的时候，那它也没有别的办法。

“你来做什么——”

这话一出，001就没办法了，只能抬起来翅膀，金纹波动。

监护人“睡”过去了。

不过这句话把床上的“少年”给弄醒了，白粼粼懵懵地撑着手臂坐了起来，闷闷地道：

“宋郁？”

但这个时候，窗帘那里已经站了化形的黑衣少年，001只好坦白地说了一下事情的经过。

白粼粼听到声音才转过去了头，面色很是茫然，但在听完对方说的话后才点了点头，而后低头看着自己的手。

啊……

他睡着会化成人形？

“少年”的脸一点点地变红，最后纤长的手指在被单上抓了抓。

001其实有点担忧，它伸手指了指床上的人，很抱歉地道：

“我被发现了，你的人实在警惕性太高……”

“我就用妖力让他暂时昏睡了。”

白粼粼低头一看，本来是看宋郁的脸的，但是后知后觉自己的腰上……还有对方的手臂。

他面色更红了，抬手就是去掰，但不知道怎么了，手指还有点难弄开。

旁边的001又化成了小雀模样，毛绒绒的，觉得自己可能做错了事，然后道：

“我把他唤醒，你替我给你的人解释一下……”

白粼粼闻言一下子抬头了，灵光一闪，道：“不用！”

天赐良机。

-

大约凌晨五点三十左右。

309房间的窗台上出现了两只小鸟，白粼粼收了收翅膀，很认真地对面前的小雀道：

“不要让他醒来得太早，我出去一趟。”

001歪了歪头：“去哪里？”

蓝羽小鸟闻言一顿，然后就是一挥翅膀，矜持地道：

“不能打探老大的行踪！”

001：“好吧。”

白粼粼这才看向窗户的玻璃，沉思两秒，歪头询问：

“你早上是怎么穿进来的？”

“……”

灰棕色小雀化成了人形，从房间里面拉开了窗户的把手。

白粼粼：“……”

咳咳咳。

-

总之好歹还是出来了。

白粼粼这算是转生之后第一次独自出门，他找了个隐蔽的巷子，化形了。

桐城的街道似乎变了不少，他循着记忆往前走，环顾着车水马龙的四周。

白粼粼甚至有种恍惚的感觉，像是回到了很多年前，他还在这里上中学，周六日会去孤儿院看老师……那是他的“家”。

“买玉米咯，三块一个！”

“好吃的水果玉米！”

他不知不觉地走到了昨天的那个地铁口，看到了小摊贩才后知后觉一件事。

白粼粼闭了闭眼。

没拿手机。

宋郁之前总是在他身边，去基地会帮他戴小挎包……现在一出门。

什么也没有。

“……”

白粼粼没办法，只好又步行到一个隐蔽的角落里，化形成本体，扑棱翅膀飞了起来。

一会儿停在一个绿化带的树上，一会儿停在一个商铺的牌匾上。

道路上有通勤的打工人，到处都是烟火气。

白粼粼其实有点迷路，他很多年没有回来了，不过东拐西拐，最终还是抵达了昌平路45号。

——孤儿院的地址。

-

酒店。

001其实有点谨慎，它在309的房间里待了一会，后面觉得毛毛的，还是回了自己的房间。
chunks.englishText:
The "youth" was dressed head-to-toe in clothes purchased by the Song family, nourished to be supple, fair, and healthy.

Song Yu raised his hand, gently tilting the "person's" chin back, leaning down once more to press his forehead against the other's.

"Nn..."

Outside, a sudden downpour began. The room was dim and warm, with faint rustling movements on the bed.

Song Yu reached out to pull the blanket over the "person." His eyelids drooped slightly, devoid of any intense emotion; he simply gathered that slender waist closer, gazing down at the "youth" sleeping soundly against the pillow.

"Linlin."

His tone was feather-light.

-

While the two slept in an embrace next door, 001 was squatting earnestly on a chair, staring at the huge television screen in its hotel room, remote control in hand, intensely focused.

It was its very first time staying in a hotel. Humans were truly incredible—able to make delicious food and construct such wonderful buildings.

001 looked around, thoroughly satisfied. But right at that moment, voices drifted from the hallway outside.

"Yes, by regulations, one person isn't allowed to book two rooms, but that gentleman said it was for his pet bird and paid a huge bonus."

"But the system shows continuous power consumption inside Room 308... Doesn't seem like a bird. Could someone else have checked in?"

"How much bonus could he possibly pay? Did you notify the boss? I only took one day off, no matter how rich they are—"

"Ten thousand."

"..."

The manager and the receptionist stood outside the door, exchanging a silent look. In the end, with unspoken agreement, they decided not to disturb the guest in Room 309. They merely knocked on Room 308's door to ensure no suspicious trespasser had moved in.

As long as the door didn't open, it meant only the bird was inside.

However, the door opened.

Goosebumps instantly erupted on both humans. The next second, a fluffy little finch stood on the carpet, tilting its head up to look at them.

"..."

"..."

-

001 actually handled this situation quite well. Facing the humans' stares, it held its head high and puffed its chest out, noticing that both of them were holding smartphones.

They could take photos.

The bird didn't mind.

In the end, however, the two humans acted very strange—covering the lower half of their faces, cautiously shutting the door, and scurrying away.

Only then did 001 transform back into the black-clothed youth and return to the chair to watch TV. But just then, another golden light streak flashed outside the window—this time not a video call, but a text message:

[Humans usually don't have much activity at this hour. I am still worried. Go check 247's demon power status now to see if there is any sign of premature transformation.]

[Send me the report.]

It was a message from the Red-crowned Crane.

001 thought about it—indeed, losing control and involuntarily transforming into human form was extremely dangerous.

It turned its gaze toward the window...

-

Room 309 was utterly quiet. The open suitcase lay on the floor, filled to the brim with clothing. Aside from a few black, grey, and white pieces belonging to Song Yu, all the rest belonged to the other "person."

At this moment, only soft, shallow breathing came from the bed.

The greyish-brown little finch slipped right through the window glass at this exact moment. It poked its head in, folded its wings, and peered toward the bed.

"Nn..."

When Bai Linlin slept, he would unconsciously let out soft vocalizations—mostly when turning over or dreaming, though he wasn't aware of it himself.

Hearing the familiar voice, the little finch tiptoed forward a couple of steps on the windowsill, just about to stick its bird head out for a peek, when suddenly—

"Linlin?"

001 instantly stood at attention, its claws clenching tight, leaning its body backward with all its might so the curtain would hide it.

There was movement by the bed.

"What's wrong?"

It was the guardian's voice, remarkably soft, as if coaxing a child.

001 closed its bird eyes, waited a moment, and once it made sure there was no further movement, it secretively poked its bird head out to check what form 247 was currently in.

It raised its wing, mobilizing its demon power, preparing to scan while...

"..."

Song Yu was staring right at it with dark, chilling eyes.

001: "..."

The greyish-brown finch couldn't help taking a step back, feeling immensely awkward. T-t-this... the Red-crowned Crane ordered it to scan, and it could only do so while he was asleep. What choice did it have?

"What are you doing here—"

The moment those words left his mouth, 001 had no choice. It snapped its wing up, and golden ripples fluctuated through the air.

The guardian was cast into a temporary slumber.

However, those words succeeded in waking the "youth" on the bed. Bai Linlin sat up groggily, propping himself up on his arms, muttering in confusion:

"Song Yu?"

By then, the black-clothed youth had already taken shape beside the curtain. 001 had no choice but to honestly explain the whole story.

Hearing the voice, Bai Linlin turned his head, his face a picture of bewilderment. After listening to the explanation, he nodded blankly, then looked down at his own hands.

Ah...

He transforms into human form when he sleeps?

The "youth's" face slowly flushed crimson. His long, slender fingers clutched at the bedsheet.

001 was actually a bit worried. It pointed at the man on the bed and said apologetically:

"I was caught. Your human's vigilance is way too high..."

"So I used demon power to make him fall asleep temporarily."

Bai Linlin looked down, intending to look at Song Yu's face, but belatedly realized... Song Yu's arm was still wrapped tightly around his waist.

His face turned even redder as he tried to pry the hand away. Yet for some reason, the interlocked fingers were surprisingly hard to loosen.

Beside him, 001 transformed back into a fluffy little finch, feeling it might have done something wrong, and offered:

"I'll wake him up, and you can explain things to your human for me..."

Bai Linlin looked up abruptly, a stroke of genius striking him: "No need!"

A god-sent opportunity!

-

Around 5:30 AM.

Two small birds appeared on the windowsill of Room 309. Bai Linlin folded his wings and said earnestly to the finch opposite him:

"Don't let him wake up too early. I'm going out for a bit."

001 tilted its head: "Where to?"

The blue-feathered bird paused, then flapped a wing, declaring demurely:

"You're not allowed to pry into the boss's whereabouts!"

001: "Okay then."

Only then did Bai Linlin look at the window glass. After pondering for two seconds, he tilted his head to ask:

"How did you phase through this morning?"

"..."

The greyish-brown finch transformed into human form, reached out, and pulled open the window latch from inside the room.

Bai Linlin: "..."

*Ahem.*

-

At any rate, he managed to get out.

This counted as Bai Linlin's first time venturing out alone since his reincarnation. He found a secluded alley and transformed into human form.

The streets of Tongcheng seemed to have changed considerably. He followed his memories forward, looking at the heavy traffic flowing around him.

Bai Linlin even felt a sense of trance, as if returning to many years ago when he was still attending middle school here, visiting the teachers at the orphanage on weekends... That had been his "home."

"Sweet corn for sale, three yuan each!"

"Delicious fruit corn!"

He unwittingly walked back to yesterday's subway entrance, and only upon seeing the street vendor did he realize something.

Bai Linlin closed his eyes in dismay.

He hadn't brought a phone.

Song Yu had always been by his side before, helping him put on his small crossbody bag whenever they went to the base... Now that he was out on his own...

He had nothing on him.

"..."
