Bai Linlin had completely adapted to life within the Song family. Not only had his original bird form grown sleek, smooth, and fluffy, but his human avatar had also taken on an increasingly vibrant and healthy glow.

The bird maintained an excellent rhythm in life: visiting the base once a week, spending the remaining time accompanying 001 out on missions to practice new skills, and dedicating all leftover moments to patrolling his territorial domain in the house.

Song Zhengguo had already completed an entire series of flower-and-bird paintings. At that moment, brushes in hand inside the study, he glanced at a certain creature preening its feathers on the inkstone and inquired:

"How about Grandpa holds an art exhibition for our bird?"

Bai Linlin: "..."

The more Song Zhengguo pondered the idea, the more reasonable it seemed. With a swift, practiced flick of his wrist, he neatly finished the stroke on the Xuan paper, capturing another sketch of the blue-feathered bird—ranging from pale blue to deep azure, naturally blended. Compared to his earliest sketches, however, this one appeared significantly rounder and fluffier.

"Little Yu will be back soon; I'll discuss it with him. It should be entirely feasible—let the whole world catch a glimpse of our bird!"

Waving his hand dismissively, the old man spoke with utter nonchalance.

Bai Linlin promptly transformed into his "youth" form, plopping down onto a chair, lifting his arms to sprawl across the desk, and grumbling with muffled dissatisfaction:

"This isn't a good idea, Grandpa. Every single one of these is me."

His slender fingers curled inward.

He felt rather embarrassed.

Song Zhengguo continued admiring his own artwork, acting as though it were some deeply profound and refined masterpiece, when in reality, it was simply a chubby blue-feathered bird perched on an inkstone.

"This is our bird's art exhibition, so naturally every piece must feature you!"

Hearing this, Bai Linlin fell into a speechless silence. He cast his gaze toward the items adorning the study walls... sketches in every conceivable style, himself on the refrigerator, himself on dinner plates, himself swinging on a swing, himself perched atop a writing brush...

Round and chubby, it truly lacked a trace of refinement.

Yet the old man seemed utterly bewitched by his own painting.

Checking the time, Song Zhengguo reminded him:

"It's eight o'clock. Off to bed with you; Little Yu will be back shortly."

Sprawled flat across the desk, Bai Linlin let out a sigh at these words. Nowadays, besides attending classes and managing company affairs, Song Yu had added yet another daily duty to his schedule... keeping surveillance on his bedtime.

So what if he had stayed up all night playing video games a few days ago?

"..."

With a soft *poof*, the "youth" transformed back into a fluffy little bird, waddling toward the door. As he nudged the door crack open, he didn't forget to give a parting flap of his wing toward the old man inside:

"Grandpa, I'm going to sleep."

"Alright, alright, off you go."

-

At around eight-thirty, a commotion sounded from outside Jin Garden.

A youth dressed in a sharp business suit pushed open the front door and headed straight for the study. Taking in the room filled from floor to ceiling with paintings and calligraphy, he merely raised an eyebrow before asking:

"Is he asleep?"

Song Zhengguo casually laid down his brush, seated himself in the chair, and chuckled as he shook his head:

"Just went back."

"How did it go?"

Song Yu's growth speed exceeded all imagination. With a calm, composed, and steady expression, he reported on the current progress of a Huabing business venture, casually touching upon a few administrative challenges along the way.

"Splendid, though you really needn't push yourself quite so hard..."

Song Zhengguo still harbored thoughts of persuasion, though he knew it would be utterly futile. True to form, the boy's very next sentence was:

"Shall I head off then? I'll go check on the bedroom."

"..."

Song Zhengguo could only shake his head with a helpless smile.

The moment the door clicked shut, quiet descended upon the study once more. However, right at that moment, a rhythmic series of vibrations emanated from the window.

As if traveling from distant realms closer by, some invisible force surged forward in an endless ripple.

Song Zhengguo frowned, involuntarily turning his head to look. Thousands of golden threads pierced straight through the glass, intertwining before stacking into a rippling expanse of flowing fabric.

The old man momentarily suspected his aged eyes were playing tricks on him, but the very next second, characters manifested across the luminous fabric:

[Tonight at the midnight hour, a gift shall be bestowed.]

[——The Red-Crowned Crane.]

Song Zhengguo's heart skipped a beat.

-

Inside the bedroom.

Song Yu discarded his suit jacket, draped it casually over a chair, and walked over to the bedside, lowering his gaze to look down. The "youth" favored sleeping in his human form, his cheek buried deep against the pillow as the soft, steady rhythm of his breathing drifted outward.

He stood quietly watching for a moment.

"Linlin, you've grown up."

chunks.chineseText:
第50章

床上的“少年”发出了点气音，似乎是被吵醒了，白粼粼隐约觉得额头被抵了下，很亲昵的感觉。

有点像小时候……

夜灯是开着的，暖黄色的光线，他的视野也逐步变得清晰，慢慢发现床边来人了。

对方撑着手臂，在看他。

白粼粼觉得被子很是暖和，本来是想要再缩进去一些的，但是余光里的人影存在感实在太强了。

他瞥了一眼，闷声闷气地道：

“你回来了？”

“嗯。”

宋郁语气温和，只是又轻声问：

“今天在家里……”

但这句话还没有说完，“少年”就直接抬起手臂勾住了他的脖子，语气含糊不清的，似乎是在说：

“抱。”

宋郁身子微微僵住了，偏偏床上的“人”还在半梦半醒地问：

“不是要抱吗？”

卧室里安安静静的。

宋郁的手背微微凸起了些青筋，他身子往下倾，只是顺着“人”的意思道：

“嗯。”

白粼粼完成任务很快就又坠入梦里了，他穿的是睡衣，手臂上的布料早就堆叠到肘关节了，至于环住的人也忘记放开了。

后面迷迷糊糊觉得不舒服了，才抬手去推。

宋郁扣住了那个手腕。

不由得摩挲了两下。

“我不吵你了。”

床上的“少年”也不知道是听到了还是没听到，只是没再蹙眉了，侧了侧头，很快就又睡着了。

宋郁本来是打算再看一会儿的，但是门口这个时候传来了很轻的叩门声，他只好先起身往那边走了。

-

门外是宋峥国，老人家这个时候面色很是凝重，急得团团转。

见到孙子出来先是探头看了下房间内，轻声询问道：

“我没把鸟儿吵醒吧？”

宋郁抬手带上了门，很是平和地道：

“没有，它睡了。”

“怎么了爷爷？”

宋峥国闻言只是深吸一口气，觉得走廊也不是个说话的地方，于是二人转移到了书房。

“坏了。”

宋郁衣服还没有换，上身是服帖的衬衫，正在抬手摘自己的腕表，听到这话蹙了蹙眉，什么事这么严重？

华秉运转一切正常。

就连S州那里他父亲也没有作妖。

按道理是——

“那鹤今晚要过来！”

宋郁闻言动作一顿，面色有些不可思议。

“什么？”

-

妖怪管理局内此刻灯火通明，过年时期的彩灯装置还没有撤，大厅连接各个活动区域的走廊里还泛着流动的金色纹路，有此起彼伏的交谈声。

“你放年假了？”

“对，好不容易回来了，确实是太累了。”

“我也是，自治区那里简直是什么好吃的都没有，749局就知道提供泡面和火腿肠……”

“今年管理局好像收纳了不少小妖怪？”

……

001在沙发上坐着，一身黑，修长的手指拆开了一个棒棒糖，塞进了自己嘴巴里，腮帮子很快鼓起来了。

草莓味道的。

管理局今天很是热闹，因为那些去年出差做任务的妖怪们回来了，它们大多也没有监护人，几乎全部是S级以上的，户籍是在南市，所以度假会回来。

001算是年纪比较小的，它没有出差过，因而也没有什么话可以聊。

不过……

小雀思考，它旅游过。

但就在这时——

“001？”

丹顶鹤的声音从背后传来，黑衣少年立马砰得一下化成原型，毛绒绒的，正襟危坐的，不过爪子还捏着那个棒棒糖的棍子。

“……”

丹顶鹤叹了口气，只是招了招翅膀，对着沙发上的小雀道：

“过来，商量一些事。”

001圆滚滚的，低着鸟头看了看棒棒糖，很斟酌地用喙叼了起来，放到了刚才拆开的包装袋里，收了收翅膀，打算待会回来吃。

……

大厅的历史回廊那里已经有些妖了，大多都是人形，不过有的会额外保留自己喜欢的特征。

灰色头发的“少年”正在仰头看着那副巨大的红底照，手指尖窜出来根根分明的刺；旁边有个正在垂眸整理自己发钗的女士，一身修身黑衣，眼尾有泛着金光的鳞片；而正在和丹顶鹤交流的……是一个狐头人形的妖，穿着古代衣服，眼睛眯成了缝，好似亲和，但又有压迫感。

001是年纪最小的S级，此刻已经化成人形跟了过来，面色认真，听着它们的交谈。

“是吗？那这个小妖看来着实有天赋。”

丹顶鹤也是点头，然后又接着道：

“它年纪是比较小的，原来在秋水巷的花鸟市场那里，不过被一个少年带走了，也就是它现在的监护人。”

“就是照片上的。”

旁边的刺猬妖很是认真地端详，不由自主地想要用手去碰一下，但它忘记了自己化出来刺了，就在这时——

001直接挡了过去，面色认真地道：

“不要弄坏。”

“……”

刺猬妖“切”了下，然后乖顺地站在旁边了，听着旁边的二妖讲话，打了个哈欠。

“它的监护人是南市的首富？独孙么？”

狐狸妖眯了眯眼，颇有些好奇。

“是的，并且749局的专员，是同247的家里人认识的。”

丹顶鹤很是认真地补充了信息，顺带点明了今天的事：

“眼下247刚好成年，我们管理局历来都有赠礼的传统，但这次情况比较特殊，我是想着……”

狐狸妖大致理解了信息，只是悠悠地道：

“我明白。”

“749局的人都和宋家有关系，我们管理局自然是不能落后……和人类有地位的人处好关系，看来是相当有必要的。”

狐狸眼尾弯弯，很是有些邪性。

它歪了歪头。

“赠礼……金银财宝恐是不够，倒不如用法器？”

-

[赠礼]

原本是只出现在有监护人的小妖怪上，管理局历年的传统是赠予一些小东西，大多是驱除灾病的小法器，附着在一些具体的物件上。

玩偶，笔，口琴……

是根据档案里监护人的信息而调整的。

但247现在实际上是个特例。

一来它的妖力等级已经在逐步上升了，现在只差考核了，其实对于S级来说只是临门一脚。

二来它的监护人社会身份相当高，甚至可以说是南市有名的权贵了，社会网络宽泛，甚至同749局的人都有关联，不容小觑。

三来它有着惊人的人类文化天赋，是目前管理局最有希望去中央培训的一个对象，实在是要重视起来。

缘于此。

丹顶鹤慎重地道：

“必须要气派一些，要给247撑撑场面。”

狐妖很自然地招了招手，把管理局内的小妖怪都汇集到了一起，弯腰笑眯眯地道：

“要建言献策。”

底下的小妖怪们窃窃私语的，有几个踊跃发言：

“赠礼……那、那我们可以一起去吗？”

“给老大长长脸！”

“对对对！”

狐妖歪了下头，倒是没有想到历史回廊里圆滚滚的鸟儿居然是个老大。

Chapter 50 (Part 1)

The "youth" on the bed let out a soft breath, seemingly awakened by the noise. Bai Linlin vaguely felt something press lightly against his forehead, a sensation that felt intimately sweet.

A bit like when he was little...

The nightlight was on, casting a warm yellow glow. His vision gradually cleared, and he slowly realized someone had come to the bedside.

The other person propped himself up on one arm, looking down at him.

Bai Linlin felt the duvet was exceptionally cozy and originally wanted to burrow deeper inside, but the figure in his peripheral vision possessed far too strong a presence.

He stole a glance and murmured in a muffled, drowsy voice:

"You're back?"

"Mm."

Song Yu's voice was gentle as he softly asked,

"At home today..."

Before he could finish his sentence, the "youth" reached up and hooked his arms around Song Yu's neck, slurring indistinctly as if saying:

"Hug."

Song Yu's body stiffened slightly. Yet the "person" on the bed pressed on in a half-dreaming state, asking:

"Didn't you want a hug?"

The bedroom was dead silent.

The veins on the back of Song Yu's hands bulged slightly. Leaning down, he gave in to the "person's" wishes and said softly:

"Mm."

Having completed his task, Bai Linlin tumbled back into dreamland almost instantly. He was wearing pajamas, the sleeves of which had bunched up around his elbows, and he forgot to release his hold on the person he was hugging.

Only later, feeling vaguely uncomfortable in his haze, did he raise a hand to push him away.

Song Yu caught hold of that wrist.

He couldn't help rubbing it gently a couple of times.

"I won't disturb you anymore."

Whether the "youth" on the bed heard him or not, his brow unfurled. Turning his head to the side, he fell fast asleep once again.

Song Yu originally intended to watch him a while longer, but a light knock sounded at the bedroom door. He had no choice but to get up and head over.

-

Outside the door stood Song Zhengguo. The old man looked exceptionally grave, pacing back and forth in anxiety.

Seeing his grandson come out, he first poked his head in to look inside the room before asking in a low voice:

"I didn't wake the bird, did I?"

Song Yu raised his hand to pull the door shut, speaking calmly:

"No, he's asleep."

"What's wrong, Grandpa?"

Hearing this, Song Zhengguo merely took a deep breath. Realizing the hallway was no place for conversation, the two moved to the study.

"This is bad."

Song Yu hadn't changed out of his clothes yet. He was wearing a crisp, fitted dress shirt and was in the middle of unbuckling his wristwatch. Hearing this, he furrowed his brow. What could be so serious?

Operations at Huabing Corporation were completely normal.

Even his father in S Province hadn't caused any trouble.

By all logic—

"That crane is coming over tonight!"

Song Yu's movements froze at the words, his expression tinged with disbelief.

"What?"

-

Inside the Demon Management Bureau, lights blazed brilliantly. The festive lantern decorations from the New Year had not yet been taken down, and the corridors connecting the main hall to various activity areas rippled with flowing golden runes. Buzzing conversations echoed back and forth.

"Are you on annual leave?"

"Yeah, finally got back. I'm utterly exhausted."

"Me too. There's literally zero decent food in the autonomous region. Bureau 749 only ever serves instant noodles and ham sausages..."

"It seems the Bureau took in quite a few young demons this year?"

...

001 sat on the sofa clad in all black. Slender fingers unwrapped a lollipop and popped it into his mouth, making his cheek bulge out immediately.

Strawberry flavor.

The Bureau was particularly lively today because the demons who had been away on missions last year had returned. Most of them had no guardians, and almost all were S-grade or above. Registered locally in Nanshi City, they returned here for their holidays.

001 was among the younger ones and had never been sent on business trips, so he didn't have much to chime in with.

However...

The little sparrow thought: *I've traveled before.*

Right at that moment—

"001?"

The Red-crowned Crane's voice drifted from behind. The black-clothed youth instantly poofed back into his original form—a fluffy little bird sitting upright in solemn posture, though his claw was still clutching the stick of the lollipop.

"..."

The Red-crowned Crane sighed, merely waving a wing at the little sparrow on the sofa:

"Come over. We need to discuss something."

Round and chubby, 001 tilted his bird head to glance at the lollipop. Deliberately using his beak, he picked it up, placed it back inside the unwrapped wrapper, and tucked in his wings, intending to come back and eat it later.

...

A few demons had gathered at the History Corridor of the main hall. Most were in human form, though some retained their favorite animal traits.

A grey-haired "youth" was looking up at a massive photo with a red background, distinct spines jutting out from his fingertips. Beside him, a lady in a fitted black outfit was looking down, adjusting her hairpin, golden-glistening scales gleaming near the corners of her eyes. And the one conversing with the Red-crowned Crane... was a demon with a fox head on a human body. Clad in ancient robes, his eyes narrowed into slits—seemingly friendly, yet radiating an aura of intimidation.

001 was the youngest S-grade demon. Having transformed back into human form, he followed them over, listening to their conversation with a serious face.

"Is that so? Then this young demon certainly possesses extraordinary talent."

The Red-crowned Crane nodded in agreement, continuing:

"He's quite young. He used to live in the flower and bird market at Qiushui Alley, but a young man took him in—who is now his guardian."

"The one in the photo."

The hedgehog demon beside them examined the photo intently, instinctively reaching out a hand to touch it. But he had forgotten about the spines protruding from his skin. Just as he reached out—

001 stepped directly in front of him, saying with a deadpan serious face:

"Don't ruin it."

"..."

The hedgehog demon clicked his tongue with a "tch," then obediently stood aside, yawning as he listened to the two demons converse.

"His guardian is Nanshi's richest man? The sole grandson?"

The fox demon narrowed his eyes, somewhat curious.

"Yes. Furthermore, the special agent from Bureau 749 knows 247's family."

The Red-crowned Crane meticulously supplemented the information, bringing up the main point for today:

"Now that 247 has just reached adulthood, our Bureau has always held a tradition of presenting gifts. However, the situation this time is somewhat special, so I was thinking..."

The fox demon grasped the context and murmured leisurely:

"I understand."

"Since Bureau 749 has ties with the Song family, our Bureau naturally cannot fall behind... Cultivating good relations with influential humans is clearly essential."

The corners of the fox's eyes curled up with a hint of wicked charm.

He tilted his head.

"A gift... Gold, silver, and jewels might not be enough. Why not use magical artifacts?"

-

[Gifting]

Originally, this practice applied only to young demons with human guardians. The Bureau's longstanding tradition was to gift minor items—mostly small magical artifacts meant to ward off disease and misfortune—enchanted onto everyday objects.

Plushies, pens, harmonicas...

They were customized according to the guardian's profile on file.

However, 247 was currently an exception in every sense.

First, his demon force level was steadily rising, with only the final evaluation remaining—which was essentially a done deal for an S-grade demon.

Second, his guardian possessed immense social status—a prominent tycoon in Nanshi with an extensive network, even connected to members of Bureau 749. He could not be underestimated.

Third, he possessed an astounding talent for human culture and was currently the Bureau's most promising candidate for central training. He truly deserved utmost attention.

For these reasons:

The Red-crowned Crane stated gravely:

"It must be grand and impressive. We need to give 247 some real clout."

The fox demon naturally waved his hand, gathering all the young demons in the Bureau together. Bending down with a beaming smile, he said:

"Come, offer your suggestions."

The little demons below whispered among themselves, and several eagerly spoke up:

"Gifts... Can—can we all go together?"

"To give Boss some face!"

"Yeah, yeah, yeah!"

The fox demon tilted his head, quite surprised that the round, chubby bird in the History Corridor was actually a "Boss."

chunks.chineseText:
它只是想了想，挥手幻化出来了几个木头箱子，上面还绑着红色的绸缎，前后用横木穿着。

大厅里的鼠鼠很是好奇地看了过去，有几只还跑过去试着扛了抗，但没有弄动，爪子在地板上打滑。

狐狸妖很是从容地拢了拢袖子，转而对着丹顶鹤道：

“那小妖要升S级？那是对它的监护人……”

丹顶鹤挥了挥翅膀，很是怒其不争地道：

“上次和我说寿命的事，一岁不到，想好了同它监护人殉情的事……”

狐狸妖闻言一怔，而后就是哈哈大笑。

“有趣。”

“我要见一见。”

001此刻已经化成了灰棕色的小雀，羽毛蓬松，站在那个大箱子上，只是高高兴兴地想着。

待会就可以见到247了。

“那这样，我打个头，我在西部那里淘了些好玩意儿，全当送给小辈一个见面礼。”

原来那个面部有鳞片的女士走了过来，抬手调动妖力，木头箱子自动打开，它扔进去了一些法器，铃铛、短刃、面纱……

“给它玩玩儿。”

狐狸妖许久没回南市，得知管理局出了个有天赋的小妖，也是很满意的，见状也一挥衣袖，琳琅满目的法器就填满了箱子，泛着些金色的光泽。

“那我也送些。”

“毕竟待会是第一次见面。”

管理局里热热闹闹的，连刚才那个刺猬妖也凑了过来，扔进去了一个银色的指虎，然后又翻翻找找，拿出一个布袋子来，悉数倒进去了。

还有一枚狼牙。

灰发的少年看了看旁边的001，抬了抬下巴。

“……”

妖怪们仿佛是有了默契，开始纷纷地排队往里面扔自己的礼物，除了那些出差回来的S级妖怪，普通小妖也认认真真地送东西。

包括最喜欢的小玩偶。

钥匙扣。

领带结。

氛围相当和谐，扔完礼物的小妖怪还挤在一起窃窃私语，大多都是盼望着待会出去能够带上它们。

那可是老大的家！

难得一见！

丹顶鹤也很是满意，从自己的书柜里扔进去了厚厚的一堆典籍，理论知识的，实践操作的，顺带……丢进去一本双修手册，成年版的。

001着实没有什么好东西，它歪头思考了下，走上前去，把自己零钱包扔了进去。

……

与此同时，锦园。

宋郁听完这话其实是皱了皱眉的，赠礼，什么时候的事？

“上次那鹤来家里说过这事，我……我给忘了，没想到是今天。”

宋峥国其实是有些着急的，说完这话又拍了拍大腿，想起来什么，抬眸看向自己孙子。

“对了！你奶奶留了东西的！”

两人最后去了三楼，那是储藏室，宋郁就这么看着自己爷爷拉出来个木头箱子，给轻巧地打开了。

里面全是些金银首饰，均是没有戴过的，意义不言而喻。

宋郁一时半会还没有太反应过来，只是又确定了下：

“爷爷，是今天的子时吗？”

老头儿其实一直在碎碎念，对着木头箱子：

“沅清，这留了大半辈子的东西，到底是派上用场了，小郁是个好孩子，这事儿……说到底还是怪我，不过沅清啊，鸟儿也很好。”

宋郁没办法，只能俯身蹲下，再问了一句：

“爷爷，是子时吗？”

宋峥国这才回了回神，点头道：

“对对对，那'布帛'上写的就是子时。”

“……”

宋郁拿出来了手机，现在时间已经是十一点半了。

时辰到了。

-

邻居此刻正在熬夜看电视剧，毕竟是热播剧场，她打了个哈欠，怀里的猫咪也发出了稳定的摩托声。

[没有什么原因，就是不爱了。]

[不爱了？你说不爱就不爱了？]

男主步步逼近，女主节节败退。

邻居啧啧，这不得亲一口？

然而就在这时，画面突然停了，开始播放了片尾曲，以及演员表……

“！”

天杀的！

天杀的！

邻居震怒，这谁让它们这么断的？

良心在哪里？

“喵……”

怀里的小猫开始伸懒腰，前爪往前伸，屁股撅得高高的，尾巴也竖了起来。

邻居眯了眯眼，开始一阵蹂躏，但就在这时，飘窗那里传来了悠扬的音乐，像是那种古代的……笛子？

还有什么节拍？

现在都是十一点多了，谁在外面啊？

邻居蹙眉，物业没管吗？

但就在这时，怀里的猫一下子跳了出来，站在了飘窗那里，眼睛直勾勾地看着外面。

邻居只好下床走了过去，也跟着看了下窗外，什么都没有，地面上还有些落叶。

但是，那个奏乐声还在响……

邻居皱了皱眉，拿了件外套就打算去门口看一看，这物业怎么回事？

不过就在她走到门口的时候，发现自己的猫没有跟过来，它还在直勾勾地看着外面。

“……”

三分钟后。

邻居抱着自己的大肥猫站在了玄关那里，偷偷打开了门，那道奏乐的声音在不远处，似乎到了拐角处了。

谁啊？

她拿出来了自己的手机，打算待会拍个照发给物业，问问什么情况。

也就在这时，那道奏乐的声音更近了，像是直接走到了别墅门口的那条路。

邻居懵懵的，因为她还是没有看到人，或许是家里还有人的缘故，她完全没觉得害怕，反倒是觉得奇怪。

拿出来手机就打算录个视频。

但就在这时，怀里的猫突然挣脱开了，站在门口对着她就是一个飞踢。

力道出奇的大。

邻居手机都被撞掉了，很恍惚，后面才发现那道奏乐声，停了。

人这会儿才觉得头皮发麻，捞着猫就关上了门，哐哐哐地往卧室里冲。

-

与此同时，别墅外面。

有长长的一行“人”，灯火通明，有小蛇妖盘成人形，扛着那些厚重的箱子，它们还特地换上了古代的衣服，双襟的那种。

管理局的妖怪全部都来了。

粗略估计，有几百号妖，浩浩荡荡的。

一共十个箱子，系着红绸缎，两侧有着各色各样的妖怪走着路，它们手里提着灯笼，妖头人形，此刻正在看着一个方向。

箱子上的鼠鼠还在动情地拉着二胡。

旁边打鼓的那只啪嗒敲了下伙伴的脑袋，示意它注意下情况。

“被看到了吗？”

狐妖眯了眯眼，手在袖子里拢着，并排的还有丹顶鹤，以及它翅膀上的灰棕色小雀。

“没事，一看就是熬夜的。”

“气场弱了而已。”

丹顶鹤很是从容地讲道。

狐妖笑眯眯的，对此不可置否，只是对着后面抬了抬手。

鼠鼠看到号令，立马开始奏乐。

队伍又开始行进了起来。

后排的侏儒兔蹦蹦跳跳的，拿着iphone拍了几张照，抽空又发了个朋友圈。

-

宋峥国其实已经心如死灰，紧张得不知道怎么办，客厅那里摆满了东西，餐桌、茶几上都是些水果糕点……

他还去拿了珍藏的茶叶，都给沏好了。

至于还礼。

Chapter 50 (Part 2)

After a moment's thought, he waved his sleeve and conjured several wooden chests bound with red silk ribbons, strung through with carrying poles at the front and back.

The little mice in the hall peered over curiously. A few ran over to try lifting them, but couldn't budge them at all, their paws slipping against the floor.

The fox demon smoothly tucked his sleeves together, turning to the Red-crowned Crane:

"That young demon is ascending to S-grade? So toward his guardian, he..."

The Red-crowned Crane flapped his wings, exasperated by his lack of ambition:

"Last time he brought up the topic of lifespan with me. Less than a year old, and he's already planning to die for love with his guardian..."

The fox demon froze for a moment upon hearing this, then burst into a booming laugh.

"Fascinating."

"I must meet him."

001 had transformed into a puffy, grey-brown little sparrow, perched atop one of the large chests, thinking happily to himself:

*I'll get to see 247 in a bit.*

"How about this: I'll lead off. I picked up some nice gizmos out West, consider it a meeting gift for the junior."

The lady with scales on her face walked over and channeled her demon power. The wooden chest popped open automatically, and she tossed in a few magical artifacts—bells, daggers, veils...

"Something for him to play around with."

The fox demon hadn't returned to Nanshi in a long time. Pleased to hear that the Bureau had nurtured such a talented young demon, he too flicked his sleeve. A dazzling array of magical artifacts filled the chest to the brim, glowing with a soft golden light.

"Then I shall give some as well."

"After all, this will be our first meeting."

The Bureau was filled with lively chatter. Even the hedgehog demon from earlier ambled over, tossing in a pair of silver brass knuckles. After rummaging around some more, he pulled out a cloth pouch and poured its entire contents inside.

Along with a wolf fang.

The grey-haired youth glanced at 001 beside him and jerked his chin upward.

"..."

As if by tacit agreement, the demons lined up one by one to throw in their gifts. Aside from the S-grade demons returning from business trips, even the ordinary little demons presented their items with utmost sincerity.

Including their favorite plushies.

Keychains.

Tie clips.

The atmosphere was exceptionally harmonious. After depositing their gifts, the little demons crowded together, whispering in hushed excitement, mostly hoping they would be allowed to join the outing.

That was Boss's house!

A rare sight indeed!

The Red-crowned Crane was immensely pleased, dumping a thick stack of ancient volumes from his bookshelf into the chest—covering theoretical knowledge, practical techniques, and... casually tossing in an adult dual-cultivation manual.

001 genuinely didn't have anything valuable. Tilting his head in thought, he stepped forward and dropped his coin purse right in.

...

At the same time, in Jinyuan Gardens.

Song Yu couldn't help but frown upon hearing this. *Gift presentation? When was this agreed upon?*

"That crane mentioned it last time he came over. I... I forgot about it! Who knew it would be tonight?"

Song Zhengguo was genuinely panicking. After saying this, he slapped his thigh, remembered something, and looked up at his grandson.

"Right! Your grandmother left something behind!"

The two eventually went up to the third floor, which served as a storage room. Song Yu watched as his grandfather pulled out a wooden chest and flipped it open effortlessly.

Inside was filled with gold and silver jewelry, none of which had ever been worn—their significance self-evident.

Song Yu couldn't quite react right away, merely asking to confirm:

"Grandpa, is it tonight at the Zi hour?"

The old man was actually muttering to himself, addressing the wooden chest:

"Yuanqing, these things kept for half a lifetime are finally put to good use. Xiao Yu is a good kid. In the end... this whole thing is still my fault, but Yuanqing, the bird is wonderful too."

Left with no choice, Song Yu squatted down beside him and asked once more:

"Grandpa, is it at the Zi hour?"

Only then did Song Zhengguo snap out of his reverie and nod:

"Yes, yes, yes. That silk scroll specified the Zi hour."

"..."

Song Yu pulled out his phone. It was already 11:30 PM.

The hour had arrived.

-

A neighbor was pulling an all-nighter watching a TV show—a hit drama series, after all. She yawned as the cat in her arms let out a steady, motor-like purr.

["There's no reason. I just don't love you anymore."]

["Don't love me anymore? You think you can just stop loving me whenever you want?"]

The male lead closed in step by step while the female lead retreated in defeat.

The neighbor clicked her tongue: *Aren't they going to kiss now?*

Yet at that exact moment, the screen suddenly froze and began playing the ending theme, along with the credits...

"!"

Damn it all!

Curse this show!

The neighbor was furious. Who authorized a cliffhanger like this?

Where was their conscience?

"Meow..."

The kitten in her arms began to stretch, extending its front paws forward, arching its butt high, and sticking its tail straight up.

The neighbor narrowed her eyes and started smothering the cat with affection. But right at that moment, melodious music drifted in from the bay window—sounding like some ancient... flute?

And what was that rhythm?

It was already past 11:00 PM. Who on earth was outside?

Frowning, she wondered: *Is property management not doing anything about this?*

Just then, the cat leaped out of her arms, perched at the bay window, and stared intently outside.

The neighbor had no choice but to get out of bed and walk over. She looked out the window too, but saw nothing except a few fallen leaves on the ground.

And yet, the music continued to play...

Furrowing her brows, she grabbed a jacket, intending to head to the front door to check. What was wrong with property management?

However, as she reached the door, she realized her cat hadn't followed. It was still staring intently outside.

"..."

Three minutes later.

The neighbor stood at the entryway cradling her chubby cat, cautiously opening the front door. The music sounded nearby, seemingly approaching the corner.

*Who could it be?*

She pulled out her phone, planning to snap a photo to send to property management and demand an explanation.

At that moment, the music grew even closer, sounding as if it had turned directly onto the road in front of the villa.

The neighbor was baffled because she still couldn't see a soul. Perhaps because there were other people in her house, she didn't feel scared at all, only deeply perplexed.

She unlocked her phone, intending to record a video.

Suddenly, the cat broke free from her arms, stood at the threshold, and launched a flying kick straight at her face!

The force was surprisingly strong.

Her phone was knocked out of her hand. Feeling dazed, she only then realized the music had stopped.

Only now did her scalp tingle with horror. Scooping up her cat, she slammed the door shut and sprinted straight back to her bedroom.

-

Meanwhile, outside the villa.

A long procession of "people" advanced under bright lanterns. Little snake demons in human form carried heavy chests, specially dressed in double-breasted ancient robes.

Every single demon from the Bureau had arrived.

By rough estimate, there were several hundred demons in a grand and magnificent march.

A total of ten chests bound in red silk were escorted by diverse demons walking on both sides. Holding lanterns high, their animal heads sat atop human bodies, all gazing in one direction.

A little mouse perched atop a chest was passionately playing the erhu.

The drum-playing demon beside it gave its buddy a rap on the head, motioning for it to pay attention to the surroundings.

"Were we seen?"

The fox demon narrowed his eyes, tucking his hands inside his sleeves as he walked side-by-side with the Red-crowned Crane, who carried the grey-brown sparrow on his wing.

"No matter. Clearly someone pulling an all-nighter."

"Just a bit low on vital aura."

The Red-crowned Crane remarked with complete composure.

The fox demon gave a genial smile, neither agreeing nor disagreeing, simply raising a hand toward the back.

Seeing the signal, the little mouse immediately struck up the music again.

The grand procession resumed its march.

A dwarf rabbit hopping in the rear snapped a few photos with an iPhone, taking time to post them onto WeChat Moments.

-

Song Zhengguo was actually feeling a sense of utter dread, so nervous he didn't know what to do. The living room was piled high with items—fruits and pastries laid out across the dining table and coffee table...

He had even fetched his prized tea leaves and brewed a fresh pot.

As for return gifts...

chunks.chineseText:
则是那一小箱子珠宝首饰。

宋峥国是真的拿出了所有的诚意了，他手心都是汗，生怕待会招待不好。

“爷爷，我去卧室一趟，如果管理局真的来了，粼粼得起床……”

宋郁面色平和，其实还算镇定，不过也换了一身比较正式的衣服，他爷爷更是如此，甚至戴上了百达翡丽的表。

“那、那待会它们要是来了？”

“算了，你快去吧。”

宋峥国深呼吸一口气，说完这话就故作不在意地在客厅里踱步了几圈。

没事，没事。

他见过那鹤的，还说过话。

这次也一样的……

宋郁抬步上楼去了。

-

白粼粼其实睡得很舒服，因而在被单手捞起来的时候还有些懵懵的，浅蓝色的头发都打了弯，“少年”扶着来人的肩头，仰头看了过去，不解地道：

“宋郁……你又回来了？”

“我抱过你了。”

宋郁只是抬手往上一带，把“人”稳稳地抱了起来，手托式的那种。

“我知道。”

白粼粼心想完成任务了，他迷迷糊糊地就要下来，手都开始推了，但就在这时——

“换件衣服？管理局那边可能来人。”

“好不好？”

白粼粼理解了下，很茫然地转过来了头，说了一个字：

“啊？”

-

宋峥国还在自己调理，他时不时地看看楼上，想催促一下，又觉得不好，他毕竟年纪最大，没道理犯怵。

也就在这时，客厅窗外那里突然传来了悠扬的音乐……

由远及近。

宋峥国愣了下，当即就觉得不对，手都抖了起来，连忙给自己孙子打电话。

不过就在这时——

门口传来了叩叩的动静。

……

白粼粼很困地站在衣帽间里，手腕被牵着，迷迷糊糊地看着宋郁手里的衣服，对方只是一边拿，一边问：

“这个？”

“不要。”

“这个？”

白粼粼摇了摇头，他还是有自己的搭配思路的，虽然现在还是很想去床上睡觉。

大约过了四五分钟，挑好了。

“少年”拿着衣服去换了，针织的咖色毛衣，搭配的其实还是短裤，毕竟在家里，温度很合适，然后戴了个格纹的贝雷帽。

“穿好了……它们为什么要来呀？”

白粼粼是真的睡懵了，他前几天通宵，本来就没调好，这次一下子按时睡，反倒是睡不够了，脑子都很晕……

宋郁牵着“人”的手，单手揽住了腰，往床边那里走，拿出来正确的袜子，低头去把穿错的脱了下来，解释道：

“爷爷说管理局今晚给了提示，说要来赠礼，上次丹顶鹤来家里的时候说的，他老人家忘记告诉我们了。”

白粼粼其实左耳朵进右耳朵出，他只是打哈欠，再反应过来的时候，窗户外面已经有了奏乐的声音了。

宋郁的动作一顿，抬眸看了下窗户。

来了？

-

客厅。

宋峥国打开门的时候，瞳孔都放大了下，张了张口，最后只是后退，后退完了又觉得不对，立马鞠躬，鞠躬完了才发现得说话，连忙道：

“啊，欢迎，欢迎。”

门口不仅仅是一只鹤。

而是全门类的妖怪，宋峥国头一次见到兽头人形的……它们还穿着服帖的古代衣服，为首的那个狐妖还了下礼，鞠了一躬。

“人类，你是247的监护人？”

丹顶鹤闻言解释了下：“他不是，他是监护人的爷爷。”

狐妖倒是意外，手腕上的铃铛发出了脆响，很仔细地观察着面前的人。

宋峥国没有任何办法，只能是先拉开门，解释道：

“小郁在楼上，大、大家先进来。”

后面的妖怪跃跃欲试的，侏儒兔还蹦跶了两下，它头一次看这么大的房子，箱子上的鼠鼠也摞成了金字塔的样子，开始瞭望。

老大的家？

于是事情就变成这样了。

宋峥国在门口，一个一个地迎了进来，从一开始看到狐妖的模样震惊……到后面看到一排排拿着乐器的小鼠进来时的面色麻木。

没事的。

没事的。

不到一会，客厅里满满当当的，全部都是非人之物，它们的视线一致且好奇，全部都在看着这个年长的人类。

直到——

楼梯处传来动静。

宋郁牵着“人”下来了，面色从容，低声道：

“粼粼……”

但就在这时，身后的“少年”愣住了，不由自主地往后退了下，困意散得干干净净。

有点，可怕。

白粼粼甚至立马就想要化为本体，但还是硬生生地压住了，走到了客厅的中央，看着五花八门的兽头。

“……”

砰！

地板上出现了一只圆滚滚的小鸟。

狐妖笑眯眯的，以为这是特地给它展示的，抬起来了手，金纹流动，往下一点，白粼粼自动化形了。

“！”

鸟震惊。

丹顶鹤看见247这没出息的样子就闭了闭眼，然后才开口一一给介绍了下，顺带看向了宋家的那老头子。

挥了挥翅膀。

“赠礼都在这里了。”

宋峥国看到十个箱子的时候，天塌了。

狐妖倒是没太在意那个人类，只是将目光看到了旁边的少年，这就是……那个孙子？

相貌倒是的确不错。

它歪了歪头，观察了下。

宋郁坦坦荡荡的，直视过去。

氛围其实有点过于安静了。

但下一秒。

狐妖转头看向诸妖怪，笑眯眯地道：

“不是照骗。”

“……”

最后才算是步入了正题，狐妖许久没回来，头一次过来镇镇场子，也是觉得新鲜极了，抬手幻化出来了一张契，然后才看向丹顶鹤：

“你来吧。”

白粼粼懵懵的，他只是不由得往宋郁那里又贴了下。

这……怎么这么多妖。

都来家里了。

丹顶鹤只是优雅地迈步上前，收了收翅膀，给了面前的“少年”一个眼神，然后抬了抬鸟头。

有金线飘了过去……

白粼粼脑海里多了一道声音：

“站直，站直，这都是给你摇来的前辈……表现好点。”

“少年”立马调整了下站姿，板板正正的，同面前的狐妖鞠了一躬。

狐妖笑眯眯的：“好孩子。”

丹顶鹤心里更是满意了，很谦虚地道：“247还是很懂事的……”

宋峥国就站在一旁，默默的。

-

很快，半空中就多了一道契。

上面有密密麻麻的文字，大抵只有两个主体，分别是妖与人。

最后的八个字是：

[不得违背。]

[不得违背。]

丹顶鹤只是对着宋郁解释道：

“247此后定然会升至S级，之前的事……我们也聊过了，我们妖怪的诚意是非常大的，相信你也能看到。”

白粼粼闻言仰头看着他们，心想聊过了？聊了什么？

他怎么不知道。

直到——

“247都愿意与你同生共死，那你也自然要拿出来诚意，此为双生契，不得背叛，不得欺骗，不得逃避……”

“你愿意吗？”

白粼粼一阵恍惚，什么？
chunks.englishText:
...It was that small chest of jewelry and trinkets.

Song Zhengguo had truly put his entire heart and soul into this sincerity; his palms were slick with sweat, terrified that he wouldn't host them properly later.

"Grandpa, I'm going to the bedroom for a moment. If the Administration really arrives, Linlin needs to get up..."

Song Yu's expression was calm, and he was actually quite composed, though he had changed into a relatively formal outfit. His grandfather was even more so, having gone so far as to put on a Patek Philippe watch.

"W-What if they arrive later?"

"Never mind, you go ahead quickly."

Song Zhengguo drew a deep breath, and after saying this, he feigned nonchalance and paced back and forth around the living room a few times.

It's fine. Everything's fine.

He had already seen that crane and even spoken with it.

It would be the same this time...

Song Yu lifted his steps and went upstairs.

-

Bai Linlin was actually sleeping very comfortably, which was why he still felt a bit dazed when he was scooped up with one arm. His light blue hair was all ruffled and curled up. The "young man" steadied himself by grasping the newcomer's shoulder, tilted his head up, and asked in confusion:

"Song Yu... You're back again?"

"I've already carried you."

Song Yu merely raised his hand in an upward heave, carrying the "person" securely in a supportive cradle hold.

"I know."

Bai Linlin figured his task was complete and sleepily tried to get down, even starting to push away with his hands, but right at that moment—

"Change into another outfit? People from the Administration might come over."

"Alright?"

Bai Linlin tried to process this, turned his head with a blank look, and uttered a single syllable:

"Huh?"

-

Song Zhengguo was still trying to calm his own nerves. From time to time, he glanced upstairs, wanting to urge them along, but felt it would be improper. After all, he was the eldest; there was no reason for him to be getting the jitters.

Right at that moment, melodious music suddenly drifted in from outside the living room window...

Growing from distant to near.

Song Zhengguo froze. Instantly sensing that something was wrong, his hands began to tremble, and he hurriedly dialed his grandson's phone.

However, right then—

A rapping sound came from the front door.

...

Bai Linlin was standing sleepily in the walk-in closet, his wrist held, looking in a daze at the clothes in Song Yu's hands. The other man merely picked them out one by one and asked:

"This one?"

"No."

"How about this?"

Bai Linlin shook his head. He still had his own matching philosophy, even though right now he just desperately wanted to go back to bed and sleep.

After about four or five minutes, the selection was made.

The "young man" went to change into the clothes: a knitted brown sweater paired, in truth, with a pair of shorts, since they were at home and the indoor temperature was very comfortable. To top it off, he wore a checkered beret.

"I'm dressed... Why are they coming here anyway?"

Bai Linlin was truly dazed from sleep. He had stayed up all night a few days ago and hadn't adjusted his schedule yet. Now that he was suddenly sleeping on time, he actually felt like he hadn't slept enough, his head spinning...

Song Yu held the "person's" hand, wrapped one arm around his waist, and walked toward the side of the bed. He pulled out the correct pair of socks, lowered his head to take off the ones put on incorrectly, and explained:

"Grandpa said the Administration gave a hint tonight, saying they're coming to bestow gifts. They mentioned it the last time the red-crowned crane came to the house, but the old man forgot to tell us."

Bai Linlin's left ear went in and right ear out; he was simply yawning. By the time he reacted, the sound of music was already playing outside the window.

Song Yu's movements paused, and he raised his gaze toward the window.

They're here?

-

The living room.

When Song Zhengguo opened the door, his pupils dilated sharply. He opened his mouth, but ended up merely stepping back. After retreating, he felt that wasn't right either, and immediately bowed. Only after bowing did he realize he needed to speak, and hurriedly blurted out:

"Ah, welcome, welcome."

At the doorway stood far more than just a single crane.

It was an entire roster of spirits. For the first time, Song Zhengguo laid eyes on beasts with human bodies... They were even dressed in well-fitted ancient garments. The fox spirit leading the group returned the courtesy with a bow.

"Human, are you 247's guardian?"

Hearing this, the red-crowned crane chimed in to explain: "He is not. He is the guardian's grandfather."

The fox spirit looked surprised, the bell on its wrist emitting a crisp chime as it carefully observed the person before it.

Song Zhengguo had no other choice; he could only pull the door open wider and explain:

"Xiaoyu is upstairs. E-Everyone, please come inside first."

The spirits in the back were eager to try their hand at things. A pygmy rabbit hopped up and down—it was the first time it had ever seen such a huge house—while the little mice stacked atop the chests like a pyramid began to survey their surroundings.

The boss's home?

And so, things turned out this way.

Song Zhengguo stood at the entrance, welcoming them in one by one. From his initial shock upon seeing the fox spirit's appearance... to his numb expression later on as a procession of little mice carrying musical instruments marched inside.

It's fine.

Everything's fine.

Before long, the living room was packed to the brim with non-human entities. Their gazes were uniform and brimming with curiosity as they all stared at the elderly human.

Until—

Movement came from the staircase.

Song Yu led the "person" down, his expression composed as he lowered his voice:

"Linlin..."

Yet at that very second, the "young man" behind him froze, instinctively shrinking back a step as the last dregs of sleepiness vanished completely.

A bit... terrifying.

Bai Linlin even had the immediate urge to revert to his true form, though he managed to forcibly suppress it. He walked to the center of the living room, facing the kaleidoscope of beast heads.

"..."

*Thud!*

A plump little bird materialized on the floor.

The fox spirit smiled warmly, assuming this was a special display put on just for it. It raised its hand with golden patterns flowing across it, tapped downward, and Bai Linlin automatically transformed back.

"!"

The bird was shocked.

Upon seeing 247's pathetic display, the red-crowned crane closed its eyes for a moment before stepping forward to introduce everyone one by one, while casting a glance at the old man of the Song family.

It fluttered its wings.

"All the gifts are right here."

When Song Zhengguo caught sight of the ten chests, his world felt like it was caving in.

The fox spirit didn't pay too much attention to the human, instead casting its gaze toward the young man standing nearby. So this was... that grandson?

His appearance was indeed quite good.

It tilted its head, observing him.

Song Yu was open and untroubled, meeting its gaze directly.

The atmosphere was, in truth, a bit too quiet.

Yet the next second.

The fox spirit turned its head toward the assembly of spirits and said with a beaming smile:

"Not a catfish scam." *(TN: internet slang for looking much better in person than expected / not being a photo fraud)*

"..."

Only then did they finally get down to business. The fox spirit hadn't returned in a long time, and coming over this once to establish its presence felt thoroughly refreshing. It raised its hand to materialize a contract, then looked to the red-crowned crane:

"You do it."

Bai Linlin was in a daze; he couldn't help but press himself a bit closer to Song Yu.

Why... are there so many spirits here?

And they all came to the house.

The red-crowned crane merely stepped forward with elegance, tucked in its wings, gave the "young man" before it a look, and lifted its bird head.

A thread of gold drifted across...

An extra voice echoed in Bai Linlin's mind:

"Stand straight, stand straight! These are all senior figures I pulled strings for you to meet... Put on a good performance."

The "young man" immediately adjusted his posture, standing rigidly straight as he bowed to the fox spirit before him.

The fox spirit smiled warmly: "Good child."

The red-crowned crane felt even more satisfied inside, and said with great modesty: "247 is quite sensible after all..."

Song Zhengguo stood off to the side, maintaining a quiet presence.

-

Soon, a contract materialized in mid-air.

Densely packed characters covered its surface, revolving primarily around two main entities: spirits and humans.

The final eight characters read:

[None shall violate.]

[None shall violate.]

The red-crowned crane simply explained to Song Yu:

"247 will undoubtedly rise to S-class hereafter. As for previous matters... we have also discussed them. The sincerity of us spirits is immense, and I believe you can see that."

Hearing this, Bai Linlin looked up at them, thinking: *We discussed it? What was discussed?*

How come he knew nothing about it?

Until—

"247 is even willing to share life and death with you, so naturally, you must show your sincerity as well. This is a twin-bound contract; no betrayal, no deception, no evasion..."

"Are you willing?"

Bai Linlin fell into a trance. What?

chunks.chineseText:
他是说了要一起死……可是这怎么换个说辞，就这么奇怪？

但就在这时。

“我愿意。”

-

宋峥国很拘谨地站在那堆妖怪里，那堆扛着乐器的小鼠在餐桌上挑挑拣拣的，一鼠拿着一个葡萄，其实都挑选好了，但还是看向了他。

斟酌地问：“人，我们能吃吗？”

宋峥国连忙道：“可以可以，就是给你们的。”

鼠鼠立马品鉴了起来。

然后发出惊叹的声音。

一开始还是一小堆妖怪，后面范围逐步扩大，都会认真地去餐桌、茶几上挑选自己喜欢的东西，然后排队过来询问这个老头子。

“这个能吃吗？”

“可以的。”

“这个也能吃吗？”

“可以的。”

最后别墅里居然一片祥和，小妖怪们从来没有见过这么多的好吃的，有几只已经开始蹦蹦跳跳地参观了。

那些双S级的妖怪们在一起讨论些什么，丹顶鹤特地带着“少年”过去了，很温和地道：

“247过段时间就可以到S级了，到时候我亲自给它把把关，来认识一下。”

001对着一套流程已经很熟悉了，环顾了下四周，决定也去拿个苹果排队去，那个老人看起来很和蔼的样子。

……

狐妖一直都笑眯眯的，只是问：

“这孩子去年八个月才来管理局，现在就快要到S级了？”

丹顶鹤脸不红心不跳地道：

“它天资比较高。”

白粼粼：“……”

反正就是这么交谈了下。

宋郁从头到尾保持一个很低的存在度，但目光始终是在那个“少年”身上的，它的小鸟……很受管理局的欢迎。

他要做的更好。

才可以。

不过就在这时，那位狐妖却看了过来，招了招手，示意人过来。

丹顶鹤其实愣了下，不由自主地道：

“这位监护人也特别的好……”

“我知道。”

狐妖笑眯眯地道。

“……”

白粼粼立马走到了宋郁旁边，抬手牵住了对方的手，其实是有些紧张的。

这里全是……妖。

“你好。”

宋郁面色平静地道，他的手指还划破了个口子，是为了签契。

正当双S级的妖怪都看了过来的时候——

狐妖很认真地询问：

“听说你……给管理局的小妖都发了手机？”

“……”

-

一直到凌晨左右，这堆妖怪才开始成群结队地离开，很认真地对门口的老头子挥手。

要么叼着果冻，要么叼着面包。

总之是扫荡一空。

宋峥国也是兢兢业业地挥手，这些小妖怪数量庞大，但又懂礼貌，他一晚上都在说“可以”。

至于那几个大妖怪，则是在门口同宋郁交代：

“手机内存也不用太大，256G就够我们用了……749局的人用的是那个什么牌子的，我们不要和他们一样的。”

狐妖揣着手，笑眯眯地道。

宋郁点了点头：

“这个您放心。”

狐妖真是越看越满意，丹顶鹤不由得有些骄傲，它就说，这247和247的监护人就是最搭的，历史回廊那照片就得挂着。

瞧瞧！

最后一众妖怪还是离开了，留下了那十个沉甸甸的木头箱子。

-

宋峥国当时准备的回礼其实管理局是拒绝了的，因为狐妖一看就知道怎么回事，只是道：

“给小妖留着吧。”

那天的事如梦似幻，实在是印象深刻。

宋峥国后面就应了陈开鹤的邀约，又出去钓鱼了，他需要平复一下心情。

主要是……那个契的事。

没事，没事。

陈开鹤后面一边挂鱼饵一边问：

“小郁这和那孩子在一起，恐怕也不会传宗接代，你这真的能接受啊？”

宋峥国始终在神游，闻言只是道：

“啊……啊，是，能。”

“……”

-

大约过了几周。

白粼粼正式地通过了S级的考核，他的红本本上的信息也得到了更正，宋郁也提前完成了学校的考试，迎来了暑假。

一人一鸟都有了空。

但就在这时——

丹顶鹤传讯过来了：

[247，你的信息我已上报，中央传来批复，你需在十日内进京……]
chunks.englishText:
He had said they would die together... but why did changing it into this phrasing sound so weird?

Yet right at that moment.

"I am willing."

-

Song Zhengguo stood somewhat apprehensively among the cluster of spirits. The group of mice carrying musical instruments were picking and choosing over the dining table, each holding a grape. Though they had already made their selections, they still looked toward him.

Deliberating, they asked: "Human, can we eat these?"

Song Zhengguo hurriedly replied: "Yes, you can, they're meant for you."

The mice immediately began to sample them.

Then let out sounds of exclamation.

Starting with just a small cluster of spirits, the scope gradually expanded until all of them were earnestly picking out their favorite items from the dining table and coffee table, then lining up to ask this old man:

"Can this be eaten?"

"Yes, you can."

"Can this be eaten too?"

"Yes."

In the end, absolute peace reigned inside the villa. The little spirits had never seen so much delicious food, and a few had already started hopping around to explore.

As for those double-S class spirits, they were gathered together discussing something. The red-crowned crane specially brought the "young man" over and said gently:

"247 will be able to reach S-class in a short while. When that time comes, I will personally oversee things for it. Come, introduce yourself."

001 was already quite familiar with this routine. Looking around its surroundings, it decided to go grab an apple and join the queue as well; that old man looked rather amiable.

...

The fox spirit had been smiling the entire time, and simply asked:

"This child only came to the Administration last year at eight months old, and now it's already about to reach S-class?"

Without turning a hair or skipping a beat, the red-crowned crane replied:

"Its natural talent is somewhat high."

Bai Linlin: "..."

And so, they conversed along those lines.

From beginning to end, Song Yu maintained a very low profile, but his gaze remained fixed squarely on the "young man." His little bird... was exceptionally popular with the Administration.

He needed to do better.

Only then would it be enough.

Right at that moment, however, the fox spirit looked over and beckoned, signaling for him to come closer.

The red-crowned crane actually paused for a second and instinctively blurted out:

"This guardian is also exceptionally good..."

"I know."

The fox spirit smiled warmly.

"..."

Bai Linlin immediately walked over to Song Yu's side, raising his hand to tug at the other man's fingers. In truth, he felt rather nervous.

This place was entirely filled with... spirits.

"Hello."

Song Yu said with a calm expression. A small cut was still visible on his finger—the result of signing the contract.

Just as the double-S class spirits all turned their attention over—

The fox spirit asked with utmost seriousness:

"I heard that you... gave cell phones to all the little spirits in the Administration?"

"..."

-

It wasn't until around midnight that this flock of spirits finally began to leave in packs, earnestly waving goodbye to the old man at the door.

Some had jelly clenched in their mouths, others bread.

In short, they had swept the place clean.

Song Zhengguo waved goodbye with conscientious dedication. Although the number of these little spirits was massive, they were well-mannered, and he had spent the entire evening repeating "yes, you can."

As for the major spirits, they lingered at the entrance to give Song Yu some parting instructions:

"The phone storage doesn't need to be too large; 256G is enough for us... The people at the 749 Bureau use that one particular brand, we don't want the same ones they have."

The fox spirit tucked its hands into its sleeves and smiled.

Song Yu nodded:

"Rest assured about that."

The more the fox spirit looked at him, the more satisfied it became. The red-crowned crane felt a surge of pride; it had always said that 247 and 247's guardian were the most perfect match—that photo in the Corridor of History really ought to be hung up.

Just look at them!

In the end, the crowd of spirits finally departed, leaving behind those ten heavy wooden chests.

-

As for the return gifts Song Zhengguo had prepared, the Administration had actually declined them, because one look from the fox spirit had revealed what was going on. It had simply said:

"Leave them for the little spirits."

That day's events felt like an illusion, leaving an impression far too profound to forget.

Later on, Song Zhengguo accepted Chen Kaihe's invitation to go fishing again. He needed to smooth out his state of mind.

Mostly because of... that contract business.

It's fine. Everything's fine.

While baiting his hook, Chen Kaihe asked:

"With Xiaoyu staying with that child like this, I'm afraid they won't be passing down the family line. Can you really accept that?"

Song Zhengguo had been spacing out and merely replied upon hearing this:

"Ah... Ah, yes, I can."

"..."

-

About a few weeks later.

Bai Linlin officially passed the S-class assessment, and the information on his red booklet was updated accordingly. Song Yu also finished his school examinations ahead of schedule, ushering in summer vacation.

Both the man and the bird finally had free time.

Yet right at that moment—

A transmission arrived from the red-crowned crane:

[247, I have already reported your information. The directive from headquarters has come down; you are required to enter the capital within ten days...]

chunks.chineseText:
第51章

白粼粼看到传讯之后就直接啪嗒啪嗒地冲向书房那里，因为宋郁在里面办公，身后的光幕其实是愣了下的，而后就是一路跟着。

最后抵达目的地。

宋郁弯腰伸手，他的小鸟立马攀爬了过来，站在肩头，收了收翅膀。

一人一鸟看向了半空中的“传讯”。

“进京？”

“啾！”

宋郁想到了前段时间丹顶鹤说的事，面色平和，只是侧头看向了自己肩头的小鸟。

白粼粼着实很骄傲。

羽毛蓬松，胸膛挺立。

他这可是头一次被“中央”召见，这妥妥的就是光宗耀祖……理应要昭告天下的。

宋郁的确直接去了一楼的茶室，他爷爷正在里面沏茶，见到来人后立马招了招手，鸟见状扑棱翅膀就飞了过去，稳稳地站在了老人的肩头。

“啾啾！”

“这怎么了？鸟儿找我？”

宋郁：“……”

“爷爷我找您。”

宋郁只好把方才的事情一五一十地说了，顺带说了下他自己的打算。

“那是，你当然要陪着，不过，鸟儿去中央……是要当大官吗？”

宋峥国倒是眉飞色舞了起来，身子微微后仰，朝自己肩头伸了伸手，鸟很矜持地伸爪子上来了。

他又感叹地道：

“那很好啊，爷爷可以教给你不少东西呢？虽说现在我们家里是从商了，原本都没有想过……”

圆滚滚的小鸟挺胸抬头的。

“这也算继承了家里的衣钵。”

“好好好。”

宋峥国是真的很高兴，以至于还从抽屉里翻出来了和田玉的扳指，当成了一个小礼物。

白粼粼扑棱翅膀下来了，很矜持地叼着那个玉石扳指，试图往自己爪子上套。

茶室里还在交谈：

“爷爷，这不是一件小事，管理局的妖怪尚且数量不可知，更何况是中央的，万一把粼粼分配到离家很远的地方呢？”

“那倒也是。”

“还有，您是有从政的经验，但那毕竟是人……粼粼以后管理的话，那就是各种各样的妖怪了……这不能归为一谈”

宋峥国不知道是最近升华了还是怎么的，已经彻底接受了，反而是摆了摆手，乐呵呵地道：

“都一样都一样。”

宋郁：“……”

-

总归是说不到一块去。

整个家里，只有宋郁一个人在担心，他的小鸟也才刚成年，一岁半，这么小就出去管理？

宋郁觉得三五岁才比较合适。

他在衣帽间里看着“少年”跪坐在地毯上挑选衣服，各种各样的上衣，短裤，还有帽子……配饰。

白粼粼其实很跃跃欲试的，他从前上学上班往往都是扮演的“被管理者”，反正没有什么主体参与感。

反倒是现在，每一天都很开心！

他这次可是代表着南市管理局的，一定要认认真真的准备。

“少年”还在挑选自己要带的衣服，其实没注意到宋郁已经俯身蹲下了，对方垂眸看着他，只是问：

“不会觉得累吗？”

白粼粼闻言抬眸看了过去，露出了相当不解的目光。

“……”

鸟已经被自己的前途亮得睁不开眼了。

大约晚上十点钟的时候。

白粼粼已经上床睡觉了，反倒是宋郁还在收拾一些行李，大体是在收尾，不过他还是查看了下京市的酒店，挑选了一下，订了个最贵的。

毕竟是出差。

丹顶鹤说的是培训之类的……希望他的小鸟一帆风顺。

宋郁走到了床边，刚想要抬手去碰一下，但突然发现自己的手背上出现了个圆圈的纹路，还泛着流动的金光。

他蹙了蹙眉，确切地说这不是个普通的图形，而是类似于……花瓣……一层层地往外散开。

宋郁愣了下，刚想要抬手仔细看下，余光却发现床上的少年后颈也有流动着的金纹，它睡得沉，脸颊泛着些湿红。

什么东西？

相同的图案。

宋郁没有吵醒床上的“人”，而是立即拿出来了手机联系丹顶鹤，对方回复得很及时，不过问得却是语焉不详的：

[图案？给我看看，拍照。]

宋郁照做。

[247状态怎么样？]

[它在睡觉。]

手机那边显示“正在输入中”，像是打了又删，总之是过了一会，才回复：

[摸一下它的额头，看看热不热？]

宋郁怔了下，而后就把手机放在了一边，微微倾身弯腰，轻声地道：

“粼粼？”

并不是为了叫醒，只是为了让“人”潜意识里知道是谁过来了。

“少年”脸颊歪了下，察觉到额头有冰凉的手指触感，不由得仰了仰下巴，唇瓣微微张着，呼了一口气。

宋郁拭了拭温，眉眼温和地打算收回来手，但就在这时，“少年”却一把攥住了他的手指，很自然地把脸埋在了他的掌心。

潮热……

有温软的唇瓣拂过。

宋郁有那么一两秒空白，直到手机又传来震动的声音：

[体温升高了没？]

宋郁这才回神，单手打字道：

[是有一些。]

对面那边倒是立马回复了：

[那你呢？]

宋郁其实不太明白，只是抬手扯了扯自己的衬衫领口，刚打字，那边就又弹了消息：

[咳咳，解释两件事，一是那个纹路，是当时你签订的那个血契的印记，它是狐妖特地的赠礼……会促进妖力流转。]

[那个就是修行的事………247不是还没和你修行么？不说这个。二，它亮了的话，其实是……说明……]

没有打完字。

宋郁皱了皱眉，他有些担忧，毕竟他的小鸟之前就发过烧……它很难受的。

不过就在他要抬手打字的时候，聊天页面上方又开始弹出来“正在输入中”的字样，一会出现，一会消失，好似很纠结。

“……”

宋郁看了一会，决定还是再问一下，也就在这时，丹顶鹤回复了：

[247快要发情了。]

-

卧室里一阵寂静。

宋郁体温也变高了，他愣了下，而后只是匆匆地把视线从手机上转移开了，深呼吸了一口气。

手机页面还在不断地弹消息：

[妖怪不像人类一年四季都在……我们是有规律的发情期的，咳咳，247它毕竟刚成年，对于自身控制能力不强，按道理来说是可以自己调整的。]

[但它过几天就要去京市了，教它也来不及了。]

[我给它发过手册的，你们看过吗？]

[247可能有点害羞……]

宋郁闭了闭眼，回头看了下手机，扫过那些信息之后，手背的青筋都微微凸起了，他起身刚要离开。

床上的“人”就被弄醒了，抓住了他的手腕，很不高兴地“嗯”了一声，但眼皮还是没有掀开的。

宋郁只能撑着手臂看过去，眼皮都泛着点热，出声安抚道：

“我不走。”

“没事……”

白粼粼迷迷糊糊的，就这么又靠着那个手背睡着了，贴着脸颊的那种，为了降温。

人心乱如麻。

-

丹顶鹤其实传授了一晚上的经验：
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 51

Upon seeing the transmission, Bai Linlin pattered as fast as he could straight toward the study because Song Yu was working inside. The light screen behind him flickered for a moment before trailing along the entire way.

He finally reached his destination.

Song Yu bent down and extended his hand. His little bird immediately scrambled up, perched on his shoulder, and tucked its wings.

Man and bird both looked toward the "transmission" floating in mid-air.

"Enter the capital?"

"Chirp!"

Song Yu thought of what the red-crowned crane had mentioned some time ago. With a calm expression, he merely turned his head to look at the little bird on his shoulder.

Bai Linlin was truly bursting with pride.

His feathers were fluffed out, and his chest was puffed up.

This was his very first time being summoned by "headquarters"—this was nothing short of bringing glory to his ancestors... It practically deserved to be proclaimed to the whole world.

Song Yu indeed went straight to the tea room on the first floor. His grandfather was brewing tea inside and waved him over the moment he saw them. Spotting this, the bird fluttered its wings and flew right over, landing steadily on the old man's shoulder.

"Chirp chirp!"

"What's this? Is the bird looking for me?"

Song Yu: "..."

"Grandpa, I'm looking for you."

Song Yu had no choice but to recount everything that had just happened from start to finish, along with his own plans.

"Well, of course you have to accompany him. But for the bird to go to headquarters... is it going to become a high-ranking official?"

Song Zhengguo beamed with high spirits, leaning back slightly as he reached a hand toward his shoulder. The bird very demurely extended a claw to step onto it.

With a sigh of admiration, he continued:

"That's wonderful. Grandpa can teach you quite a few things, you know? Although our family has branched into commerce now and never originally expected..."

The round little bird puffed out its chest even more.

"This can also be considered inheriting the family mantle."

"Splendid, splendid."

Song Zhengguo was so delighted that he even fished a Khotan jade thumb ring out of the drawer to serve as a small congratulatory gift.

Bai Linlin fluttered down, demurely clamped the jade thumb ring in his beak, and tried to slip it onto his claw.

The conversation continued in the tea room:

"Grandpa, this isn't a small matter. The number of spirits in the Administration is already unfathomable, let alone those at headquarters. What if Linlin gets assigned somewhere very far from home?"

"That's true as well."

"Furthermore, you have political experience, but those were humans... If Linlin is managing things in the future, he'll be dealing with all sorts of spirits... You can't lump them together."

Whether Song Zhengguo had undergone some recent spiritual sublimation or what, he had completely accepted the situation. Instead, he waved a hand dismissively and said with a hearty laugh:

"It's all the same, all the same."

Song Yu: "..."

-

They simply couldn't get on the same page.

Throughout the entire household, only Song Yu was worried. His little bird had only just reached adulthood—a year and a half old—and they were sending it out to manage things at such a tender age?

Song Yu felt that three or five years old would be much more appropriate.

Inside the walk-in closet, he watched as the "young man" knelt on the carpet, picking through clothes—various tops, shorts, hats... and accessories.

In truth, Bai Linlin was itching to try them all on. Whenever he went to school or work in the past, he usually played the role of the "managed," lacking any real sense of active participation.

On the contrary, every single day now was full of joy!

This time, he was representing the Nanshui City Administration; he absolutely had to prepare with the utmost seriousness.

The "young man" was still selecting the outfits he wanted to bring, oblivious to the fact that Song Yu had already crouched down. The man lowered his gaze to look at him and simply asked:

"Won't you feel tired?"

Hearing this, Bai Linlin raised his head to look over, wearing a thoroughly puzzled expression.

"..."

The bird was so blinded by the dazzling sheen of its own bright future that it couldn't even open its eyes properly.

Around ten o'clock in the night.

Bai Linlin had already gone to bed, whereas Song Yu was still tidying up some luggage, mostly putting the finishing touches on things. Still, he checked hotels in the capital city, filtered through them, and booked the most expensive one available.

After all, this was a business trip.

The red-crowned crane had mentioned something about training... He hoped his little bird's journey would be smooth sailing.

Song Yu walked over to the bedside, just as he was about to reach out and touch him, when he suddenly noticed a circular pattern appearing on the back of his own hand, shimmering with a flowing golden radiance.

He furrowed his brow. To be precise, this wasn't an ordinary design, but rather something akin to... petals... spreading outward layer by layer.

Song Yu froze. Just as he wanted to raise his hand to examine it closely, his peripheral vision caught sight of flowing golden patterns on the back of the sleeping youth's neck as well. The youth was sleeping soundly, his cheeks flushed with a faint, damp warmth.

What on earth is this?

The exact same pattern.

Not wanting to wake the "person" on the bed, Song Yu immediately took out his phone and contacted the red-crowned crane. The other party replied promptly, though the questions were rather cryptic:

[A pattern? Let me see. Take a picture.]

Song Yu did as instructed.

[How is 247's condition?]

[He's sleeping.]

The phone screen displayed "Typing...", as if the sender kept typing and deleting. After a brief pause, a reply finally came through:

[Touch his forehead and see if it's hot.]

Song Yu was taken aback. He laid his phone aside, leaned in slightly, and whispered softly:

"Linlin?"

He wasn't trying to wake him, but merely letting the "person" subconsciously know who had approached.

The "young man" tilted his cheek. Sensing the cool touch of fingers against his forehead, he instinctively lifted his chin slightly, lips parted just a fraction as he breathed out.

Song Yu tested his temperature. With a gentle expression in his eyes, he prepared to withdraw his hand, but right at that moment, the "young man" grabbed his fingers and naturally buried his face right into his palm.

Damp warmth...

Soft, tender lips brushed past.

Song Yu's mind went blank for a second or two, right until his phone vibrated with another incoming message:

[Has his body temperature risen?]

Only then did Song Yu snap back to reality, typing with one hand:

[It has risen somewhat.]

The other side replied immediately:

[What about you?]

Song Yu didn't quite understand. He simply raised a hand to tug at his shirt collar, and just as he began to type, another message popped up:

[Cough cough, let me explain two things. First, that pattern is the mark of the blood pact you signed back then; it's a special gift from the fox spirit... It will accelerate the circulation of spirit power.]

[As for that business about cultivation... didn't 247 cultivate with you yet? Never mind, skip that. Second, if it's glowing, it actually... well, it means...]

The message cut off before it was finished.

Song Yu frowned. He felt a wave of worry; after all, his little bird had run a fever before... It must have been very uncomfortable for him.

However, just as he was about to raise a hand to type a reply, the chat interface once again showed "Typing..." at the top, appearing and disappearing as if the sender were deeply conflicted.

"..."

Song Yu watched for a moment, deciding he should ask again anyway. Right at that instant, the red-crowned crane replied:

[247 is about to go into rut.]

-

A heavy silence enveloped the bedroom.

Song Yu's body temperature shot up as well. He froze for a moment, then hastily jerked his gaze away from the phone and drew a deep breath.

Messages kept popping up incessantly on the screen:

[Spirits aren't like humans, who are active all four seasons... We have regular rutting seasons. Cough cough, since 247 has only just reached adulthood, its self-control isn't very strong. Logically speaking, it's supposed to be able to regulate itself.]

[But it's leaving for the capital in a few days, and there's no time to teach it now.]

[I sent it a manual, you guys read it, right?]

[247 might be a bit shy...]

Song Yu closed his eyes and looked back at his phone. Glancing over those messages, the veins on the back of his hand bulged slightly. He stood up, preparing to leave.

The "person" on the bed was stirred awake by the movement. Grasping Song Yu's wrist, he let out a displeased "Mm," though his eyelids still didn't lift.

Song Yu had no choice but to brace himself on the bed and look down. With the heat lingering on his eyelids, he spoke in a soothing tone:

"I'm not leaving."

"It's fine..."

Still half-asleep, Bai Linlin simply leaned back against the back of that hand and drifted off again, pressing his cheek right against it to cool down.

His heart was an absolute mess of tangled thoughts.

-

In truth, the red-crowned crane spent the entire rest of the night imparting its experience:

chunks.chineseText:
[但你也不要太担心，它只是有点反应，并不会说突然那什么，247刚成年，在那方面就是个雏鸟。]

[这是有阶段的……现在可能也就是想要拥抱之类的……]

丹顶鹤发完这个消息，话锋一转：

[你也是个‘雏鸟’吧？]

宋郁崩溃，在卧室里打下了一个字：

[是。]

丹顶鹤点头，很是满意地道：

[那我给你们的手册是很有用的，记得去看。]

[现在毕竟时间不够，你注意观察，及时和我联系就行，反正它等级升得太快，妖力蓬勃，也是需要散一散的……]

丹顶鹤在管理局里来回踱步的，也是有些紧张兮兮的，毕竟现在还没有双修……只有真正的“压住”，这才算彻底套牢了。

不行不行。

它还是得当面和247聊聊。

[我还是不放心，这样，你明天带它过来。]

丹顶鹤优雅打字，收了收翅膀。

-

翌日。

白粼粼醒过来的时候还有点懵懵的，睁开眼就发现宋郁在给他穿袜子，他一时半会其实是反应不过来的。

他芯子是人不错，但是当鸟太习惯了，还以为是在戴脚环，很自然地又伸了伸自己的人腿。

宋郁单手扣住那个脚踝，面不红心不跳地问：

“睡得好么？”

白粼粼听到这道声音才回了回神，仿佛一下子有了灵智一样，开始往外抽自己的小腿，但是没弄开。

“……放开呀。”

“少年”面色有些泛红，手指攥着床单，最后就生气了。

“宋郁！”

白粼粼使出了自己的终极绝招，砰得一下化成小鸟，圆滚滚地站在面前人的手指上，爪子被捏着的那种。

金鸡独立.jpg

宋郁：“……”

“好，我错了。”

圆滚滚的鸟矜持地抽出来了自己的爪子，扑棱翅膀就要下地，但是被反手握住了，放到了人的肩头。

白粼粼：！

宋郁已经从善如流地去浴室了，很平和地说了晚上要去管理局一趟的事，被问及原因也只是面不改色地道：

“可能是进京的事。”

白粼粼了然，然后就化形成了“少年”模样，站在旁边看着宋郁。

一秒，两秒。

“怎么了？”

人微微压着呼吸，轻声问。

白粼粼只是不解地道：

“都是我先洗漱的。”

“……”

鸟本位思考模式。

-

大约在晚上两点三十五分，车子抵达了熟悉的巷子口，白粼粼在副驾上睡着了，因为拥抱的约定，导致他现在化人形的时间都比较多了……

“粼粼？”

白粼粼闻言蹙了蹙眉，不知道怎么了，总是有些腰酸……他隐约感觉人在替他解安全带，迷迷糊糊地睁开了眼睛。

抬手抱住了。

敷衍一下。

宋郁抬手按住了“少年”的肩胛骨，抬手把那个安全带的卡扣弄开，什么想法也没有了，只是轻声问：

“还困吗？”

“嗯。”

白粼粼抬手抵住那个肩头，要推开，但是不知道怎么了，使了两下力才推开，后面才下车了。

“拜拜。”

宋郁垂眸看着“人”，压根就没有看他，不过还是温和地道：

“我在外面等你。”

……

管理局内。

丹顶鹤早已恭候多时，见到那只圆滚滚的蓝羽小鸟立马就挥了下翅膀，有道金线腾空就飞了过去，结结实实地拍了下到处说闲话的鸟头。

白粼粼懵懵的，转头看了过来，才啪嗒啪嗒地往这边走。

顺带把挎包摘了下来，递给了旁边的鼠鼠。

“001呢？”

白粼粼又没有找到，其实是有点郁闷的，但前面的丹顶鹤只是悠悠地道：

“它出差了，回来估计就是双S了。”

鸟震惊。

鸟一个加速往前走。

“什么时候的事？我怎么不知道？”

丹顶鹤收了收翅膀，很是闲庭散步地走着，解释道：

“任务很急，上面调走的。”

“手机都收了的。”

白粼粼仰着鸟头，甚至都还短暂地停了脚步，这么厉害……

“赶紧过来。”

鸟啪嗒啪嗒地跟了上去。

办公室。

白粼粼其实是有点惆怅的，它本来是打算带着001一起去京市的，还可以旅旅游，多好啊……

不过对方回来就是双S了？

鸟一个爪子斜着，一个爪子直着，认真思考。

他觉得还是001的比较好，出去接任务……一看就比在办公室里处理文件要帅……

鸟羡慕，鸟不说。

“正好你问起来001了，它倒是给你留了个东西。”

丹顶鹤走到了书桌那里，抽出来了一本笔记，放到了桌上，又道：

“我看了，全部都是些基础的术法，你可以学一学。”

“通俗易懂的。”

白粼粼感动，扑棱翅膀飞了上来，用爪子掀开了一页。

全是“简笔画”，各种各样的小鸟pose，伸翅根，打坐，转圈……

“……”

确实通俗易懂。

白粼粼调动妖力收了起来，然后认认真真地仰头看向丹顶鹤，对方还在讲：

“……还有另外一件事。”

“关于你和你监护人的血契。”

-

大抵是把那天的事情讲清楚了，但丹顶鹤也是听取了监护人的建议，略去了监护人在场的事。

“所以，你最好是把双修手册带上。”

“争取就在这次出差的时候，拿下。”

白粼粼红温了。

他爪子都开始抠地，不过被一道金线给提了起来，稳当当地落到了一个杯垫上。

“……但是，我应该能控制住的吧？”

鸟不死心地仰头道。

丹顶鹤闻言有些困惑：

“你控制干什么？这不是千载难逢的好机会？凡事都可以推到‘发情期’上，你那监护人奈何不了你的。”

“我就是……咳咳。”

“总之，把握好机会。”

白粼粼其实是想说他只是想让宋郁长生……没有那个意思。

鸟觉得被误会了。

鸟爪子抠了抠杯垫，成功搞出来一对窟窿。

白粼粼深呼吸一口气，仰头把自己的想法全说出来了。

办公室里安安静静的。

一秒，两秒。

丹顶鹤只是问：

“你还搞上了人类的柏拉图？”

白粼粼：“……”

“也就是说，前些日子和我说‘殉情’的不是你？”

鸟翅根夹紧了。

“你的监护人签血契的时候你是不在场？”

鸟拘谨。

“你这么搞，你监护人知道吗？”

鸟开始歪头梳理羽毛。

丹顶鹤在房间里踱步了一会，还是很不理解，甚至自顾自地道：

“一个还是个幼鸟的时候，跑来和我说想要监护人长生，甚至不行的话，还要一起死。”

“一个则是孤身一人来管理局登记，在那道士的面前始终坚定地维护某只小妖……还签了血契，除非他死了，否则是无法违背的。”

“噢……”

丹顶鹤转头看了过来，认认真真地道：

“一妖一人，原来是纯正友谊？”
chunks.englishText:
[But don't worry too much. It's just reacting a bit; it's not like it's going to suddenly... you know. 247 just came of age, and it's still a fledgling in that regard.]

[There are stages to this... Right now, it probably just wants hugs and things like that...]

After sending this message, the red-crowned crane changed the subject:

[You're also a 'fledgling' yourself, aren't you?]

Song Yu felt a mental breakdown coming on. He typed a single character in his bedroom:

[Yes.]

The red-crowned crane nodded, looking quite satisfied as it replied:

[Then the manual I gave you is going to be very useful. Make sure to read it.]

[Since time is running short now, just pay attention and keep in touch with me. Besides, its rank is rising too fast, and with its demonic power surging so vigorously, it needs some release anyway...]

Pacing back and forth within the Administration, the crane was also feeling rather nervous. After all, they hadn't undergone dual cultivation yet... Only by truly "suppressing" him would he be completely and securely locked down.

No, this won't do.

It still needed to talk to 247 in person.

[I'm still uneasy. How about this, bring him over tomorrow.]

The red-crowned crane typed with elegance, tucking its wings back.

-

The next day.

When Bai Linlin woke up, he was still somewhat dazed. The moment he opened his eyes, he found Song Yu putting a sock on his foot, and for a brief moment, he simply couldn't process it.

Though his soul was human, he was far too used to being a bird, instinctively assuming he was having a leg ring put on, and naturally stretched out his human leg further.

Song Yu cupped that ankle with one hand, his face neither red nor breathless as he asked:

"Did you sleep well?"

Only upon hearing this voice did Bai Linlin snap back to reality. As if intelligence had suddenly flooded back into him, he began to pull his calf back, but couldn't wrench it free.

"...Let go."

The "youth" flush-faced, fingers clenching the bedsheet, finally grew angry.

"Song Yu!"

Bai Linlin unleashed his ultimate secret weapon: with a *poof*, he transformed into a little bird, standing round and plump right on the person's finger, held firmly by the ankle.

*Single-legged Golden Rooster Standing.jpg*

Song Yu: "..."

"Alright, my bad."

The round, plump bird reservedly withdrew its claw, flapped its wings to get down to the floor, but was grabbed by the backhand and placed right onto the person's shoulder.

Bai Linlin: !

Song Yu had already smoothly made his way to the bathroom, saying quite calmly that he needed to make a trip to the Administration tonight. When asked for the reason, he simply replied without changing his expression:

"It's probably about the trip to the capital."

Bai Linlin understood, then transformed back into his "youth" form, standing to the side and watching Song Yu.

One second, two seconds.

"What is it?"

The person slightly lowered his breathing, asking softly.

Bai Linlin just looked at him in bafflement, saying:

"I always wash up first."

"..."

Bird-logic thinking mode.

-

At around 2:35 AM, the car arrived at the familiar alley entrance. Bai Linlin had fallen asleep in the passenger seat; because of the hugging agreement, he spent much more time in his human form these days...

"Linlin?"

Bai Linlin frowned slightly at the call, wondering what was wrong—his lower back always felt a bit sore lately... He vaguely sensed someone unbuckling his seatbelt, and drowsily opened his eyes.

He raised his hands for a hug.

Just to go through the motions.

Song Yu raised a hand to press against the "youth's" shoulder blades, unclipping the seatbelt buckle. All other thoughts vanished, and he simply asked softly:

"Still sleepy?"

"Mm."

Bai Linlin raised a hand to press against that shoulder, trying to push him away, but for some reason, it took him two tries of actual effort before he managed it, finally getting out of the car.

"Bye-bye."

Song Yu lowered his gaze to look at the "person," not meeting his eyes at all, yet still speaking with gentle warmth:

"I'll wait for you outside."

...

Inside the Administration.

The red-crowned crane had been waiting for a long time. The moment it saw that round, plump blue-feathered bird, it immediately flicked its wings. A thread of golden light shot through the air and gave a solid smack right to the bird head of the one who loved spreading gossip everywhere.

Bai Linlin, dazed, turned his head to look before clacking his way over.

Along the way, he took off his crossbody bag and handed it to the little mouse standing nearby.

"Where's 001?"

Failing to find 001, Bai Linlin actually felt a bit gloomy, but the red-crowned crane ahead of him just said leisurely:

"It went on a business trip. When it comes back, it'll probably be double-S rank."

The bird was shocked.

The bird accelerated its pace forward.

"When did this happen? How come I didn't know?"

The red-crowned crane tucked its wings back, strolling as if taking a leisurely walk in the park, and explained:

"The mission is urgent; it was transferred from above."

"Even its phone was confiscated."

Bai Linlin tilted his bird head upward, even pausing his steps briefly. So amazing...

"Hurry up and come over."

The bird clacked its way to catch up.

The office.

Bai Linlin was actually feeling a bit melancholic. He had originally planned to take 001 along with him to Beijing so they could do some sightseeing—how wonderful that would have been...

Still, the other guy would be double-S rank when it came back?

The bird kept one claw tilted sideways and one claw straight, thinking earnestly.

He felt that 001's life was much better. Going out on missions... just from the look of it, that was much cooler than processing paperwork in an office...

The bird felt envy, but the bird kept it to itself.

"Since you asked about 001 just now, it actually left something for you."

The red-crowned crane walked over to the desk, pulled out a notebook, placed it on the surface, and added:

"I took a look. It's all foundational spellcraft; you can study them."

"Very straightforward and easy to understand."

Bai Linlin was touched. He fluttered his wings to fly up and flipped open a page with his claw.

It was full of "stick figure drawings" showing various little bird poses: stretching wing roots, meditating, spinning in circles...

"..."

Indeed, straightforward and easy to understand.

Bai Linlin mobilized his demonic power to pack it away, then earnestly tilted his head up to look at the red-crowned crane, who continued speaking:

"There is one more matter."

"Concerning the blood pact between you and your guardian."

-

Essentially, it explained the events of that day, though the red-crowned crane took the guardian's suggestion and omitted the fact that the guardian had been present.

"Therefore, you'd best bring the dual cultivation manual with you."

"Strive to seal the deal during this business trip."

Bai Linlin turned bright red.

His claws even began scratching instinctively at the floor, but a thread of golden light hoisted him up, landing him steadily upon a coaster.

"...However, I should be able to exercise restraint, right?"

The bird asked stubbornly, tilting its head up.

Upon hearing this, the red-crowned crane looked somewhat perplexed:

"Why on earth would you want to restrain yourself? Isn't this a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity? You can pin everything on your 'rut period'; your guardian won't be able to do a thing to you."

"It's just that... *cough cough*."

"In short, seize the opportunity."

Actually, Bai Linlin wanted to say that he only wanted Song Yu to attain longevity... he didn't have *that* kind of intention.

The bird felt terribly misunderstood.

The bird's claws scratched at the coaster, successfully gouging out a pair of holes.

Bai Linlin took a deep breath, tilted his head up, and poured out all his thoughts.

The office fell into a dead silence.

One second, two seconds.

The red-crowned crane simply asked:

"Are you trying to have a Platonic human relationship now?"

Bai Linlin: "..."

"In other words, you weren't the one who talked to me about 'dying for love' the other day?"

The bird clamped its wing roots tight.

"You weren't present when your guardian signed the blood pact?"

The bird grew stiff and cautious.

"If you pull this kind of stunt, does your guardian even know?"

The bird began tilting its head to preen its feathers.

The red-crowned crane paced around the room for a moment, still finding it utterly incomprehensible, and muttered to itself:

"One of them ran over to me when he was still just a fledgling, saying he wanted his guardian to attain longevity, and if that didn't work out, they'd die together."

"The other came to the Administration all alone to register, standing firm before that Daoist priest to protect a certain little demon... and even signed a blood pact that cannot be broken unless he dies."

"Oh..."

The red-crowned crane turned its head over and said with utter earnestness:

"A demon and a human... turned out to be pure, innocent friends?"

chunks.chineseText:
“001上次帮你检测妖力波动……是废了好大功夫，说你和你的监护人天天睡一起……”

白粼粼彻底绷不住了，立马扑棱翅膀就要飞走，但是被一条金线稳稳地拦住了，在桌子上滚了滚，成个毛球模样。

“行了。”

丹顶鹤很是怒其不争的，心想这247整天在管理局大摇大摆的，在和监护人的相处上倒是畏手畏脚。

“反正这次是个好时机。”

“你自己看着办，对了，我给你的双修手册你到底看了没有，我给了你最新的一本。”

白粼粼闻言愣了下，仰着鸟头看了过来，心想什么新的一本？

丹顶鹤还在说：

“原来觉得你小，毕竟还没成年，给你的是删减版的，主要都是人类身体构造的事情，毕竟双修都是人形的……”

白粼粼还在低着鸟头，到处思考什么新的一本？

直到——

“但是这次我给你的是成年版的，附带了图的，就前段时间，放在那木箱子里了。”

“你看了没啊？”

白粼粼只是浑身一震，坏了，今天宋郁去收拾储藏室的东西了。

啊！

-

不到三点，围墙那里就出来一个背着挎包啪嗒啪嗒狂走的小鸟，宋郁看到后就开了车门。

“粼粼？”

鸟扑棱翅膀飞了上来，只是仰着头看过来，想要问什么，但是——

“怎么了？”

宋郁神色仍旧温和。

白粼粼还是很着急，他到底看了没有，看了没有？

这对他很重要！

副驾驶的小鸟化成了少年模样，最终还是直接问了，脸颊都泛起来些红晕，他还是存不下心事。

“手册么？我没有见过。”

白粼粼长舒一口气，还好还好，一切都还来得及。

宋郁始终是垂着眼眸看“人”的，观察着细微的表情，轻声道：

“是很重要的东西么？”

“少年”面颊都是红的，还喘着气，只是仰头看了过来，眼睛圆圆的，摇头。

“不重要。”

“这样啊。”

宋郁很温和地笑了下。

-

大约过了几天，一人一鸟终于要出门了，客厅里很是热热闹闹的。

阿姨其实不太知道具体的情况，只是又提着一袋子小衣服过来了，顺带拿着一包旺仔小馒头。

“小鸟要出远门呐？”

“快来看看阿姨给你做的小衣服。”

白粼粼正在伸爪子品鉴小馒头，闻言就扑棱翅膀飞了过来，仰着鸟头看阿姨。

“啾啾！”

“哎。”

阿姨只是打开了一个小手提箱，里面放着好几层小衣服，光是针织的围兜就有十多个，纯色的、渐变的、卡通图案的……应有尽有。

宋峥国从楼上下来了，见到后也是夸赞，妇人也是有些不好意思，说了句：

“我也就会这点巧活……”

白粼粼圆滚滚的，在餐桌上啪嗒啪嗒地走着，闻言很自然地用鸟头去拱阿姨的手指。

“鸟儿很喜欢你的。”

阿姨也是心里满满的，抬手轻轻地摸了摸小鸟的脑袋。

楼下一片和谐。

直到——

“粼粼。”

鸟立马站直了。

宋郁刚去楼上拿东西了，此刻正在楼梯扶手这里，面色偏冷，语调没什么起伏。

他抬步走了过来，伸出来了手指，白粼粼从善如流地上来了。

稳当当地站在了人的肩头。

宋郁一下子就好了，转而开始同阿姨说了一些事情，主要是家里只有爷爷一个人，不用做太多饭菜之类的。

另外就是谢谢这些小衣服。

“爷爷，那我们先走了。”

宋峥国只是背着手，见状点了点头，不过还是嘱咐了下：

“照顾好鸟儿。”

“我会的。”

-

一人一鸟终于开始了二人之旅。

白粼粼其实后面反思了下，不知道自己为什么心虚，不就是拱了下……

？

难道是因为宋郁当时不在。

为什么有种被捉奸的感觉。

“……”

不过后面他就没空想这个事了，因为车程很长，白粼粼不由得就困了。

要么是挂在宋郁的衣襟上睡，要么是化形成“人”躺在后座上。

身体热热的。

睡得也很沉。

直到中途停了下来。

白粼粼感觉被捞了起来，他攀附着那个手臂，眼皮都掀不开，坐车太长时间了……

“要不要去看海？”

！

白粼粼又精神起来了，其实是中途在一个沿海城市停了，宋郁本来打算的就是这样，沿途带着他的小鸟逛一逛。

没有001。

鸟站在了人的肩头，羽毛蓬松，感受着海风阵阵的吹拂，有种前所未有的自由感。

白粼粼不由得感怀了起来。

海的那边是什么？

但就在这时——

“卖烤肠了，三块钱一个，五块钱……”

鸟获得了随机烤肠礼包。

不再感怀了。

-

大约休整了一天，之后才抵达了京市，宋郁这次就顺利很多，不到一个小时，他们就到了房间。

这是一个套房，像是那种公寓，不仅有阳台、客厅、主卧……还有个小厨房。

总之应有尽有的。

白粼粼就在套房的卧室里复习，趴在床上，小腿在上面晃着，“少年”用手撑着下巴，看着丹顶鹤给他带的复习资料。

“粼粼？”

宋郁其实在收拾那些衣服，抬步走了过来，面色平和。

“嗯嗯。”

很敷衍了。

宋郁抬手握住了那个脚踝，垂眸耐心地给套上了袜子。

“不要看太晚。”

白粼粼在床上翻了个身子，完全忘记挣开了，只是在走神，喃喃地道：

“中央的管理局……会不会很吓人？”

宋郁微微蹙了下眉，刚想要安抚，但是床上的“少年”此刻已经砰得一下化成了圆滚滚的小鸟，此刻正啪嗒啪嗒地走过来。

仰着鸟头道：

“我们一起去。”

是陈述句。

“好。”

-

中央管理局处于景阳大街的广场，至少地址是这么写的。

宋郁带着他的小鸟抵达了目的地，环顾了下四周，其实没有看见确切的入口。

白粼粼今天还特地装扮了一下，穿着一个浅蓝色的防晒小披风，爪子上套着同色系的超轻脚环。

很是靓丽。

广场上的人有不少来夸鸟的。

白粼粼挺胸抬头的。

终于在正午十二点的时候，广场上的人变得很少，周遭安安静静的。

宋郁本来是要侧眸问问他的小鸟具体位置的，但就在这时，面前似乎多了一道水波纹的“墙”。

全部是透明的。

但在一点点地逼近……

-

里面是完全不同的景象，“人”来“人”往的，几乎像是到了另外一个平行世界，大厅的规模是南市管理局的十倍不止，比外面的广场还大……

宋郁站在原地，他肩头的小鸟也是很恍惚，环顾了下四周。

他们似乎站在一个“出入口”，有不少“人”直接往这边走，面色匆匆的，不过在看到旁边的人类的时候，还是眯了眯眼。

也就那么一瞬。

而后就离开了。

宋郁完全辨别不了人和妖了……
